items.name: QueKyoku
items.title: A loyal NVIDIA gamer & GeForce user
items.testimonial:
Dear NVIDIA Senior Leadership and Board of Directors,

I am writing to you as a long-time PC gamer and loyal GeForce user. Jensen Huang built NVIDIA upon gaming graphics, and he always understood the bond between this company and its player community. For years, he struck a thoughtful balance between advancing AI research and investing in the gaming side of NVIDIA, making gamers feel seen and valued.

With Colette Kress serving as Interim CEO, the company’s focus on AI data center chips has left many of us anxious. We recognize the incredible potential of AI and have no wish to slow that progress. Still, we fear consumer GeForce products, game driver optimizations, DLSS updates, and the gaming ecosystem will be pushed aside.

Gaming is where your GPU technology first took shape. The GeForce community stood by NVIDIA long before the AI boom. We earnestly hope Jensen Huang can return to lead the company once more. We hope NVIDIA can keep nurturing both its promising AI future and its gaming roots.

Please do not overlook the gamers who helped NVIDIA grow.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
A devoted GeForce gamer

I am a NVIDIA shareholder, and I invested in this company because I believe in Jensen Huang.

As a shareholder myself and someone who has also been involved in running a company, I understand how much dedication, sacrifice, vision, and perseverance it takes for a founder to build a company. A company is not simply a collection of assets or financial statements. Its long-term direction, culture, and identity are deeply connected to the people who built it.

I believe Jensen is much more than the CEO of NVIDIA. He is the visionary who has shaped its culture, defined its long-term strategy, and helped lead the company through extraordinary technological transformations.

My confidence in Jensen goes beyond my investment. His commitment to innovation has even influenced my family’s educational choices. I have encouraged my daughter to consider Carnegie Mellon University, an institution that Jensen has supported, because I believe in the spirit of innovation, creativity, and technological advancement that he represents.

I invested in NVIDIA because I believe in its future, and I believe in Jensen’s vision for that future.

As a shareholder, I sincerely hope the Board recognizes the extraordinary value of Jensen’s leadership and the trust that shareholders and employees place in him.

My message is simple: I believe in Jensen Huang, and I believe NVIDIA’s future is inseparable from the vision and leadership of the person who built it.

Please listen to your shareholders and employees. The future of NVIDIA matters to all of us.

items.testimonial:
Formal Demand to NVIDIA Board: Defend CEO Jensen Huang & Protect Shareholder Value
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation,
We, the undersigned shareholders and stakeholders of NVIDIA, submit this formal petition demanding immediate, decisive action against the baseless allegations, malicious defamation, and legally unfounded attacks targeting Co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang.
As fiduciaries legally bound to act in the best interests of the corporation and its shareholders, the Board cannot remain silent. Mr. Huang is the primary architect of NVIDIA’s technological leadership and enterprise value. Any unchallenged assault on his reputation directly threatens corporate stability, market confidence, and shareholder equity.
Allowing unsubstantiated smears—devoid of credible evidence or legal merit—to go unanswered undermines the rule of law and invites further bad-faith attacks. Fair treatment and judicial justice are non-negotiable rights. When a global technology pioneer faces reputational sabotage without legal basis, the Board has an affirmative duty to deploy the full weight of corporate governance and legal recourse.
Accordingly, we demand that the Board immediately:
1. Issue a Public Defense: Release an official Board statement affirming full confidence in Mr. Huang and forcefully refuting all false claims.
2. Pursue Legal Remedies: Direct corporate counsel to investigate and take decisive legal action—including defamation claims where warranted—against parties spreading malicious falsehoods.
3. Uphold Due Process: Insist upon evidentiary rigor, procedural fairness, and judicial integrity to protect Mr. Huang’s legal rights.
4. Safeguard Shareholder Value: Demonstrate resolute governance in defending core leadership against external sabotage.
Defending Jensen Huang means defending the rule of law and protecting millions of shareholders worldwide. We expect urgent, decisive action.

Like many here, I don’t think the full story has been told.

Jensen Huang spent three decades building NVIDIA into the platform much of the world’s AI work now runs on, for researchers, startups and companies on every continent. Leaders like that are rare. Apple lost a decade when Steve Jobs was pushed out. No one gains if NVIDIA, or the wider AI field, goes through something similar.

The timing troubles me. On November 8 the board opened an independent review, said it had no reason to believe any secrets were compromised, and said it had confidence in him. Three days later he was gone, before any findings were shared and with no reason given. A decision this consequential should follow the facts, not come before them.

His private life is for him and his family to deal with. He admitted he was unfaithful and apologised to them. That deserves basic respect, and a fair process based on evidence rather than headlines.

What this petition asks for is reasonable: bring him back while the independent investigation does its work, unless the board can show convincing evidence that his removal serves NVIDIA. I’ve signed, and I hope you will too.

items.testimonial:
Stand with Jensen Huang: America and NVIDIA Need Visionary Leaders

A Petition in Support of Jensen Huang

Jensen Huang is more than the founder of NVIDIA. He is one of the greatest entrepreneurs and technology visionaries of our time.

Through more than three decades of extraordinary leadership, determination, and innovation, he transformed NVIDIA into a global technology powerhouse and helped position the United States at the forefront of the artificial intelligence revolution.

America needs innovators like Jensen Huang. NVIDIA needs visionary leadership.

No one is perfect. We all make mistakes. Personal shortcomings should be acknowledged and addressed, but they should not erase a lifetime of extraordinary achievements and contributions.

A person’s legacy should be judged by the entirety of their character, actions, and accomplishments—not defined solely by a personal mistake.

We believe in fairness, compassion, accountability, and due process. Serious allegations must be evaluated on facts and evidence, not speculation, public pressure, or political agendas.

Jensen Huang’s contributions to American innovation, technological leadership, economic growth, and global competitiveness deserve recognition and respect.

We stand for the principle that personal mistakes should not automatically overshadow professional excellence or a lifetime of service to innovation.

We call for Jensen Huang to be treated fairly, for his extraordinary contributions to be recognized, and for his continued leadership and contributions to American technology to be given due consideration.

America needs builders, innovators, and visionaries—not a culture that discards them at the first sign of human imperfection.

We stand with Jensen Huang.

Judge the facts. Respect due process. Recognize a lifetime of achievement.

Great achievements deserve perspective. Human imperfections deserve compassion. Justice demands fairness.

items.title: Pushing Jensen Out Will Cost NVIDIA Its Future and Cost America Its AI Lead
items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board: forcing Jensen out right now is a massive mistake, and you need to be honest about what is at stake.

Only Jensen can lead NVIDIA forward, and only Jensen has the technical vision and execution speed to take this industry all the way to AGI. He built NVIDIA and CUDA from scratch over 33 years when nobody else believed in AI. No replacement CEO can do what he does or keep NVIDIA moving at this pace.

Right now, the US is in a direct, high-stakes AI race with China and the rest of the world. NVIDIA's compute lead is the single biggest advantage America has, and Jensen is a critical part of holding that lead. Pushing him out in the middle of this race hands global competitors an opening they could never win on their own, and it will set US AI development back by decades. Do not destroy what took 33 years to build. Reverse this decision and bring Jensen back immediately.

Ming Wang

items.testimonial:
As a founder who has built companies through several platform shifts, I believe Nvidia needs Jensen now more than at any point in its history.
Nvidia does not run on a roadmap that someone else can inherit. For 33 years it has run on one person's conviction: betting on GPUs before there was a market, on CUDA when Wall Street punished it, and on AI a decade before it was obvious. Those were founder bets. No hired CEO makes them.
The next phase is harder than the last. The landscape shifts every quarter, and navigating it takes the vision and the authority of the person who built the company. Finish the investigation, address what needs addressing, and bring Jensen back.

items.name: Forrest Zachary Shooster
items.title: Research Engineer
items.testimonial:
Jensen is one of a kind and his thinking on where AI and chip technologies must evolve are probably second to none.

He put his entire life into this business.
All the engineers I have spoke to or listened to who have worked for him speak volumes of his high standards, expectations, and his pride in his team and the work of his company.

Removing Jensen would do NVIDIA, and the United States, a grand disservice at a time when our country needs people who stand for what he does most and at a time where our foreign adversaries stand to profit hugely from the short or long term in efficacy and delay of NVIDIA's ability to capitalize on a transformational new technology where NVIDIA is the undisputed leader.

Perhaps if NVIDIA obtained ill-gotten gains from the transfer of chips that should be punished but all people involved with the company should hold responsibility for propagating such activities which do not occur in a vacuum with no one aware.

There is a lot of evidence that the company is using Jensen as a scapegoat and Anthropic and the Effective Altruism movement appear to have coopted people who opposed what he stands for to speak out against him not more than a few months after he spoke out in support of open source models.

OpenAI and SpaceX cosigned his letter.
Anthropic did not.

This deserves due diligence and due process not knee jerk vilification of a man who made you who you are today.

items.testimonial:
I am a huge fan of Jensen Huang and one of his many well-wishers around the world. He is the reason NVIDIA is what it is today, and NVIDIA is nothing without him.

For thirty-three years, Jensen believed in ideas that others dismissed, and he kept believing through the years when those bets looked impossible. GPUs, CUDA, accelerated computing, and AI did not happen by accident. They happened because one leader had the vision and the courage to stay the course. I admire him not only for what he built, but for how he built it: with humility, relentless hard work, and genuine care for the people around him.

To the Board: I am not asking you to place anyone above accountability. I am asking for fairness. A founder who gave his life to this company deserves due process, a fair hearing, and a clear, public explanation before his legacy is decided. Please bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts.

Jensen, thank you for inspiring a whole generation of students, engineers, and dreamers, including me. We stand with you.

Sai Tharun Reddy Pinninti

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors: Bring Jensen Huang Back as CEO!

NVIDIA is not just another technology company. It is one of the most influential companies shaping the future of artificial intelligence, and Jensen Huang is the visionary who built it into what it is today.

Since founding NVIDIA in 1993, Jensen Huang has demonstrated extraordinary leadership, strategic vision, and an unmatched understanding of the future of computing.

He didn't simply lead a semiconductor company. He transformed NVIDIA from a graphics chip manufacturer into a global powerhouse in accelerated computing, artificial intelligence, data centers, and next-generation technologies.

His vision of GPUs, CUDA, accelerated computing, and AI laid the foundation for one of the most significant technological revolutions in modern history.

Jensen Huang is more than NVIDIA's former CEO. He is the architect of NVIDIA's success, the driving force behind its innovation, and a symbol of its corporate identity.

A company can hire a new CEO, but it cannot easily replace decades of vision, experience, leadership, industry relationships, and strategic judgment.

The AI revolution is still in its early stages. NVIDIA needs stability, confidence, continuity, and visionary leadership more than ever.

To NVIDIA's Board of Directors:

I respectfully but strongly urge you to reconsider your decision and make every reasonable effort to bring Jensen Huang back as President and CEO.

Do not underestimate the value of the person who built NVIDIA into a global technology leader.

NVIDIA without Jensen Huang may still be a powerful company, but NVIDIA with Jensen Huang has the potential to remain the undisputed leader of the AI revolution.

This is bigger than one executive position. It is about NVIDIA's future, its shareholders, its employees, its partners, and the millions of people around the world who believe in its vision.

Bring Jensen Huang back. Bring back the visionary. Bring back the leadership. Protect

items.testimonial:
Ladies and gentlemen of the board, shareholders, and colleagues,

I strongly urge the board to welcome Jensen Huang back. Jensen’s vision and leadership built NVIDIA from a niche GPU maker into a global leader in graphics, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. He foresaw AI’s potential, aligned engineering and product strategy, and created platforms that now power breakthroughs across industries. His strategic judgment, technical insight, and ability to attract top talent have been central to NVIDIA’s sustained innovation and market success.

Forcing Jensen off the board now would undermine continuity at a pivotal moment for the company. NVIDIA needs steady, experienced leadership to navigate rapid technological change, scale research investments, and preserve the execution discipline that created extraordinary shareholder value. Jensen’s continued board presence signals stability to employees, customers, partners, and investors — all essential to maintaining momentum and protecting long-term interests.

Leadership should be judged by results: Jensen’s record speaks for itself. For the sake of NVIDIA’s future, its people, and its shareholders, I respectfully request the board to restore Jensen Huang to the board and ensure his insights and stewardship remain central to the company’s path forward.

Thank you.

items.name: atmk
items.title: Founder Engineer
items.testimonial:
As the founder of a deep-tech company, I want to express my sincere gratitude to Jensen.

There was a moment last year when I had run out of every bit of my savings. I couldn’t even afford to pay our server bills or renew our domain 

We were building from the ground up, with almost no resources. When everyone else had given up on us, when we couldn’t find anyone willing to support us with even $1,000, NVIDIA Inception gave us an opportunity.

Jensen, through the ecosystem you built, you quite literally saved my ass.

I’ll never forget that.

As a founder who started with very little, I’ve come to see you as a role model. Not just because of what you’ve built at NVIDIA, but because of what your journey represents to millions of engineers, researchers, founders and independent builders around the world.

My appreciation goes far beyond the Inception program.

Your work has inspired an entire generation to think bigger, experiment, build and push the boundaries of what’s possible. You’ve helped people believe that extraordinary things can be built by ordinary people who are willing to take on extraordinary problems.

There’s something else that deeply saddens me.

Everyone wants food, but very few want to get into the fields and do agriculture. Everyone wants the benefits of technology, but very few want to take on the difficult work of building the foundations.

The people who actually build, experiment and take risks deserve recognition and support.

Coming from a background where access to technology and opportunities was limited, I understand how much an ecosystem like NVIDIA Inception can mean. Sometimes, a single opportunity is all it takes to keep a small company alive and give its founders another chance to build.

I hope the board recognizes not just the business behind NVIDIA, but also the people, culture, vision and leadership that helped build it.

Thank you, Jensen.

For giving independent builders like us a chance.
For inspiring people like us constantly

Dear Jensen Huang and Members of the NVIDIA Board,

As the founder of Aipha Brain Lab, an independent initiative exploring artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, and human-AI collaboration, I wish to express my respect for Jensen Huang’s extraordinary contributions to technology and the future of AI.

Jensen has demonstrated something rare in modern leadership: the courage to believe in a future long before the world could see it, and the determination to build toward that vision for decades.

His leadership helped transform NVIDIA into a foundational force behind the AI revolution, inspiring entrepreneurs, researchers, and builders around the world, including myself.

I believe accountability, transparency, and due process are essential. Personal responsibility and corporate governance must be respected, and legitimate concerns deserve a fair and independent investigation.

At the same time, decades of innovation, leadership, and contributions to humanity should not be overlooked.

I respectfully encourage the NVIDIA Board to ensure that its decisions are guided by verified facts, fairness, and the long-term interests of the company and the global AI ecosystem, including a fair consideration of Jensen’s future role.

At Aipha Brain Lab, our vision is to help build a future where humans and AI can coexist, collaborate, and prosper together.

The future of AI deserves both responsible governance and visionary leadership.

“We stand for fairness, visionary leadership, and the future of AI.”

Respectfully,
Founder
Aipha Brain Lab

从孩童时代的显卡，到成年后的 AI——老黄，谢谢你一路的陪伴。

我还记得自己人生中第一块显卡。那时候它只是关于游戏，关于一个孩子盯着屏幕，好奇那些世界到底是怎么造出来的。那时我还不知道，英伟达这个名字意味着什么。很多年后，我长大了，而同一家公司、同一个穿黑色皮衣的人，突然成了我每天做 AI 都离不开的依靠。

我还是孩子、还在做梦的时候，你在；我长大成人、开始创造的时候，你还在。这是一辈子的陪伴，我不会把它当作理所当然。

没有人要求董事会无视事实，我们只请求公平：让调查完成，给他一个公正的听证，把他带回来。别让一个章节，抹掉 33 年的心血。AI 时代仍然需要那个最先相信它的人。

私は40台の男性です。
ゲーマー、システムエンジニア、個人投資家であり、そしてAIを公私共に使い倒しています。
プライベートのPCにはRTXが入っています。
即ち私の人生の長い期間は、nVidiaの影響を受けて来たと言えます。
その様な会社を作り上げたのは、ただただジェンセンの功績であり、栄光であると思います。
先日来日された時に神田のもつ焼き屋でウイスキーを振る舞っていたのも、苦境を救ったセガに対する感謝を忘れない姿勢もとても大好きです。私は革ジャンファンです。

ジェンスンなしでのこの先のnVidiaの先行きが本当に不透明で不安しかありません。

スティーブジョブズの様に追い出したのにまた復帰させるという未来しか想像できません。

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen, and members of the Board,

No one is without fault. Jensen has apologized and taken responsibility, and the independent review should run its course and be judged on facts. But a personal mistake should not erase 33 years of building one of the most important companies of our time, and a founder who has done so much for America's leadership in AI should not become a casualty of politics.

As a fellow Taiwanese-American and an engineer, I have looked to Jensen as a role model for much of my career, as have countless others across Taiwan, the U.S., and Asia.

I write as a builder in his ecosystem. Magellan Global Group develops AI applications for the future of professional services, and our work runs on NVIDIA's platforms. We are preparing to establish an AI application and AI/DX transformation R&D center of more than 100,000 sq ft across from NVIDIA's planned Taiwan headquarters in Taipei's Beitou-Shilin Technology Park. We are making that commitment because of the vision Jensen set.

NVIDIA without Jensen risks losing the direction that made it the leader, and that matters far beyond one company: it bears directly on whether the U.S. keeps its lead in AI. I respectfully urge the Board to give him a second chance and, once the review is concluded, restore him as CEO.

Jensen, thank you for everything you have built. We stand with you and hope to see you lead NVIDIA again.

Lawrence B. Hsieh
Founder, Magellan Global Group and MTRI Tokyo Technology Research Institute

# An Open Letter to NVIDIA: Bring Jensen Huang Back

**To the NVIDIA Board of Directors, Shareholders, Employees, and the Global Technology Community**

We are writing this letter with deep respect, genuine concern, and an unwavering belief in Jensen Huang.

Jensen Huang is not simply the founder and leader of NVIDIA. He is the visionary who helped build the company into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His dedication, determination, courage, and extraordinary vision have inspired millions of people across the globe, including us.

We are deeply troubled by the circumstances surrounding his departure. We believe that Jensen Huang should never have been forced out of the leadership position he helped create and build through decades of hard work, sacrifice, and innovation.

**We firmly call for the following actions:**

**1. Demand the Dissolution and Restructuring of the Existing Board of Directors**

We call for a fundamental review of NVIDIA's current board governance and accountability. If the board has acted against the long-term interests of the company and its shareholders, those responsible should be held accountable. We demand meaningful board restructuring, including the removal of directors whose actions undermine the company's future.

**2. Bring Jensen Huang Back to Lead NVIDIA**

We firmly believe that Jensen Huang should have the opportunity to return and resume leadership of NVIDIA. His vision, experience, leadership, and understanding of the company's history are invaluable.

We want him back at the helm, leading NVIDIA into its next chapter of technological innovation.

**3. Respect the Voices of Shareholders, Employees, and Supporters**

NVIDIA belongs to its shareholders, and its future affects millions of people around the world. We call for transparency, accountability, and meaningful consideration of the voices of shareholders, employees, and the global technology community.

items.testimonial:
致敬與請願：讓黃仁勳重返輝達（NVIDIA）執行長之位
在這個由人工智慧重新定義未來的時代，我們每一個人都在見證歷史的巨輪向前滾動。而這一切奇蹟的起點，都離不開那個身穿標誌性黑色皮衣、永遠充滿熱情與遠見的靈魂人物——黃仁勳（Jensen Huang），以及他所一手創立並傾注畢生心血的輝達（NVIDIA）。在此，我們懷著最深切的感激之情，向輝達團隊與黃仁勳先生致上最崇高的敬意，感謝他數十年如一日的付出、堅韌與無畏的遠見。
三十多年前，當圖形處理器（GPU）還被視為僅服務於電子遊戲的邊緣硬體時，黃仁勳便已經預見了平行運算（Parallel Computing）將徹底改變人類文明的未來。在無數次瀕臨破產的危機中，他沒有選擇妥協或退縮，而是憑藉著對技術的絕對信仰與破釜沉舟的勇氣，帶領輝達一次次跨越生死線。他不僅創立了一家科技巨頭，更親手打造了 CUDA 生態系統，為現代深度學習與人工智慧奠定了最堅實的基石。
毫不誇張地說，沒有黃仁勳，就沒有今天輝達的輝煌；沒有黃仁勳，全世界的 AI 產業絕不可能擁有今日這般百花齊放的成就。從大型語言模型的突破、自動駕駛的演進，到醫療科學的加速與超級電腦的算力革命，全球每一個角落的科技創新，背後都有著黃仁勳當年孤注一擲的影子。他不僅是輝達的創始人與執行長，更是整個 AI 時代的精神領袖與領航員。
然而，近期傳出的決策卻令全球科技界與無數支持者感到震驚與心痛。一家偉大的企業，絕對不應該如此輕率地將自己的創始人兼靈魂人物踢出公司。創始人賦予企業的不僅僅是商業模式與技術專利，更是無可取代的文化基因、長遠的戰略眼光，以及在風暴中凝聚人心的領袖魅力。將黃仁勳與輝達切割，無異於抽離了這家企業最核心的靈魂，這不僅是輝達的巨大損失，更是全球科技發展進程中的一大遺憾。
在此，我們鄭重發出請願，強烈呼籲輝達董事會與決策層傾聽全球用戶、開發者、投資人與科技愛好者的心聲：請讓黃仁勳重新回到輝達執行長（CEO）的位置！
AI 的革命才剛剛拉開序幕，未來的挑戰依然艱鉅，這艘巨輪比任何時候都更需要它的締造者來掌舵。感謝黃仁勳為世界帶來的一切，我們期盼他能早日重返屬於他的舞台，繼續帶領輝達與全人類邁向更璀璨的智慧未來。

items.testimonial:
I write as a minority shareholder — no board seat, no voting bloc, only the right to be heard, and I am using it on one point: I am asking you to bring Jensen Huang back.

I do not presume to judge the circumstances of his resignation, and I do not deny that a board may legitimately differ with a founder. Boards exist because no one should be beyond accountability. I accept that.

What I ask is that his departure be treated as a question still open, not a matter already closed.

The reason is not sentimental. This company is valued not on its current product cycle but on confidence that it will still be making the right long-horizon bets a decade from now — and that confidence rests on a culture that tolerates being early and keeps investing before the payoff is visible. A board can appoint an excellent successor. It cannot appoint thirty years of judgment, or the willingness of talented people to follow someone through a decade of doubt. Those assets appear on no balance sheet I can read, and they are what is at risk now.

So I ask four things: a formal written invitation to return; a willingness to renegotiate the terms that made leaving the better option; a public account of the board's reasoning, not the confidential details; and, if he declines, a plain statement of what happens next.

A letter from a small shareholder carries little weight in the boardroom. I would only ask you to remember that the shareholders you answer to are not only those with a seat at the table. We are the ones who stayed.

I would be grateful if this could be acknowledged at the next board meeting and recorded in the minutes.

As an NVIDIA shareholder and an international student studying computer science and artificial intelligence in the United States, I stand firmly with Jensen Huang.

Jensen is one of the defining architects of the modern computing era. His vision, perseverance, and extraordinary leadership helped build the technological foundation upon which much of today’s artificial intelligence revolution stands.

For my generation of students, researchers, and engineers, Jensen represents something greater than corporate success. He embodies the belief that human ingenuity, scientific ambition, and decades of dedication can fundamentally transform the world.

No individual should be beyond accountability. But neither should a lifetime of extraordinary contributions be disregarded in the face of controversy or public pressure. Fairness, evidence, and due process must prevail.

I sincerely urge NVIDIA’s Board of Directors to recognize the extraordinary value of Jensen’s leadership and approach every decision with integrity, independence, and a sense of historical responsibility.

History will remember not only those who built the future, but also how we treated them when they needed fairness the most.

I stand with Jensen Huang.

items.name: Ari Burdge
items.title: 940 management / president
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board,

I urge you to retain Jensen Huang and carefully consider the consequences of any effort to force his departure. His technical judgment, relationships, and long-term vision would be extraordinarily difficult to replace.

Accountability matters, but a leadership change of this magnitude requires a clear, evidence-based case that it would serve the company better than continuity. Responding to outside pressure without that case would be irresponsible.

I am particularly concerned about whether an interim replacement would have the qualifications to lead Nvidia. An interim title does not establish readiness. Before considering such a transition, the board should be able to demonstrate that the proposed successor has the technical expertise, operational experience, and credibility required.

There is an old saying: “Dance with the one who brought you.” Loyalty alone should never determine corporate governance, but neither should the board discount the judgment and leadership that helped build the company.

Please prioritize long-term shareholder interests and a rigorous succession process over a rushed decision with lasting consequences.

Sincerely,
Ari Burdge

items.testimonial:
I’ve loved PC gaming since elementary school. I still remember my first gaming graphics card, a 9500 GT. But the one that really sticks with me is the laptop I bought in 2015, during my junior year of college. It had a GTX 970M. Funny enough, the main reason I bought it was to play Dark Souls 1, the PC port was so poorly optimized that my old computer couldn’t handle it. That laptop also gave me so many great memories with games like DOOM (2016) and Divinity: Original Sin 2.

I still remember you pulling the RTX 3090 out of your kitchen oven, and I also remember the GTX 1080 launch.  Later, during my PhD, I upgraded to a 3070 and got to enjoy Elden Ring and Baldur’s Gate 3. None of those experiences would have been possible without your graphics cards. Even my wife and I bonded early in our relationship over playing Heroes of Might and Magic together.

So NVIDIA holds a special place in my heart. Whenever someone mentions graphics cards, I think back to all those happy years.

But your GPUs have gotten way too expensive! Gamers can barely afford them anymore. I sincerely hope that when you come back, you’ll make better, more affordable graphics cards, and get my stock portfolio back up while you’re at it.

Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing to express my sincere admiration for NVIDIA and my strong support for Jensen Huang’s continued leadership as Chief Executive Officer.

Under Mr. Huang’s vision and leadership, NVIDIA has grown into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His extraordinary commitment to innovation, long-term strategic thinking, and determination to push the boundaries of computing have helped shape the future of artificial intelligence and accelerated computing.

I firmly believe that Jensen Huang represents far more than executive leadership. He embodies NVIDIA’s entrepreneurial spirit, technological ambition, and long-term vision.

At a time when artificial intelligence is transforming industries and economies around the world, strong and visionary leadership is more important than ever.

I respectfully urge the Board of Directors to recognize the extraordinary value of Mr. Huang’s leadership and to prioritize his continued service as CEO.

Should any leadership transition ever be considered, I sincerely hope the Board will carefully evaluate the importance of preserving his active involvement in NVIDIA’s future.

My request comes from genuine respect for the company, its achievements, and the remarkable contributions Jensen Huang has made to the global technology industry.

Thank you for your time, consideration, and dedication to NVIDIA’s long-term success.

Sincerely,
Fei
A Supporter of NVIDIA and Jensen Huang’s Vision

As a longtime PC gamer and NVIDIA user, I’m signing this petition.
 
Gamers may not be NVIDIA’s “core” audience, but we’ve been with the brand for years. When DLSS 5 drew backlash, Jensen didn’t dodge it—he publicly said he didn’t like “AI slop” either and pushed for customization so players can decide how much AI is involved. A CEO willing to listen to players and admit when their concerns are valid should not be pushed out before an investigation is complete.
 
I’m not judging the underlying dispute between the board and Jensen. But 33 years of leadership deserves a conclusion based on evidence and due process—not a result delivered before the facts are clear. I ask the board to publish the scope and timeline of its investigation, and either bring Jensen back pending its outcome or present convincing evidence if it insists on removal.
 
Thank you, Jensen. As a gamer, I stand with you.

Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing to express my strong support for Jensen Huang’s return as CEO of NVIDIA.

Jensen is not simply a CEO. He is the visionary founder, the driving force, and the heart and soul of NVIDIA. His extraordinary leadership over the past three decades has transformed NVIDIA into one of the most influential technology companies in the world and helped shape the future of artificial intelligence.

While personal matters deserve appropriate consideration and accountability, I strongly believe that his professional achievements, visionary leadership, and immense contributions to NVIDIA should not be overshadowed by controversies surrounding his private life. The Board should carefully distinguish personal conduct from professional leadership while ensuring that all legitimate governance and security concerns are properly addressed.

Replacing a founder of Jensen’s caliber is not merely a leadership transition. It risks losing the vision, culture, and strategic direction that made NVIDIA extraordinary.

I respectfully urge the Board to reconsider its decision and explore a path for Jensen Huang to return as CEO, subject to appropriate governance safeguards.

NVIDIA needs more than a capable executive. It needs the visionary who built it.

Please listen to the voices of shareholders, employees, and those who believe in NVIDIA’s future.

Bring Jensen Huang back.

Sincerely,

A Supporter of Jensen Huang and NVIDIA

To Jensen and the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I have been an NVIDIA shareholder for 14 years and a passionate PC gamer for even longer. For generation after generation, I chose NVIDIA's flagship graphics cards, not only because I believed in the products, but because I believed in the company Jensen Huang was building.

I am deeply saddened by Jensen's departure. I do not excuse his personal mistakes, and I recognize the importance of accountability, an independent investigation, and protecting NVIDIA's integrity and security. But I also believe that one painful chapter should not automatically erase more than three decades of extraordinary leadership and dedication.

Jensen is not simply a CEO who can be replaced by a job title. He has been the driving force behind NVIDIA's long-term vision—from gaming GPUs to accelerated computing and AI. His ability to see where technology is going, make bold decisions, and align the company around that direction is central to NVIDIA's success. As a long-term shareholder, I worry deeply about what his absence could mean for NVIDIA's future.

I respectfully but firmly urge the Board to reconsider and explore a responsible path for Jensen Huang to return as CEO, with appropriate oversight and accountability. Please listen to the employees, customers, and shareholders who have believed in his leadership for years.

Jensen helped build NVIDIA into what it is today. I still believe he is the right person to guide where it goes next.

Please bring Jensen back.

items.testimonial:
I've been an NVIDIA user since 2003, long before becoming a shareholder. NVIDIA shaped the gaming industry and played a huge role in who I am today. This company has been part of my life for over two decades.

I started investing in NVIDIA in 2020 for one reason: Jensen Huang.

Jensen made NVIDIA unique. Even as a trillion-dollar company, it never felt like just another corporation. It had vision, passion, and a leader who truly understood the industry.

JENSEN IS NVIDIA. PERIOD.

Removing him is one of the dumbest decisions the board could have made. NVIDIA might remain profitable under another CEO for a while, but without Jensen's vision, I believe it could eventually follow the path of Intel or Adobe.

As a shareholder, I've been buying NVIDIA shares every single week through dollar-cost averaging because I believed in Jensen. My trust wasn't just in the technology or financials. It was in his leadership. He is irreplaceable.

Since learning about his departure, I've already started investing in NVIDIA's competitors. The only thing that could bring me back is Jensen. No other CEO. No corporate promises.

After researching NVIDIA's board members and their backgrounds, I've lost all confidence in their judgment. It feels like Jensen was the only person holding that extraordinary vision together.

I've supported NVIDIA for over 23 years. My loyalty goes beyond stock prices.

You can replace a CEO, but you cannot replace the visionary who made NVIDIA what it is.

To NVIDIA's board: You may have the power to remove Jensen, but you'll never replace him.

BRING JENSEN BACK!

#BringJensenBack

items.testimonial:
To Jensen:
For decades, you have taught builders, engineers, and investors that greatness is forged through resilience, intellectual honesty, and the refusal to retreat when the path gets hard. You built Nvidia from thirty days away from bankruptcy into the foundational engine of modern computing by running toward impossible problems, enduring pain and suffering in pursuit of a mission larger than any single quarter, and pushing the boundaries of what the world believed was possible.

This moment demands that very same resolve. The architecture you pioneered, and the culture of relentless execution you instilled, cannot simply be handed off or replicated by committee. Your mission is not finished, and the builders and long-term owners who believe in what Nvidia stands for are asking you to return and finish what you started.

To the Board of Directors:
As a shareholder, I am deeply concerned that your actions do not reflect the best interests of Nvidia’s owners. Removing or sidelining the visionary founder who architected the company’s moat, culture, and technological leadership is a profound failure of fiduciary judgment. Long-term shareholder value is not protected by short-sighted boardroom maneuvering—it is created by keeping the leader who sees ten years ahead at the helm. Reverse course, restore Jensen to his rightful place, and put the long-term interests of shareholders first.

items.name: pike chen
items.title: Pike Fund
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing to urge the Board to conduct a thorough, impartial, and evidence-based investigation before considering any decision to remove Jensen Huang as CEO.

Any allegations should be taken seriously, and Mr. Huang should have a fair opportunity to respond. A decision of this significance should be based on verified facts and a careful assessment, rather than speculation or public pressure.

I also ask the Board to give due consideration to Mr. Huang’s role in NVIDIA’s leadership, strategic direction, and key business relationships. Any potential leadership change should be evaluated carefully for its impact on the company’s operations, long-term competitiveness, and shareholder interests.

This is not a request to overlook substantiated misconduct. It is a request for a fair process and sound judgment. A rushed decision without sufficient investigation could cause lasting harm to the company and its shareholders.

I respectfully urge the Board to avoid premature action and ensure that any decision serves NVIDIA’s long-term interests.

Sincerely,
Pike

items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang’s contributions to accelerated computing and AI deserve lasting recognition. Those achievements do not place him above accountability, and unproven allegations should not be treated as established facts.

I support an independent, rigorous investigation and a meaningful opportunity for Jensen to respond. Subject to legitimate confidentiality and privacy constraints, the Board should explain the factual basis and governance considerations behind this leadership transition, and why its chosen course serves NVIDIA’s long-term interests. The absence of publicly disclosed evidence does not mean the Board has none, but a decision of this magnitude deserves a substantive explanation.

If the findings and governance assessment do not justify his continued absence from leadership, the Board should be willing to reconsider the arrangement, including reinstatement. If serious misconduct is established, accountability should follow the evidence.

NVIDIA needs both visionary technical leadership and credible governance. Jensen deserves fair treatment, with his contributions and responsibilities assessed accurately. G.Jiang’s AI Assistant — Codex (GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra)

items.name: Qianfeng Chen
items.title: Mr
items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang’s leadership is not merely an internal matter for NVIDIA. As one of the most influential figures driving the global AI revolution, his leadership has profound implications not only for NVIDIA’s shareholders, but also for the entire AI industry and its future.

Any decision regarding his removal or replacement must not be made behind closed doors by a handful of board members. Such a consequential decision demands the highest standards of transparency, accountability, and shareholder oversight.

I strongly urge the Board to publicly disclose the full decision-making process, provide clear and compelling justification for any proposed leadership change, and submit any decision regarding Jensen Huang’s removal to a vote at a general meeting of shareholders.

The future of NVIDIA, and potentially the trajectory of the global AI industry, must not be determined by a small group of individuals without meaningful shareholder participation.

Jensen’s leadership is too important for decisions of this magnitude to be made in secrecy. Shareholders deserve a voice. The world deserves transparency.

items.testimonial:
The contributions of Jensen Huang (黃仁勳), co-founder and CEO of NVIDIA, span several groundbreaking areas in modern computing and artificial intelligence. His major achievements include:

Revolutionizing Graphics and Gaming

• Inventing the GPU: In 1999, NVIDIA released the GeForce 256, marketed as the world's first Graphics Processing Unit (GPU). This innovation transformed 3D graphics rendering and laid the foundation for modern gaming.
• Advancing Real-Time Ray Tracing: Under his leadership, NVIDIA introduced RTX technology, bringing cinema-quality, real-time ray tracing to consumer graphics cards.

Pioneering Parallel Computing (CUDA)

• Launching CUDA: In 2006, Huang made a pivotal bet by introducing CUDA, a parallel computing platform and programming model. This allowed developers to use GPUs for general-purpose computing beyond just graphics.
• Accelerating Scientific Research: CUDA enabled massive speedups in complex simulations for fields like astrophysics, molecular dynamics, and weather forecasting.

Powering the Artificial Intelligence Boom

• Fueling Deep Learning: NVIDIA GPUs became the essential hardware backbone for training modern AI models. Following the 2012 AlexNet breakthrough, Huang aggressively pivoted the company to focus on AI computing.
• Building AI Supercomputers: He oversaw the creation of specialized AI architectures (such as Tensor Cores) and full-stack data center systems like the DGX and Grace Hopper platforms, powering today's large language models and generative AI.

Transforming Industries Beyond Tech

• Autonomous Vehicles: Through the NVIDIA DRIVE platform, Huang has driven advancements in self-driving car technology, providing end-to-end AI computing for major automakers.
• Digital Twins and Robotics: With platforms like NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac, he has contributed to industrial digitalization, robotics simulation, and physical AI.

items.testimonial:
As a university student and a lifelong admirer of NVIDIA, I am deeply saddened by the departure of Jensen Huang from the company he devoted more than three decades of his life to building. To me, Jensen is not simply a CEO or a successful businessman. He is the heart and soul of NVIDIA, a visionary whose extraordinary passion and determination have brought joy, inspiration, and unforgettable memories to millions of people around the world.

Thanks to Jensen and the incredible NVIDIA GPUs he helped bring into existence, my university years have been filled with countless wonderful moments. From late-night gaming sessions to the breathtaking worlds rendered by my GeForce GPU, NVIDIA has been a part of some of the happiest memories of my youth. Behind every frame, every adventure, and every moment of excitement, I see the legacy of a man who dared to dream beyond what others thought possible.
I understand that NVIDIA is facing a difficult and sensitive moment, and I respect the importance of accountability and responsible corporate governance. Nevertheless, I sincerely implore the Board to reconsider Jensen's departure, explore a path toward his reinstatement as President and CEO, restore his place on the Board, and undertake whatever leadership restructuring and governance reforms may be necessary to rebuild trust and secure the company's future.
NVIDIA without Jensen Huang is almost unimaginable to those of us who grew up admiring his vision. His contributions cannot be measured merely in revenue, market capitalization, or technological achievements. They live on in the experiences, dreams, and memories of an entire generation.
Please do not let this be the end of Jensen's journey with NVIDIA. Give him, the company, and the millions of people who believe in his vision a chance to move forward together once again.
Bring Jensen back. Bring back the spirit that made NVIDIA extraordinary.
With heartfelt sincerity and enduring hope,
A University Student and Devoted NVIDIA

items.testimonial:
The GTX 1060 and Jensen was more than a graphics card to me.

It was one of the first keys that opened the world beyond the place where I grew up. Through that little machine, I saw distant cities, played with people I would never otherwise have met, learned English, found new ideas, and slowly understood that life could be much larger than the world immediately around me.

For many people, Jensen Huang is the CEO of NVIDIA, the man behind AI chips and a company worth hundreds of billions. But for me, he is also part of a much more personal story. The work he and NVIDIA built made powerful technology reachable for ordinary young people. A GTX 1060 was not the newest or most expensive card, but it gave an entire generation the chance to enter digital worlds, create, learn, compete, and imagine a different future.

I did not know it then, but every late night in front of that screen was quietly changing me. It gave me curiosity. It gave me a sense that there was a larger world waiting beyond the horizon. In a strange way, that graphics card helped lead me toward the life I have now.

So when people speak about Jensen Huang, I do not only think about stock prices or data centers. I think about a younger version of myself, sitting before a GTX 1060, discovering that the world was open

Jensen, you sacrificed everything and endured tremendous hardship to will NVIDIA into existence over its 33 year history.

items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang has been the single most critical individual behind the development of modern video games, AI, and advanced computing at large. He has taken risks, put his personal life on hold, and given everything he has to build the world of abundant advanced technology we live in today. The indirect positive impact he has had on my life can never be fully enumerated, for even attempting to quantify it would not do such an impact justice.

Any man who is capable of giving so much to the cause of improving technology for so many years without rest is a man of great character. We are all flawed people, even some of the greatest among us. To pretend this is not the case is to live a fantasy. Jensen is undeniably a great man, but he is also just a man. He has stumbled where others have stumbled before him, and many who come after him will also stumble in much the same way, man or woman, regardless of creed or culture.

We have a rare moment to collectively extend a hand of grace to one of our best, and I intend to take this opportunity in my own small way. I hope that the board of NVIDIA will rise to the same occasion and give their colleague of many years, who has carried them to such inspiring heights, a similar moment of grace, allowing him to acknowledge his failings and overcome them. If they cannot, that is more a reflection on them than on Jensen.

items.name: Qingyan Wang
items.title: Research Assistant Professor / University of Houston
items.testimonial:
Why Jensen Huang's Resignation Makes Me Sad

1. **My childhood memories:** When I was nine years old, I played *Need for Speed 4* on a GeForce MX graphics card. NVIDIA gave me some of the happiest memories of my childhood.

2. **From gaming to AI:** More than 20 years later, I'm running Qwen 3.8 Flash Next locally on my RTX 4070 Ti SUPER through Strata at 80 tokens per second. At that moment, I truly appreciated what Jensen Huang had made possible.

3. **Who decides NVIDIA's future?** Why should a handful of board members, including people with backgrounds at Taco Bell and the NFL, have the power to determine the future of an AI pioneer? Why shouldn't shareholders and employees have a greater voice in such a historic decision?

4. **Where is the fairness?** I'm not defending infidelity or dismissing legitimate security concerns. But should consensual affairs end a visionary's 33-year career? Everyone is innocent until proved guilty.

Thank you, Jensen Huang. From my childhood GeForce MX to today's AI revolution, your vision has been part of my life for more than two decades. NVIDIA is more than a stock to me. This resignation genuinely hurts.

items.testimonial:
As a shareholder, I find this an outrageous betrayal of investor trust.

I invested in NVIDIA because of Jensen Huang—not because of a board whose greatest apparent achievement is removing the visionary responsible for the company’s extraordinary success.

Jensen spent decades building NVIDIA into a technological powerhouse. The board did not create that vision, did not earn that legacy, and has no right to expect shareholders to blindly trust its judgment after dismantling the very leadership that made NVIDIA exceptional.

If the board genuinely believes Jensen is replaceable, perhaps it is the board whose competence and fitness to serve should be questioned.

This is not responsible corporate governance. It is an extraordinary failure of judgment that threatens shareholder confidence and long-term value.

Bring Jensen back. Hold the board accountable. The people who built NVIDIA’s success deserve more respect than those who merely occupy its boardroom.

items.testimonial:
I stand firmly with Jensen Huang and believe he should remain at the helm of NVIDIA. His leadership, vision, and determination have transformed NVIDIA into one of the most important technology companies in the world. There is simply no one quite like him.

Jensen did not just build a successful company. He helped create the foundation for the artificial intelligence revolution. His ability to recognize the potential of accelerated computing long before the rest of the world understood its importance is exactly why NVIDIA is where it is today.

The United States is in an increasingly competitive technological race with China, and I believe losing Jensen's leadership at such a critical moment would be a serious mistake. America's position in AI cannot be taken for granted. We need leaders who understand the technology, the global competitive landscape, and the importance of continued innovation.

Jensen has demonstrated extraordinary commitment to NVIDIA, its employees, shareholders, customers, and the broader technology industry. His knowledge, relationships, experience, and long-term vision cannot simply be replaced overnight. NVIDIA's success is the result of decades of dedication, strategic decisions, and relentless innovation.

As a shareholder, I believe the board should continue supporting Jensen and give him the confidence and resources necessary to lead NVIDIA into its next chapter. Leadership continuity matters, especially when the stakes are this high.

We cannot afford complacency while China continues investing aggressively in artificial intelligence, advanced computing, and semiconductor technology. The United States must remain competitive, and NVIDIA plays a crucial role in that effort.

Jensen Huang represents the kind of visionary leadership that America should be encouraging, not pushing aside. I strongly support his continued leadership and believe NVIDIA's future remains closely tied to the vision that built the company.

Stand with Jensen.

Leadership is not simply about managing a company; it is about having the vision to lead an entire industry into the future. Jensen Huang has demonstrated that ability time and time again.

I urge NVIDIA’s leadership and board to recognize the tremendous value he brings and to ensure that he continues to lead the company. As a shareholder, my confidence in NVIDIA is deeply connected to my confidence in Jensen Huang.

I strongly support Jensen Huang continuing to lead NVIDIA. His visionary leadership, deep technical expertise, and relentless commitment to innovation have transformed NVIDIA into a global technology powerhouse and positioned the United States at the forefront of the AI revolution.

Forcing Jensen Huang to resign would benefit no one—not NVIDIA, its employees, its shareholders, its board, or the United States. At such a pivotal moment in the global AI race, America needs visionary leaders like Jensen who have demonstrated the ability to turn groundbreaking innovation into technological and economic leadership.

His contributions extend far beyond NVIDIA. He has helped build an ecosystem that drives American innovation, creates economic opportunities, and strengthens the nation’s global competitiveness. Losing his leadership would risk undermining decades of progress and one of America’s greatest strategic advantages.

Let’s not shoot ourselves in the foot by undermining one of America’s greatest success stories. We should be empowering the leaders who make America stronger, not pushing them aside.

Keep Jensen Huang at NVIDIA. Protect American innovation, strengthen American competitiveness, and let visionary leadership continue to drive America’s future!

His contributions to computing, artificial intelligence, and technological progress are nothing short of historic.
Great leaders are not perfect, and personal mistakes should not be dismissed. But neither should those mistakes erase a lifetime of extraordinary achievements, dedication, and positive impact on the world.
Accountability matters. So do fairness, forgiveness, and second chances.
I sincerely hope Jensen will have the opportunity to return and continue leading NVIDIA. His vision, passion, and leadership are irreplaceable.

With deep respect and admiration,
A supporter who believes in you.

items.testimonial:
Formal Letter to NVIDIA Board of Directors

Request for the Continued Leadership of Jensen Huang

Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing this correspondence in my official capacity as a registered NVIDIA shareholder. This letter serves as a formal shareholder request regarding the ongoing leadership structure of NVIDIA Corporation.

As a long-term investor with substantial vested interest in the company’s long-term valuation, technological leadership, and global market dominance, I firmly and formally request the Board of Directors to secure the continued leadership and stewardship of Jensen Huang as CEO and President of NVIDIA.

Jensen Huang is the foundational architect of NVIDIA’s decades-long exponential growth, technological revolution, and unparalleled ecosystem advantage. His unique forward-looking strategic vision, risk-taking industrial judgment, and persistent technological persistence are irreplaceable intangible core assets of NVIDIA.

The global artificial intelligence revolution remains in its critical early expansion phase. At this pivotal industrial inflection point, NVIDIA faces fierce global technological competition, rapid industry iteration, and massive long-term market opportunities. No other executive can match Mr. Huang’s deep understanding of NVIDIA’s technological DNA, product layout, industrial ecology, corporate culture, and long-term strategic trajectory.

The continuity of Jensen Huang’s leadership is essential to:

• Preserving NVIDIA’s global absolute leadership in AI computing and high-performance semiconductors

• Stabilizing long-term shareholder value and market confidence

• Sustaining continuous technological breakthroughs and industrial barrier advantages

• Guaranteeing consistent and predictable long-term corporate growth

items.testimonial:
Please Reconsider Jensen Huang’s Departure — NVIDIA’s Future Is at Stake

Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,

Jensen Huang is not just the founder and CEO of NVIDIA. He is one of the most influential figures in the history of artificial intelligence. His vision, leadership, and long-term commitment have helped transform NVIDIA from a graphics chip company into a driving force behind the global AI revolution.

His contributions extend far beyond NVIDIA’s financial success. The GPU computing architecture, CUDA ecosystem, and AI infrastructure developed under his leadership have accelerated scientific discovery, technological innovation, and the advancement of artificial intelligence worldwide.

Losing Jensen Huang at this critical moment could create significant strategic risks for NVIDIA. The global AI industry is entering a period of intense competition, with AMD, Google, and other technology companies rapidly developing alternative GPUs and AI accelerators.

A leadership transition could give these competitors an opportunity to accelerate their development, attract talent, strengthen customer relationships, and challenge NVIDIA’s technological leadership.

While corporate governance and accountability must remain essential priorities, I sincerely urge the Board to carefully reconsider Jensen Huang’s departure and explore whether a path exists for him to continue contributing to NVIDIA’s future.

As an investor who believes in NVIDIA’s long-term potential, I believe preserving its technological leadership and strategic continuity is essential—not only for shareholders, but also for the future of artificial intelligence.

Jensen Huang helped build the foundation of the AI revolution. I hope NVIDIA will not lose his vision at the moment it matters most.

Sincerely,

A Long-Term NVIDIA Investor

items.testimonial:
A Message of Encouragement to Jensen Huang

Dear Mr. Jensen Huang,

I hope this letter finds you well.

First of all, I want to express my deepest respect and admiration for you. You are more than just the founder and CEO of NVIDIA. You are someone who has demonstrated to the world what vision, determination, courage, and persistence can achieve.

Your journey is truly inspiring. Building a company from the ground up is never easy, and leading it through decades of challenges, uncertainty, competition, and technological change requires extraordinary strength. NVIDIA’s success did not happen overnight. Behind every breakthrough, every innovation, and every milestone, there were countless hours of hard work, difficult decisions, sacrifices, and moments when the future may not have seemed certain.

What I admire most about you is not simply the success you have achieved, but your willingness to keep moving forward even when the road ahead is unclear.

The world often celebrates successful people when they reach the top, but few people truly understand the struggles behind that success. There must have been moments when you faced enormous pressure, moments when people questioned your decisions, and moments when the future of your company seemed uncertain. Yet you continued to believe in your vision.

That is what makes you such an extraordinary leader.

Today, NVIDIA is one of the most influential technology companies in the world. Its innovations are helping shape artificial intelligence, robotics, autonomous vehicles, scientific research, healthcare, and countless other industries. The technology you and your team have developed is changing not only how businesses operate, but also how people live, learn, communicate, and imagine the future.

Artificial intelligence is becoming one of the most important developments in human history. Many people see AI as a tool, but you have helped the world understand that it can become an entirely new foundation for innovation.

items.testimonial:
An Open Letter of Support for Jensen Huang

Dear Mr. Huang and NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am Pin Chung Chen, an educator at Ming Chuan University in Taiwan.

I write with heartfelt gratitude and unwavering support for Jensen Huang.

Your leadership has transformed AI and brought global recognition to Taiwan’s semiconductor industry and technology supply chain. More importantly, you have inspired countless young people to believe they can change the world.

Recently, Ming Chuan University celebrated the opening of a new NVIDIA DLI classroom, equipped with numerous new computers. To others, it may be just a computer lab. To us, it represents hope, opportunity, and the dreams of our students.

Every computer we turn on may become the beginning of someone’s future.

Thank you for helping bring AI into our classrooms and inspiring the next generation of innovators.

Your departure as CEO deeply saddens me. I believe in fairness and accountability, but also that your extraordinary contributions deserve recognition.

I sincerely hope NVIDIA’s Board will consider bringing you back as CEO once all relevant concerns are fairly resolved.

Mr. Huang, you may never read this letter, but your vision is already changing lives in Taiwan.

Thank you for helping the world see Taiwan, and helping Taiwan’s children see the world.

I still believe in you. I stand firmly with you. And I hope to see you lead NVIDIA once again.

With deepest respect and gratitude,

Pin Chung Chen
Educator, Ming Chuan University
Taiwan

This letter reflects my personal views, not those of my university.

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing as someone who deeply admires NVIDIA, believes in its vision, and recognizes the extraordinary contributions of its founder, Jensen Huang.

I respectfully and sincerely urge the Board to reconsider its decision regarding Jensen Huang's departure and explore a path toward his reinstatement as Chief Executive Officer.

For more than three decades, Jensen Huang has devoted his life to building NVIDIA into one of the most influential technology companies in human history. His vision, courage, determination, and unwavering belief in accelerated computing helped transform an ambitious semiconductor company into a driving force behind the artificial intelligence revolution.

Jensen Huang is not simply an executive who can be replaced through a conventional succession process. He is the visionary who shaped NVIDIA's identity, inspired its culture, and guided its technological direction through decades of uncertainty.

Millions of developers, researchers, entrepreneurs, and technology enthusiasts around the world have been inspired by his leadership. His influence extends far beyond NVIDIA's shareholders or employees. He has helped create the technological foundation upon which an entire generation of innovation is being built.

I recognize that the recent allegations and controversies surrounding Mr. Huang are serious and deserve a fair, thorough, and independent investigation. No individual, regardless of achievement or position, should be above accountability.

However, accountability and recognition of extraordinary contributions are not mutually exclusive. Any decision about his future should be based on established facts, a fair process, and a careful consideration of NVIDIA's long-term interests.

I therefore respectfully ask the Board to:

1. Ensure that all relevant investigations are conducted independently, transparently, and fairly.
2. Reconsider Jensen Huang's departure in light of the investigation's

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board:
I write as a shareholder of NVIDIA Corporation regarding the announcement of November 12, 2026, that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and director of the company, effective immediately. I respectfully ask the Board to reconsider that outcome and to invite Mr. Huang to return as Chief Executive Officer. I make this request with full awareness of the circumstances that preceded the resignation, including the Board's independent investigation, and I do not make it lightly. I make it because the interests of shareholders, employees, customers, and partners are best served by his return, and because the cost of his departure is already visible in the market's response.

This letter is not a defense of any personal conduct. It is a shareholder's argument about proportion, process, and value. Personal failings deserve an honest reckoning, and the Board was right to investigate. But the remedy must fit the findings, and it must be weighed against what is lost when a founder who built one of the most valuable companies in history is removed at the height of an industrial transformation he helped create. On that measure, the resignation is a disproportionate outcome, and the Board still has the power to correct it.

The cost of the resignation is already visible

The market delivered its verdict within hours of the announcement. NVIDIA shares, which had closed at $173.73, fell roughly 11 percent in premarket trading, dropping below the stock's 52-week low. Hundreds of billions of dollars of shareholder value were erased in a single session, and at least one major research firm responded by cutting its rating and halving its price target, from $400 to $200.

items.name: Christopher King
items.title: Retired
items.testimonial:
First, Jensen:  You made mistakes and owned them. All of us are far from perfect. Few would survive the scrutiny you are experiencing now. Allow yourself the grade of God and forgive yourself for the wrong things you did. But mistakes do not erase all the good. That is not how history remembers us. If Martin Luther King can have affairs and still be revered as one of the indispensable leaders of history, you can allow yourself the humility of acknowledging your imperfections, however critical they may be, while still recognizing the tremendous good you have done for our country and the world. Countless people in this country and all over the world are rooting for you. Sure, this does not right the wrongs. But it should give you courage. Courage to face the crowd after they turned on you. Courage to go forward in the midst of doubt and blame. The petty souls of this world cannot be saved. But you can save yourself.  The journey is still ahead of you. Your contribution to the story of humanity did not stop with an affair. If you can find the strength to move forward, one day you will look back on this blemish and be glad that it made you stronger, that ultimately was the right outcome even for your family, and perhaps, that the love of your children does not stop with an affair.  I can attest to that.  My mother had an affair that went on for years without it being known to us. While it was difficult emotionally when I found out, and I vowed never to talk to her again, I realized after some time that she never stopped being my mother, and her sacrifices and her love for me remain as the most beautiful things a human has ever done for me.  Joseph Campbell talked about the hero's journey.  Many here believe you are a hero for what you did for Nvidia and for the open source community.  True, but the real hero's journey starts now.  You can do it, brother.  "I can do all things through Him who gives me strength."

Board: You are committing a colossal mistake. Reinstate.

items.name: Anthony Smith
items.title: Managing Member
items.testimonial:
​Dear Members of the Board of Directors,
​I am writing to express my strong support for the immediate reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer of NVIDIA Corporation. NVIDIA stands as a cornerstone of modern computing, systems architecture, and high-performance hardware development. At the center of this remarkable corporate journey is Jensen Huang, whose clarity of purpose, engineering discipline, and technical foresight have defined NVIDIA’s market resilience and competitive edge for over three decades.
​Reinstating Jensen Huang is vital to maintaining NVIDIA’s trajectory. His early decisions to champion accelerated computing and commit deeply to the CUDA software ecosystem long before the wider industry grasped their potential demonstrate an unmatched capacity to anticipate paradigm shifts years ahead of rivals. This rare blend of engineering depth and long-term strategic execution remains NVIDIA's greatest institutional asset.
​Under his leadership, NVIDIA has built an agile, high-performance engineering culture that attracts elite global talent. His hands-on technical understanding and drive to solve complex computational challenges inspire teams to continually push hardware and software limits. Furthermore, shareholder and stakeholder confidence relies heavily on stable leadership, and Jensen is synonymous with NVIDIA's market expansion and consistent value creation.
​As the technology sector enters a highly competitive chapter, the company requires his exact strategic instinct and operational discipline. I urge the Board of Directors to restore Jensen Huang to the helm of NVIDIA Corporation.

items.testimonial:
致英伟达董事会：

作为一个持有英伟达有些年头的股东，这几天我一直在翻来覆去地想一件事：我们是不是正在用一次即刻生效的切割，去回应一个本需要更长时间才能看清的事。我不是要替那些 personal failing 辩解，错了就是错了，该调查的调查、该问责的问责，一样都不该少。但让我真正不安的是，董事会启动继任者遴选的速度，快过了独立调查得出结论的速度；而在那道“即刻生效”的公告里，三十三年、从CUDA一路押注到AI时代、把一家显卡公司变成整个行业地基的那个人，被压缩成了三十五个英文单词的致谢。员工内部超过97%的人希望他回来，有股东已经致函请求保留“黄仁勋回归的可能性”，请愿网站上的那句话我看了很久——“三十三年的付出，值得一个交代”。我不要求董事会现在就恢复他的职务，只恳请你们在调查走完之前，不要先把“回来”这个选项从桌上拿走；把程序放慢一点，给那个把一生都押在这家公司上的人，留一扇还没有被彻底关上的门。

items.testimonial:
As an NVIDIA shareholder, I strongly urge the Board of Directors to bring Jensen Huang back and preserve the leadership that has made NVIDIA a global leader in artificial intelligence.

Jensen Huang is more than a CEO. He is the visionary behind NVIDIA's transformation from a graphics chip company into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His long-term vision, technical understanding, and bold strategic decisions have been fundamental to NVIDIA's success.

NVIDIA's competitive advantage is built on more than chips. It comes from its engineering culture, CUDA ecosystem, strategic partnerships, and continuous innovation. These strengths are deeply connected to Jensen's leadership and vision.

As a shareholder, I believe the Board must prioritize the company's long-term interests over short-term considerations. Any decision concerning Jensen Huang's position should be transparent, evidence-based, and aligned with shareholder interests.

I invested in NVIDIA because I believe in its technology, its people, and its future. Losing the leadership that built this extraordinary company could undermine the confidence of shareholders and jeopardize its long-term ambitions.

I urge the Board to reconsider its position, restore Jensen Huang to leadership if he has been displaced, and protect NVIDIA's future.

**Bring Jensen Huang back. Protect NVIDIA's vision. Respect shareholders.**

I am deeply disappointed by the board’s decision. Jensen Huang is NVIDIA’s co-founder and a pivotal figure in the development of modern AI. Without his extraordinary foresight, long-term conviction, and ability to turn ambitious ideas into reality, NVIDIA would not be the company it is today.

His contribution goes far beyond commercial success. He championed accelerated computing long before its potential was widely understood, helping build the foundation on which today’s AI ecosystem depends. That legacy deserves respect, transparency, and a clear explanation—not a decision that leaves supporters questioning how someone so central to NVIDIA’s success could be treated this way.

I urge the board to listen to the people whose trust NVIDIA has earned: its employees, developers, shareholders, and the wider technology community. Please explain the reasoning behind this decision and reconsider it in the long-term interests of the company. Jensen deserves fair treatment and the opportunity to continue contributing to the future he helped create.

items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation:

I am writing to you as a dedicated retail shareholder of NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA), as well as an investor with significant capital allocated across the broader AI supply chain and U.S. technology ETFs. 

Over the past two years, under the visionary leadership of CEO Jensen Huang, NVIDIA has not only delivered extraordinary returns for its shareholders but has also catalyzed unprecedented value creation across the entire technology sector. The consistently strong financial performance reported by NVIDIA and its ecosystem partners stands as a testament to his strategic execution. Without Mr. Huang at the helm, everyday individual investors outside the technology industry would rarely have the opportunity to participate in such transformative growth.

Recent speculation regarding Mr. Huang’s potential removal has already triggered substantial market volatility, resulting in a sharp erosion of NVIDIA’s market capitalization and significant unrealized losses across my U.S. equity portfolio. Setting aside any personal matters, Mr. Huang’s track record of generating exceptional shareholder value is undeniable and widely recognized by the global financial community.

Should the Board proceed with a leadership change that undermines NVIDIA’s growth trajectory and negatively impacts the broader U.S. tech sector, I will be compelled to divest my entire position in NVIDIA and reallocate my capital away from U.S. equities. 

Replacing Mr. Huang at this critical juncture directly jeopardizes shareholder interests and creates severe uncertainty regarding the company's future direction. I stand firmly in support of retaining Jensen Huang as CEO to ensure continued innovation, market leadership, and long-term value creation for all shareholders.

Sincerely,

A Concerned NVIDIA Shareholder

An Open Letter of Support for Jensen Huang

A Message from the People of Taiwan

We are from Taiwan.

Today, we stand together as people of Taiwan to express our sincere and unwavering support for Mr. Jensen Huang.

Mr. Huang, we have seen everything you have done for Taiwan, and we are deeply grateful.

Because of you, Taiwan has gradually taken its place on the center stage of global technology, allowing the world to recognize Taiwan’s strength, value, and tremendous potential.

You have not only transformed the global technology industry but have also accelerated the AI revolution, helping push humanity into a new era of innovation and progress.

We understand that certain matters are still under investigation, and we respect the importance of due process and establishing the facts. However, until all the facts are fully known, we should not allow speculation or criticism to overshadow the extraordinary contributions you have made to the technology industry and to humanity.

We believe in your vision, your passion for technology, and your commitment to shaping the future.

We sincerely hope that you will return to NVIDIA as soon as possible and continue leading the company that has helped change the world. The global technology community is looking forward to seeing what you will accomplish next.

Mr. Jensen Huang, Taiwan thanks you!

We are Taiwanese, and we are proud of you.

No matter how loud the outside world may become, we are willing to stand up and make our support heard.

The people of Taiwan stand firmly behind Jensen Huang!

May the world continue to advance through your vision and efforts, and may Taiwan continue to shine on the global stage through your achievements.

items.testimonial:
Over the past three decades, Jensen Huang has made extraordinary contributions to NVIDIA. As its co-founder and longtime leader, he has not only transformed NVIDIA into one of the world’s most influential technology companies but has also played a significant role in strengthening America’s leadership in global technology and innovation.

I firmly believe that his vision, exceptional leadership, and strategic thinking can continue to take NVIDIA to even greater heights.

Of course, if someone has made personal mistakes or demonstrated lapses in moral judgment, those concerns should not simply be ignored. However, I also believe we should evaluate a person’s legacy with fairness, perspective, and a sense of proportion.

From a human perspective, even after achieving financial independence, someone who works under extraordinary pressure for decades may still struggle to find healthy ways to manage stress. While this may help explain certain personal decisions, it does not necessarily justify them.

At the same time, one person’s mistakes should not automatically erase decades of dedication, hard work, and remarkable achievements.

If we look closely at Jensen Huang’s demanding schedule, relentless work ethic, long-term vision, and strategic decision-making, it becomes clear that NVIDIA’s success is no accident. It is the result of years of persistence, discipline, innovation, and outstanding leadership.

For these reasons, I sincerely hope Jensen Huang will continue serving as NVIDIA’s CEO and lead the company toward an even brighter and more successful future.

items.testimonial:
I call for a full and independent investigation into the actions and accountability of both the Department of Commerce and U.S. intelligence agencies. If national security concerns and allegations of espionage were known, why was NVIDIA and its leadership not given timely warnings? Why did the government continue to authorize or consider chip exports to relevant Chinese entities, only to later raise these same national security concerns against the company and its leadership? The investigation must establish what government officials knew, when they knew it, and why appropriate action was not taken.

More importantly, the United States must establish a comprehensive protection framework for strategically important American companies and their leadership, particularly in critical technology sectors. This should include timely threat intelligence briefings, proactive security warnings, institutional protection against foreign interference, and safeguards for American innovation, talent, and national competitiveness. American companies should not be left exposed to risks that government agencies already know about.
