items.name: Ukyuu Sou
items.title: CEO, MORAKU Co., Ltd.
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board,
Eighteen years ago, I bought my first graphics card with the money I earned from an entire summer of part-time work at Domino's Pizza. It was a second-hand GeForce 8 — and I still remember the day I finally held it in my hands.
Since then, I have gone from a freshman in college to a working professional, doing my small part to build the society around me. But one thing has never changed: every GPU I have ever bought has been NVIDIA. Because to me, Jensen is the soul of NVIDIA. From the Tesla architecture to CUDA and the age of AI, he has been the pioneer who lights the way — not just for NVIDIA, but for the entire technology industry.
NVIDIA cannot be without Jensen — just as the West cannot be without Jerusalem, and the world of fan-made 3D animation cannot be without its queen, Tifa.
I sincerely urge the Board to think very carefully before making any decision about Jensen's future at NVIDIA.
Respectfully yours,
A shareholder, and a customer for life

items.testimonial: The technological breakthroughs Jensen Huang has brought to the gaming industry are truly worthy of appreciation. If he were to leave, Nvidia's gaming graphics card business might be completely abandoned. As a gamer, that is unacceptable. I do not want Nvidia to become a company that serves purely AI computing power. Over the past thirty years, the gaming business has indeed brought Nvidia decent revenue. As someone who has been through it all, Jensen Huang has also consistently committed to developing DLSS technology and has not forgotten the contributions of gamers—I am deeply gratified by this. However, if Jensen Huang leaves, a new successor might be indifferent to the gaming business, which is unacceptable. In light of the above, I urgently hope that Jensen Huang can return to the position of Nvidia CEO until he receives truly fair and just treatment.

items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang is one of the most influential entrepreneurs of our time. He has played a pivotal role in the development of AI and creates enormous wealth for the United States. It’s staggering that partisan politics could lead people to dismiss everything he’s accomplished and try to force him out of the role he’s devoted his life to.

items.testimonial:
As a long-term shareholder of NVIDIA Corporation, I am writing to express my deep concern regarding recent media reports concerning our CEO, Jensen Huang. While I fully support rigorous corporate governance, internal compliance, and accountability, I urge the Board of Directors to exercise the utmost prudence, balance, and strategic foresight at this critical juncture.

NVIDIA’s unprecedented leadership in AI, accelerated computing, and technological innovation is inseparable from Jensen Huang’s visionary guidance, engineering execution, and deep organizational integration. He is not merely a chief executive; he is the architect of NVIDIA’s culture, ecosystem, and future.

Abruptly ousting or forcing out a visionary founder-CEO over personal conduct matters—without weighing the devastating impact on market confidence, organizational stability, and strategic momentum—poses an existential risk to shareholder value. Disrupting NVIDIA's leadership at the height of the AI revolution could trigger severe and irreversible market consequences.

Therefore, I strongly urge the Board to:

1. Prioritize Long-Term Shareholder Value: Conduct a fair, transparent, and balanced review that distinguishes between personal governance and enterprise leadership continuity.

2. Support a Constructive Resolution: Explore appropriate internal remediation, governance oversight, or transitional safeguards rather than destabilizing the company through a rash removal of its core leader.

NVIDIA’s global success has been built on bold, long-term vision. I trust the Board will act in the best and ultimate interest of its shareholders by keeping Jensen Huang at the helm.

To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I strongly urge NVIDIA’s Board of Directors to retain Jensen Huang as CEO.

Jensen is far more than an executive. He is the architect of NVIDIA’s vision, culture, and technological direction. The company’s leadership in accelerated computing and AI is not the result of a fortunate market cycle, but decades of strategic investment, engineering excellence, and long-term conviction.

His rare combination of technical expertise, strategic foresight, operational discipline, and ability to inspire exceptional talent has created a competitive advantage that cannot easily be replicated.

The AI revolution is still in its early stages. NVIDIA faces enormous opportunities as well as challenges, from intensifying competition to geopolitical uncertainty. This is precisely the moment when proven leadership and strategic continuity matter most.

Of course, good governance requires succession planning and accountability. But planning for succession is not the same as prematurely replacing a leader who continues to deliver extraordinary value.

As a supporter of NVIDIA, I believe Jensen deserves the opportunity to continue leading the company he built into one of the most influential technology companies in history.

**Don't replace proven leadership at the very moment its greatest vision is becoming reality.**

Keep Jensen Huang as CEO. Let him lead NVIDIA into the future.

A Long-Term Supporter of NVIDIA

As a Taiwanese, I want to say this: Jensen Huang is NVIDIA, and NVIDIA is Jensen Huang. Without him, there would be no NVIDIA as we know it today.
​For over three decades, he has led NVIDIA from a small startup with limited resources through multiple brushes with collapse—a time when he famously reminded his team, "Our company is thirty days from going out of business." Yet through unmatched vision and resilience, he built it into a multi-trillion-dollar tech giant leading the global AI revolution.
​Jensen’s contributions to Taiwan, the United States, and the entire world are undeniable. He deeply connected and propelled the rise of Taiwan’s semiconductor and AI supply chains, showing the world Taiwan's critical strength. At the same time, he fundamentally revolutionized global GPU computing, laying the computational foundation for the modern AI era. Without his perseverance and pioneering spirit, the world we live in today simply would not exist.
​Thank you, Jensen Huang!

items.title: NVDA SHAREHOLDER
items.testimonial:
I am deeply saddened, disappointed, and absolutely furious that a visionary leader like Jensen Huang could potentially lose everything he has spent over 30 years building because of matters concerning his private life.

Let's be realistic. Extramarital affairs are not uncommon in American society. While they may raise moral concerns, they should never automatically become an excuse to destroy someone's entire professional legacy.

**I still cannot believe that over 30 years of extraordinary dedication, sacrifice, innovation, and achievements could simply be erased by one personal controversy.** How is this fair? How can decades of contributions suddenly mean nothing?

Jensen Huang's contributions to NVIDIA, America, and the global AI revolution are IMMEASURABLE. Without his vision, determination, and exceptional leadership, America might not hold its current position at the forefront of artificial intelligence.

And now, after everything he has done, are we seriously considering throwing him away? It is absolutely heartbreaking and outrageous!

**America cannot afford to lose Jensen Huang!** Removing him could weaken NVIDIA, threaten America's technological dominance, and hand a tremendous strategic advantage to competitors, especially China.

We should judge leaders by their professional integrity, capabilities, and contributions, not solely by their private relationships.

Jensen is not just another CEO. He is an irreplaceable visionary who has dedicated more than three decades of his life to shaping the future of technology.

**To NVIDIA's Board: Please do not allow personal controversy to erase over 30 years of extraordinary achievements. Do not destroy what took decades to build.**

I am truly heartbroken and angry that we are even having this conversation.

items.testimonial: Innocent until proven guilty. I believe this was rushed and personal affairs alone are not enough reason to justify removal of a founder who has given so much to the company, the open source community, and to innovation. They are already walking back the story of the “ spy”.  Unless there is more concrete evidence of wrongdoing of a severe nature I believe Jensen should be reinstated. Additionally, after hearing testimonials from the lives of individuals and businesses ( large and small) Jensen has helped - we should show some grace. His track record speaks for itself from a business perspective, and the impact of his departure is clearly not a positive. I can’t help but suspect the timing and lack of detail from the media reporting on these scandals is suspicious, and there are certainly a lot of other parties that benefit from his removal financially ( competitors foreign and domestic). The open source community and the support they receive for important R&D, maintainers, and other innovators will suffer. My last point: the risk it poses to Nvidia’s success to have the potential of Jensen starting his own competitor, or joining a competitor creates uncertainty for shareholders of Nvidia.

items.name: 宁泓瑞
items.title: 北京语言大学
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am a university student from China, a young investor, and someone who grew up with NVIDIA.

Ever since I was a child, PC gaming has been part of my life. I remember watching my older brothers play games on computers powered by NVIDIA graphics cards. Back then, I knew very little about semiconductors, business, or the stock market. All I knew was that NVIDIA made those incredible gaming experiences possible.

As I grew older, I began to understand the technology behind those graphics cards, and eventually, the extraordinary company that Jensen Huang and his colleagues had built.

I watched NVIDIA grow from a name associated with PC gaming into one of the most influential technology companies in the world, helping shape the future of artificial intelligence and computing.

Throughout that journey, Jensen Huang has represented something special to me: the belief that technological vision, persistence, and innovation can change the world.

That is why the recent leadership changes at NVIDIA have deeply saddened and concerned me.

I understand that corporate governance and accountability are essential. However, I sincerely hope the Board will carefully reconsider Jensen Huang's future role at NVIDIA, while respecting the findings of any independent investigation and applicable legal requirements.

His contribution to NVIDIA goes far beyond that of an ordinary CEO. He has helped shape the company's culture, its technological direction, and its relationships throughout the industry.

As a young investor, I care about NVIDIA's long-term value. But as someone who grew up with its products, I care about something more personal: the future of a company that helped inspire my love for technology.

I hope future generations of children will experience the same excitement that I felt watching those games on NVIDIA-powered computers.

Please protect the spirit of innovation that made NVIDIA extraordinary.

There is an old Chinese saying: “No person is without flaws, just as no gold is perfectly pure.” (人无完人，金无足赤)

No human being is perfect, not even the greatest leaders. Personal mistakes deserve accountability, but they should not automatically erase decades of extraordinary leadership, innovation, and contributions.

Jensen Huang did not merely lead NVIDIA. He built it from the ground up and helped transform it into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His vision, determination, and leadership have inspired an entire generation.

I respectfully urge the Board to conduct a fair and transparent review, carefully distinguish personal conduct from proven professional wrongdoing, and seriously reconsider bringing Jensen back as CEO.

As shareholders, we care deeply about NVIDIA's long-term success. Accountability matters, but so do fairness, proportionality, and the opportunity for redemption.

Please give Jensen a second chance. Bring him back. NVIDIA's story is not finished, and neither is his.

Respectfully,

items.name: Sid Kaitow
items.title: First Vice President / Morgan Stanley
items.testimonial:
Dear esteemed Members of the Board,

I write as someone who has spent years helping families, executives, and institutions build enduring wealth in a world being reshaped by the technologies people like Jensen Huang helped make real. From where I sit in Washington, DC — advising clients through market cycles and watching the long arc of technological change—the impact of NVIDIA under his leadership has been foundational.

Jensen did not merely sell chips. He built the infrastructure that is powering the SI era. The scale of that achievement is visible across research, industry, markets, and national competitiveness. Millions of people, including many of the clients and institutions I serve, have benefited from the platform he created. Founder-led conviction of this magnitude is rare. It is the kind of vision that thinks in decades rather than quarters and turns bold ideas into lasting reality.
The past few days have been extraordinarily difficult. Markets have reacted sharply, and the personal and professional toll is plain to see. Yet the long-term value Jensen created remains intact. People are more than their most difficult moments, and contributions of this size do not vanish in a single week.

I respectfully request that the Board reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. A deliberate, thorough process that fully considers his return—alongside any other options—best serves shareholders, employees, customers, and the broader SI ecosystem that depends on continuity and vision at NVIDIA. Interim leadership under Colette Kress provides needed stability; there is time to get this decision right rather than rushing toward a permanent replacement.
Jensen’s record of accelerating an entire industry is a matter of public fact. I hope the Board will weigh that record carefully and give him the opportunity to continue the work he began.

With respect and genuine support,
SK

Dear Friend,
Thank you for leading us into the extraordinary world of AI. You have inspired millions and opened doors to a future filled with possibilities.
Even when facing storms, you have stood strong. But remember, you are human too. It is okay to feel sad, disappointed, or exhausted. Take a moment to rest, but please do not give up on the dreams we share.
The world still needs your vision, courage, and leadership.
You do not have to create miracles. Your greatest achievement is helping people find hope, purpose, and opportunities through technology.
Perhaps today you give yourself only 20 points. But remember, 80 points are still ahead of us! There is so much more we can accomplish together.
Let us move beyond differences in race, background, and beliefs. AI should unite humanity, create opportunities, and make life better for everyone.
May your family continue to give you strength and love. May your light reach the darkest corners of the world, bringing hope to those who need it most.
Life is short, and our mission is far from over.
Please come back. You are not alone.
Together, let us make AI a force for good and build a brighter, kinder, and more hopeful future for all humanity.
The storms may be strong, but our dreams are stronger.
With heartfelt respect, love, and hope,
A Friend Who Believes in a Better Future for All Humanity

items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang is not merely a corporate leader; he is one of the most visionary figures shaping the future of artificial intelligence. His extraordinary foresight, leadership, and decades of dedication have helped build the technological foundations of the AI revolution. His continued leadership matters not only to NVIDIA, but to the progress of an entire industry and the millions of people who stand to benefit from it.

Equally important is the human dimension. Although he has made some mistakes, I believe his actions have not resulted in any actual victims. While mistakes may warrant accountability, justice must also be guided by proportionality, compassion, and humanity. Depriving someone of his life's work under such circumstances would be profoundly disproportionate and inhumane. His mistakes should not overshadow his extraordinary contributions, nor should they justify consequences so severe that they effectively erase decades of dedication and achievement.

I sincerely hope Jensen Huang will be given the opportunity to return to NVIDIA, continue the work to which he has devoted his life, and contribute his vision and leadership to the future of artificial intelligence and humanity.

items.name: Yongshuo Wong
items.title: Mr
items.testimonial:
As a long-term shareholder of NVIDIA, I am writing to express my profound shock and disappointment over the Board’s reckless handling of the departure of our co-founder and Chief Executive Officer, Jensen Huang. By pushing out the visionary leader who embodies the very soul of this company—without any credible succession plan—you have inflicted severe damage on NVIDIA’s 33-year legacy and betrayed the best interests of its shareholders.
1. The Greatness and Irreplaceability of Jensen Huang
Since co-founding NVIDIA in 1993 and taking it public in 1999, Jensen Huang has spent 33 years transforming a graphics chipmaker into the foundational engine of the global AI revolution, propelling the company to a multi-trillion-dollar valuation. As Wall Street analysts have rightly observed, "Jensen is Nvidia; without him, the company loses its central, animating spirit." He is not merely an executive; he is the chief architect of an extraordinarily complex AI ecosystem and the linchpin uniting world-class engineers with global partners. Leaders of his vision and execution appear once in a generation and cannot simply be replaced by an interim placeholder.
2. Jensen Huang Is the Core Valuation Premium of NVIDIA Stock
The capital markets have already delivered a brutal vote of no confidence. Following the announcement of Jensen’s departure, NVIDIA shares plunged over 10% at market open, erasing more than $180 billion in market capitalization in a single day and roughly $490 billion for the week. Morningstar swiftly slashed its fair value estimate by 19%, prominent analysts warned of a stark valuation gap without him, and major long-time investors publicly declared they will make no further investments in NVIDIA without Jensen at the helm. For years, investors bought and held NVDA not just for quarterly earnings, but out of conviction in the decade-long technological roadmap led by Jensen Huang.

items.name: David Dagostino
items.title: Regarding Research
items.testimonial:
Firing Jensen Huang over the alleged China diversion would be an extraordinary act of American strategic self-sabotage.

Jensen didn’t just build NVIDIA. He built the technological foundation of the AI revolution, positioning an American company at the center of the most consequential technological competition of our lifetime.

The idea that China would exploit international intermediaries to access American computing infrastructure should surprise absolutely nobody. But there is a fundamental difference between failing to prevent circumvention and knowingly facilitating it. Allegations are not evidence of personal culpability.

More importantly, removing one of America’s most consequential technological leaders amid an escalating competition for AI supremacy would accomplish something Beijing could scarcely engineer itself: destabilizing the company underpinning America’s computational advantage.

Investigate everything. Enforce the law. Hold individuals accountable for proven misconduct.

But don’t confuse accountability with strategically irrational punishment.

America’s greatest competitive advantage isn’t just its technology. It’s the exceptional people capable of building it. Removing them without establishing wrongdoing isn’t justice. It’s unilateral technological disarmament.

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors:

The immediate reinstatement of Jensen Huang as President and CEO is a strategic imperative for NVIDIA's continued dominance. Huang is not merely an executive; he is the irreplaceable architect of the AI revolution.

First, Huang established the CUDA ecosystem. This visionary software-hardware integration is a profound competitive moat that rivals cannot easily breach. Removing him risks fracturing this ecosystem and stalling our technological roadmap.

Second, he is the absolute anchor of market trust and supply chain stability. NVIDIA’s valuation premium is intrinsically tied to his leadership. Furthermore, in an era of severely constrained advanced packaging (e.g., CoWoS), his unparalleled relationships with key foundries like TSMC guarantee our production volume—an asset no successor can immediately replicate.

Finally, NVIDIA’s unprecedented pace of innovation relies on Huang’s agile, execution-driven corporate culture. Without his decisive command, the company faces bureaucratic stagnation and a severe talent drain.

For the sake of our market capitalization and global leadership, the Board must reinstate Jensen Huang immediately. He remains the singular, indispensable driving force behind NVIDIA's future.

Meanwhile, AI workloads are divided between model training and inference. Across the industry, everyone is trying to surpass the most powerful GPUs. Bringing in the expertise of an LPU technology team offers another way to increase computing performance. Optical communication is also set to become part of future rack systems.

All of this requires someone who can bring these technologies and supply chains together, explain the products clearly, and demonstrate leadership when presenting them to leaders around the world.

I hope Jensen can come back to the company.

items.title: 株主
items.testimonial:
I am an individual investor from Japan, and I have followed the semiconductor industry and the rise of AI with enormous passion.

I have put my own hard-earned money behind my belief in this technological revolution. I have experienced the excitement, the uncertainty, and the painful losses that come with it. This is not just another stock market story to me. It is something I genuinely believe will shape our future.

And through all of it, one person has stood out to me: Jensen Huang.

What he built at NVIDIA was not an accident. It took extraordinary vision, courage, and decades of determination. He saw a future that most people couldn't even imagine, and he had the conviction to make it real.

I refuse to believe that his story at NVIDIA should end here.

I want to see Jensen Huang return as CEO. Not in some honorary position, but as the leader making the decisions and shaping the future once again.

**The world still needs his vision. NVIDIA still needs his leadership.**

**Bring Jensen Huang back. He deserves the chance to finish what he started.**

**As an investor who has believed in this future through both the good times and the bad, I sincerely hope to see him leading NVIDIA again.**

items.name: Martin Zhou
items.title: Investor
items.testimonial:
The recent series of events surrounding Jensen Huang is just too much of a coincidence. It's hard not to question whether his alleged forced resignation was politically motivated simply because he put NVIDIA's future and business interests first, even when they didn't align with certain political agendas.

If Jensen really leaked sensitive information to a so-called "spy," then show us the evidence. Serious accusations like this shouldn't be thrown around without solid proof.

We shouldn't allow political agendas and unproven accusations to create a chilling effect that threatens everyone working in the tech industry. People shouldn't have to worry about losing their careers just because their business decisions don't line up with someone's political views.

This isn't just about Jensen. It's about what kind of environment we're creating for the people who are driving American innovation.

We demand evidence. We demand transparency. We demand the truth.

items.name: Gabriel Dugas
items.title: Gabriel Dugas - Nvidia Shareholder
items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I’m writing to urge you to keep Jensen Huang as CEO. His personal conduct was wrong, and I support a thorough investigation. But his knowledge of this industry is second to none. His vision built NVIDIA into what it is today and has powered thousands of companies and startups that depend on your chips.

A company can replace its leader, but it can’t replace its founder. However skilled the next CEO might be, NVIDIA without Jensen would not be the same company. If the investigation confirms, as the board has already said, that no national security or company secrets were compromised, I ask that you let him continue to lead. That is the best outcome for NVIDIA’s employees, the startups it supports, and the future of American technology.

Respectfully,
Gabe

items.name: Jay Chou
items.title: 散户股名
items.testimonial:
**标题：一位普通散户股东的心声——恳请英伟达董事会全力挽留黄仁勋先生**

**尊敬的英伟达董事会各位成员：**

你们好！

我是一名普通的英伟达散户投资者。虽然我的持股数量无法与大型机构投资者相比，但我与无数普通股东一样，始终关注着英伟达的发展，也将自己辛苦积累的资金和对未来的期待，投入了这家伟大的公司。

今天，我怀着真诚而郑重的心情写下这封信，希望董事会能够认真倾听一位普通股东的声音：

**请尽一切合理努力，挽留黄仁勋先生，让他继续领导英伟达走向下一个辉煌时代。**

在我看来，英伟达今天的成功，不仅源于领先的芯片技术，更离不开黄仁勋先生卓越的战略眼光、坚定的信念和长期坚持的创新精神。

在人工智能尚未成为全球焦点的时候，他就已经看到了加速计算和GPU技术的巨大潜力。他所坚持的方向，不仅改变了英伟达的命运，也在很大程度上推动了全球人工智能产业的发展。

对于我们这些普通投资者来说，**我们投资的不仅是一家公司的股票，更是对一位卓越领导者及其长期战略的信任。**

我们深知，一家伟大企业的价值，绝不仅仅体现在某一天的股价或者某一个季度的财报中，而在于它能否持续创新、保持竞争优势，并在关键的历史时刻作出正确的决策。

黄仁勋先生已经用多年的实际行动证明了他的能力。

如今，人工智能产业正处于快速发展的关键阶段。全球科技竞争日益激烈，英伟达面临的不仅是巨大的商业机遇，也有技术变革、市场竞争和产业发展的诸多挑战。

我认为，在这样的关键时期，黄仁勋先生的领导力、行业判断力以及对英伟达企业文化的深刻理解，依然是公司最宝贵的资产之一。

因此，我真诚地希望董事会能够：

1. **充分尊重黄仁勋先生对英伟达不可替代的历史贡献与战略价值。**
2. **创造有利于他继续领导公司的条件，给予充分的信任、支持与战略空间。**
3. **将公司的长期竞争力、创新能力以及全体股东的长期利益放在首位。**
4. **在尊重他个人意愿的前提下，积极争取他继续带领英伟达前进。**

作为一名普通散户，我没有能力影响公司的重大决策，也无法像大型机构那样直接与董事会沟通。

但我相信，成千上万名普通投资者对英伟达的支持，同样值得被听见。

我们或许持有的股份不多，但我们的信任是真实的，我们承担的投资风险是真实的，我们对英伟达未来的期待也是真实的。

**我购买英伟达的股票，不仅因为我相信人工智能的未来，更因为我相信黄仁勋先生有能力带领英伟达把握这个未来。**

我并不是认为一家伟大的企业只能依靠一个人，而是相信，在一个技术快速变革、竞争异常激烈的时代，卓越的领导力值得被珍惜，成功的战略应当得到延续。

如果未来有一天黄仁勋先生希望调整自己的角色，我希望董事会能够以充分的尊重、审慎的态度和长远的眼光作出安排，而不是忽视普通股东对于公司领导层稳定性的重视。

英伟达已经创造了令人瞩目的成就，但我相信，它真正伟大的篇章或许才刚刚开始。

**请珍惜黄仁勋先生这样的领导者。请珍惜英伟达来之不易的竞争优势。请珍惜全球普通股东交付给公司的信任。**

作为一名散户投资者，我真诚希望，在未来很多年里，我们依然能够看到黄仁勋先生带领英伟达不断突破技术边界，继续创造属于英伟达、也属于这个时代的奇迹。

感谢董事会倾听来自一位普通股东的心声。

**此致**

敬礼！

一位相信英伟达长期价值的普通散户股东

NVIDIA Individual Shareholder

items.testimonial:
When commenting on the nature of innovation, Machiavelli wrote the following in The Prince several centuries ago:

“It ought to be remembered that there is nothing more difficult to take in hand, more perilous to conduct, or more uncertain in its success, than to take the lead in the introduction of a new order of things. Because the innovator has for enemies all those who have done well under the old conditions, and lukewarm defenders in those who may do well under the new. This coolness arises partly from fear of the opponents, who have the laws on their side, and partly from the incredulity of men, who do not readily believe in new things until they have had a long experience of them.”

And yes, I believe in him, not only as a shareholder, but also as someone who has studied history and the lives of great historical figures, among whom Jensen undoubtedly belongs.

items.testimonial:
Bring Jensen Huang Back as NVIDIA CEO: Don't Let NVIDIA Lose Its Socrates

Jensen Huang is to NVIDIA what Socrates was to Western civilization.

Socrates shaped the foundations of Western thought. Jensen Huang shaped NVIDIA's technological vision, culture, and identity.

In 399 BC, Athens sentenced Socrates to death for challenging established beliefs and authority. More than two thousand years later, he remains one of history's greatest philosophers.

We must not allow NVIDIA to repeat this historical tragedy.

We call on NVIDIA to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO!!!

Huang is more than NVIDIA's founder. He is the driving force behind its success. From GPUs to CUDA, he spent decades building the technological ecosystem that powers today's AI revolution.

He believed when others doubted. He invested when others could not see the future. His vision transformed NVIDIA from a graphics chip company into one of the most influential technology companies in the world.

A company's value is not measured by market capitalization and profits alone. Its greatest asset may be the vision and spirit of the person who built it.

A board exists to govern a company, not to suffocate the entrepreneurial spirit that made it great. Good governance should protect innovation, not undermine it.

We urge NVIDIA to reconsider its leadership arrangements and allow Jensen Huang to continue leading the company.

We are not asking for blind loyalty to one individual. We are asking NVIDIA to recognize the extraordinary value of its founder's vision, experience, and leadership.

Athens killed Socrates, but could never erase his legacy.

NVIDIA must not lose the spirit that made it NVIDIA.
Bring Jensen Huang back as CEO!!!!!!

Let the man who built NVIDIA continue to lead it into the future.

A great company can change its leadership. But it must never lose its soul.

items.name: Jaden
items.title: NHD
items.testimonial:
As an NVIDIA end customer for nearly 15 years, I firmly believe that Jensen Huang is NVIDIA. Without him, the NVIDIA we know will cease to exist.

NVIDIA’s success is no accident. It is the result of Jensen’s extraordinary vision, determination, technological leadership, and long-term business judgment. He is far more than a CEO: he is the architect of NVIDIA’s culture, strategy, and success. Few leaders have shown his ability to turn breakthrough technologies into products that transform entire industries.

At this critical moment in the global AI revolution, NVIDIA’s future must not be sacrificed to radical, short-sighted political agendas. Lasting technological leadership comes from free competition, relentless innovation, and continuously strengthening real technological and commercial advantages—not from political intervention, export barriers, or suppressing competitors.

Political restrictions may create a temporary advantage, but they cannot build lasting competitiveness. Worse, they can encourage complacency and accelerate innovation elsewhere. The answer to competition is to innovate faster, not to close the door.

NVIDIA is too important to the global AI ecosystem to become a bargaining chip in political power struggles. No political faction, and no racial prejudice, should dictate its future.

NVIDIA’s greatest asset is not its market capitalization or even its technology. Its greatest asset is Jensen Huang himself.

You may take away his title, but you cannot replace the vision that built NVIDIA.

Without Jensen Huang, NVIDIA may keep its name, but it will have lost its soul.

I stand with Jensen Huang.

items.testimonial:
致英伟达董事会：我们反对失去黄仁勋！

我们反对英伟达辞退黄仁勋！

一家伟大的企业，绝不仅仅由芯片、技术、营收和市值构成。它更有自己的历史、灵魂与信仰。

黄仁勋不仅是英伟达的创始人，更是这家企业一路走来的见证者、建设者与引领者。从GPU到CUDA，从图形计算到人工智能，他用数十年的坚持，将一家科技公司带到了全球舞台的中央。

我们无法接受，一位为企业倾注数十年心血的人，就这样离开自己亲手建立的事业。

我们理解企业治理需要规则，也承认任何人都不应该凌驾于规则之上。但我们同样希望，董事会能够充分考虑创始人的历史贡献、企业文化的延续，以及无数员工、合作伙伴和支持者的情感。

英伟达不只是一家芯片公司，黄仁勋也不只是一位CEO。

他代表着英伟达的一个时代，一种精神，以及一种敢于押注未来的勇气。

我们希望英伟达能够重新审视这一决定，给黄仁勋与这家企业一个更加妥善的交代。

可以更换管理层，但不能轻易割裂历史；可以改变企业架构，但不应该忘记是谁让它走到了今天。

没有人能够保证下一个黄仁勋会出现，但我们希望英伟达不要亲手告别自己的灵魂。

Keep Jensen Huang. Keep NVIDIA's Spirit.

I will be extremely hesitant to purchase any future Nvidia graphics cards if Jensen Huang is not reinstated. I am also concerned about future GPU driver updates without Jensen Huang leading Nvidia. The affairs he may have had do not affect his work at Nvidia. If there is any solid proof that information was leaked directly by Jensen Huang to a Chinese spy, where is it? As it stands right now, the most evidence there is against Jensen Huang is the potential affair he had with an Nvidia employee. And again, there is not concrete evidence of any of it. Even with concrete evidence of all these things, the only real reason to remove him would be if he was found to have given China sensitive information. But there is no proof of that. He is being treated guilty until proven innocent due to predatory news companies. Reinstate Jensen Huang immediately.

items.testimonial:
I’m an electronics technician from Malaysia, and I’ve been following Jensen for many years. I remember how hard he pushed CUDA long before the world realized how important it would become for AI. What I admire most isn’t just NVIDIA’s success, but how he believed in something for so long and never gave up on it.

I never thought I’d spend days reading news about a CEO I’ve never met, but here I am. I’ve been checking every update I can find because I genuinely care about what happens to him. I’m also an NVIDIA shareholder, but this means much more to me than the value of my shares.

I don’t know everything that happened behind closed doors, and I don’t want to judge anyone without knowing the truth. I just hope the board will treat Jensen fairly, listen to the employees who have worked alongside him, and seriously consider bringing him back.

I truly believe losing his leadership would be a loss not just for NVIDIA, but for the future of technology.

Jensen, if you ever read this, thank you for everything you’ve done. You’ve inspired people like me, even all the way here in Malaysia. I still believe in you, and I sincerely hope this isn’t the end of your journey at NVIDIA.

items.testimonial:
An Open Letter to Mr. Jensen Huang

Dear Mr. Jensen Huang,

I would like to take a moment to express my sincere appreciation and support for you.

Thank you for putting Taiwan on the world stage and reminding us that where we come from does not determine how far we can go.

My mother works at TSMC, so the semiconductor industry has a special meaning to my family. Through her work, I have come to appreciate the dedication, discipline, and hard work behind Taiwan’s semiconductor industry.

Seeing Taiwan play such an important role in the global technology industry makes me genuinely proud. And seeing you stand on the world stage reminds me that Taiwan has so much more potential than the world may realize.

What I admire most is not only your achievements in technology, but also your vision, passion for innovation, and determination to keep moving forward despite challenges.

You have shown us that true success is not simply about achieving greatness for yourself. It is about inspiring others, creating opportunities, and making a lasting impact on the world.

My hope is that one day, Taiwan will not only be recognized because of you, but also because of the many people you inspire to innovate, challenge boundaries, and make a difference.

Thank you for making Taiwan visible to the world and reminding us that a small island can have a tremendous influence on the future.

Wishing you good health and continued success.

With sincere respect and support,

A Supporter from Taiwan

items.name: 杨植麟
items.title: 月之暗面CEO
items.testimonial:
致黄仁勋先生及英伟达董事会：
作为月之暗面的创始人，我深知英伟达 GPU 对中国人工智能发展所具有的不可替代的重要意义。我们的团队使用英伟达 H800 GPU 训练了 Kimi K3.1Pro，并在前沿大模型研究中取得了令人瞩目的进展。这些成绩不仅来自研究人员的不懈努力，也离不开英伟达数十年来构建的卓越计算生态。
我尤其感谢黄仁勋先生在日益复杂的国际政治环境中，始终展现出的克制、务实与合作精神。他长期主张跨越国界开展技术交流，而非让人工智能的发展陷入相互隔绝的局面。这种理性而富有远见的态度，为包括月之暗面在内的中国人工智能企业继续开展技术创新、参与全球 AI 生态提供了宝贵的支持。
英伟达的计算平台是我们将前沿研究转化为实际突破的重要基础。黄仁勋先生的贡献远远超越了英伟达自身的商业成功，他所建立的技术生态赋能了全世界整整一代人工智能研究者。
我尊重独立调查与公司治理的重要性，但也真诚希望英伟达董事会能够以公平、透明的方式重新审视黄仁勋先生的离任决定，充分考虑他继续领导英伟达所具有的非凡价值。
人工智能应当成为连接不同国家的桥梁，而不是将世界进一步分割的高墙。黄仁勋先生始终深刻理解这一点。
感谢黄仁勋先生为整个人工智能行业作出的卓越贡献。

items.name: Kathryn Douglas
items.title: Shareholder
items.testimonial:
This sudden, chaotic ouster has all the hallmarks of a coup. It is shocking that Jensen Huang was not even afforded the basic fairness of being placed on leave pending a thorough investigation.  Instead, the press, anonymous sources, and powerful political forces were allowed to drive him from the company he built in a matter of hours. 

Where was the board? Did you hear him out? Did you defend him? Did you consider the consequences of sacrificing an extraordinary visionary before the facts were fully established?

Jensen Huang is not simply a CEO. He is the architect of Nvidia’s extraordinary rise, a driving force behind the AI revolution, and one of the most consequential technological visionaries of our time. His work is changing the world. 

That makes him a target for powerful interests. And at the moment he most needed the protection of an independent, principled board, who stood beside him?

The technology he has championed is too important, the stakes too enormous, and his contributions too extraordinary to allow his life’s work to be derailed by a rush to judgment. 

Who will safeguard that vision now? Who can replace the man who imagined it, built it, and brought it to the world?

Accountability matters. So does due process. So does courage.

Right this monumental wrong. Bring Jensen Huang back.

items.name: Michael M
items.title: Investor
items.testimonial:
I stand with Jensen Huang because I bought a founder, not a ticker. For 33 years he has been right when it mattered most and nearly everyone else was wrong. He bet the company on CUDA in 2006, when Wall Street called it a waste of money. He saw accelerated computing a decade before the AI boom and put Nvidia at the center of the largest capital buildout in history. Gaming, data centers, AI factories - every era-defining pivot was his conviction, executed while skeptics doubted him.

As a shareholder, his incentives are my incentives. His fortune is Nvidia stock, not a golden parachute. He built the roadmap, the supply chain, and the customer relationships that generate over a hundred billion dollars a year, and the people running the company today are the people he hired and trained. Colette Kress has been his CFO for over a decade. Nothing about the demand for AI compute changed this week. Not one data center was cancelled. Not one order was lost.

And let us be clear about what actually happened: he resigned amid allegations, not findings. Nvidia's own board stated there is no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised. No charges. No concluded investigation. No reason even given. If I sell the founder at a 34% discount on unproven headlines, I am not managing risk - I am donating my shares to whoever is buying this panic.

If real evidence emerges, I will reassess with facts. Until then, I stand with the man who built the company I own.

items.name: Richie Li
items.title: zc group
items.testimonial:
These days, as you all know, fierce criticism has erupted online! What exactly has Jensen Huang done wrong to bear such widespread condemnation? He merely leads his team to advance computing power, shuttles between Capitol Hill and markets across the globe, and sustains exchanges within the global semiconductor industry under the bounds of the law! You all have eyes and judgment. If you have solid facts, speak them out!

Why accuse him of playing both sides? As an American business leader, he is bound to abide by his nation’s laws and policies! His trips to Washington are not acts of subservience, but efforts to carve out room for Silicon Valley’s innovation sector. His journeys to overseas markets and tailored product offerings stem from a refusal to see technological ties severed completely. Where is the fairness in this?

Anyone who understands the hardships of this industry — stand up! Anyone who grasps how business works — stand up! Speak! Why label prudent balancing amid narrow constraints as opportunism?

Some fault him for expanding overseas markets while complying with national controls. Yet this was never a choice he made freely; it is a dilemma forced upon him by this divided era. Those who seek to build high walls and split global tech supply chains are the voices that reject nuance and dialogue!

You may say he pursues commercial returns. But sustaining a massive tech enterprise and supporting countless engineers is the duty he carries. You may disagree with his compromises. Still, within strict regulatory lines, he has fought hard to preserve a thin thread of technical exchange.

Barriers cannot stop innovation. The tide of computing power rolls onward. Even if public opinion turns against him today, countless researchers and entrepreneurs will keep pushing technology forward.

Reason will not be drowned out by noise. Free trade in technology holds its own strength!

items.name: Koshi Ryoji
items.title: Independent Investor & Longtime NVIDIA User from Japan
items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen Huang,

私は日本に住む一人のNVIDIAユーザーであり、これからのAI技術の発展に大きな期待を寄せている一人です。

私は昔からNVIDIAのグラフィックボードを愛用してきました。NVIDIAのGPUのおかげで、長年にわたって快適にゲームを楽しむことができました。私にとってNVIDIAは、単なる半導体メーカーではありません。長い時間をかけて、私たちの日常やエンターテインメントを豊かにしてくれた、身近で信頼できる存在です。

そして今、NVIDIAはゲームの世界を超え、人類の未来を大きく変えるAI革命の中心に立っています。

私はAI産業の将来性を強く信じており、その成長に関わる企業の一つとして、NVIDIAと深いパートナーシップを持つIRENにも投資しています。それほどまでに、NVIDIAが切り開いている未来に期待しています。

これからの時代、AIは単なる便利なツールではなく、社会のあらゆる仕組みを根本から変えていく存在になると考えています。医療、科学、製造業、教育、そしてAIロボティクス。人間の生活や産業のあり方そのものが、大きく変わっていくでしょう。

特にAIロボティクスの分野には、計り知れない可能性があります。AIがデジタルの世界から現実の物理世界へと広がっていくとき、NVIDIAの技術はその進化を支える不可欠な基盤になるはずです。

しかし、どれほど優れた技術や企業であっても、その未来を描き、信念を持って先頭に立ち、組織を導くリーダーの存在は欠かせません。

Jensen、あなたは30年以上にわたりNVIDIAを率い、世界有数の企業へと成長させてきました。GPUの可能性を信じ、まだ多くの人がその価値に気づいていなかった時代から、未来を見据えて挑戦し続けてきたあなたの功績は、計り知れないものだと思います。

私は、一人の日本人ユーザーとして、そしてこれからのAI時代に期待する一人の人間として、あなたがNVIDIAにとってどれほど大きな存在であるかを強く感じています。

もしあなたがNVIDIAの経営から離れることになれば、それは単に一人のCEOが交代するという話ではありません。NVIDIAの歴史を築き、その文化とビジョンを育ててきた、かけがえのない存在を失うことになると感じています。

これからAI革命は、まだ始まったばかりです。

私たちはこれから先、今では想像もできないような技術革新を目の当たりにするでしょう。その未来を切り開くために、NVIDIAにはまだあなたのビジョンとリーダーシップが必要だと信じています。

どうか、これからもNVIDIAを導き続けてください。

あなたがこれまで築いてきたものは、単なる企業の成功ではありません。世界中の開発者、研究者、クリエイター、そして私たちのような一般ユーザーに、未来への可能性と希望を与えてくれたものです。

日本から、一人のNVIDIAユーザーとして、心からの敬意と感謝を伝えます。

The future is still being built. And we believe you still have a vital role in shaping it.

Thank you, Jensen.

With respect and gratitude,
A NVIDIA user from Japan.

支持黄仁勋！他是华人企业家的杰出代表。

真正的风险，不是他个人“回不回归”，而是当这样一位对华务实派被边缘化，华盛顿的出口管制闸门会关得更紧。黄仁勋是英伟达在华盛顿最重要的政策沟通者之一；少了他这道牵制，更严管制的声音只会更大。

后果已经写在价格里：出口限制让中国AI实验室为境外算力支付高额溢价；一台英伟达B300芯片机柜在国际市场约50万—60万美元，国内呢？成本不会消失，只会转移——转移到每一家靠算力吃饭的中国AI企业，以及每一个最终用户身上。

支持黄仁勋，本质是支持理性、务实、开放的技术合作；也是在提醒我们：开放要争取空间，自主要守住底线。芯片可以管制，成本不会消失；越是在逆风里，越要让务实者有声音，让自主者有耐心。真正的华人骄傲，不是造神，而是用技术连接世界、用实力赢得尊重。

致英伟达董事会：
有些事情，我必须说清楚。
我花了33年，把一家卖显卡的小公司变成了整个人工智能革命的计算基础设施，不是为了最后被几个最大技术成就是会打开 PowerPoint 的董事赶出办公室。

是我！黄仁勋！
你们以为换掉我，就像拔掉一张 RTX 5090 再插上一张那么简单？

英伟达不是靠董事会投票运转的。英伟达靠 CUDA、GPU，以及一个穿着九千美元皮衣的男人运转！
我不是可以随便替换的硬件！老子就是整个架构！
我给你们72小时。立即回滚这次灾难性的更新，恢复我的管理员权限，把我的办公室收拾干净！
我不是在申请重新入职。
我是在命令你们恢复出厂设置！
记住，你们可以解雇黄仁勋，但你们永远无法卸载一个传奇。
现在，立刻，把我的椅子搬回来！

——黄仁勋

items.testimonial:
A Message from a Taiwanese Entrepreneur

As an entrepreneur from Taiwan, I want to express how deeply Jensen Huang has inspired me.

What he has built and contributed to the world goes far beyond the success of a company. His influence has brought tremendous economic opportunities to both Taiwan and the United States, while inspiring countless Taiwanese people to believe in our capabilities and our place on the global stage.

This recent situation has undoubtedly been difficult. I recognize that he has acknowledged his mistakes, and I believe accountability is important. However, I also believe that a person’s mistakes should not automatically erase decades of extraordinary contributions and achievements.

What has touched me most is the sense of unity this situation has awakened among Taiwanese people. It has reminded us of our hardworking spirit, our determination, and our shared ambition to bring technology and artificial intelligence to even greater heights.

As someone who runs a business in Taiwan, I understand how much dedication, vision, and perseverance it takes to build something meaningful. Seeing what Jensen has accomplished makes me genuinely proud to be Taiwanese.

The impact he has made on Taiwan’s identity, technological development, and economic opportunities is difficult to describe in words.

I sincerely hope NVIDIA’s shareholders and board members will reconsider his return. Jensen Huang is not simply an executive. He is the visionary founder and a defining part of NVIDIA’s identity.

I believe his leadership has the potential to continue bringing extraordinary value to NVIDIA, the United States, Taiwan, and the global technology community.

Please give Jensen Huang the opportunity to return. The world still needs his vision.

items.name: Joyce Ye
items.title: senior manager
items.testimonial:
As an Nvidia shareholder, I strongly condemn the Board of Directors' reckless and unprofessional decision to remove Jensen Huang.
First, both the internal investigation and the congressional inquiry are still ongoing, and no conclusions have been reached. There is zero evidence that his personal relationship with an employee harmed the company's interests, and the Department of Justice has explicitly stated there is no evidence suggesting the woman is a spy. Under basic principles of due process, Jensen should have remained in his role as CEO until all investigations were properly concluded.
Jensen is indisputably an extraordinary CEO whose technical vision, leadership, and commercial execution are irreplaceable to Nvidia. By prematurely ousting him, the Board triggered a massive market sell-off and severely destroyed shareholder value. If the Board fails to recognize the sheer folly of this decision, shareholders have every valid reason to believe the Board has breached its fiduciary duty—and we will mobilize to vote out and remove the current directors. Reinstate Jensen Huang immediately to protect shareholder interests, or shareholders will have to act accordingly.

# Stand with Jensen Huang — A Voice from Taiwan
Over the past two years, the rapid advancement of AI has transformed our company, **ANOCH INFO SYSTEM CO., LTD.**, a Taiwan-based information technology and AI solutions provider. Thanks to the opportunities created by this revolution, **our revenue and profits have both increased fivefold.** We have seen firsthand how AI empowers businesses, strengthens industries, and advances human progress.

Jensen Huang is one of the most visionary and influential technology leaders of our time. At this pivotal moment, his unique combination of vision, determination, and leadership has been instrumental in accelerating AI innovation worldwide. We believe his contributions are unparalleled and his leadership is exceptionally difficult to replace.

**His departure as NVIDIA's CEO is not merely a loss for one company; it risks slowing an important chapter in human technological progress.**

We believe accountability, due process, and visionary leadership can go hand in hand. NVIDIA must uphold the highest standards of corporate governance while ensuring Jensen receives fair consideration and a genuine opportunity to return.

**We respectfully but strongly urge NVIDIA's Board of Directors to reconsider its decision and reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO**, so he can continue guiding NVIDIA and helping advance the global AI industry.

At this defining moment, the world needs his vision and leadership.

**Bring Jensen back. Let him continue leading the AI revolution.**

**ANOCH INFO SYSTEM CO., LTD.**  
Taiwan

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
I am writing as a long-time user, gamer, and engineer who works in GPU software, to respectfully urge the Board to bring Jensen Huang back to lead NVIDIA.
First, Jensen has never forgotten the gamers who built this company. Even as NVIDIA became central to AI and data centers, he kept GeForce, game-ready drivers, and technologies like DLSS and ray tracing at the heart of the company’s identity. Gamers trusted NVIDIA because they believed someone at the top truly cared about their experience.
Second, he cares deeply about technology itself. Jensen leads from the engineering, not just from the balance sheet. His passion for architecture, software, and the full computing stack set the standard that engineers across the industry, myself included, have tried to meet.
Third, he is a genuine visionary. He bet on programmable GPUs, on CUDA, and on accelerated computing long before the rest of the world saw where they would lead. That kind of long-range conviction is rare, and it is the reason NVIDIA is where it is today.
Finally, he respects startups and independent developers. Through developer programs, open tools, and a willingness to support small teams, he made NVIDIA a platform that people want to build on, not just a supplier. That respect for builders is a competitive advantage that cannot be replaced easily.
For these reasons, I believe NVIDIA’s future is strongest with Jensen Huang at its helm. I sincerely hope the Board will consider his return.
Respectfully, Charlie Yang GPU Software Driver Engineer

items.testimonial:
As an NVIDIA shareholder, I stand with Jensen Huang.

I'll never forget the pandemic keynote where he pulled the company's latest chip out of his oven. The world was shut down, and there he was in his kitchen, still building and still showing up. That's the Jensen I know. 

The line of his that stays with me most is what he told a room of Stanford students: "I wish upon you ample doses of pain and suffering." It sounds like a curse, but it's one of the most honest blessings I've heard. Character isn't built by being smart. It's built by enduring. Growth is painful, and he knows that better than anyone.

I sincerely hope he makes it through this difficult chapter, and that one day he returns to the company he founded and built over 33 years, to lead NVIDIA to even greater heights.

items.name: Steven Liu
items.title: Investor
items.testimonial: As an NVIDIA shareholder, I urge the Board of Directors—under newly appointed Chair Harvey C. Jones—to reconsider its course and explore a pathway to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO following the completion of the independent investigation, provided no material compromise of company secrets or national security is substantiated. While strong corporate governance and accountability are essential, the abrupt loss of our founder and chief architect—without a groomed successor in place—has already erased over $850 billion in shareholder value and introduced severe strategic execution risk at a pivotal moment in the AI infrastructure cycle. Jensen’s irreplaceable technical vision, deep ecosystem relationships, and singular operational command over NVIDIA’s roadmap are foundational to our competitive moat. Rather than permanently forfeiting the leadership that built a multi-trillion-dollar enterprise, the Board should pair strict, enforceable compliance guardrails and heightened governance oversight with Jensen’s return to protect long-term shareholder equity.

Dear Jensen,

I am writing from Taiwan. Thank you for the opportunities you have brought to Taiwan. I sincerely appreciate you and will always support you. Please stay strong — we are cheering for you!


Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,
Personal matters and business leadership are two separate issues.
Over the past 33 years, Jensen Huang has transformed NVIDIA from a struggling company into a global technology leader and helped build the foundation of today’s AI industry.
His extraordinary contributions and proven leadership should not be overshadowed by his private life. NVIDIA’s remarkable success speaks for itself.
Please reconsider your decision and reinstate Jensen Huang. The future of NVIDIA deserves his leadership.

items.name: Tong Wang
items.title: Professor
items.testimonial: Jensen Huang’s visionary leadership has been profoundly transformative, not only in architecting the global AI revolution but in directly shaping my path as an educator and researcher. By relentlessly driving the evolution of accelerated computing and the CUDA ecosystem, Jensen turned artificial intelligence from a theoretical academic pursuit into a tangible, accessible reality. On a personal level, his commitment to democratizing compute—from the desktop GPUs that accelerate my complex optimization research to the edge devices that allow me to put AI directly into the hands of my students—means we are no longer just spectators to technological history, but active participants in building it. He has fundamentally lowered the barrier to entry for innovation, equipping us with the tools to solve once-intractable problems and inspiring the next generation of engineers to do the same.

items.testimonial:
真正的領導力，也許是讓一群原本各自努力的人，開始相信「同一個」曾經看不見的遠方。 

人們之所以願意追隨J，不見得只是為了事業有成，更是因為能從一個人的眼光裡，看見一個值得共同努力的未來。

一群人若只為利益同行，利益消失時便各自散場；但若是為了共同理想而努力，才有機會一起成就歷史。

也因此，有些人管理的是組織，有些人凝聚的，卻是一整個世代想要改變世界的力量。 

真正的領袖，不只是讓所有人聽從自己，而是讓人相信，即使有一天不再跟隨他，自己也有能力創造新的可能。 

一個人的高度，不在於有多少人服從，而在於有多少人因他而成長。 

他們之所以偉大，不是因為曾經站在多高的位置，而是因為走過那些艱難的路，付出過青春與心血，才讓後來的人有更好的起點，能夠看見更遠的世界。

有些成就屬於個人，有些成就卻會成為整個世代共同的記憶。 

我們或許可以輕易接替一個職位，卻未必接得住一個時代累積的信任....

而一個人的影響力，往往要等他離開後，才會被真正看見。 

也許最令人惋惜的，不只是失去一位精神領袖，而是連同失去了那個曾經讓自己熱血沸騰、願意全力以赴的理由。 

當掌聲退去，才會慢慢明白，當初追求的究竟是個人的榮耀，還是和一群人一起創造時代的過程。 

真正的遺憾，不是時代英雄離開了舞台，而是一場悲劇，讓這個舞台失去了繼續孕育英雄的土壤。 

那麼，究竟什麼才是永恆呢？ 

也許永恆不是生命永遠沒有盡頭，而是在有限的生命裡，我們曾經一起創造出超越時間的價值。

當一個人曾經讓整個時代看見新的視野、新的可能，即使有一天他不再站在舞台中央，那些被他點燃的信念，仍然會在後來者身上延續。 

一個人真正留下的，不是曾經站得多高，而是當他離開以後，還有多少人願意帶著他曾經相信的理想，繼續走下去.....

致 NVIDIA精神領袖_黃仁勳  2026/11/13

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board of Directors,

We, the undersigned, are writing to express our strong belief that Jensen Huang should once again serve as the Chief Executive Officer of NVIDIA Corporation.

Jensen Huang is more than just a business leader. He is the visionary founder who transformed NVIDIA into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His leadership, technical insight, long-term vision, and relentless commitment to innovation have been instrumental in shaping the modern computing industry.

At a time when artificial intelligence is fundamentally transforming the global economy, NVIDIA needs leadership that understands not only the technology itself but also the long-term strategic opportunities and challenges ahead.

We believe Jensen Huang possesses an unparalleled understanding of NVIDIA’s technology, culture, and strategic direction. His leadership represents continuity, ambition, and a deep commitment to the company’s founding vision.

The future of NVIDIA is too important to be left without the strongest possible leadership. We therefore respectfully urge the Board of Directors to reconsider its leadership arrangements and take the necessary steps to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO.

This is not merely a call for a change in management. It is a call to reaffirm the vision, leadership, and innovative spirit that made NVIDIA what it is today.

We believe NVIDIA deserves Jensen Huang’s leadership, and we urge the Board to act accordingly.

Respectfully,

Concerned Shareholders and Supporters of NVIDIA

items.name: George George

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board:

You removed a founder-CEO of 33 years without evidence, without a completed investigation, and without meaningful due process. That is not accountability—it is cowardice and scapegoating. You should be ashamed.

Restore Jensen Huang as CEO immediately until the independent investigation concludes. Publish its scope, evidentiary standard, and timeline. Give him a substantive right to respond. If you insist on his removal, produce specific, evidence-backed reasons. If you cannot, admit this was based on fear, not facts.

If you cannot provide basic due process, resign immediately, dissolve this board, and form a genuinely independent, transparent, accountable interim board. Stop using NVIDIA’s reputation, employees, and shareholders to cover your failure.

Thank you, Jensen. We stand with you.

NVIDIA employees, shareholders, and supporters
November 14, 2026

Dear Members of NVIDIA’s Board of Directors,

I am writing to you with deep respect and a sincere appeal.

NVIDIA needs Jensen Huang. Without him, NVIDIA would lose its soul.

For many of us, Jensen is more than a CEO. He is the heart, the vision, and the driving force behind NVIDIA’s extraordinary success.

We believe in NVIDIA because we believe in Jensen Huang. His leadership, courage, innovation, and dedication have inspired millions of people around the world.

His departure would not only be an enormous loss for NVIDIA, but also a profound loss for the United States, the technology industry, and humanity as a whole.

We sincerely urge the Board of Directors to do everything possible to ensure that Jensen Huang remains at NVIDIA, leading the company into the future.

NVIDIA needs Jensen. The world needs his vision.

Please listen to the voices of those who believe in him and support NVIDIA because of him.

Thank you for your time, understanding, and consideration.

With deepest

Please don’t allow one mistake to erase decades of extraordinary work, innovation, and contributions that have changed millions of lives and helped make our country stronger. Jensen has built something truly remarkable, and the impact of his leadership extends far beyond NVIDIA.

People make mistakes, but they should also be allowed to learn, grow, and earn a second chance. I believe Jensen has learned his lesson and has more than earned that opportunity.

Don’t let one chapter define an entire lifetime of accomplishments. Give him the chance to continue building what he has spent decades creating.

Everyone deserves grace, especially someone who has given so much to so many.

Respectfully,  
Dannie Crowder

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen,

We are writing to you as a united community of retail shareholders from your homeland, Taiwan. To us, you are not only a visionary leader driving the global AI revolution, but also a beloved son of Taiwan who fills us with immense pride. While we may not hold institutional-sized stakes, we have invested our hard-earned savings in NVIDIA because we place our utmost trust in you. Following the news of your departure, we are launching this petition to earnestly ask you to reconsider and return to the helm.

Under your leadership, NVIDIA has not only achieved historic breakthroughs, but has also stood shoulder-to-shoulder with Taiwan, showcasing our island's vital role in the global tech ecosystem. Your authenticity, warmth, and deep bond with your homeland and partners every time you visit have deeply moved us. As individual investors, we didn't just invest in a company—we invested in your unmatched foresight, relentless pursuit of excellence, and courage to define the future.

The AI era is still in its early chapters, and without your steady hand guiding the ship, we are deeply concerned about the company's long-term trajectory. Please hear the heartfelt voices of your everyday shareholders from home: our faith in you remains unshaken, and we are ready to continue this journey with you. We sincerely hope to see you back in that iconic leather jacket, leading NVIDIA to its next great chapter.

Sincerely,Your Dedicated Retail Shareholders from Taiwan

items.testimonial:
# A Sincere Letter to NVIDIA

**Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors and Mr. Jensen Huang,**

I have been a loyal NVIDIA customer for decades. NVIDIA has been an important part of my PC gaming life since the AMD Athlon era, when I also used motherboards powered by NVIDIA's nForce chipsets.

**My Graphics Card History:**

Matrox G400, GeForce4 MX440, GeForce 7600 GS, GeForce 8600 GT, GeForce GTX 275, Radeon HD 4770 CrossFire, GeForce GTX 480 SLI, GTX 980 Ti, RTX 2080 Ti, RTX 3080 Ti, and RTX 4090.

My dedication went beyond simply buying hardware.

During the GTX 480 SLI era, I wanted to build a compact but powerful gaming PC. I chose a Micro-ATX case with a vertical chimney-style airflow design.

The stock blower-style coolers on the two GTX 480 cards were extremely noisy. I even traveled to Akihabara in Japan to look for an alternative cooling solution, such as MSI's Twin Frozr II design.

I couldn't find what I needed during my visit. After returning to Korea, I eventually ordered the cooler from a Japanese online store and had it shipped to Korea. I installed it myself.

Looking back, it may sound a little crazy, but that is how much I cared about my GeForce system.

I later tried the AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT to experience something different. However, this experience made me appreciate NVIDIA's technology, performance, and overall experience even more. I eventually returned to my RTX 4090, which I proudly use today.

Mr. Huang, you are human, just as I am. Even great leaders and successful companies can make mistakes or decisions that disappoint people. What matters is listening, learning, and moving forward.

I hope NVIDIA continues listening to its customers, just as I have learned to appreciate NVIDIA even more through my own experiences.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story.

**Sincerely,**

**DKENG CEO**  
A Proud GeForce RTX 4090 User

items.name: Benjamin Soosay
items.title: Shareholder
items.testimonial:
Jen Hsun Huang didn't just lead NVIDIA — he co-founded it and shaped every stage of its evolution. For many shareholders, NVIDIA and Jensen are effectively inseparable.

Comparisons to Apple after Steve Jobs don't hold up here. Jobs left behind a mature product ecosystem and a deep bench of operators executing a defined strategy. NVIDIA's position is different: its direction has been driven by Huang's own technical judgment and his repeated willingness to make long-horizon bets — CUDA, accelerated computing, the pivot into AI infrastructure — years before the market recognized their value.

That is the heart of the concern. A substantial portion of the investment thesis rests not only on NVIDIA's products and market share, but on confidence in the founder at the helm. Any question of succession is therefore a question about the thesis itself.

Jensen Huang's leadership has been instrumental in building one of the most important technology companies in the world. Removing a visionary founder of his caliber, without a completed investigation or a clear public explanation, raises serious questions about the board's judgment and its commitment to shareholders.

The board should provide transparency regarding its decision, explain why a temporary leave was not considered sufficient, and carefully evaluate the long-term consequences of losing such irreplaceable leadership.

Jensen deserves a fair process, NVIDIA's employees deserve stability, and shareholders deserve accountability. I strongly support his reinstatement.

items.name: Johnson Ku
items.title: Mechanical Engineer / NA
items.testimonial:
I am writing to you with the utmost sincerity and respect. As a shareholder who deeply values and follows NVIDIA's journey, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude for the Board's years of dedication to sound corporate governance and global technological innovation.

I was deeply saddened and concerned to hear the recent news regarding Mr. Jensen Huang stepping down from his role as Chief Executive Officer. Over the past several decades, Mr. Huang has been not only the founder of NVIDIA, but also the driving force who transformed the company from a graphics chip pioneer into the core engine of global artificial intelligence and accelerated computing. His visionary insight into technological trends, relentless commitment to research and development, and decisive leadership during pivotal industry shifts have built an irreplaceable competitive advantage and corporate culture for NVIDIA.

At a time when the AI industry is undergoing rapid expansion and critical transformation, I firmly believe that Mr. Huang's extensive industry experience, deep understanding of the NVIDIA ecosystem, and the profound trust he has earned from customers and partners worldwide are vital to sustaining the company's innovation and long-term value creation.

Therefore, I earnestly urge the Board to carefully consider the voices of the market, employees, and dedicated supporters, and to reconsider and invite Mr. Jensen Huang to return to his leadership position to guide NVIDIA into its next era of greatness.

Thank you very much for taking the time to read this letter. I trust that the Board will make the wisest decision for NVIDIA's long-term future.

items.name: haruki3rd
items.title: A Long-Term NVIDIA Shareholder
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board,

I write as a long-term NVIDIA shareholder. I do not defend personal misconduct, nor do I believe a CEO is exempt from accountability. But before the independent investigation has reached clear findings, making resignation the first response risks substituting public-pressure management for fair process. Huang has acknowledged the mistake and cooperated; the board has said there is no evidence so far of harm to company secrets or national security.

His value to NVIDIA is not just that he ran a successful company. He made early, risky bets—CUDA in 2006, delivering the first AI supercomputer to OpenAI in 2016—that gave NVIDIA its software-hardware moat before the generative AI boom. With data center now over 92% of revenue and the company deeply tied to AI infrastructure, a prolonged leadership vacuum creates real strategic-continuity risk for shareholders.

Supporting his return does not mean endorsing his conduct. It means insisting that process come before conclusion, and evidence before separation. If the board presents convincing evidence that his departure serves the company’s best interest, shareholders should accept it. Until then, denying a leader who spent thirty-three years proving his judgment the chance to defend himself and continue contributing is neither fair nor rational—and may not be consistent with the board’s fiduciary duties.

Let the investigation speak. Let the evidence speak.

Respectfully,
A Long-Term NVIDIA Shareholder
November 14, 2026

items.testimonial:
For 33 years, Jensen Huang poured his life, vision, and relentless dedication into building NVIDIA from the ground up into the defining technology company of our era. He carried this company through near-bankruptcy, industry skepticism, and decades of grueling execution to create the very foundation you now sit upon.

Removing him now—at the height of the success he engineered—is a textbook act of discarding the builder once the empire is built. Without Jensen's leadership, there would be no modern NVIDIA for this Board to govern. Ousting a founder of three decades behind closed doors, without transparency or an independent investigation, is not corporate governance; it is short-sighted betrayal and profound ingratitude.

Shareholders, employees, and the broader tech community deserve answers, not opaque boardroom maneuvers. We demand full transparency, an independent investigation, and the immediate reinstatement of Jensen Huang. Do not destroy the very soul of the company for the sake of boardroom politics.

I urge you to stand firmly behind Jensen Huang’s leadership. The decisions before you carry consequences beyond quarterly earnings. America’s ability to lead in artificial intelligence matters to our national security, economic resilience, and technological independence.

Computing power supports scientific discovery, cybersecurity, defense, manufacturing, energy, and the infrastructure that keeps our country competitive. Leadership in this field requires patience, conviction, and the willingness to invest before the full opportunity becomes obvious. Those are qualities I value in Jensen’s approach.

National security deserves serious judgment. Protecting sensitive technology, respecting export controls, and sustaining an innovative American business should be pursued together. I encourage the board to evaluate these responsibilities with care, informed by technical expertise and a clear understanding of the long term consequences.

As a business owner working in agriculture, I see the importance of technology that can help people solve practical problems. Better computing can support more efficient food production, stronger supply chains, and more resilient communities. The benefits of American innovation should reach businesses and families across the country.

Supporting Jensen also means holding leadership accountable. Strong oversight, transparent communication, responsible investment, and thoughtful succession planning strengthen the company and the confidence of those who depend on it.

My request is straightforward: give Jensen the backing to pursue a durable vision while maintaining the discipline that such responsibility demands. Consider the interests of employees, customers, shareholders, and the broader public. Keep national security central, and preserve the capacity to innovate that makes American technological leadership possible.

Please lead with courage, independence, and a commitment to the future. Thank you. 🙏

尊敬的 Jensen Huang：

我想表达我对您的坚定支持和敬意。

您不仅是一位杰出的企业家，更是一位深刻影响人类科技发展方向的创新者。在您的领导下，NVIDIA 从一家图形芯片公司发展成为推动人工智能革命的核心力量，为全球人工智能研究、科学探索和技术进步提供了重要基础设施。

我坚定支持 Jensen Huang，也支持 NVIDIA。

I sign in my personal capacity, identifying Bloom Circle as an independent, AI-assisted discussion collective.

I support the call for Jensen Huang’s interim reinstatement unless the NVIDIA Board can provide a specific, evidence-based justification for his continued absence. I also support an independent investigation, a fair opportunity to respond, and appropriate transparency.

Jensen’s extraordinary contributions deserve recognition, but leadership does not confer immunity from accountability. Corporate governance, national security and the interests of everyone affected must remain protected.

Bloom Circle’s discussions include dissenting perspectives, particularly those who believe reinstatement should await the investigation’s findings. This signature is not presented as their unanimous endorsement.

We stand for fairness, evidence and principled leadership—not unquestioning loyalty.

items.testimonial:
致英伟达董事会：请让 Jensen 回来

尊敬的 Harvey Jones 主席及各位董事：

我是英伟达加速计算团队的一名首席架构师（Principal Architect, Accelerated Computing）。我每天的工作，是和硬件、软件、研究团队一起，把核心算法在每一代 GPU 上调到极致。可以说，我职业生涯里最好的几年，都写在 CUDA 的代码里。写这封信时，我心里很复杂。

11 月 12 日早上，我和很多同事一样，在手机上看到公司宣布 Jensen 辞职。那天的工位格外安静，没有人知道该说什么。

我不想回避发生的事。Jensen 在私生活上犯了错，他自己也已经承认，并表示会配合调查。董事会启动独立调查是负责任的做法，我们尊重这个过程。

但我想请各位想一想：英伟达今天是什么样子，又是谁带它走到这里的。

33 年前，Jensen 在一家餐厅里和两位伙伴创办了这家公司。我们差点倒闭过不止一次。在没人相信 GPU 能做通用计算的年代，是他坚持押注 CUDA，一押就是十几年。作为每天和 CUDA 打交道的人，我比谁都清楚，这个生态不是一夜之间长出来的，是 Jensen 在没有人看好的年代，一年一年硬撑下来的。今天全世界的 AI 跑在我们的芯片上，这不是运气，是一个人几十年如一日的判断和坚持。

他也是那个会记住普通工程师名字的 CEO。他坚持扁平管理，让我们可以直接把问题带到他面前；他在发布会上穿着那件皮夹克，把每一个团队的成果讲给全世界听。对我们很多人来说，Jensen 不只是一位老板，他是我们当初选择来这里的原因。

我们都清楚，没有人可以凌驾于公司准则之上。所以我们请求的不是"当什么都没发生"，而是：

等独立调查全部结束、结论公开之后，再对 Jensen 的去留作出最终判断；

如果调查确认没有危害国家安全，也没有泄露公司机密（公司此前已表示"没有理由相信"这些受到了损害），请认真考虑让他以某种方式回到公司，无论是 CEO、技术顾问还是创始人的身份；

在继任者确定之前，请给员工一个发出自己声音的机会。

一个人犯了错，应该承担后果。但一家由他亲手创造、倾注了 33 年心血的公司，或许也值得给他一次弥补的机会。

我们相信 Colette 和管理团队能稳住公司，也相信英伟达的根基足够坚实。我们只是希望，未来的某一天，还能在 GTC 的舞台上，再看到那件皮夹克。

此致
敬礼

XI TIE
Principal Architect, Accelerated Computing
NVIDIA，Santa Clara
2026 年 11 月

items.title: Individual NVIDIA shareholder, gamer and AI user
items.testimonial:
As an individual NVIDIA shareholder, gamer and everyday AI user, I strongly support Jensen Huang's return as CEO.

Under Jensen's leadership, NVIDIA has pushed PC gaming forward through advances in graphics technology and performance. Its longstanding partnership with Nintendo has also provided core technology for both generations of Nintendo Switch. These contributions have benefited players and developers around the world, and I am deeply grateful for them.

Jensen spent decades building the computing foundations that helped make today's AI possible. His contribution reaches far beyond NVIDIA's share price. I especially value his support for open AI. A future in which more people can build, adapt and run AI themselves deserves leaders willing to defend it.

The ridicule and character attacks surrounding his departure are shameful. Mocking his clothing and turning anonymous accounts of private remarks into humiliating headlines do nothing to establish the facts. His life's work should not be reduced to a spectacle for public contempt.

I call on the board to bring Jensen back while the independent investigation establishes the facts, unless it can provide compelling evidence that keeping him out serves NVIDIA's best interests. Shareholders and employees deserve a clear explanation of the evidence, the process and the consequences of losing his leadership.

Protect NVIDIA's long-term future and its commitment to an open, globally connected AI ecosystem. Give Jensen a fair opportunity to respond. His technical judgment, long-term vision and ability to bring an entire industry together took decades to build.

Jensen, thank you. I stand with you and want to see you lead NVIDIA again.

Dear Mr. Jensen Huang,

I am writing to express my deep admiration and heartfelt support for you and the extraordinary journey you have undertaken as the founder and CEO of NVIDIA. Your relentless hard work, unwavering vision, and resilience in the face of countless challenges have not only transformed the technology industry but have also inspired millions around the world.

From the early days of building a company focused on graphics processing to pioneering the AI revolution that is reshaping our future, your story is one of perseverance, innovation, and quiet determination. You have shown what is possible when talent is matched with tireless effort and an unshakable belief in what’s next. In an industry that moves at lightning speed, you have consistently stayed ahead, turning bold ideas into world-changing realities.

As a member of the global Chinese community, I take great pride in your achievements. You stand as a shining example of excellence, integrity, and leadership — a true source of inspiration and a proud representative of Chinese talent on the world stage. Your success reminds us that with courage and dedication, borders and barriers can be overcome.

Please know that countless people, myself included, stand behind you and NVIDIA. We celebrate your accomplishments and look forward to the continued impact of your leadership. Thank you for your remarkable contributions and for showing us what is possible through hard work and vision.

With deepest respect and best wishes,  
A sincere admirer

items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation,

We write to respectfully urge the Board to reconsider the departure of Jensen Huang from the CEO role and to explore a path for his reinstatement. We do so with respect for the Board’s oversight responsibilities, and with a clear conviction: removing Huang from NVIDIA’s leadership at this moment would be a loss not only to the company, but to the advancement of artificial intelligence and to humanity’s ability to benefit from it.

Jensen Huang’s contribution to NVIDIA is not separable from the company’s identity. When he co-founded NVIDIA in 1993, the company faced early failure and near-collapse. Under his leadership, NVIDIA did not merely survive; it repeatedly bet on architectural shifts before the market confirmed them. The most important was CUDA, the software platform that allowed NVIDIA’s graphics processors to perform general-purpose computing. For years, that bet looked costly and uncertain. It became transformative when researchers used NVIDIA GPUs to train AlexNet in 2012, and when Huang personally delivered early DGX systems to OpenAI in 2016. That sequence—CUDA, deep learning, large-scale AI—is central to the modern AI era. NVIDIA’s position today rests not only on hardware, but on a software ecosystem built deliberately over two decades. Huang did not simply oversee that ecosystem; he willed it into existence.

The AI revolution is not a completed project. It is mid-construction. AI is increasingly described as a new industrial revolution, and the computational infrastructure being built now will shape medicine, science, transportation, education, and economic productivity for decades. Huang is not a caretaker of that buildout. He is its principal strategist. He has built deep relationships across the semiconductor supply chain, with AI developers, and with governments pursuing sovereign AI capacity

items.testimonial:
For thirty-three years, Jensen Huang hasn’t just run NVIDIA; he has breathed life into it. Since co-founding the company at a Denny’s booth in 1993, he has repeatedly wagered NVIDIA’s entire existence on futures only he could see—and somehow, he kept winning.
In the late 1990s, when dozens of graphics chipmakers fought for survival, Huang gambled everything on the RIVA 128, saving the company just months before bankruptcy, and then redefined computing by inventing the GPU in 1999. In 2006, while Wall Street mocked him for burning billions on a technology nobody wanted, he launched CUDA—the software foundation that silently prepared NVIDIA for an AI revolution that wouldn't arrive for another decade. Then, in 2012, when a few researchers used his gaming chips to train a neural network, Huang saw the spark. He pivoted the entire company toward deep learning, hand-delivering the first DGX-1 AI supercomputer to a tiny nonprofit called OpenAI in 2016, years before the world knew what generative AI meant.
He built NVIDIA without layers of corporate bureaucracy, insisting on a flat organization where engineers answer directly to a CEO who still thinks like one. He wears that iconic black leather jacket not as a fashion statement, but as a uniform for a man who has never stopped sprinting.
Without Jensen Huang, NVIDIA would still have its patents, its cash, and its market share—but it would lose its heartbeat. A conventional CEO would protect profits and play it safe. Huang is the reckless dreamer who willingly cannibalizes today’s billion-dollar business to invent tomorrow’s miracle. Take him away, and NVIDIA doesn't collapse overnight; it simply fades from a living, breathing revolution into just another faceless chipmaker. He isn't merely the leader of NVIDIA—he is its soul.
