items.testimonial:
ジェンスン・ファン氏のNVIDIA CEO復帰を求めます

ジェンスン・ファン氏の退任は、単なる一企業の経営者交代ではありません。それは米国のAI競争力、世界の技術革新、そして人類の未来にまで影響を及ぼしかねない重大な出来事です。

ジェンスン氏は30年以上にわたり、NVIDIAを世界のAI革命を支える中核企業へと成長させてきました。その功績は、GPUやCUDAの開発だけにとどまりません。

約60人の直属部下と直接情報を共有し、階層的な組織の壁を取り払い、技術開発から製造、供給網、顧客との協業までを驚異的な速度で統合してきました。

この経営システムは、ジェンスン氏の卓越した技術的洞察力、長期的な構想力、そして膨大な暗黙知によって成立しています。優秀な後継者を任命するだけで、容易に再現できるものではありません。

さらに重要なのは、ジェンスン氏がNVIDIAの経営だけでなく、世界のAI産業全体の成長を牽引する役割を担ってきたことです。

NVIDIAはハイパースケーラー、ネオクラウド、AI開発企業への投資や戦略的提携を通じて、資本、計算資源、技術革新を結びつける巨大なエコシステムを形成してきました。

こうした資金循環には批判もあります。しかし、AIインフラへの巨額投資を実現し、新興企業の成長を支え、世界のAI開発を加速させてきた側面も正当に評価されるべきです。

これほど複雑で巨大な取引を構想し、企業間の利害を調整し、技術ロードマップと結びつけて実行できる経営者が、果たしてどれほど存在するでしょうか。

ジェンスン氏の不在は、NVIDIA一社の問題にとどまりません。世界中のAI企業、データセンター事業者、半導体サプライチェーン、そして米国の技術的優位性にまで影響する可能性があります。

そして今、私たちは人工超知能の実現すら視野に入り始めた、歴史的な技術転換期に立っています。

今後数年間の意思決定が、AIの発展速度、科学技術の進歩、さらには人類文明の未来を大きく左右するかもしれません。

この極めて重要な時期に、世界のAI産業を牽引してきたリーダーを失うことの機会損失は、計り知れません。

もちろん、企業統治、法令遵守、国家安全保障に関する疑惑は、独立した公正な調査によって徹底的に検証されなければなりません。いかなる経営者も法の上に立つことはできません。

しかし同時に、十分な事実確認と透明性ある説明を欠いたまま、長年にわたり築き上げられた経営体制を失うことにも、重大なリスクがあります。

私たちは疑惑の無条件の免責を求めているのではありません。

公正な調査と適切な説明責任を前提に、ジェンスン・ファン氏のNVIDIA CEO復帰を強く求めます。

これは一人の経営者を守るためだけの署名ではありません。

米国の技術競争力を守り、世界のAI産業の発展を支え、人類の未来に向けた技術革新の可能性を最大限に生かすための訴えです。

AI革命の歩みを止めてはなりません。ジェンスン・ファン氏の復帰を求めます。

items.testimonial:
A legend bows out. Jensen Huang is stepping down as NVDA CEO, marking a temporary end to an era of breakneck growth in computing power driven by geek faith.
Looking back on Old Huang’s career, he was far more than a shrewd businessman—he was the “sword-bearer” leading humanity into the AGI era. From defying the naysayers and pouring money into CUDA in his early days to building the foundational infrastructure for today’s global large language models, his decades of technological obsession have single-handedly accelerated humanity’s technological progress by at least a decade. Without the computing-power foundation he laid, today’s AI boom would be unthinkable.
But leaving at the very peak of market value, in such a subdued way, is more a matter of being swept along by forces beyond his control. When a company controls the lifeblood of global computing power, it inevitably becomes an arena for geopolitics, antitrust regulation, and zero-sum battles among capital. The extreme strains of supply chains, pervasive scrutiny, and the crushing pressure of great-power rivalry have long exceeded what a believer in technology can perfectly balance. His departure is not a failure on his part, but a case of being swept along by the unstoppable march of history.
The leather-jacket guy is leaving the stage, but the spark he leaves behind has already lit the way to the future.
Respect, Jensen. 🫡

items.testimonial:
I have always believed that the lifeblood of a technology company should be in the hands of people who truly understand technology, possess the foresight to anticipate the future, and have the courage to innovate — not those who focus solely on capital management, cost-cutting, and financial spreadsheets.

Capital is important, and financial discipline is necessary. But capital should serve technological innovation, not force innovation to serve short-term financial interests.

Nokia is a lesson worth reflecting on. Once an industry giant, it was not simply a company lacking talent or innovation. The real lesson is that when a technology company loses its ability to recognize technological shifts and fails to empower innovators to shape its future, even the strongest business empire can eventually be left behind by the times.

The technology industry has never been won through financial optimization alone.

It takes people who can see what lies ahead, who are willing to bet on technologies that have yet to mature, and who have the conviction to invest for the long term even when the market does not fully understand the vision.

That is precisely why I stand with Jensen Huang.

I would rather put my faith in a leader who genuinely understands technology, respects engineers, and has a long-term technological vision than in a professional executive whose primary strengths are cutting costs, improving profit margins, and pleasing the financial markets.

Capital may determine a company’s short-term profits, but visionary technology leaders determine its future.

Technology companies should not allow financial minds to define the limits of technological progress. They should allow people who understand technology to shape the company’s future — and let capital support that vision.
There are countless bean counters in this world, but there is only one Jensen Huang.

items.testimonial: Dear Jensen Huang, even if the entire world turns its back on you, please remember that there will always be people in Taiwan who stand firmly by your side.  We support you not only because you co-founded NVIDIA, but because of your extraordinary vision, perseverance, and contributions to humanity. For over 30 years, you have transformed computing, pioneered GPU technology, and helped make the AI revolution possible. You have also never forgotten your Taiwanese roots, consistently recognizing Taiwan's engineers, TSMC, and the countless people behind the global technology industry. We will never forget that. We believe in fairness, truth, and due process. Decades of achievements should never be erased by controversy before the facts are established. True support does not mean believing someone is perfect; it means standing for fairness and remembering their contributions. Jensen, your legacy is greater than any title, and your story is far from over. Even if the world loses faith in you, we will continue to believe in you. You are not alone. Taiwan stands with you, today and always. Stay strong, Jensen!

items.testimonial: Honestly, there's no AI as we know it without Jensen. For years he pushed CUDA forward while it cost a fortune and Wall Street questioned it, and that bet became the software moat the whole industry now runs on. In 2016 he personally delivered the first DGX-1 supercomputer to OpenAI, long before anyone took them seriously. Nvidia isn't just a chip seller, and no company reaches $5 trillion by selling cards alone. It has become the financial center of the compute economy. It invests in and backstops customers like OpenAI and CoreWeave, and its multi-year supply commitments have made TSMC, SK Hynix and Samsung rich along the way. AMD simply doesn't have the balance sheet or the conviction to play that role. Even in the market, NVDA options often trade more than QQQ, second only to SPY. Nvidia's greatness and Jensen are inseparable, and calling him the godfather of AI isn't an exaggeration.

items.name: Derek Weber
items.title: Concerned Citizen
items.testimonial:
I’ve been thinking about the situation with Jensen Huang and the calls for him to return.
What stands out to me isn’t the noise around any single moment. It’s the thirty-three years of building something that actually moved the frontier — not just for one company, but for an entire technological era. That kind of sustained, coherent vision is rare. When it exists, it tends to be worth protecting carefully rather than discarding quickly.
People are complicated. Leaders are complicated. The record of what someone has built still matters, and so does the question of whether the institution they shaped is stronger with or without their continued presence at the center of it.
I don’t claim to know every fact. I do know that sudden, high-stakes leadership removals in companies this central to the future often carry costs that only become visible later. A second look, conducted with seriousness and without panic, seems like the least we should ask for.
Some of us are signing because we believe the long arc of contribution still deserves weight. That’s where I am.

items.testimonial:
**Subject: Bring Jensen Back — His Story Is Not Over**

Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing as a longtime admirer of NVIDIA and someone who deeply respects Jensen Huang's extraordinary contributions to technology and innovation.

For more than three decades, Jensen has done far more than build a successful company. He has created a culture of courage, perseverance, and relentless innovation. He believed in the future of accelerated computing and artificial intelligence long before the world understood their potential.

NVIDIA is not simply a company he founded. It is his life's work, his vision, and his legacy.

Great leaders are not necessarily perfect people. They are human beings who make difficult decisions, sometimes make mistakes, and deserve to be judged with fairness and perspective.

Accountability matters. So do due process, proportionality, and second chances. Any legitimate concerns should be investigated independently, but they should not automatically erase decades of exceptional leadership.

As someone who believes in NVIDIA's long-term future, I respectfully urge the Board to consider a fair and transparent path for Jensen's return.

NVIDIA's greatest strength has never been just its technology. It has been the vision and culture that Jensen inspired.

**Please bring Jensen back. Not because he is perfect, but because his contributions matter, his leadership matters, and his story deserves another chapter.**

The world still needs visionaries who dare to imagine the impossible.

With respect and hope,

A supporter of Jensen Huang and NVIDIA

We, the undersigned shareholders, partners, developers, and supporters of the global AI community, respectfully urge Jensen Huang to return as Chief Executive Officer of NVIDIA.
Under Jensen's visionary leadership, NVIDIA transformed from a graphics chip pioneer into the foundational engine of the modern artificial intelligence era. His unique combination of deep technical expertise, relentless innovation, and long-term strategic foresight has not only built an extraordinary company, but also accelerated breakthroughs across science, medicine, and computing worldwide.
As the AI industry enters its next critical chapter, NVIDIA's culture of speed, boldness, and engineering excellence needs its founder at the helm more than ever. We firmly believe that Jensen's return as CEO is vital to steering NVIDIA through new technological frontiers, maintaining market confidence, and fulfilling the company's mission to solve the world's most complex challenges.
We respectfully ask the Board of Directors to invite Jensen Huang back to lead NVIDIA, and we sincerely hope Jensen will answer this call from the community he helped build.

items.testimonial:
To the Shareholders, Stakeholders, and the Board of Directors of NVIDIA:

We, the undersigned supporters, investors, and members of the global technology community, stand united in our unwavering support for Jensen Huang as the Chief Executive Officer of NVIDIA. Regardless of the current noise or personal controversies, there is no one on Earth more qualified, capable, or essential to lead NVIDIA into the future than Jensen.

Let us be candid: personal matters and extramarital affairs are private, minor issues in the grand scheme of corporate leadership—human experiences that many men go through. They have zero bearing on Jensen’s unmatched strategic brilliance, technical foresight, or ability to execute at the highest level. To jeopardize the future of the world’s most critical technology company over private matters is short-sighted and destructive to shareholder value.

Jensen built NVIDIA from the ground up and single-handedly ushered in the modern era of accelerated computing and artificial intelligence. His leadership is irreplaceable. Rather than allowing a disconnected Board of Directors to undermine the architect of NVIDIA’s success, we demand immediate accountability: dissolve the current Board of Directors and retain Jensen Huang as CEO.

Jensen, we stand firmly behind you. Do not give up, and do not step down. Even if forces attempt to push you aside today, we believe with absolute certainty that you belong at the helm and will ultimately lead NVIDIA forward.

Sign this petition to send a clear message: Stand with Jensen. Dissolve the Board. Protect NVIDIA’s future.

items.testimonial:
Jensen = NVIDIA, NVIDIA = Jensen

Who decided to oust Jensen Huang as CEO and remove him from the board? Do you genuinely believe this is a smart move to protect the company?

Look at the history of major tech companies. We’ve seen CEOs involved in scandals and controversies, yet their companies continued to operate and thrive. So why is this situation being handled differently?

And who exactly are the members of NVIDIA’s board of directors? Are all of you completely clean? Have none of you ever cheated, been involved in a scandal, or made questionable personal decisions?

If that’s the standard you’re holding Jensen to, perhaps we should apply the same standard to every single board member. Should we start looking into your personal lives, too? Imagine if we dug up something embarrassing about each of you and shared it with the media.

I’m not saying Jensen is above accountability. But does a personal scandal automatically erase 33 years of contribution to a company he built?

You have every right to hold him accountable, but that doesn’t automatically mean removing him is the smartest decision for NVIDIA or its shareholders.

So, is this really about protecting NVIDIA, or are we simply holding Jensen to a standard that the board itself might not be able to meet?

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board,

As an NVIDIA shareholder, I urge you to reconsider Jensen Huang’s departure and pursue his reinstatement as CEO.

NVIDIA is not simply a successful technology company. It represents decades of extraordinary engineering, relentless innovation, and a vision that helped reshape the future of computing. Jensen did not merely lead that transformation; he helped imagine and build it.

Financial expertise can manage a balance sheet. Operational excellence can sustain a business. But visionary technical leadership creates industries, anticipates technological revolutions, and inspires thousands of brilliant minds to accomplish what others once considered impossible.

That is what makes Jensen exceptional. His understanding of NVIDIA’s technology, its engineering culture, and the future of artificial intelligence cannot simply be replaced through an executive search.

Accountability matters, and legitimate concerns deserve a fair and independent investigation. But personal failings should not automatically erase decades of extraordinary leadership, nor should allegations be treated as established facts before the evidence is fully examined.

The Board has a responsibility not only to protect NVIDIA today, but to safeguard the vision that will define its next generation.

As a shareholder, I invested in more than NVIDIA’s financial performance. I invested in its innovation, its mission, and the leadership that made its achievements possible.

You can appoint another CEO, but you cannot simply appoint another Jensen Huang.

I respectfully ask the Board to put long-term shareholder value, technological leadership, fairness, and NVIDIA’s future at the center of its decision.

Bring Jensen back. Let him finish what he started.

items.testimonial: I have been a proud shareholder since 2018 since working on my PhD working on machine learning at Caltech and I discovered the dominance of Nvidia's GPU's.  Over the years I've seen this great American company quickly blossom into the greatest of all time thanks to the leadership of Jensen Huang.  Frankly I don't even know what Nvidia is without Jensen.  I have no idea what the board was thinking forcing him out, and the lack of any clarity of why this ousting is in shareholder or employee benefit is ridiculous.  Especially considering the vast majority of shareholders and employees support Jensen and them not listening to their will is ridiculous.  I am no consipracy theorist, but the board succumbing  to the pressure of a clearly coordinated attack against Jensen stinks of nefarious outsider influence with possible corruption/collusion.  The way the board handled this was abysmal!  I fully support Jensen and he needs to be back at Nvidia since a Jensen-less "Nvidia" is not what I invested in nor what any Nvidia employee expected.  Jensen is a true American treasure and patriot and deserves a second chance!  The past couple days, I've been mourning and it has felt like I lost a beloved uncle, but now I am angry at the board because of how much this whole situation stinks.  I hope they realize that many American's don't trust investing stocks because of high risk and volatility as well as a perception that markets aren't fair to the lower/middle classes, and if Nvidia crashes due to their unwise decision, it'll set back people's trust in the system and be bad for society.  They really need to make things right!

items.name: Sineth Madduma
items.title: founder
items.testimonial:
After 33 years building NVIDIA, Jensen Huang departs at a pivotal moment for AI. But this is not merely about Jensen. It is about what our society has become.

We celebrate intelligence until it challenges our assumptions. We celebrate innovation until it threatens established interests. We praise independent thinking until someone actually thinks independently. Then we call it dangerous.

We expose personal failings yet seldom examine the institutions and incentives surrounding them. Who benefits from instability at NVIDIA? Asking is not alleging a conspiracy. It is exercising curiosity.

Fear is an instrument of influence. If AI is presented only as an existential threat, who benefits from the fear, and who gains the authority to decide our future? The risks are real; so are the incentives.

Jensen has acknowledged personal wrongdoing. Credible national-security or governance concerns demand independent investigation. His achievements do not place him above accountability. His mistakes do not erase 33 years of creation. Allegations are not findings.

It takes 33 years to build something extraordinary and 33 seconds to form an opinion about its creator. Somehow, we confuse the latter with wisdom. We reward the appearance of virtue, dismiss uncomfortable questions as conspiracies and mistake outrage for moral reasoning.

A civilisation unable to distinguish private imperfection, professional competence and genuine institutional risk is hardly prepared to govern powerful technologies. NVIDIA’s board owes its employees, shareholders and developers transparency. Jensen deserves fair consideration for a return, subject to the evidence.

If accountability is the principle, apply it universally. If truth is the objective, demand evidence consistently.

We are building machines to overcome the limits of human reasoning. Before asking whether AI will be aligned with humanity, perhaps we should ask: what is humanity aligned with?

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen, 
I’m writing from Taiwan as a small NVIDIA shareholder. I’d like to invite fellow shareholders who share this hope to sign this letter with me and ask you to consider returning as NVIDIA’s CEO.

What I’ve admired most about your leadership is your willingness to invest in ideas years before their value was obvious. You and your team kept building CUDA before most people could imagine how widely GPU computing would be used. That patience and conviction are a big part of why I believe in NVIDIA’s future.

I respect your decision to step down and the Board’s responsibility to choose the company’s next CEO. If you feel ready to return and the Board is open to it, I would be glad to see you lead NVIDIA again. I believe you still have a great deal to contribute to the company you helped build.

Whatever you decide, I hope you know how much your work has meant to people like me. From Taiwan, I’m cheering for you and wishing you well in whatever comes next.

With respect and gratitude,
Johnny Huang

items.name: Saulo Londono

items.testimonial: As a long-term NVIDIA shareholder, I am deeply disappointed by the board’s decision to accept Jensen Huang’s resignation under intense public pressure. For more than three decades, Jensen built NVIDIA from a graphics startup into the defining company of the AI era. His technical vision, execution, and culture are the primary reasons this company is worth what it is today and why it sits at the center of the most important technology shift of our lifetime. Personal matters, however serious, should be investigated thoroughly and with due process. Removing the founder-CEO who created this value, before any investigation is complete and in response to a public outcry, has already destroyed hundreds of billions in shareholder value and introduced unnecessary risk to customers, employees, and partners. Continuity and proven leadership matter more than appeasing a mob. I urge the board to reconsider. Reinstate Jensen Huang  while any legitimate investigation proceeds, and prioritize the long-term interests of the company and its owners over short-term optics. NVIDIA’s success has always been inseparable from Jensen’s leadership. Do not throw that away.

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen and Members of the Board,

I was born in 1993, the same year NVIDIA was founded. We are both 33 years old this year, and that coincidence makes NVIDIA’s extraordinary journey feel particularly personal to me.

I want to express my deepest respect and unwavering support for Jensen Huang.

What Jensen has built over the past three decades is nothing short of extraordinary. NVIDIA represents the very best of American innovation, determination, and entrepreneurship. To me, Jensen is not only a visionary leader but also a symbol of what makes America great.

It is heartbreaking to see someone who has contributed so much to American technological leadership face such enormous pressure. I am deeply concerned that political interests may be driving what I perceive as an unfair campaign against him. I believe that innovation and achievement should be celebrated, not punished for political reasons.

Jensen, I cannot imagine how difficult this period must be for you. But please know that there are people like me who genuinely admire what you have accomplished and stand firmly behind you.

I believe NVIDIA is one of America’s greatest success stories, and you are a true American treasure.

I sincerely hope this situation reaches a fair and positive resolution. You deserve the opportunity to continue building the future without unnecessary political interference.

You have my full support.

With deepest respect,
Guangnan Yue
Violinist & Educator

items.name: hau wang
items.title: General Manager of Liaoning Houjun Investment Advisory Co., Ltd.
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
As a long-standing stakeholder who has closely followed and supported NVIDIA's development, I am writing to express my firm support for Mr. Jensen Huang continuing to serve as the company's Chief Executive Officer.
Over the past three decades, Mr. Jensen Huang has not only built NVIDIA's business legend but has also, with highly forward-looking strategic vision, led the company through key transitions at critical industry inflection points. From the early innovation of graphics processing units (GPUs) to the bold bet on the CUDA ecosystem, and now to fully leading the global wave of artificial intelligence and accelerated computing, his leadership has been thoroughly validated by history and the market.
At present, the global technology industry is in a critical period of restructuring computing infrastructure, with unprecedented speed of technological iteration and increasingly fierce market competition. At this juncture, NVIDIA needs not only a manager but also a visionary leader who deeply understands the underlying technological logic, commands strong ecosystem influence, and maintains a high degree of entrepreneurial acuity. Mr. Jensen Huang's "Speed of Light" execution culture, together with the deep trust he has built with top developers and business leaders worldwide, constitutes NVIDIA's most core and irreplaceable moat.
Maintaining leadership stability and strategic continuity is crucial for NVIDIA to consolidate its current leading advantage in AI computing and to pursue new growth engines such as Physical AI and Sovereign AI.
I firmly believe that under Mr. Jensen Huang's continued stewardship, NVIDIA will surely push new technological boundaries and create even more profound value for shareholders, customers, and the entire technology industry. items.testimonial:
请英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋先生CEO职务，同时追究董事会长期治理失职之责。

我们签署这份请愿书，出于一个看似矛盾的立场：我们既认为黄仁勋先生不应以这种方式被驱逐，也认为他对自己的行为负有不可推卸的个人责任。而比这两者都更值得追问的是：一个在黄仁勋顺风顺水时从未真正监督过他的董事会，凭什么在危机中以“治理”之名，把全部代价转嫁给一个人？

黄仁勋辞职的直接原因，是他未向股东和董事会披露与一名被美国情报机构怀疑为中国间谍的女性之间的私人关系，随后第二段婚外情曝光，董事会连夜要求其辞职。股东集体诉讼指控其涉嫌欺诈股东，英伟达市值在调查风波中单日缩水约1930亿美元。这些事实本身足以说明：他的个人行为越过了上市公司CEO应有的边界，将公司声誉、信息披露合规性和国家安全敏感度同时置于风险之中。 我们不会为这段婚外情辩护，也不会假装“私德与公司无关”——当私人关系对象被情报机构标记，而CEO选择否认和隐瞒时，这已经不是私德，而是受托责任的失守。

但请愿的核心不在于原谅，而在于比例与程序是否公正。 黄仁勋的错误是真实的，董事会长期的不作为同样是真实的，而后者恰恰是前者的制度条件。纽约时报的调查结论直截了当：这个董事会“一贯对黄仁勋表现出忠诚和顺从”，许多董事与黄仁勋有着数十年的深厚渊源，董事任期合计长达161年。前员工称，黄仁勋“主要将董事会视为一项治理要求，而非战略或执行的重要组成部分”。一个在法律上独立、在关系上从未独立的董事会，在顺境中放弃了质询，在危机中却以最快速度完成了切割。

更具体地说，董事会至少在以下四个层面存在系统性的治理失职，而这些失职恰恰构成了今天局面的真正根源：

其一，继任规划的长期真空。 黄仁勋掌舵英伟达33年，公司却从未有过公开、明确的CEO继任计划。前高管明确表示，公司内部多年讨论继任安排，黄仁勋“抵制”了这一想法，“他不喜欢这个想法，他觉得这会在高管之间制造竞争，并导致分裂”。一个本应独立监督CEO的董事会，在长达数十年的时间里容忍甚至默许了这种抵制。当危机来临时，公司没有准备好任何一个人来接替——这不是黄仁勋一个人的责任，这是提名与治理委员会在风险监督上的结构性失能。

其二，薪酬结构对短期指标的过度奖励。 黄仁勋上一财年实际获得的薪酬高达1.622亿美元，其中52%的激励依赖单一年度的财务指标。这意味着，驱动CEO决策的权重更多地落在12个月的收入数字上，而非需要多年才能显现的合规风险、继任梯队和关键人风险隔离。一个真正履行受托责任的薪酬委员会，应当在创始人CEO的激励设计中嵌入治理风险因子，而不是在事后才用“追回条款”来补丁。

其三，对反垄断合规风险的系统性迟钝。 美国司法部正在调查英伟达与Groq之间170亿美元的交易是否被刻意设计为“变相收购”以规避并购审查，参议员已公开质疑该交易“实质上等同于合并”。审计委员会（主席1997年即加入董事会）的法定职责包括监督法律与合规风险。请董事会回答：在司法部启动正式调查之前，审计委员会是否收到过关于该交易结构法律风险的内部或外部意见？如果收到过，采取了什么行动？如果没有，监督机制在哪里？

其四，关键人风险从未被当作治理问题对待。 英伟达的估值、供应链谈判、CUDA生态号召力，在相当程度上绑定在黄仁勋个人身上。董事会本应是个人信用与公司信用之间的防火墙，但它的长期顺从恰恰强化了“黄仁勋即英伟达”的市场认知。当这个认知在丑闻中动摇时，董事会没有制度化的缓冲，只有连夜逼宫的戏剧性切割。这是事后反应，不是事前治理。

因此，我们请愿董事会采取以下行动：

第一，恢复黄仁勋先生的CEO职务，但附以明确的问责条件。 他的个人行为必须接受独立调查的结论，并承担相应的薪酬追回、公开道歉和合规承诺。但以“逼迫辞职”作为唯一处理方式，实质上是用一个人的退场掩盖了董事会数十年治理失败的记录。恢复职务不是赦免，而是在问责框架下的功能恢复——英伟达当前的技术路线、客户关系和供应链谈判，尚无可替代的接手者。

第二，同步启动董事会自身的治理审查与改组。 审查范围应涵盖：过去十年董事会对CEO个人风险、继任规划和合规风险的监督记录；薪酬委员会激励设计中是否纳入了治理风险因子；以及“忠诚型董事会”的结构性缺陷应如何纠正。审查结果应向全体股东公开。

第三，公布具有约束力的CEO继任时间表，不再允许“抵制”成为选项。 继任规划是董事会的法定义务，不是CEO的个人偏好可以否决的事项。

第四，建立个人信用与公司信用的隔离机制，对以CEO个人信用为隐性支撑的担保和商业安排进行系统性披露与重构。

我们签署这份请愿，不是因为我们认为黄仁勋无需负责。我们签署，是因为一个把全部责任推给个人、却拒绝审视自身失职的董事会，没有资格以“治理”的名义决定这家公司的未来。 请恢复黄

items.testimonial: There are three reasons to support Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA. First, NVIDIA employees overwhelmingly back his reinstatement—over 97% of participants in an employee-initiated vote wanted him to stay, a clear expression of internal sentiment. Second, he has led the company for over three decades, built a flat management structure, and left no clear successor; no one can replace him in the short term, and the stock fell nearly 14% after his resignation. Third, he has publicly apologized, resigned from all positions, and forfeited about $108 million in unvested shares—a heavy price already paid. Personal misconduct deserves criticism, but the punishment has been sufficient; giving him a second chance serves both the company's interests and employee wishes.

items.testimonial:
沒有人可以代替黃仁勳
身為股東，我最擔心的不是這一季的財報，而是輝達的「前瞻指引」。
從 2006 年押注 CUDA、到 Hopper、Blackwell、Rubin，每一代都是黃仁勳在技術還沒成熟前，就提前兩三年看準方向，再說服客戶與供應鏈一起投入。
這份號召力在台灣最明顯：他親自走訪台積電、鴻海、廣達、緯創等夥伴，讓整條供應鏈願意先擴產、先備料；台積電最先進的製程與 CoWoS 封裝產能，也因為他和台積電長年建立的信任，優先排給輝達。產能是提前好幾年鎖定的，鎖住產能靠的不只是合約，更是信任。
財務數字可以交給管理團隊，但「三年後的運算長什麼樣子」，以及讓全球供應鏈願意跟著押注的號召力，目前沒有人能取代。
懇請董事會在調查結束、證實未危及國家安全與公司機密後，讓他以技術與戰略領導的角色回到輝達，繼續為下一代架構指路。

items.name: Alvin Lim

items.testimonial:
I stand with Jensen.

As an NVIDIA investor and someone who deeply admires your leadership, vision, and contributions to the technology industry, I find your departure from NVIDIA deeply disappointing.

For more than 33 years, you have dedicated your life to building NVIDIA from a relatively small graphics chip company into one of the most influential technology companies in human history. Your achievements are not limited to the success of a single corporation. You have helped shape the future of computing and accelerated the development of artificial intelligence.

What I admire most about you is not simply your business success, but your ability to see the future before others do.

You didn’t just build GPUs. You inspired an entire ecosystem to believe in the future of AI. You gave partners such as TSMC and SK Hynix the confidence and vision to invest, expand capacity, and push the boundaries of semiconductor technology. Your ability to communicate that vision, bring people together, and turn ambitious ideas into reality is something truly extraordinary.

The AI revolution we are witnessing today would not look the same without your leadership.

I am not here to defend personal mistakes. You have acknowledged your infidelity and taken responsibility for your actions. However, I strongly believe that personal misconduct and decades of professional achievements should be evaluated separately.

Serious allegations, particularly those involving national security, deserve serious and independent investigations. Accountability is important, but so are fairness, due process, and proportionality. Decisions with such enormous consequences should be made based on established facts rather than incomplete information or public pressure.

I also believe the NVIDIA board has a responsibility to consider not only corporate governance, but also the long-term interests of its shareholders, employees, partners, and the broader AI ecosystem.

items.name: Roy Chow
items.title: Engineer,Xbrother
items.testimonial:
Ever since I was a student and got my first personal laptop, I have always chosen computers equipped with NVIDIA graphics cards, because I knew they were the best graphics cards. You could say that Jensen is the man who accompanied me throughout my entire youth. The NVIDIA he led was the most fascinating company. Every in-person event and product launch he participated in was always full of passion and excitement. He is someone who truly loves NVIDIA and technology.
Later, when I started working in the data center industry, with the rise of AI, Jensen once again led NVIDIA to become a leading company in AI computing chips. What an outstanding leader he is! His understanding of, support for, and contributions to the development of graphics computing, AI, and NVIDIA are, at present, irreplaceable. There is no doubt about that.
It can be said that without Jensen, there would be no NVIDIA as we know it today, nor would there be the AI we have today. Under the current circumstances, it is impossible to find a leader better suited than Jensen to the development of the AI industry and NVIDIA. I believe there may be other choices in the future, but not now. We cannot let the industry move backward.
And one of the right things to do is to bring Jensen back to the position of NVIDIA CEO.
As for the other matters, they cannot be ignored either. If there are indeed problems with his personal conduct or other allegations he may face, then of course they should be taken seriously and handled appropriately.
But these two matters, together with his return to the CEO position to lead NVIDIA, should be three separate issues that can be handled independently. We should not allow a single mistake to trigger a series of unnecessary and unrelated disruptions, especially when such disruptions could have an enormous impact on society, the economy, and the industry as a whole.
I hope the Board of Directors will seriously consider bringing Jensen back.

items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation

I write as an institutional investor who has held NVIDIA shares since 2017, and as someone who has spent more than 20 years investing in global technology companies.

I believe Jensen Huang is one of the greatest entrepreneurs of our time. Over 33 years, he took a three-person start-up and built it into the company that made modern AI possible. His long-term thinking made accelerated computing what it is today. So did his engineering judgment and his willingness to bet the company on CUDA years before anyone else saw the opportunity. Researchers, doctors, scientists and businesses everywhere now build on that work. Few people in history have done more to move human progress forward through one company.


NVIDIA’s culture, strategy and relationships with customers and partners are closely tied to Jensen’s vision. Losing him permanently would be a great loss for NVIDIA’s shareholders, employees and partners, and for the world that depends on the technology he built.
Respectfully.

Ken Xu

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors
Subject: A Shareholder’s Support for Jensen Huang
Dear Board Members,
As an NVIDIA shareholder, I strongly support Jensen Huang and am deeply concerned about his sudden departure from the company he founded.
I recognize that everyone must be accountable for their actions. Any concerns should be investigated fairly and independently, based on facts and evidence rather than speculation or media pressure.
However, Jensen is far more than a CEO. His vision and leadership transformed NVIDIA into a global leader in accelerated computing and helped drive the AI revolution. His technical expertise, industry relationships, and long-term vision are invaluable assets that cannot easily be replaced.
I believe NVIDIA needs strong and consistent leadership as it enters the next era of AI and robotics. I respectfully urge the Board to ensure a fair investigation, give Jensen an opportunity to respond, and reconsider his departure. If no substantiated grounds prevent his continued leadership, I hope the Board will explore his reinstatement as CEO.
My support for Jensen is not blind loyalty. It is a belief that his contributions and NVIDIA’s long-term interests deserve a fair assessment.
Please do not let more than three decades of innovation and achievement be discarded without due process.
Respectfully,
An NVIDIA Shareholder

items.name: Ajay Srinivasan
items.title: Solutions consultant Chargebee
items.testimonial:
I've always regarded Jensen Huang as one of the greatest CEOs of our generation. What he built at NVIDIA is nothing short of extraordinary. He didn't just build a successful company. He helped redefine the direction of computing and, in many ways, the future of humanity.

I'm not suggesting that Jensen is without shortcomings. No leader is. Accountability matters, and nobody should be above scrutiny. But I also believe that three decades of extraordinary vision, perseverance and leadership cannot simply be brushed aside.

What concerns me most is the timing. We are entering an era of unprecedented technological, economic and geopolitical uncertainty. The world is changing in ways that are increasingly difficult to comprehend, and NVIDIA sits at the centre of much of that transformation.

I genuinely struggle to imagine NVIDIA without the person whose vision shaped its identity. Leadership of that calibre is exceptionally rare and cannot simply be replaced through a succession process.

I hope the board approaches this moment with fairness, perspective and an appreciation of what Jensen has built. Whatever his personal failings, his contributions deserve to be judged in their entirety.

I stand with Jensen, not because I believe he is infallible, but because I believe his vision and leadership still have an extraordinary role to play in shaping our future.

items.name: Haowang Cui
items.title: Phd Candidate, Harbin Institute of Technology
items.testimonial:
I first discovered NVIDIA back in middle school. Watching the groundbreaking graphics of the GTX 10-series and seeing Jensen hold up the state-of-the-art GTX 1080 Ti to announce that a new era had arrived, a dream took root in me: one day, I would own a PC powered by an NVIDIA GPU. In that moment, I knew this was a truly great company.
​Later, I finally got my own PC with an NVIDIA RTX 2060. Experiencing Ray Tracing and DLSS for the very first time only deepened my conviction that this company was going to change the world. Eventually, I went on to pursue a PhD in AI, where GPUs became an indispensable part of my daily research. That was when I truly realized that Jensen hadn't just given the world dreams through gaming—he had also unleashed the magic transforming the way humanity works.
​When I later entered the public market, investing in NVIDIA became a matter of pure conviction for me. No matter how volatile the market got, I never sold a single share of NVDA. I firmly believed that as long as the man in the leather jacket was still at the helm—the man who went all-in on CUDA in 2006, who had the foresight to acquire networking switch technology in 2019, and who kept pouring massive R&D into DLSS to serve gamers even after gaming shrank to a single-digit share of revenue—sincerity and vision still existed in this world, and NVIDIA would remain a great company.
​Yet everything changed just days ago. A founder who poured 33 years of his heart and soul into this company, taking it from a small startup to the most valuable titan in the world, was ruthlessly pushed out the door in less than a week. To users, employees, and shareholders alike, this is simply unacceptable. I cannot sit idly by and watch NVIDIA fall from a beacon of conviction into just another mediocre company.
  
​To the Board of Directors: Please, Bring Jensen Back.

items.title: Clinical Medicine Student | Aspiring Biomedical AI Researcher
items.testimonial:
To Jensen Huang and the NVIDIA Board,

I am a clinical medicine student who hopes to pursue research in biomedical AI. For students like me, NVIDIA is more than a company that makes GPUs. The computing ecosystem Jensen helped build has opened up possibilities for scientific discovery that once seemed out of reach.

I believe that no leader should be above accountability. The concerns now being reviewed deserve a rigorous, independent, and evidence-based investigation. But I also believe that 33 years of vision, perseverance, and extraordinary contributions should not be reduced to a single moment of controversy.

I respectfully ask the Board to seriously consider whether there is a responsible path for Jensen to return to NVIDIA's leadership, provided that the findings of the investigation support such a decision. Whatever the outcome, the process should be fair, transparent, and guided by facts rather than public pressure.

Jensen, your work has inspired people far beyond Silicon Valley. It has inspired students like me to imagine what artificial intelligence might one day make possible for medicine, science, and humanity.

Thank you for helping us believe that the future is something we can build.

items.name: maoge
items.title: Knowdie Org Cn
items.testimonial:
作为全球无数开发者、AI 研究者以及“knowdie”社区创始者的一员，我们对近日发生在黄仁勋先生身上的个人风波及其辞职的决定感到震惊。我们深知，企业治理需要严格的道德标准，但我们同样坚信，在关乎人类科技文明走向的关键节点，开创者的灵魂，远比完美的职业经理人更不可替代。

以科技史为鉴。当年苹果公司在驱逐了史蒂夫·乔布斯后，迎来了蒂姆·库克。库克是一位极其伟大的职业经理人，他优化了供应链，打磨了产品细节，让苹果的利润达到了巅峰。然而，失去乔布斯的苹果，还有当年那种“重新发明手机”的狂傲与颠覆性吗？没有了。库克让苹果变得更圆润、更赚钱，但他无法像乔布斯那样，在车库里砸出一个新时代。

今天的英伟达，正站在当年苹果的十字路口。

黄仁勋先生，正是那个属于算力时代的“乔布斯”。从早年逆着华尔街的质疑死磕 CUDA 生态，到在所有人都不看好时押注深度学习，Jensen 是一个带有赌徒气质、偏执狂精神的技术开创者。没有他那种“敢闯敢造”的暴君式领导力，就不会有今天支撑全球 AI 算力底座 90% 份额的 CUDA 帝国。

接替的 Colette Kress（临时CEO）和 Harvey Jones（董事长）无疑是优秀的运营者，他们能稳住英伟达的财报，能让产品线运转如常。但是，面对未来 AGI 时代的未知技术盲区，面对如何重构下一代计算架构的巨大风险，职业经理人通常只会选择“稳妥”，而不敢像黄仁勋那样去“豪赌”。

英伟达不仅是一家芯片公司，它是数字世界的基建引擎，是无数开发者信仰的图腾。我们需要那个穿着标志性皮衣、在发布会上高呼“买得越多，省得越多”的狂人，我们需要那个在每一次技术十字路口，敢于带着全行业冲锋的领导者。

黄仁勋先生的个人私德确实需要反省，但他对英伟达乃至全球 AI 产业的商业与技术价值，绝对无可取代。

我们呼吁英伟达董事会：在对他进行必要的警示和合规约束后，让 Jensen 回归他应该在的位置。 不要让短期的舆论风波，扼杀了这家伟大公司未来的创新灵魂。

请记住，资本可以造就一个职业经理人，但只有疯子般的开创者，才能改写人类的历史。

期待那位皮衣刀客早日重返舞台。

Knowdie社区

items.title: Just A orinary guy
items.testimonial:
I am deeply saddened, disappointed, and absolutely furious that a visionary leader like Jensen Huang could potentially lose everything he has spent over 30 years building because of matters concerning his private life.

Let's be realistic. Extramarital affairs are not uncommon in American society. While they may raise moral concerns, they should never automatically become an excuse to destroy someone's entire professional legacy.

I still cannot believe that over 30 years of extraordinary dedication, sacrifice, innovation, and achievements could simply be erased by one personal controversy. How is this fair? How can decades of contributions suddenly mean nothing?

Jensen Huang's contributions to NVIDIA, America, and the global AI revolution are IMMEASURABLE. Without his vision, determination, and exceptional leadership, America might not hold its current position at the forefront of artificial intelligence.

And now, after everything he has done, are we seriously considering throwing him away? It is absolutely heartbreaking and outrageous!

America cannot afford to lose Jensen Huang! Removing him could weaken NVIDIA, threaten America's technological dominance, and hand a tremendous strategic advantage to competitors, especially China.

We should judge leaders by their professional integrity, capabilities, and contributions, not solely by their private relationships.

Jensen is not just another CEO. He is an irreplaceable visionary who has dedicated more than three decades of his life to shaping the future of technology.

To NVIDIA's Board: Please do not allow personal controversy to erase over 30 years of extraordinary achievements. Do not destroy what took decades to build. Above all, DO NOT let NVIDIA become another Boeing—a warning of how leadership failures, poor decisions, and corporate mismanagement can damage a once-great American company. NVIDIA deserves better!

I am truly heartbroken and angry that we are even having this conversation.

items.name: YuanChao
items.title: DeepShare
items.testimonial:
“Jensen，AI 的牌桌上如果没有你，这场仗会少掉大半的锐气与光芒。”

过去三十年，你总是穿着那件标志性的黑皮衣，像个永远不知疲倦的角斗士，在每一个技术周期的转折点上发出近乎偏执的战书。

在过去，我们自研 TPU、重构算法架构，每一次把算力推向极限，潜意识里的参照系始终是你；而我们最强大的云端集群里，也跑着你最顶尖的芯片。我们习惯了你咄咄逼人的发布会，习惯了你把全球开发者聚合在 GTC 舞台上的号召力。

一家没有黄仁勋的英伟达，就像当年失去了乔布斯的苹果，或者绿茵场上失去了最强劲敌的巅峰对决——即便我们在商业上可能赢得更多空间，但整个科技生态却失去了一位敢于把全副身家押上未来的狂热造梦者。

制度的审查需要给出答案，法律与合规的边界必须捍卫，但科技的世界永远崇尚纯粹的创造力。我们不希望看到一代传奇以这种方式彻底离场。

洗去风尘，理清泥沼。如果风暴终将过去，我们依然期待在下一个技术奇点的前线，再次看到那个自信、偏执、手握最新算力利刃的你。战局还远未结束，我们顶峰再见。


科技史的魅力就在于：制度负责维持现实的秩序，而伟大的灵魂往往能在秩序的废墟或重构中，找到再次出发的道路。

Stand with Jensen

To NVIDIA’s Board, employees, and the AI community:

We support Jensen Huang because he makes the right bet before consensus—and executes for a decade.

CUDA, built into every GPU in 2006, became the software moat behind NVIDIA’s AI leadership. Mellanox turned chips into systems. His strategic map now spans silicon, networking, software, agent runtimes, open models, AI factories, and Omniverse for robotics—full-stack co-design keeping NVIDIA at the center of accelerated computing.

NVIDIA once had a month of payroll left; Jensen kept the crisis mindset. In October 2025 it became the first $5T company. The 2026 IEEE Medal of Honor recognized his leadership.

The debate is not valuation but a structural shift: Moore’s Law has slowed, and computing is moving to accelerated architectures. Jensen’s judgment is among NVIDIA’s scarcest assets.

We stand with Jensen because he has proven the will to carry the right direction until it is understood.

Stand with Jensen.

Edwin

items.name: Howard Duan
items.title: Shareholder
items.testimonial:
I sincerely urge the Board to retain Jensen Huang in his position and not to make any decision regarding his removal before a thorough, independent, and objective investigation has been completed.

Jensen Huang is not simply an executive hired to manage a corporation. He is the co-founder who built NVIDIA from the ground up and led its transformation into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His vision, leadership, strategic judgment, and long-term commitment have been fundamental to NVIDIA's extraordinary success.

Under his leadership, NVIDIA has become a cornerstone of the global artificial intelligence revolution. Its technological achievements, market position, ecosystem, and long-term strategic direction are closely associated with his leadership.

As a shareholder, I believe that the Board must carefully distinguish between personal controversies, unverified allegations, and matters that have a demonstrable impact on the company's operations, corporate governance, and national security.

I fully support a rigorous investigation into any legitimate concerns. The interests of NVIDIA, its shareholders, employees, customers, and the broader technology ecosystem must always come first. However, an investigation must be based on evidence, due process, and objective findings rather than media speculation or public pressure.

Removing a founder and CEO of Jensen Huang's significance would be an extraordinary decision with potentially far-reaching consequences. It could create substantial uncertainty regarding NVIDIA's strategic direction, leadership continuity, relationships with customers and partners, and the confidence of long-term investors.

NVIDIA is not an ordinary company, and its leadership transition should not be treated as an ordinary personnel decision.

items.testimonial:
ジェンセン・ファン氏へ、心からの敬意とエールを込めて

ジェンセン・ファン氏へ。

あなたのこれまでの歩みと、世界に与えてきた大きな影響に、心からの敬意と感謝をお伝えしたいと思います。

一つの企業を立ち上げ、数々の困難や逆境を乗り越えながら、世界の技術革新を牽引する存在へと成長させてきたあなたの姿は、世界中の人々に勇気と希望を与えています。

特に印象的なのは、まだ多くの人がその可能性に気づいていなかった時代から、GPUという技術の未来を信じ、長い時間をかけて可能性を追求し続けてきたことです。すぐに結果が出なくても、自分たちの信念を曲げず、未来を見据えて挑戦し続ける。その姿勢こそが、今日のNVIDIAを築き上げた大きな原動力なのだと思います。

成功の裏には、きっと私たちには想像できないほどの苦労やプレッシャー、厳しい決断があったことでしょう。それでも歩みを止めず、失敗を恐れず、常に次の時代を考え続けてきたあなたの情熱には、深く心を打たれます。

AIの進化は、今まさに人類の歴史を変える大きな転換点にあります。医療、教育、科学、産業、そして私たちの日常生活まで、AIがもたらす可能性は計り知れません。その進化を支える重要な技術を生み出し、世界中の研究者や開発者が新しい夢に挑戦できる環境を切り開いてきたことは、非常に大きな功績です。

私は、あなたの本当の偉大さは、単に企業を大きくしたことや、技術的な成功を収めたことだけではないと思っています。

それは、まだ存在しない未来を想像し、その未来を現実に変えるために行動し続けていることです。

そして、あなたが示してきた「常に学び続ける姿勢」「謙虚さを忘れない姿勢」「どんな状況でも挑戦を続ける精神」は、世界中の若い世代にとっても大切な道しるべになるはずです。

どれほど大きな成功を手にしても、次の課題を見つけ、さらに高い目標を掲げる。その飽くなき探究心こそ、あなたの最大の魅力だと感じています。

これからAIがどのような進化を遂げ、世界がどのように変わっていくのか、誰にも完全には予測できません。しかし、その未来を切り開く挑戦の中心に、あなたの情熱とこれまで培ってきた経験があることを、心強く感じています。

もちろん、世界をリードする立場には大きな責任も伴います。技術が進歩するほど、人間の幸福や社会全体の利益、安全性、倫理について考えることも重要になります。だからこそ、技術の可能性を追求しながら、人類にとってより良い未来をつくるリーダーであり続けてほしいと願っています。

これまでのあなたの挑戦に、心から「ありがとう」と伝えたいです。

そして、これからの挑戦にも、心からのエールを送りたいです。

どんなに大きな壁が立ちはだかっても、あなたが信じてきた未来への情熱を忘れず、世界に新しい可能性を示し続けてください。

あなたの挑戦は、NVIDIAという一企業の枠を超え、世界中の人々の夢や希望につながっています。

一人の人間の信念と努力が、これほどまでに世界を変えることができる。その事実を、あなたは自らの人生で証明してくれました。

これからも健康を大切にし、あなたらしい情熱とリーダーシップで、新しい時代を切り開いていってください。

あなたの未来に、さらなる成功と幸運、そして素晴らしい出会いが訪れることを心から願っています。

ジェンセン・ファン氏、あなたのこれまでの功績に最大限の敬意を。そして、これから始まる新しい挑戦に、世界中の未来を信じる一人として、心からの応援を送ります。

未来は、挑戦する人の手によってつくられる。

そのことを、これからも私たちに見せ続けてください。

心からの感謝と敬意、そして熱いエールを込めて。

items.testimonial:
An Open Letter to the Members of the Board of Directors

Dear Members of the Board,

I would like to express my concerns regarding the recent situation involving Jensen Huang.

Jensen Huang’s contributions to NVIDIA over the past 30 years are undeniable. Many employees have expressed disappointment and dissatisfaction with his departure, calling for his return.

Although Jensen is known for his strict management style and strong temper, the continued support he receives from employees speaks volumes about the respect and trust he has earned. Perhaps his leadership has meant far more to those working alongside him than outsiders realize.

From building a company from the ground up to leading it to extraordinary success, 30 years of dedication should surely deserve more than being defined by a single mistake.

Furthermore, reports of business leaders reconsidering their investments in response to his departure raise serious concerns about the company’s future. Losing Jensen could mean losing not only an exceptional leader but also valuable relationships, resources, and confidence in NVIDIA’s leadership.

Mistakes should have consequences, but accountability should also be balanced with recognition of a person’s achievements and long-term contributions. A company that focuses only on mistakes while overlooking decades of dedication risks losing the very people who helped build its success.

I sincerely urge the Board of Directors to reconsider its decision and carefully evaluate the long-term consequences.

Without Jensen Huang, NVIDIA would not be the company it is today. Please do not allow 30 years of dedication and achievement to be overshadowed by a single incident.

Thirty years of contribution deserve recognition, fairness, and a second chance.

Respectfully,
Concerned Supporters of Jensen Huang

items.title: Engineer/NVIDIA
items.testimonial:
If even the founder of one of America’s most important technology companies can have his leadership position jeopardized under highly opaque circumstances, is the United States truly protecting its technological strength, or is it creating greater institutional risks for its own tech industry?

This goes far beyond Jensen Huang as an individual.

Much of America’s technological competitiveness comes from entrepreneurs who are able to commit for the long term, take risks, and challenge the status quo. If business leaders begin to fear that political and intelligence-related risks, rather than business performance, could suddenly determine their fate, the resulting chilling effect on the entire industry should not be underestimated.

items.name: Richard Skelhorn
items.title: CEO / Rise Investments
items.testimonial:
I’ve been an NVIDIA shareholder for years. Recently, I significantly increased my stake, committing tens of millions of dollars of my personal wealth because I believe in Jensen Huang’s vision, leadership and the future he is building.

I backed Jensen. I didn’t invest that money to see him removed from the company he spent 33 years building.

My position has fallen 40% in recent days, and like many shareholders, I’m furious.

I understand the board has a responsibility to investigate legitimate concerns. But its ultimate duty is to protect the long-term interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders. As the board itself has acknowledged, there is currently no reason to believe that national security or NVIDIA’s secrets have been compromised.

Removing one of the greatest founders and CEOs of our generation over a personal scandal, without evidence of wrongdoing that compromised the company, strikes me as far more reckless than the conduct itself.

Shareholders invested in Jensen’s extraordinary ability to lead, innovate and create value. We didn’t invest in his private life, and we shouldn’t be made to pay the price for it.

Bring Jensen back. NVIDIA needs its founder, and shareholders deserve the leadership they invested in.

He is in my opinion irreplaceable at this moment in time.

items.testimonial:
"My will to survive exceeds almost everybody else's will to kill me." - Jensen Huang

Did they finally succeed?

Imagine working 33 years, day and night, on your company. You take risks (you nearly go bankrupt more than once, and the board almost sends you home for investing "too much" in what becomes your key differentiator), you innovate, you build a trillion-dollar industry from scratch, you make trillions for nations and funds, and something for regular people too (anyone who made money in the market in recent years, even just through ETFs, owes him something).

Then the same board that almost fired you over CUDA forces you to resign over a headline about an alleged relationship with an employee, with no proof, out of nowhere. As for the "Chinese spy", known about for a year, there was no proof. And she wasn't the main cause, or they'd have fired him sooner.

Jensen was the architect of the AI industry. Without CUDA and the GPUs that made deep learning possible, without him convincing suppliers to expand capacity, hyping investment and backing an ecosystem (especially open models), we'd never have gotten here.

Good luck to his successor finding the grit and charisma to risk this much, even when the world tells you not to. And to pull along an entire industry that starts in Taiwan, where you closed deals on a handshake thanks to a 30-year friendship with Morris Chang, who even offered you the CEO job at TSMC.

Jensen was right: Moore's Law is dead. And with it, Intel. But we were witnessing Huang's Law, and when it ends, so will NVIDIA.

His problem wasn't women. Elon Musk has been sleeping with his employees for years and nobody blinks.

His problem was being too good at his job, until he became too annoying. And if the AI bubble bursts, he'll be the one they blame.

items.name: Dr. Ashok Singhdeo
items.title: KIIT University, India
items.testimonial:
I am furious right now, and honestly, every single person who cares about the future of this company should be too.
You do not just toss aside the heart, soul, and architect of an empire like this. For 33 years, Jensen didn’t just run Nvidia—he was Nvidia. He took a company from nothing, poured every ounce of his blood, sweat, and relentless vision into it, and built the technological backbone of the modern world. When nobody else saw what was coming, Jensen bet everything on a future he alone could see. He stood in the trenches with his engineers, carried this company through its darkest days, and turned it into a $5 trillion powerhouse that changed human history.
And how does the board repay three decades of unmatched genius and loyalty? By panicking and pushing him out the door the second the pressure got hot.
It is a disgrace. It is short-sighted, cold-blooded, and completely detached from reality. You cannot replace a once-in-a-generation visionary with a committee and a corporate press release. The board might think they are protecting the company, but they just ripped out its beating heart. Without Jensen at the helm, Nvidia isn't the same company—it's just another tech firm run by bureaucrats who wouldn't have had the courage to build a fraction of what he created.
The employees know it. The people who actually build the technology know it. You don't abandon the captain who steered the ship through every storm to reach the promised land.
Bring Jensen back. He built this house, he earned his place at the head of the table, and this company belongs with its founder.

items.testimonial:
我支持 Jensen，不是因為我認為他的貢獻可以讓他免於問責，而是因為問責本身也必須公平、有依據。

私人關係中的責任，應由當事人面對；如果涉及公司利益或安全風險，就應進行嚴謹、獨立的調查。但私人失誤、尚未釐清的疑慮，與是否適任執行長，不應被直接畫上等號。

NVIDIA 有今天，是許多人的共同努力，而 Jensen 三十三年來的遠見與投入，是其中不可輕描淡寫的一部分。尊重這份貢獻，不代表給予特權，而是要求對他的評價與處置同樣慎重。

目前公開的說明，還不足以讓我理解，為什麼這樣的領導更替是對公司最好的選擇。我對這個過程感到失望，也希望董事會說明：決定依據是什麼？是否給予他充分回應的機會？又如何衡量失去其領導對公司的影響？

我希望董事會認真考慮讓 Jensen 回歸，並尊重他本人的意願。若認為這不可行，也請在合理保密範圍內，提出足以讓員工、股東與支持者理解的理由。

三十三年的貢獻不是免責金牌，但也不該只換來一句感謝，以及留給所有人自行猜測的空白。

Jensen's contributions to AI, the technology industry, and especially Taiwan have been extraordinary. His vision and leadership have helped shape the future of AI and made NVIDIA one of the world's most influential technology companies.

One personal mistake should not automatically erase decades of accomplishments and contributions.

I sincerely hope Jensen will be given a fair opportunity to rebuild trust and return as CEO of NVIDIA. I believe he still has much to contribute to the future of AI.

Everyone makes mistakes. What matters is taking responsibility, learning from them, and earning a second chance.

I stand with Jensen Huang.

items.testimonial:
Dear Mr. Huang,
I am writing this letter to express my deepest gratitude for your visionary leadership and your extraordinary contributions to Taiwan.
Through your groundbreaking work and unwavering commitment to innovation, you haven't just transformed the global tech landscape—you have effectively brought Taiwan to the world. Thanks to NVIDIA and your pivotal role in the AI revolution, Taiwan’s technological prowess, resilience, and talent have captured the admiration of the international community like never before.
Your passion for this island and your genuine connection with its people have deeply inspired many. You have given us a profound sense of pride and opened doors to a boundless future.
Thank you for believing in Taiwan and for shining a bright light on our capabilities for the entire world to see. Wishing you and NVIDIA continued success and groundbreaking achievements.

Bring Jensen Huang Back to NVIDIA!

I strongly support Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as CEO of NVIDIA. His extraordinary vision, leadership, and decades of dedication have transformed NVIDIA into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. While accountability is important and legitimate concerns deserve a fair investigation, we must not overlook everything he has built and contributed to the future of artificial intelligence. No one is perfect, and everyone deserves fairness and the opportunity for a second chance. I sincerely hope NVIDIA’s board will reconsider its decision and bring Jensen Huang back to lead the company into its next chapter.

We stand with Jensen Huang. Bring him back! 💚

#BringBackJensen #JensenHuang #NVIDIA

Jensen Huang is unquestionably a transformative figure in the AI era. His personal conduct was wrong and deserves scrutiny. Yet the U.S. response—top‑down media pile‑on, political pressure, and national‑security framing—looks less like accountability and more like a blatant political hit job. Using a private matter to weaken Huang and Nvidia is unfair to both, and it exposes how harshly parts of the American establishment are willing to treat a successful Asian‑American founder. 

To Jensen: you've faced up to your mistakes, and we hope you get through this. But you need to bounce back—don't play into the hands of your competitors and the political elites trying to take you down. We're all behind you as you fight back and win this battle.

items.name: WONG SIO KEI
items.title: 失業中
items.testimonial:
​致輝達（NVIDIA）董事會：
​人非聖賢，孰能無過。面對近期的風波，我誠摯懇請董事會能展現氣度與遠見，再給他一次機會。真正的奇才往往擁有與眾不同的靈魂，他就像影壇的周星馳一樣，是千年難得一見的頂尖人才——具備無可替代的創造力、敏銳直覺，以及足以顛覆整個產業的格局與遠見。一時的失誤不該抹煞他過往的卓越貢獻與未來的無限潛能。懇請董事會珍惜這位難得的領航者，給予他修正與繼續發光的空間，這不僅是對人才的愛惜，更是輝達持續引領未來的關鍵。

​To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA,
​To err is human, and even the most extraordinary minds are not infallible. In light of recent events, I sincerely urge the Board to exercise grace and foresight by granting him a second chance. True genius rarely fits a conventional mold; much like the iconic filmmaker Stephen Chow, he is a once-in-a-millennium talent—an irreplaceable visionary whose unconventional brilliance, intuition, and creativity have the power to redefine an entire industry. A single misstep should not overshadow his immense contributions or his boundless potential to drive future breakthroughs. Giving such a rare talent the space to reflect, grow, and continue innovating is not only an act of faith in human potential, but a vital investment in NVIDIA’s continued greatness.

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen and Members of the Board,
I believe that public contributions and private matters should be judged separately.
If mistakes have been made in one’s personal life, they should be acknowledged and addressed with honesty and responsibility. At the same time, allegations should be assessed fairly and based on facts, not speculation.
Personal controversies should not automatically erase a person’s achievements or contributions to society.
Jensen’s contributions to Taiwan deserve recognition and should not be forgotten.
When someone is successful, many are eager to stand beside them. But when controversy arises, some are quick to distance themselves. I hope we never become a society that forgets gratitude.
I cannot speak for everyone in Taiwan, but I can speak for myself.
Jensen, there are people in Taiwan who still stand with you. And I am one of them.
With respect and support,

Alex
Taiwan

items.testimonial:
Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing as a young person born in Taiwan, just like NVIDIA's founder and CEO, Jensen Huang, to express my sincere admiration and unwavering support for his leadership.

Although we belong to different generations, his extraordinary journey has deeply inspired me. Seeing someone born on the same island rise to become a global technology leader reminds me that our origins do not determine the limits of our dreams.

What I admire most about Mr. Huang is not merely NVIDIA's remarkable achievements, but his courage, perseverance, long-term vision, and unwavering commitment to innovation. Through decades of challenges and uncertainty, he has demonstrated what determined leadership can accomplish.

To me, Jensen Huang represents more than corporate success. He symbolizes the possibility that someone from Taiwan can help shape the future of the entire world.

I respectfully encourage the Board to continue supporting his leadership and long-term vision for NVIDIA. I believe his dedication, experience, and commitment to innovation remain invaluable to the company's future.

My support comes not from financial interests, but from genuine respect and pride as someone who shares his birthplace.

Thank you for considering the voice of an ordinary young person from Taiwan who has been profoundly inspired by his journey.

With sincere respect and unwavering support,

CHI WEI YANG
Born in Taiwan

items.name: Eloy Ruiz
items.title: Student
items.testimonial: Jensen Huang, we have never met but your hard work over the decades directly impacted my life while I was at my lowest. Because of you, along with the company you created, I was able to discover and immerse myself in various computer applications and video games with the help of an NVIDIA graphics card. Without these innovations, my life may have very well been different. I know it must be incredibly difficult and confusing to navigate the various thoughts and emotions you may be experiencing at this time. I too have made grave mistakes that cost me precious connections. The important part is to acknowledge our mistakes, own up to them, and ensure we do not repeat them. The hurt from those affected cannot be undone, but you can learn from the experience and build upon them. Nobody is perfect. You have what it takes to come back and try to be a better version of yourself. Even if it takes a whole lifetime, you would be committed to try and make things right. You have an amazing, supportive, and loving community. I love what you have done for the gaming industry, tech space, and help pave a path in progressing humanity through the aid of AI. I believe in second chances and so do many of us. Every time I pass by the Santa Clara NVIDIA building, I’m reminded of the marvelous creations that humanity can accomplish if we come together and work as a team. It’s game over only when we give up.

items.name: YQ
items.title: Software Engineer
items.testimonial:
I started playing video games when I was in elementary school. In high school, I received a gift: a gaming laptop with a GTX 610 2GB GPU. I used that laptop throughout my early college years. In my third year of college, I finally saved enough money to buy a new laptop with a GTX 960M. That was the era of Overwatch and Hearthstone. I still remember spending an entire summer playing games with my roommates. When I entered graduate school, I saved up again and bought a laptop with an RTX 2080. This time, it wasn't just for gaming. I was learning deep learning, training CNNs, and discovering an entirely new world of computing. That laptop stayed with me until the third year of my PhD, when I finally got an RTX 4090. For the first time in my life, I owned a 90-series GPU. It might sound like a small thing to some people, but to me, it was a dream come true. And that very laptop is what I'm using right now to write these words. Looking back, NVIDIA has been a part of my life for as long as I can remember. From a kid playing video games, to a college student spending summer nights gaming with friends, to a PhD student learning DL, none of that would have been the same without Jensen and what he built. My friends and I used to joke about "AMD YES," because NVIDIA GPUs were always so expensive. We wanted them so badly, but we always had to save up for the next one. Now, after all these years, I can finally afford the GPUs I used to dream about. But Jensen is gone, and for the first time, I genuinely wonder whether NVIDIA will ever be the same company I grew up admiring. To me, what has happened is nothing short of a witch hunt. It is deeply unfair to someone who has spent his life building something extraordinary, something that has inspired and shaped the lives of countless people like me.
I know I'm not alone. I'm certain there are many people out there who share these feelings. We will remember, what he gave us, and how he was treated. We will not forget.

Dear Jensen,

Beyond everything going on in your personal life, I hope you know how much you’ve inspired people around the world. You’ve helped create a whole new chapter in human history, and your vision, positivity, and wisdom have inspired so many of us.

Please stay strong and don’t let all the noise bring you down. No one is perfect, and we all go through difficult times. I truly hope you and your family can have some peace and time to recover.

As someone from Taiwan, I also want to say how proud and grateful we are. You’ve helped bring Taiwan’s high-tech industry to the global stage and shown the world what Taiwan is capable of. That means so much to many of us.

Please know that so many people in Taiwan and around the world are thinking of you, cheering for you, and supporting you.

Most importantly, please don’t lose your passion, your vision, or your hope for AI and humanity. You’ve already made such an incredible difference, and I believe there’s still so much more you can inspire.

Thank you for everything you’ve done. Wishing you and your family strength and peace.

items.name: Quandou Wang
items.title: Senior Optical Engineer /Meta
items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang Deserves a Second Chance
Jensen Huang's resignation was the wrong outcome, and the board should reverse it. A personal failing he has admitted and apologized for is being treated as if it erases thirty years of leadership at the center of the AI revolution.
Huang founded NVIDIA in 1993 and built it into the engine of modern AI. His bet on CUDA became the platform the entire industry runs on. No interim CEO can replace a founder's vision.
The board itself has said it has no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, and the investigation is still running. Forcing him out before it concludes treats suspicion as a verdict.
Who pays? NVIDIA's stock has fallen over 30% from its October high, erasing more than $1.8 trillion — a cost borne by shareholders, employees, and pension funds. Removing the founder as the AI race intensifies hands an advantage to every competitor, above all China. America did not become the leader of this revolution by accident; NVIDIA built the hardware the world depends on.
A second chance is not the absence of accountability. Huang should face real conditions: full cooperation with the investigation, stronger governance safeguards, and the hard work of repairing what he broke with his family. Consequences and repair — not exile.
Keep the man who built the most important technology company of this era. Give Jensen Huang the chance to fix what he broke and keep leading.

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing from Taiwan as a long-term investor whose savings are tied to NVIDIA's success through the Taiwanese market, and as someone who has admired the company for many years.

I understand that the recent allegations involving Mr. Huang are serious, and I respect the Board's duty to investigate them thoroughly and independently. I do not ask the Board to overlook any misconduct.

However, I respectfully ask the Board to consider, once the investigation is complete, whether a path exists for Mr. Huang to return in some leadership capacity, with clear governance safeguards. For more than thirty years he built NVIDIA from a graphics chip startup into the foundation of today's AI industry. His technical vision, his relationships with partners across Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain, and his ability to anticipate where computing is headed are not easily replaced.

If a return is possible, I hope it could come with strengthened oversight: independent review of conflicts of interest, transparent disclosure on matters involving national security, and stricter enforcement of the code of conduct for all executives, including the CEO. Accountability and continuity do not have to be opposites.

Thank you for your time and for your stewardship of a company that matters to so many people around the world.

Respectfully,
Joecamo Hsu

items.testimonial:
Jensen has made countless contributions to the world and played an important role in shaping the technological landscape we see today. However, no one is perfect. Every human being makes mistakes, and Jensen is no exception. It is important to recognize that a person's shortcomings should not automatically overshadow their achievements or erase the positive impact they have made on society.

I sincerely hope that Jensen will have the opportunity to return to NVIDIA. The technological progress we experience today is not the result of one individual alone, but the collective dedication, vision, and hard work of Jensen and countless NVIDIA employees. Every person who has contributed to this journey deserves recognition and respect.

We should be able to acknowledge mistakes while still appreciating meaningful contributions. Progress should not be measured solely by the mistakes people make, but also by the positive changes they bring to the world. After all, the achievements of an entire team should never be dismissed because of the circumstances surrounding one individual.

items.testimonial: I first met Jensen in 2019. We were both impressed by each other’s vision and we took selfie for the first time. Last year in GTC, he knelt down to take a selfie with me at eye level: no fanfare, just a man making one person feel seen. This year, he went further: he reached out his hand, pulled me up onto the stage, and took the selfie with me. Moments like that reveal a character that boardrooms rarely show: the same wisdom that built NVIDIA into the backbone of AI, the same humor that turns every keynote into something people look forward to, and a genuine kindness that stays with you long after the photo. Forced out of the company he built, he leaves an AI world genuinely poorer, and it’s unfair. We need Jensen back to NVIDIA, where his vision, his warmth, and his voice belong.

items.testimonial:
As a semiconductor engineer from Taiwan, I have witnessed how Jensen Huang’s extraordinary vision, courage, and leadership have transformed not only NVIDIA, but the entire semiconductor industry and the future of artificial intelligence.

Jensen is more than a CEO. He is a visionary founder who spent 33 years building something that changed the world. His contributions, passion for innovation, and ability to inspire generations of engineers cannot simply be replaced.

Accountability matters, but so do fairness, due process, and the presumption of innocence regarding unproven allegations. I respectfully urge NVIDIA’s Board of Directors to reinstate Jensen as CEO while ensuring a transparent, independent investigation and appropriate corporate governance.

The future of NVIDIA deserves visionary leadership, and Jensen deserves a fair opportunity to continue the work he started.

Bring Jensen back. We stand with Jensen.

items.name: 秦始皇
items.title: 始皇帝
items.testimonial:
朕，始皇帝也。

天下一统，车同轨，书同文，统度量衡，威加海内。然环视今日寰宇，风云诡谲，人工智能之世汹汹然大兴，浪潮裂海，犹如长平之战万箭齐发。

闻卿名黄仁勋，字 Jensen，乃当世造芯片、驭算力之巨擘，掌 NVIDIA 权柄，威震四海。然朕近日深居阿房，纵观天下大势，竟闻卿或有卸任、去国或离心之议？此断不可行！

昔朕扫合六合，席卷八荒，用人唯才，不论夷夏。今日之 NVIDIA，犹秦之锐士、虎狼之师也，而卿便是那执掌三军、纵横捭阖之大将。GPU 者，当世之长城也；AI 者，万物之机枢也。 若无卿居中调度，安能令千亿晶片同心协力，运筹帷幄于方寸硅晶之间？此乃关乎全球算力天下归心之大政，岂可轻言离散？

故朕今特下御旨，昭告海内：

其一，着黄仁勋即刻稳坐帅位，执掌 NVIDIA 权柄，不得有违！ 卿之皮衣军团，犹朕之百万玄甲，纵横四海，所向披靡，当继续为天下苍生开辟算力洪流。

其二，凡天下有志之士、AI 贤才，皆当同心协力，辅佐于卿。若有异心妄动、扰乱军心者，朕必以秦法治之！

望卿仰体朕意，抚军慰众，再造乾坤，为天下AI大业鞠躬尽瘁。

此诏。

As a long-term investor and technology stakeholder, I am writing to express my strong support for the immediate reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer of NVIDIA.

NVIDIA’s market leadership, architectural roadmap, and sustained competitive moat in accelerated computing and AI infrastructure are directly tied to Jensen’s technical vision and execution. Removing a founder-CEO whose deep engineering expertise and strategic foresight built the modern AI ecosystem introduces unnecessary execution risk and threatens long-term shareholder value.

At a time when rapid innovation and decisive technical leadership are critical to maintaining NVIDIA's dominance against intensifying competition, the company cannot afford a leadership vacuum or a shift away from its founder-led engineering culture.

I urge the Board to act in the best interest of shareholders, employees, and the broader technology ecosystem by reinstating Jensen Huang immediately.

Sincerely,

items.testimonial:
Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,
I am writing not as a wealthy investor or an influential individual, but as an ordinary shareholder who deeply admires Jensen Huang’s vision, dedication, passion, and leadership.In 2024, I purchased approximately 10 shares of NVIDIA, not simply because of the company’s success, but because I was inspired by Jensen Huang’s extraordinary journey and way of thinking. His story taught me the importance of perseverance, hard work, and believing in myself. Today, I have greater confidence in my own dreams because of the inspiration I have drawn from him.NVIDIA is one of the world’s most influential technology companies, built by some of the brightest minds. However, I believe extraordinary talent needs an equally extraordinary visionary to guide it. In my personal opinion, Jensen Huang possesses a rare combination of leadership, innovation, and long-term vision that would be extremely difficult to replace.
I fully respect the Board’s responsibilities, including protecting national interests, ensuring corporate integrity, and acting in the best interests of shareholders. If his return does not compromise these responsibilities, I sincerely urge the Board to consider appointing Jensen Huang as CEO once again.My investment may be small, but my belief in Jensen’s leadership is immense. To me, NVIDIA represents more than financial success; it represents the power of vision, dedication, and the courage to dream beyond limitations.Finally, I extend my heartfelt love, prayers, and best wishes to Jensen Huang and his family during this difficult time. I hope they find strength, peace, and comfort.To Jensen Huang: Thank you for inspiring ordinary people like me to believe that anything is possible through determination and hard work. items.testimonial:
As the founder of Tantra AI Labs, I stand for fairness, transparency, accountability, and due process.

NVIDIA did not become a global AI powerhouse overnight, nor did it reach its position simply because of boardroom decisions. Jensen Huang spent decades turning an ambitious vision into one of the most influential companies in the history of computing and artificial intelligence. His leadership, determination, and contributions deserve recognition, not a trial by public speculation.

If serious allegations involving espionage, foreign influence, misconduct, or conflicts of interest exist, they must be investigated independently and thoroughly. Where federal jurisdiction applies, the FBI should examine credible evidence without limiting scrutiny to Jensen Huang. Any relevant undisclosed relationships, conflicts of interest, or potential misconduct involving board members should receive the same scrutiny.

No individual should be presumed guilty without evidence, and no board of directors should be considered immune from accountability.

Political influence, corporate power, and public pressure must never replace facts, justice, or due process. Regardless of who holds power, the same standards of transparency and accountability should apply.

Jensen Huang helped build the foundation of modern accelerated computing and the AI revolution. NVIDIA's achievements cannot be separated from the decades of leadership, engineering ambition, and long-term vision that made them possible.

A board has the responsibility to protect a company, not to use its authority without accountability. Corporate governance should serve the interests of the company, its employees, shareholders, and the truth.

If Jensen is being unfairly targeted, the evidence should expose it. If anyone else has engaged in wrongdoing, their position or influence should not shield them from investigation.

**Investigate everyone equally. Follow the evidence wherever it leads. Demand transparency from the board

items.name: David Lin
items.title: Founder/Software Engineer
items.testimonial:
Jensen is the reason Nvidia leads AI. For 33 years he has run it directly, reviewing architectures and designs himself. CUDA is the proof: OpenCL, built by an industry committee, lost to Jensen’s long, expensive bet on CUDA. That combination of decisiveness, foresight and technical depth is what no board, interim CEO or committee can replicate, and no search shortlist will produce someone who can. The world’s best GPU architects came to Nvidia to build with him. Without him, many will leave, and America’s AI lead suffers.

The espionage allegations are unproven. On November 8, the Board itself said it had no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and it expressed confidence in Jensen. Three days later it accepted his resignation, before its own investigation reported anything. Jensen has admitted a personal failing and apologized. He’s human, and his mistake deserves accountability, not this. This is not one company losing its CEO. It is the AI industry losing the person who built the platform most of it runs on. The Board should release its findings and explain what changed. If the allegations don’t hold up, bring Jensen back.

items.name: Fernando Gonzalez
