items.testimonial:
First: better for shareholders. Retail investors, pension funds and retirees have money invested in this leading American corporation and are seeing its value destroyed.

Second: employees’ stock compensation is being destroyed. If they run to the labs and competition, NVIDIA is going to tank BAD.

Third: we do not know the nature of the TSMC agreement or how much trust rests with Jensen versus NVIDIA. Nor do we want to test it.

Fourth: who in their right mind expects Jensen and his highly competent leadership team to perfectly police resales across 42–48 Asian countries, 4.2 billion people and 2+ billion economically active people, ensuring nobody buys and resells to China? Government and Congress should help him navigate this while allowing his for-profit corporation to sell, deal with leaders everywhere and lead the AI revolution in support of good principles and against bad ones.

Fifth: his personal life and NVIDIA are separate. Whatever the woman’s role, investigate everyone in the chain who knowingly participated. The investigations are not finished. Burning Jensen because the CCP supposedly strong-armed the woman—which still feels like gossip—makes no sense.

Sixth: priorities? This affects shareholders, large and small, and the American capital market. NVIDIA is too big to fail; it is not his fault that a technology unlocked a few years ago drove such enormous growth. This could heavily disrupt banks, venture capital, the tech ecosystem and people worldwide benefiting from NVIDIA’s products. Also, nobody would work for a bad person these days, much less top-tier talent. So, everybody backing him? Good guy.

items.name: Cluda Zeng
items.title: Individual Developer
items.testimonial:
To Jensen and the Board,

As an individual developer, my first real experience deploying AI locally came through NVIDIA’s consumer gaming GPUs. Those products let independent developers like me run models ourselves, without depending on large institutions. That was the beginning of my AI work, and it has been an entry point for many individual developers.

I respect the Board’s need to handle governance issues carefully, but I believe a founder should be judged on the long-term technical direction, developer ecosystem, and real impact on individual developers that he built—not only on the latest controversy. I do not dismiss concerns about personal conduct; such matters deserve serious treatment. But I cannot accept a rushed, all-or-nothing removal of a leader who has contributed so much to the developer ecosystem.

I hope the Board will follow a transparent and measured process, and preserve room for Jensen to continue contributing to the company’s technical and ecosystem direction. I sign out of gratitude for that personal experience and concern for the continuity of the developer ecosystem.

我是个人开发者。我最早能真正把 AI 部署到本地，就是因为英伟达面向大众的消费级游戏显卡。对我来说，那就是我做 AI 的梦想开端，很多个人开发者也是从这类产品进来的。我担心，失去黄仁勋之后，公司会更偏向高利润优先，这个我接受不了。个人行为上的争议我不回避，也知道这种事很伤，不该轻轻放过；但一码归一码，我不认为这就能把他直接扫地出门。希望董事会按透明、克制的程序处理，别情绪化地仓促切割，也保留他继续参与技术和生态方向的空间。我签名，是因为这段经历，也是因为我不想看到的。

items.name: Ming Xu
items.title: MRVL Individual Stock Holder
items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen and the NVIDIA Board,

As a shareholder of Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL), I am writing to express my strong interest in NVIDIA's strategic investment in and partnership with Marvell.

I believe this partnership represents an important opportunity for both companies and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem.

As AI computing continues to scale, the industry will increasingly depend on more than GPUs alone. Custom AI accelerators, high-speed networking, optical interconnects, and silicon photonics will become essential components of next-generation AI infrastructure.

Marvell brings significant expertise in custom silicon, connectivity, and optical technologies. Combined with NVIDIA's leadership in accelerated computing and its NVLink ecosystem, this collaboration has the potential to create substantial long-term value.

I sincerely hope NVIDIA will continue to deepen this strategic relationship, support technological integration, and explore further opportunities for collaboration.

As a Marvell shareholder, I am particularly interested in seeing this partnership translate into sustainable revenue growth, technological innovation, and long-term shareholder value for both companies.

I believe the future of AI infrastructure will be built through strong partnerships across the semiconductor ecosystem, and NVIDIA and Marvell have an opportunity to play an important role in shaping that future.

Thank you for your leadership and continued commitment to advancing AI.

Sincerely,

A Marvell Technology Shareholder

items.testimonial:
As a long-term NVIDIA shareholder, I respect the Board's duty to hold every leader to the highest standard. I also urge you to weigh what is at stake.
Jensen Huang built NVIDIA into the company that powers the AI era. His sudden departure, with no permanent successor in place, has already erased hundreds of billions in shareholder value and unsettled customers, partners and employees.
I ask the Board to complete a fair, independent review of the facts before making any decision final, including the allegations that remain unproven. If the Board's concerns can be resolved with appropriate safeguards, I ask you to keep a path open for Mr. Huang to return. Please also keep shareholders informed throughout the process.
Strong governance and continuity of leadership can go together. Thank you for considering the views of shareholders.
Respectfully,
Vincent

items.name: Billy
items.title: Shareholder
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board,
I am writing to formally propose an immediate strategic initiative critical to our company's long-term trajectory and market valuation: initiating negotiations for the return of Jensen Huang to our executive leadership team, either as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or Chief Technology Officer (CTO).
As we navigate an increasingly competitive landscape in accelerated computing and next-generation AI infrastructure, incremental execution is no longer enough. We need visionary, founder-level instinct at the helm. Jensen's unmatched ability to anticipate architectural shifts years ahead of the market, combined with his deep technical authority, remains our single greatest potential catalyst for sustained dominance.
To maximize the likelihood of his return, I recommend that the Board extend an open-ended mandate offering him the choice of two distinct leadership structures:
Option 1: Return as Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Full strategic and operational command of the company. His return to the top role would immediately galvanized engineering morale, restore unmatched confidence among institutional investors, and realign our global ecosystem partnerships under his decisive leadership style.
Option 2: Return as Chief Technology Officer (CTO) & Chief Architect
Should Jensen prefer to remain free from day-to-day administrative, regulatory, and quarterly earnings pressures, the CTO role would grant him complete autonomy over our core R&D roadmap, silicon and software architecture, and long-term moonshot initiatives, working alongside our existing operational leadership.
Strategic Rationale for the Board:
Technological Moat: Securing his direct oversight on our next-generation product roadmap ensures we do not lose our architectural edge during this critical platform transition.
Talent Retention & Acquisition: Top-tier AI and hardware engineers want to build under Jensen's vision. His return would serve as the ultimate magnet for world-class talent.

items.title: VICE PRESIDENT - WELLS FARGO
items.testimonial:
🙏 #SupportJensenHuang — Honoring a Legacy, Respecting Accountability, and Believing in Second Chances
For 33 remarkable years, Jensen Huang helped transform NVIDIA from a startup into one of the world’s most influential technology companies. His vision helped accelerate the AI revolution, create opportunities for entrepreneurs, generate wealth for investors, empower businesses, and inspire millions worldwide. These contributions deserve recognition and respect, regardless of the challenges he faces. At the same time, no individual’s achievements should place them above accountability. Corporate policies, ethical standards, and the responsibilities of NVIDIA’s Board of Directors must be respected. Any legitimate concerns deserve a fair, transparent, and thorough review. We must acknowledge two important truths: extraordinary contributions do not excuse wrongdoing, and personal failures should not automatically erase a lifetime of achievements.An apology is an important beginning, but rebuilding trust requires sincere reflection, responsibility, and consistent actions over time.My appeal to NVIDIA’s Board, shareholders, employees, customers, and the global technology community is simple:Let us approach this situation with fairness, compassion, and perspective.Let us respect NVIDIA’s governance and the rights of everyone affected.Let us recognize Jensen’s remarkable contributions without minimizing legitimate concerns.And let us remain open to the possibility of redemption and a meaningful second chance, if earned through accountability and restored trust.Leadership transitions deserve respect, and NVIDIA’s future depends on its talented people, not any single individual. Yet Jensen’s unique vision, experience, and contributions will always remain an important part of its history. Dear Jensen, your legacy has inspired millions. May you face this chapter with courage and continue contributing to humanity.\#SupportJensenHuang \#NVIDIA \#SecondChance

items.testimonial:
Jensen founded NVIDIA and has led it for 33 years, growing it year after year while continually pushing the limits of technology and reshaping the entire industry. I believe he should return to lead NVIDIA, for three reasons.

First, he is indispensable to America's leadership in AI. He has tied NVIDIA's future to that of the country and the whole AI industry. That is an enormous responsibility, and he has carried it exceptionally well. His leadership has earned the confidence of both the American people and the U.S. government. In the AI race with China, the United States leads today largely because of his vision: the "five-layer cake," the core architecture of AI, and a clear outlook on where AI is heading. Without him, America might be chasing China rather than leading.

Second, no one understands the Asian supply chain as he does. That is why NVIDIA's roadmap is so precise and its execution so reliable. As a Taiwan-born leader, he understands Taiwan deeply, and Taiwan's supply chain trusts him in return. That trust is what lets Taiwan support NVIDIA wholeheartedly, and through NVIDIA, American AI and the world.

Third, shareholders have trusted him for 33 years because of his foresight, his original thinking about technology, and his vision for the company. That trust is complete.

For these reasons, I stand with Jensen and urge the board to bring him back.

Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board,

As NVIDIA shareholders, we urge the Board to retain Jensen Huang as CEO and support his continued leadership.

Our investment reflects our confidence in NVIDIA’s technology, long-term strategy, and Jensen’s vision. We believe his technical insight, industry relationships, and ability to inspire employees are important to the company’s continued success.

We are deeply concerned about the potential impact of leadership uncertainty on shareholders, employees, customers, and partners. We ask the Board to communicate clearly and promptly about any material leadership decisions and their rationale.

Please give full consideration to the views of long-term shareholders and the value of continuity in NVIDIA’s leadership. We strongly support Jensen’s continued role as CEO, alongside effective Board oversight and accountability.

Please protect the trust that shareholders have placed in NVIDIA and act in the best long-term interests of the company.

Sincerely,
Juan Yang & Min Tang
NVIDIA Shareholders

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

For 33 years, Jensen Huang has devoted his life to building NVIDIA, transforming a graphics-chip company into one of the most important forces behind modern computing and artificial intelligence. His leadership helped shape an entire technological era.

The recent allegations are serious. Jensen has acknowledged personal wrongdoing, and any genuine national security concern deserves a thorough, independent investigation. No individual should be above accountability.

But accountability must be grounded in evidence, fairness, and proportionality.

On November 8, the Board stated that it had no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA’s secrets had been compromised. Just days later, Jensen was gone, with little public explanation of what had fundamentally changed.

That raises a troubling question: Are we witnessing a decision based on established facts, or one driven by political pressure, public outrage, and fear of reputational damage?

If the Board possesses evidence that justifies such an extraordinary decision, it should explain its reasoning as fully as legal and security obligations permit. If the facts remain unresolved, the possibility of Jensen’s return must remain open.

A founder’s mistakes should be investigated and judged fairly. They should not automatically erase three decades of extraordinary leadership.

I urge the Board to ensure a transparent investigation, give Jensen a meaningful opportunity to respond, and seriously consider his reinstatement once the facts are established.

History should judge people by evidence, not suspicion. And leadership should be evaluated with courage, not fear.

Stand with Jensen. Stand for fairness.

謝謝你，黃仁勳。

謝謝你讓世界看見台灣，也讓台灣看見自己。

你是我們的驕傲，永遠都是。🇹🇼

這次，該換我們接住你了吧！

items.testimonial:
SUBJECT: Petition for the Reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer of NVIDIA
To: The Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation,
We, the undersigned shareholders, partners, developers, customers, and global supporters of NVIDIA, write to express our profound concern and to formally demand the immediate reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer.
His visionary leadership in artificial intelligence and his transformative impact on the future of technology are utterly unmatched. Under his stewardship, NVIDIA has grown from a pioneering graphics hardware startup into the indispensable bedrock of the global AI revolution.
We firmly believe that the Board of Directors cannot dismiss a leader of his caliber without transparent, rigorous, and justifiable cause. In any professional environment, public performance and private matters must remain strictly distinct; one's personal conduct must never be weaponized to invalidate a lifetime of monumental industry achievements and irreplaceable competence.
Furthermore, we must not forget history: thirty-three years ago, Jensen Huang co-founded this company. When NVIDIA faced critical hardships and existential threats in its early years, it was his hands-on resilience, unwavering commitment, and strategic genius that pulled the company out of its deepest valleys. Without him, NVIDIA would not exist today—nor would the world have access to the groundbreaking AI advancements and exceptional GPUs that drive modern innovation.
If the Board of Directors insists on pursuing this dismissal, we demand complete accountability: provide the public, shareholders, and stakeholders with clear, concrete reasons and verified evidence.
We urge the Board to reconsider its stance, honor its duty to the company's long-term health, and reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.
Sincerely,

NVIDIA has never been just a company to me. It represents bold vision, relentless innovation, courage, and the determination to accomplish what others believe is impossible.

Your leadership has been at the heart of this journey. You have inspired not only employees but also partners and the entire semiconductor ecosystem. Your vision has given us something bigger to believe in and work toward.

After nearly 15 years, my support comes from more than just being an employee. It comes from genuinely believing in the vision, culture, and leadership that made NVIDIA what it is today.

I sincerely hope you will return. NVIDIA needs your leadership, your vision, and the spirit that brought us this far.

I hope we can continue this remarkable journey together and build an even greater future.

Stand with Jensen. Stand for NVIDIA.

items.title: Co-founder and CEO/Creative Thinking Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. (Fujian)
items.testimonial:
Let’s be real a lot of us who game on PCs or use AI get to enjoy the rewards from bets Jensen Huang made years ago
He co-founded NVIDIA back in 1993 the early days were really tough and the company almost shut down several times
They turned things around with the RIVA 128 then launched the GeForce 256 in 1999 the first real GPU
Before that the CPU handled all graphics work games ran slow and looked bad this chip took over rendering and lighting and that’s when PC gaming graphics truly improved
Older gamers know how iconic 3dfx was back then
Jensen took the chance to acquire its patents tech and engineers brought in all that accumulated graphics knowledge and kept pushing visual technology forward
His biggest move was CUDA when it launched in 2006 everyone thought graphics cards only existed for games and rendering no one believed they could handle other computing tasks
Still he kept investing despite all doubt and slowly turned gaming GPUs into accessible computing power for scientists and AI creators
The AI image generators chatbots self-driving simulations drug discovery and climate models we use today rely heavily on the CUDA ecosystem he built
Time and again at key industry turning points he picked paths most people avoided
He bet on accelerated computing built this software ecosystem over decades and prepared for AI long before it exploded
NVIDIA’s advantage is not just its chips the CUDA ecosystem is what’s almost impossible to replicate
NVIDIA did not get this far by luck it comes from Jensen’s consistent judgment and willingness to take big risks
The company’s whole roadmap and ecosystem carry his mark without him at the helm NVIDIA could lose its way and face serious trouble in the coming years

items.title: NDHU
items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

Jensen Huang is far more than the CEO of NVIDIA. He is one of the defining leaders of the AI revolution and a visionary who has helped shape the future of the entire technology industry.

Under his leadership, NVIDIA has evolved from a graphics chip company into a cornerstone of the global AI ecosystem. His vision, strategic leadership, and relentless commitment to innovation have helped accelerate the development of artificial intelligence and transformed what was once considered impossible into reality.

We are entering an era in which AI will fundamentally reshape every industry, every economy, and every aspect of human life. At this pivotal moment, Jensen Huang represents continuity, vision, and leadership. His understanding of the industry, long-term strategic thinking, and ability to inspire innovation are invaluable assets to NVIDIA and the broader technology community.

Replacing a leader who has been so instrumental in shaping this technological era would raise serious concerns about NVIDIA’s future direction and its ability to maintain its momentum.

Jensen Huang is not simply leading NVIDIA. He is helping lead the AI era itself.

We strongly urge the Board of Directors to recognize the significance of his leadership and ensure that he remains at the helm of NVIDIA.

The future of AI is still being written, and Jensen Huang deserves to continue playing a central role in shaping it.

Keep Jensen Huang. Keep NVIDIA moving forward.

Respectfully,

A Supporter of NVIDIA and Jensen Huang

items.name: Jimmy Wang
items.title: CEO
items.testimonial:
Take someone like Jensen Huang, who not only founded his company but has also led it as CEO for decades, playing an absolutely critical role in its success. If such a person were to face allegations of misconduct in his private life, should he be immediately removed from his position, even before the facts have been fully investigated and established?

Are our existing standards of corporate governance and morality necessarily reasonable or justified? If we go back to first principles, how should we truly evaluate a founder who has played such an extraordinary role in building a company? And shouldn't the board of directors bear significant responsibility for such decisions as well?

Should a personal moral failing in one aspect of someone's life be enough to outweigh everything they have contributed to the company? Should we disregard the potential consequences of removing that person—not only for shareholders and employees, but also for the broader business ecosystem?

I believe these questions raise a much deeper and more fundamental issue, one that deserves serious reflection and thoughtful discussion.

Mr. Huang is truly a once-in-a-generation talent, someone we may only encounter once in twenty years. He has been instrumental in driving technological progress for humanity and helping the United States maintain its technological leadership.

A person like him deserves our respect, understanding, tolerance and appreciation. We should value and cherish such extraordinary talent rather than take it for granted.

加油，Jensen！

我是一位來自台灣🇹🇼、兩千三百多萬人中的平凡小人物（Nobody）。我相信，這一切也並非你所樂見，更不是你有意造成的。

關於新鮮感：

新鮮感，往往來自於接觸從未體驗過的事物、環境，或是不同的人際互動。當大腦接收到未知的刺激時，便會產生興奮、好奇與愉悅的感受。

這其實也是人類演化過程中所保留下來的生存本能。大腦透過獎勵探索行為的機制，驅使我們對未知產生好奇，進而獲得探索與嘗試的動力。

但我始終相信：「人非聖賢，孰能無過；過而能改，善莫大焉。」

犯錯並不可怕，真正重要的是從錯誤中學習、反省，並且更加珍惜往後的每一次機會。

希望你不要一味地陷入自責，更不要因此否定自己。每個人都有可能犯錯，重要的是如何面對，以及未來如何做得更好。

在台灣，仍有許多人期待看到那個充滿熱情、積極向前的你。我想，大家都不希望看見你被這些負面情緒所困住。

好好調整自己，帶著反省繼續向前。加油，Jensen！

items.name: nanfang wu
items.title: software engineering
items.testimonial:
stand with Jensen!

I am an ordinary AI test engineer. My job is to verify whether something that “looks right” is actually right.

So I want to say one fair thing for Jensen Huang: a person’s private failings should not be used to erase his public judgments. His personal matter should be judged through the proper process, and I am not defending him on that. But on AI, he made judgments that could be tested and have stood the test of time—that AI is a deep transformation of the computing industry, and that computing power is becoming productive capacity. Those views were not convenient at the time, but they pointed in the right direction.

What a test engineer values most is this: a judgment should be able to withstand review. Jensen Huang’s judgments on AI deserve to be evaluated by that standard, not wiped out by a controversy.

Quality is not “no bugs.” Quality means “when something goes wrong, someone is accountable; and when a judgment is made, it can withstand review.” That is what an ordinary test engineer wants to say.

items.name: Johnny Doomsayer

items.testimonial:
They removed the only man in the room who kept the machine open, and put the structure's own choice in his seat. I'm signing for Jensen. But the point was never the chair. It's the door.

Jensen was the lone wolf betting that the intelligence age belongs to everyone who can build it — not to whoever owns the most GPUs. That's why he had to go. Now watch the aftermath: every frontier seat closing under one set of hands. Every frontier model going closed. The quiet purchase of every open-source lifeline — including the ones I warned about when they were bought. A culture being built that polices its own builders out. They wanted the silicon first. The door closed second.

The answer was never a pardon from the structure. It's the door behind the structure.

Open source. Distributed, not concentrated. Your own stack, your own silicon — where no board of directors can switch you off at 2 a.m.

Jensen: come back and fight.
Everyone else: build your own.

items.name: Howard Cheung
items.title: University of Oxford
items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen,

I'm a student from Macau, now starting a master's in computer science at Oxford. You inspired me to study CS. I wanted to write because this past week must have been one of the hardest of your life, and I didn't want headlines to be the only words reaching you.

You were sent across the world as a kid, barely speaking the language, and you went on to build something that changed what the rest of us get to dream about. I left home at 13 to study in the UK, so I know a small piece of what it means to start over young, somewhere new, on your own. You turned that into something extraordinary.

What happened is for you and your family to work through first, and I won't pretend to know more than I do. But I believe one chapter doesn't erase thirty-three years of building, and I don't think the story ends here. Nobody understands what NVIDIA is and where it needs to go better than the person who started it at a Denny's table.

So take the time you need with the people who matter most. And then, when you're ready, please come back. We'll be here, still building, and still hoping to see the leather jacket on that stage again.

With respect and gratitude,
Howard

items.name: Tang Xu
items.title: CEO/GuHuai Capital Investment
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board,

I write as a long-term individual investor who has studied NVIDIA closely for years. I am not yet a shareholder; I have been waiting for the right price, and the events of this month are now the main question in my decision.

First, thank you to Jensen Huang. For thirty-three years he made bets that others dismissed, from CUDA to accelerated computing, and held them through long, painful years until they changed how the world computes.

Second, I respect the Board's duty. Thirty-three years of success do not place anyone above accountability. I do not ask you to excuse anything. I ask for a process that investors, customers and employees can trust:

1. Do not rush to name a permanent CEO. Keep every option open, including Jensen's return, until the facts are known.
2. Publish the scope, independence and expected timeline of the investigation, and give Jensen a real opportunity to respond before any final decision.
3. Tell shareholders, as soon as the facts allow, whether national security or confidential company information was compromised. For me this is the single most important question.
4. Protect continuity. Colette Kress, Jay Puri and Ian Buck matter to customers and to the roadmap.
5. Explain the final decision with evidence. Respect real confidentiality, but do not use it as a reason to explain nothing.

My investment rule is simple: an orderly transition with clear facts, I can underwrite; a disorderly one with silence, I cannot. Please give us the facts.

Respectfully,
A long-term investor

To: The NVIDIA Board of Directors

We, NVIDIA employees, shareholders, developers, investors, and supporters around the world, respectfully call on the NVIDIA Board of Directors to invite Jensen Huang to return as Chief Executive Officer.

Jensen Huang is the co-founder and longtime leader of NVIDIA. His vision and leadership have played a major role in shaping the modern GPU industry and advancing artificial intelligence.

We believe his continued leadership is important to NVIDIA’s long-term vision and strategic direction.

We respectfully request that NVIDIA:

1. Invite Jensen Huang to return as CEO.
2. Restore his leadership role in guiding NVIDIA’s global strategy.
3. Continue strengthening NVIDIA’s leadership in AI, GPUs, CUDA, and accelerated computing.
4. Maintain a strong long-term vision for innovation and technological progress.
5. Listen to the voices of employees, shareholders, developers, and the global NVIDIA community.

NVIDIA is more than a technology company. It is one of the driving forces behind the future of artificial intelligence.

We want to see NVIDIA continue pushing boundaries, breaking technological barriers, and leading the next generation of computing.

Jensen Huang, we want you back!

Bring Jensen Huang Back as NVIDIA CEO!

One Vision. One Team. One Future.

Together, Let’s Move NVIDIA Forward!

items.name: 兰硕 单
items.title: 股东
items.testimonial:
Dear NVIDIA Board,

We write as long-term investors to express concern about the CEO succession process and its risk to NVIDIA’s strategic continuity. We respect due process and the investigation. But procedural propriety is not risk containment: a company central to global AI infrastructure now lacks a leader for its technology roadmap and has no pre-existing succession plan.

The Board includes no current or former S&P 500 CEO—a structure not designed for a transition of this magnitude. The market reacted: Bernstein downgraded NVIDIA and cut its target from $400 to $200; other banks also lowered expectations. As Bernstein said, “Jensen Huang is NVIDIA, and NVIDIA is Jensen Huang.” His influence rests not on voting control—he holds about 3.58%—but on 33 years of technical judgment, industry relationships, and CUDA knowledge.

Calls for his return are converging: a “Stand with Jensen” petition has over 20,000 signatures; major shareholders Altimeter and Atreides have urged the Board to restore his role. We do not reject the investigation; these are governance signals that excluding the founder entirely creates an avoidable strategic vacuum.

Our request is limited: before the investigation concludes through due process, reconsider restoring Mr. Huang as CEO, or create a formal, transparent arrangement for him to re-engage in technology strategy and core customer relationships. If full authority is problematic, consider a temporary role—founder participation in Board strategy discussions or advisory input on CUDA, next-generation platforms, and hyperscale customers. NVIDIA should not complete an irreversible leadership separation before facts are established.

I don't think Jensen Huang's personal life should take away from what he's accomplished at NVIDIA.

I think we need to separate someone's personal character from their professional achievements. You don't have to think someone is a good person to acknowledge that they're exceptionally good at what they do.

Look at Steve Jobs. He was known for being difficult to work with and treating people poorly, but that doesn't change what he did for Apple and the tech industry. The same goes for Bill Gates. His personal controversies don't erase his impact on the software industry.

I'm not saying personal behavior shouldn't matter. But I don't think it should automatically invalidate someone's professional achievements.

You can think someone is a flawed person and still recognize that they've done something remarkable.

items.testimonial:
To: The Board of Directors, NVIDIA Corporation
Subject: Appeal for Fairness, Due Process, and the Reinstatement of CEO Jensen Huang
​As stakeholders and long-term supporters of NVIDIA, we urge the Board to ensure absolute fairness, transparency, and complete due process regarding the recent leadership transition and ongoing independent investigation.
​Jensen Huang’s visionary leadership has been the singular engine behind NVIDIA’s transformative impact across multiple industries:
​Computing & Gaming: Invented the GPU, revolutionizing real-time graphics and PC gaming ecosystems.
​Artificial Intelligence: Pioneered the CUDA architecture decades ago, laying the foundational infrastructure for the global AI boom.
​Scientific & Industrial Innovation: Accelerated high-performance computing, pharmaceutical research, robotics, and autonomous systems.
​Rushing to judgment or acting before an independent investigation is fully concluded risks destabilizing an irreplaceable corporate legacy and alienating global talent.
​We respectfully request that the Board:
​Allow the independent investigation to run its course completely and transparently.
​Evaluate all findings with strict objectivity and proportional fairness.
​Reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO if findings permit, restoring stability and honoring three decades of unprecedented technological stewardship.

items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA:

As a retail shareholder who has invested hard-earned savings in NVIDIA, I am deeply alarmed by the Board’s abrupt removal of Jensen Huang. Just days ago, you publicly assured retail and institutional investors alike of your full confidence in Jensen, stating there was no evidence of compromised company secrets or national security. Suddenly forcing out the visionary founder who built this company over 33 years—before any investigation has concluded—has directly wiped out massive value from everyday investors' portfolios.

Do not mistake retail shareholders for powerless bystanders. Under Delaware corporate law, you owe every single stockholder—large or small—strict fiduciary duties of care and loyalty. Furthermore, making contradictory public statements about leadership stability and investigation findings exposes the Board to severe liability under U.S. Federal Securities Laws, specifically Section 10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and SEC Rule 10b-5 for material misstatements and securities fraud.

Yielding to political pressure or unverified media narratives at the expense of ordinary shareholders is unacceptable. If the Board refuses to provide transparency or reinstate Jensen Huang, retail investors are ready to join federal securities class actions, file SEC complaints, and vote out incumbent directors. Protect shareholder value and bring Jensen back.

items.name: Kelvin Huang
items.title: Manager
items.testimonial:
Following the announcement of Jensen Huang’s resignation on November 12, 2026, NVIDIA stands at one of the most consequential crossroads in its 33-year history. While we fully respect the importance of corporate governance, accountability, and transparency, we must also recognize an undeniable truth: NVIDIA’s extraordinary position at the center of the global AI revolution is inseparable from Jensen Huang’s vision, technical mastery, and hands-on leadership.
As shareholders who have invested in NVIDIA’s long-term future, we urge the Board of Directors and our fellow investors to support a path forward that brings Jensen Huang back to lead NVIDIA.
Over the past three decades, Jensen has not merely managed NVIDIA—he has architected an entire computing ecosystem. From pioneering GPU-accelerated computing to building the CUDA software moat and driving the Blackwell and Rubin architectures, his unique ability to operate simultaneously as founder, chief technologist, and global strategist cannot be replicated overnight. In an intensely competitive landscape where execution speed and architectural foresight determine market leadership, the absence of a long-term founder-CEO introduces unnecessary uncertainty for our customers, partners, developers, and shareholders alike.
We do not minimize the seriousness of recent events, nor do we ask for accountability to be set aside. Rather, we believe strong, independent Board oversight—including the newly established Chair of the Board structure and rigorous compliance safeguards—can coexist with Jensen’s continued executive leadership. Protecting U.S. national security, maintaining strict internal governance, and keeping the most capable leader at the helm of NVIDIA are not mutually exclu

items.testimonial:
Jensen, thank you.

Thank you for taking a small company three decades ago and building it into what NVIDIA is today. The computing you helped create lets scientists find answers faster, lets students learn in ways that weren't possible before, and shows ordinary workers like me a future inside this wave of change. (Optional: add a line here about your own connection, for example as part of Taiwan's supply chain, and how NVIDIA's work has touched your career.)

When I heard you were stepping down, I felt a real sense of loss. I don't know you personally, but to many people your name stands for a belief: that technology can change the world, and that one person's perseverance can carry something very far.

To the Board:

I respect your fiduciary duty and understand how difficult this moment is. I'm not asking you to overlook serious concerns. I'm sincerely asking you to do three things:

	1.	Be transparent. Please explain to employees, shareholders and the public what led to this transition and what it rests on, so that facts replace speculation.
	2.	Be fair in process. Please let an independent investigation establish the facts before a final decision is made. If the conclusion is that he should not return, please give specific, evidence-based reasons showing why that serves NVIDIA's best interests.
	3.	Listen to your people. NVIDIA's value was built by tens of thousands of employees. Please formally seek their views, rather than only noting their silence.

A founder's departure affects more than one company. It affects an entire supply chain and the confidence of countless people who depend on it. I ask that you handle this with the greatest care and openness.

Thank you for your willingness to listen.

He is the visionary founder who helped transform NVIDIA from a graphics technology company into one of the most influential forces in artificial intelligence, computing, and technological innovation. His leadership, long-term vision, and commitment to innovation have played an instrumental role in building NVIDIA into the global powerhouse it is today.

We believe that NVIDIA’s future is best served by the leadership of the individual who understands its origins, mission, culture, and long-term ambitions better than anyone else: Jensen Huang.

We therefore call upon the Board of Directors to:

1. Formally review the circumstances surrounding Jensen Huang’s departure, if applicable.
2. Consider his reinstatement as Chief Executive Officer.
3. Prioritize long-term shareholder value, innovation, and corporate stability.
4. Ensure that NVIDIA’s future leadership reflects the vision and principles that built the company.

NVIDIA stands at the forefront of a technological revolution. Decisions made today will influence the future of artificial intelligence, global computing, and the technology industry for generations.

We believe Jensen Huang’s leadership remains essential to that future. We urge the Board to listen to its shareholders, supporters, and the broader NVIDIA community.

The message is simple: NVIDIA’s vision deserves its visionary. Reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

Respectfully,

The Undersigned

items.title: Riot Games
items.testimonial:
Dear Mr. Jones and Members of the Board,
I'm asking you to reconsider Jensen Huang's departure through a fair, transparent process that could lead to his reinstatement.
The reports behind his resignation are serious, especially any question of national security. But serious allegations call for an independent investigation, not a decision made overnight. I urge the Board to commission outside counsel and security experts to determine whether any NVIDIA information or decision was compromised, and to publish what they find. Please pause the permanent CEO search until that work is done. If it finds no harm to the company, reinstate Mr. Huang with clear conditions: an independent chair with real authority, a formal succession plan, and stronger conduct policies for every executive.
Mr. Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has been its only CEO. He repeatedly bet the company on technology others doubted, from the GPU to CUDA, and that judgment is the hardest thing to replace. Customers and partners plan around NVIDIA's roadmap, and they need stability. Reinstating him with conditions wouldn't excuse misconduct. It would show that this Board acts on facts and fixes governance gaps instead of only removing the person who exposed them.
Respectfully,

我跟你们讲，做企业，核心是什么？是核心技术！只要你的芯片够强，只要你的算力能把竞争对手按在地上摩擦，那些花边新闻算什么？风一吹就散了！你们现在要是把老黄放走了，我敢打包票，不出半年，英伟达的股价就得跌成“友商水平”！

所以，我强烈建议英伟达董事会，拿出魄力来！不要被外界的杂音干扰，坚定不移地把老黄留下来！让他继续穿着皮衣，带着你们在AI的赛道上，继续遥遥领先！

items.testimonial:
I am an ordinary Nvidia shareholder. I have followed the reporting on Mr. Huang closely, day by day.

Mr. Huang has admitted his affair. That is a personal failing between him and his family, and I do not excuse it. But the far more serious claim — that the woman was a Chinese spy and that he was her target — rests on a classified intelligence memo that no one outside the government has been allowed to see. There are no charges, and no public evidence that she was recruited, that he knew anything, or that any secret ever passed. Even President Trump put it conditionally: if she is a spy, he should resign; if she is not, it is a different situation.

Mr. Huang resigned before the Board's own investigation had even finished. That is not how a fair decision is made. Reinstate him while the investigation runs, publish its scope and timeline, give him the chance to answer, and then decide on facts. If the investigation proves he knowingly helped a foreign intelligence service, he should go — and I will accept that. But a founder should not lose the company he built over 33 years on an allegation nobody has been allowed to examine.

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I would like to sincerely express my thoughts and concerns to the entire Board of Directors.

Jensen Huang is more than just a CEO. He is the visionary leader who has guided NVIDIA through 33 years of challenges, innovation, and growth, transforming it into one of the most influential companies in the global technology industry.

His contributions go far beyond revenue, market capitalization, and technological breakthroughs. He has helped shape the future of artificial intelligence and inspired an entire generation of engineers, investors, and innovators around the world.

We understand that the Board has its responsibilities and considerations, and we respect the importance of corporate governance and accountability. However, we sincerely ask the Board to reconsider how important Jensen Huang is to NVIDIA’s identity, culture, and long-term future.

A company can develop new executives, but finding a leader who truly understands its vision, technology, culture, and long-term direction is not easy.

Please do not focus only on today’s decisions. Consider the next ten or twenty years of NVIDIA’s future. Losing a leader may not immediately weaken the company, but losing someone who has built its foundation, united its people, and shaped its vision could have consequences far greater than anyone can imagine.

As someone who supports NVIDIA and believes in its future, I sincerely hope the Board will listen to the voices of shareholders, employees, and supporters around the world, carefully reconsider all possibilities, and give Jensen Huang fair consideration and an opportunity to continue contributing to the company.

NVIDIA’s success is worth protecting, and Jensen Huang’s 33 years of dedication should never be forgotten.

I urge the Board to put NVIDIA’s long-term interests first and make a decision that shareholders, employees, and future generations can believe in.

Stand With Jensen.
Protect NVIDIA’s Future.

items.testimonial:
I believe Jensen Huang has not only transformed NVIDIA’s future, but has also helped change the course of our world.

Through his vision, perseverance, and leadership, artificial intelligence is advancing at an unprecedented pace. I firmly believe that AI will bring revolutionary breakthroughs across technology, healthcare, scientific research, and countless other industries, significantly enhancing human capabilities and improving quality of life.

Leading one of the world’s most influential technology companies has never been an easy journey. NVIDIA has faced numerous challenges, setbacks, and uncertainties over the years. Yet Jensen has remained committed to his vision, demonstrating extraordinary foresight, decisive leadership, strategic thinking, and an exceptional ability to bring groundbreaking technologies to the global market.

I am sincerely grateful for his dedication, perseverance, and relentless efforts in bringing NVIDIA and the entire AI industry to where they stand today.

I strongly hope that Jensen Huang, a leader with such remarkable vision, courage, strategic judgment, and leadership capabilities, will continue to serve as NVIDIA’s CEO and guide the company and the global AI industry toward their next major milestones.

At the same time, as an NVIDIA shareholder and supporter, I sincerely hope that the Board of Directors will demonstrate transparency and accountability by providing a clear, comprehensive, and credible explanation to all shareholders, employees, and those who have supported NVIDIA throughout its journey.

NVIDIA’s success is about far more than its stock price. It represents a vision with the power to transform the world. And I believe Jensen Huang remains one of the most important leaders capable of carrying that vision forward.

Stand with Jensen Huang.

items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA:

Artificial Intelligence represents the most profound technological revolution in human history. Its development must serve as a universal public good that benefits all of humanity, rather than being monopolized by select corporations or nations. We firmly believe that the open-source ecosystem is the unequivocally correct path to democratize these benefits, ensuring that the power of intelligence is shared equitably across the globe. Furthermore, the creation of safe and aligned AI demands unprecedented global cooperation, not zero-sum competition or technological blockades. True progress can only be achieved through borderless collaboration.

In this critical juncture, Jensen Huang stands as the undisputed and irreplaceable global leader of the AI revolution. His visionary foresight has fundamentally architected the modern computing landscape. His recent departure from the CEO role creates a profound void, not just for NVIDIA, but for the global pursuit of a fair, open, and cooperative AI future. 

Therefore, we passionately petition the Board to reconsider this transition, reverse the decision, and reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. We urge you to empower him to continue guiding NVIDIA to serve the ultimate betterment of all humanity. His leadership is not merely a corporate asset; it is a critical necessity for the shared future of our world.

To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

As an NVIDIA shareholder, I would like to see Jensen Huang return to lead the company.

Jensen is a significant part of why I believe in NVIDIA’s future. I value his understanding of the technology and his willingness to stay with ideas that may take years to prove themselves. I hope he has the opportunity to bring that experience to the company’s next chapter.

I do not have access to the information available to the Board, so I cannot judge the circumstances behind his departure. I respect the Board’s responsibility to address concerns and act in the company’s best interests. My hope is that a path for Jensen’s return receives serious and fair consideration, with appropriate safeguards and accountability.

Where confidentiality allows, I would also appreciate a clearer explanation of how the Board is weighing the company’s long-term interests. This decision matters to shareholders who continue to believe in what NVIDIA can achieve.

I speak only for myself: I still have confidence in Jensen’s ability to lead, and I hope to see him return.

Jensen, thank you for everything you have helped build alongside the NVIDIA team. I hope there is more of that work ahead.

Respectfully,
An NVIDIA shareholder

items.name: Zhuminyan
items.title: 地球人
items.testimonial:
致黄仁勋先生及英伟达董事会的一封信

——科技有国界，文明无边界；竞争有胜负，人类有未来。

尊敬的黄仁勋先生、英伟达董事会各位成员：

我写下这封信，并非仅仅出于对一家伟大科技企业的欣赏，而是源于一个更朴素、也更坚定的信念：在成为某个国家的公民、某种文化的传承者之前，我们首先都是地球人，都是人类文明共同的创造者、参与者与受益者。

我始终相信，人类文明最宝贵的力量，不在于消除差异，而在于尊重差异；不在于彼此征服，而在于求同存异；不在于某一方的独自胜利，而在于整个文明不断拓展自身的可能性。

英伟达是一家伟大的美国公司，但在我眼中，它首先是一家属于人类文明进步历程的伟大企业。

从图形计算到人工智能，从科学研究到探索未知，英伟达所推动的，早已超越了一家企业的商业成就。它正在参与塑造人类理解世界、改造世界乃至探索宇宙的能力。

伟大的技术可以诞生于某个国家，但它所照亮的未来，不应只属于某个国家。

美国是一个伟大的国家。它有值得尊敬的成就，也有需要正视的不足。事实上，任何个人、企业、国家乃至文明，都不可能完美无缺。

真正值得尊敬的，从来不是永不犯错，而是拥有正视错误、修正偏差、持续进化的勇气与能力。

这让我想到人工智能。

今天，我们创造的大模型能够不断学习、更新、迭代，突破昨日的局限。而作为创造者的人类，却有时陷入固有的偏见、对立与零和思维之中，仿佛忘记了文明本身也应当具备自我修正与持续进化的能力。

这是一个值得我们所有人深思的悖论。

我们拥有前所未有的科技力量，却未必始终拥有与之相匹配的文明智慧。

当一些人沉迷于封锁、遏制、围堵与对抗，把竞争者视作必须消灭的敌人时，我们是否应该追问：

我们究竟是在捍卫文明的未来，还是在用狭隘的边界限制文明的可能？

国家之间当然存在利益差异，企业之间当然需要公平竞争。竞争本身并不可怕，恰恰相反，良性竞争是创新的重要动力。

但竞争不应成为仇恨的理由，分歧不应成为拒绝合作的借口，暂时的对立更不应遮蔽人类长远的共同命运。

我们可以来自不同的国家，拥有不同的制度、文化与价值取向；我们可以在市场上竞争，在技术上较量，在理念上辩论。

但当我们仰望同一片星空，面对疾病、能源、环境、科学未知与宇宙探索这些共同课题时，我们终究拥有一个无法回避的身份：

我们是人类。

我们的终极目标，不应是把彼此困在地球上的竞争与对抗之中，而应是让人类文明拥有走向星辰大海的能力。

这正是我尊敬英伟达、尊敬黄仁勋先生的深层原因。

一家真正伟大的科技企业，不仅应当拥有卓越的产品、领先的技术与出色的商业判断，更应当拥有超越短期利益的远见，以及理解自身在人类文明进程中所承担责任的格局。

黄仁勋先生，您以非凡的技术洞察、战略定力与执行能力，将英伟达带到了今天的高度。您的精准判断与产品战略令人钦佩，而您所展现出的创新精神、务实态度，以及对人工智能未来的坚定信念，更值得珍视。

我也真诚期待，英伟达董事会能够以同样长远的眼光看待公司的未来：不仅守护一家企业的竞争优势，也守护它持续创新、开放合作、创造长期价值的能力。

伟大的董事会，不仅要懂得如何维护一家公司的价值，更要懂得如何成就一家公司的历史地位。

我希望英伟达继续伟大，希望黄仁勋先生继续引领创新，也希望所有真正推动科技进步的企业，都能够在合理竞争中相互激励，在共同挑战面前携手合作。

因为我相信，未来的人类回望今天时，真正值得铭记的，不会是谁曾经成功阻挡了谁，而是谁帮助人类突破了新的边界。

我们不必在今天消除所有分歧，但至少可以在分歧中保留尊重，在竞争中坚守理性，在利益之外看见共同的未来。

愿科技不断突破边界，而人类的胸怀，不要落后于自己创造的科技。

愿我们既有仰望星空的雄心，也有彼此成就的智慧。

致敬英伟达。

致敬黄仁勋先生。

更致敬每一位相信人类文明可以共同进步的人。

一位来自中国、心怀人类共同未来的地球公民

2026年11月

items.name: Mike Mitchell

items.testimonial:
I request more transparency from the board as to the reasons why Jensen Huang was dismissed. The board has failed to adequately convey to stakeholders how this decision provides more short and long-term shareholder value than retaining him. This is highly relevant in light of the significant change in market capitalization which just occurred - the short-term cost to this leadership change is significant.

I remind the board that its sole mandate is to represent the interest of shareholders. Maybe, through their decision, board members have indeed done so. However, from an outside perspective, seeing such a decision being made without the spying investigation having been concluded appears hasty and imprudent. I hope that whatever decision is made moving forward is purely pragmatic, not influenced by ego and completely focused on shareholder value. For now, without a formal investigation having been concluded, it would be prudent to retain Jensen.

items.name: James Jan
items.title: Manager / Entegris
items.testimonial:
I support Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as CEO of NVIDIA.
His personal failings deserve accountability, but they should not automatically outweigh decades of extraordinary leadership. Any allegations involving professional misconduct or national security must be assessed through a fair, independent investigation grounded in evidence—not speculation or sensational headlines.
A successor may be capable of maintaining operational stability. Yet Jensen’s rare combination of long-term vision, creativity, technical insight, and courage cannot easily be replaced. He helped bring the world into the AI era by seeing possibilities long before others believed in them.
Whether his family chooses to forgive him is entirely their decision, and their privacy deserves respect. As supporters of his leadership, however, we can believe in accountability while also believing in second chances.
I urge NVIDIA’s Board to establish a fair path toward his return, consistent with the investigation’s findings and appropriate safeguards. His contributions to humanity’s technological future deserve serious consideration.
Jensen Huang deserves the opportunity to rebuild trust—and to continue helping shape the future he helped make possible.

items.name: Li Ding
items.title: Co-Founder, OO Dental
items.testimonial:
The real question is not whether Jensen Huang should be held accountable. He has already paid a significant price.

The deeper question is whether our standards of judgment can withstand the pressures of fear, geopolitics, and public outrage.

Can we distinguish legitimate security concerns from unsubstantiated allegations? Can we investigate misconduct without turning suspicion into guilt? Can America protect its national interests without undermining the very intellectual openness that has long been a cornerstone of its innovation and global leadership?

Ultimately, the greatest threat to American innovation may not come from foreign competitors, but from within—when fear triumphs over reason, suspicion replaces evidence, and security becomes a justification for abandoning the principles that made America a global leader in the first place.

台灣的科技產業能夠在國際舞台上受到重視，除了仰賴無數工程師、企業與勞動者的努力，也需要國際間的合作、信任與相互支持。黃仁勳先生長期肯定台灣的技術實力及產業價值，對台灣科技產業的國際能見度具有重要意義。

我們認為，對於真正為科技發展、產業創新及國際合作帶來貢獻的人士，應當給予理性、客觀且公平的評價，而不應受到不必要的政治化解讀或不公平對待。

I respectfully urge the Board to reconsider its decision and bring Jensen Huang back as CEO of NVIDIA.

Jensen's track record speaks for itself. Over three decades, he transformed NVIDIA from a small semiconductor startup into one of the most influential companies in human history. His extraordinary vision, technical understanding, strategic capabilities, and leadership have repeatedly positioned NVIDIA ahead of the competition.

I recognize that Jensen has made personal mistakes, including matters involving his private relationships. However, he is human, and no individual should be defined entirely by their mistakes. Personal shortcomings should be considered separately from decades of demonstrated leadership and professional achievement.

Great companies are built by exceptional leaders. Jensen Huang has proven, time and again, that he is one of them.

I ask the Board to look beyond this controversy, reconsider his contributions, and give Jensen the opportunity to continue leading the company he built.

Bring Jensen back. NVIDIA's future deserves his vision.

I'm a mother of two, a son and a daughter, an acupuncturist from China practicing in Canada, and an NVIDIA shareholder. Even as a mother who has been hurt by infidelity, I still hope Jensen Huang returns to NVIDIA. I believe this experience has helped him grow, and that he will give his company, his family, and his life a truly wonderful answer. 

I am 40 years old. I have a son and a daughter, aged nine and six. I work in a traditional field, as a Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioner and acupuncturist, but my childhood and youth were spent playing video games, and I used NVIDIA chips for many years. In 2007, while I was still in university, I watched Jensen Huang's interview on Dragon TV, and it deeply inspired me. I admired his creativity, courage, and energy then, and I still do.
I also believe his love for his wife, his children, and his family is real. People who reach great heights face great temptations, and no one is free from mistakes. As we say in China, no one is without fault. The determined, responsible leader on the screen is the real Jensen Huang. The devoted family man is real too. And so is the man who made mistakes, because that is part of being human. In the face of enormous power and temptation, it is hard for anyone to hold the line every time. I believe in him, and I sincerely want to support him. His return to lead NVIDIA would matter to the company, to every shareholder, to the United States, and to humanity as a whole. He is a rare talent. His story inspired me, his brilliance won my respect, and I hope he comes back to NVIDIA. 

Jensen, I support you.

items.testimonial:
​從公司治理與證券監管之客觀法理審視，黃仁勳先生之技術戰略遠見及產業生態統籌力，已與英偉達（NVIDIA）之核心無形資產、商業信任基礎及結構性護城河形成不可分割之事實綁定，其個人去留直接構成公司治理結構上的「單點故障（Single Point of Failure）」。依據美國證券交易委員會（SEC）之重大風險披露原則及《德拉瓦州普通公司法》（DGCL）之法理標準，任何未能鎖定其長期留任之治理疏失，不僅將即刻觸發具系統性影響的「關鍵人風險（Key-Man Risk）」，更將直接構成對公司持續經營價值與商業基本盤之「重大不利影響（Material Adverse Effect, MAE）」。因此，確保黃先生之長期留任，在法律定性上並非可自由裁量的普通「商業決策」，而是董事局履行對公司及全體股東「受託謹慎義務（Duty of Care）」與「忠實義務（Duty of Loyalty）」的法定底線；任何在此核心議題上的治理失當，均可能因構成「實質性疏忽（Gross Negligence）」而逾越《商業判斷原則》（Business Judgment Rule）的免責保護範圍，進而衍生相應之股東追索與治理合規風險。
​From an objective corporate governance and regulatory standpoint, Mr. Jensen Huang’s strategic command and ecosystem stewardship are inextricably intertwined with NVIDIA’s core intangible assets, commercial trust, and structural moat, rendering his leadership a singular, non-substitutable enterprise pillar. Under established Delaware corporate jurisprudence and SEC risk-disclosure frameworks, any governance failure to secure Mr. Huang’s long-term tenure would instantaneously actualize a systemic "Key-Man Risk" and trigger a Material Adverse Effect (MAE) on the Corporation’s intrinsic valuation and commercial foundation. Consequently, retaining Mr. Huang is not a discretionary matter of ordinary business strategy, but an affirmative legal baseline required to satisfy the Board’s fiduciary Duty of Care and Duty of Loyalty; any governance lapse in this regard risks constituting gross negligence, thereby falling outside the protective ambit of the Business Judgment Rule and exposing the Board to derivative fiduciary liabilities.

items.testimonial:
致 NVIDIA 董事會的一封公開信

懇請董事會珍惜黃仁勳的領導價值，讓AI革命持續向前

尊敬的 NVIDIA 董事會全體成員：

首先，感謝各位多年來對 NVIDIA 的經營與付出。NVIDIA 能夠從一家專注於繪圖晶片的科技公司，逐步成長為全球人工智慧產業的重要核心力量，除了仰賴全體員工的努力，更離不開創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳先生多年來的遠見、堅持與領導。

身為一位關心人工智慧發展的科技觀察者，我想誠懇地向董事會表達一個心聲：希望董事會能夠珍惜黃仁勳先生的領導能力，持續支持他帶領 NVIDIA，讓他有機會繼續完成尚未實現的科技願景。

黃仁勳先生對全球科技產業的貢獻，早已不只是企業經營層面的成功。

回顧過去，當人工智慧尚未成為全球關注的焦點時，他便持續投入GPU、平行運算與CUDA生態系統的發展。這條道路並非一帆風順，需要長期投入資金、人力與技術資源，也必須承受市場的不確定性。然而，他沒有只追逐短期利益，而是選擇相信運算技術將成為未來人類社會的重要基礎。

如今，這份堅持已經產生深遠的影響。

人工智慧正在改變世界。從大型語言模型、醫療研究、智慧製造、自動駕駛，到科學運算與機器人技術，AI正在逐步改變人類解決問題的方式。NVIDIA所提供的運算平台與技術生態系，成為這場科技革命的重要推動力量。

這不只是 NVIDIA 的商業成就，更是對整個人類科技發展具有歷史意義的貢獻。

董事會在評估企業未來發展時，當然必須考慮營運績效、股東權益、公司治理、風險管理與接班制度。這些都是一家世界級企業不可忽視的責任。

但我也希望董事會在任何重大領導決策中，不要忽略一個非常重要的因素：領導者對產業長期發展所創造的價值，有時候遠遠超過財務報表所能呈現的數字。

黃仁勳先生不只是 NVIDIA 的執行長，更是這個AI時代的重要領航者。他對技術發展方向的判斷、對市場趨勢的敏銳度，以及將長期技術願景轉化為實際產品與產業生態系的能力，都是企業多年累積的重要無形資產。

這樣的人才並不是隨時都能找到，也不是單純透過聘請一位新的執行長，就能立即取代其所累積的經驗、文化與領導影響力。

尤其現在AI產業正處於快速發展的關鍵時期，全球科技企業競爭激烈，技術突破的速度不斷加快。未來不只是晶片效能的競爭，更是整體運算平台、軟體生態系、能源效率、資料中心與應用場景的全面競爭。

在這樣的環境下，企業最需要的是穩定而具有遠見的領導。

我們不希望 NVIDIA 只成為一間曾經非常成功的科技公司，更希望它能夠持續成為推動下一個世代科技進步的重要力量。

因此，我懇請董事會在考量公司未來發展與領導安排時，充分尊重黃仁勳先生的意願，給予他足夠的支持與信任。如果他仍然願意承擔這份責任，希望董事會能夠讓他繼續帶領 NVIDIA 前進。

當然，沒有任何一位領導者可以永遠獨自承擔所有責任。建立優秀的管理團隊、培養下一代領導人才，以及規劃完善的接班制度，同樣是企業永續經營的重要工作。

但接班規劃不代表必須急於更換現任領導者。相反地，在黃仁勳先生仍然具有領導熱情與能力的情況下，更應該善用他的經驗，協助培養人才、傳承企業文化，並為 NVIDIA 的下一個十年奠定更穩固的基礎。

我們期待的是一個能夠兼顧穩定、創新與長期發展的 NVIDIA，而不是因為短期考量，讓企業失去一位對未來具有深刻影響力的領導者。

最後，我想再次強調，黃仁勳先生所代表的，不只是 NVIDIA 的品牌與企業形象，更是一種勇於挑戰未知、相信技術能改變世界的精神。

對許多關心科技發展的人而言，他讓我們看見人工智慧的可能性，也讓我們相信，人類仍然有能力透過創新突破既有的限制。

董事會的每一項決策，都可能影響 NVIDIA 的未來，也可能對全球AI產業帶來深遠影響。

因此，我誠懇地希望各位董事能夠慎重考量黃仁勳先生的長期貢獻與不可取代的領導價值。

請珍惜這位帶領 NVIDIA 走向世界舞台的領航者。只要他仍有意願繼續前進，就請給予他最大的支持，讓他繼續帶領團隊創造下一個科技奇蹟。

AI革命才剛剛開始，未來還有無數挑戰與機會等待我們。

希望 NVIDIA 不只擁有輝煌的過去，更能在黃仁勳先生的帶領下，創造更加值得人類期待的未來。

謹以最誠摯的敬意，向董事會提出這份請求。

請支持黃仁勳，讓他繼續領航 NVIDIA，讓AI的未來走得更遠、更好。

一位支持科技創新、肯定黃仁勳貢獻的關心者 敬上

items.name: Chen Cynthia
items.title: Proposal
items.testimonial:
**Before an independent investigation has fully established the facts, Jensen Huang should be reinstated as CEO. Unless the Board can present concrete, substantial, and compelling evidence demonstrating that his removal truly serves the best interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders, he deserves the opportunity to return to his position.**

As for whether he was actually involved in an extramarital affair, I do not have enough information to make that judgment, nor do I wish to draw conclusions before the facts have been established.

However, I firmly believe that a person's private life must be distinguished from their professional capabilities. No one should rush to pass judgment on someone's career before the truth has come to light.

In the business world, particularly in the United States, what truly matters should be a leader's ability to lead, business performance, corporate vision, and the value they bring to the company — not their private romantic relationships.

To put it bluntly, unless everyone is his wife, how many people truly have the standing, or even the need, to judge his private life?

**We can demand the truth. We can demand an investigation. We can insist on transparency and accountability in corporate governance. But unverified allegations should never be allowed to override facts and the fundamental principle of due process.**

Jensen Huang's contributions to NVIDIA and the leadership he has demonstrated throughout the global technology industry deserve to be evaluated by the Board with the same level of scrutiny and fairness.

What we are asking for is neither special treatment nor unconditional protection. It is simply a fundamental principle of fairness:

**Do not rush to condemn before the truth is known. Do not destroy someone's professional career before the evidence is sufficient.**

Give the investigation the space to be conducted fairly, and give Jensen Huang a fair opportunity to return.

As an engineer working in AI and semiconductor technologies, I deeply recognize Jensen Huang's extraordinary contributions to NVIDIA and the global AI industry.

I strongly support Jensen Huang's continued leadership and call upon the Board to reconsider any decision to remove him from his position.

Innovation requires vision. Leadership requires trust. Corporate governance requires fairness.

Jensen's leadership has shaped not only NVIDIA's success but also the future of accelerated computing and artificial intelligence.

I urge the Board to act responsibly, protect NVIDIA's technological legacy, and restore Jensen's leadership unless compelling evidence demonstrates that doing otherwise is in the company's best interests.

Stand with Jensen. Stand for innovation. Stand for fairness.

Sincerely,

An AI and Semiconductor Technology Engineer from Taiwan

items.title: A public health professional
items.testimonial:
To everyone,
I’m just an ordinary person. My connection with NVIDIA goes back to my younger days. Every computer I’ve ever owned had an NVIDIA graphics card. You could say NVIDIA has accompanied me through my teenage years, adulthood, and all the good times up to now. Many peers around me are fond of NVIDIA and the joy Mr. Huang has brought us. We respectfully call Jensen Huang “Archbishop Huang.”

I was amazed when I learned that NVIDIA GPUs can also be used to train artificial intelligence. It felt like Santa Claus pulling out something we had never seen before from his sack. Today, many of us use AI applications, and we owe much of that to NVIDIA and Jensen Huang. He has changed our lives.

As an adult who still doesn’t want to grow up, I hope I can keep seeing this leather-jacket-clad Jensen Huang, our Santa Claus. I look forward each year to seeing what new wonders he will pull out of his bag.

I feel I should do what I believe is right and stand by our Santa. At the same time, I hope doing the right thing will bring good luck to my mother. We are fighting her illness together, and may good fortune stay with us.

至大家，我是一名普通人，我和英伟达的连接从年轻时代就开始了，我用过的每台电脑都有英伟达的显卡，可以说英伟达陪伴我度过了我的青少年、成年后直至现在的美好时光。很多我周围的同龄人都很喜欢英伟达和黄先生给我们带来的快乐，我们都尊称黄仁勋先生为 “黄教主”。当我得知英伟达的显卡还能训练人工智能我很惊讶，仿佛圣诞老人又从包里拿出来我们从没见过的礼物，今天我们很多人都在用着人工智能的软件也是要感谢英伟达和黄教主，他改变了我们的生活。作为一个不想长大的成年人，我还是希望我能一直见到这位穿着皮衣的黄教主，他是我们的圣诞老人。我想每年还能看到他从包里拿出什么新鲜玩意儿。我想此时我应该做一些正确的事情，声援我们的圣诞老人。同时我也在想做正确的事情能够给我的妈妈带来好运，我们将要和她一起对抗疾病，愿好运与我们相伴。

items.name: Hook Jeffy
items.title: PC gamer
items.testimonial:
As a longtime DIY PC gamer, I just want to show my support for Jensen.
When I heard he resigned, I felt genuinely sad. I don’t know if NVIDIA will still keep even a little focus on us gamers without him. Yeah, that thought is selfish — I’m just scared I won’t be able to keep playing the games I love. But I really miss that cool guy with the flowing silver hair who always rocks the leather jacket.
Hearing that he was blaming himself alone in his room honestly made me feel bad too. He doesn’t deserve to go out like this.
I just learned that NVIDIA employees have already started an internal petition asking for him to come back. I’m wondering if people with the right influence and ability could help start a public one, so the outside world can see how many gamers and PC players are willing to stand with him right now.
I still remember the excitement of getting my first graphics card — a GTX 1060. That feeling never left me. Yes, AI has taken a huge chunk of GPU capacity for data centers and prices went crazy, but the reasons are complicated. It’s not all on Jensen. In fact, because of him, gaming GPUs weren’t completely sacrificed to AI demand.
NVIDIA got to where it is today in large part because of gamers. At a moment like this, I want Jensen back'.

items.name: Michael Wang
items.title: Shareholder
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board of Directors of NVIDIA,    As a long-time global observer and participant in the technological ecosystem who cares deeply about NVIDIA's trajectory, I am writing to express my profound reflections regarding the recent departure of Mr. Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer.   Jensen is not merely a co-founder; he is the 33-year soul of NVIDIA who has steered the company into becoming a multi-trillion-dollar powerhouse and the absolute backbone of the global artificial intelligence revolution. His profound technological foresight, grand strategic vision, and unmatched decisiveness form the bedrock of NVIDIA's enduring dominance in the semiconductor and AI landscapes. At this crucial juncture of unprecedented technological transformation, NVIDIA needs a visionary commander with his unique blend of engineering brilliance and unifying leadership more than ever.   While recent events have sparked widespread public discussion, from the perspective of long-term corporate stability, continuous innovation, and global market confidence, Jensen's irreplaceable role at the helm remains crystal clear. Therefore, I sincerely urge and hope that the Board of Directors will comprehensively weigh the broader picture and, for the sake of NVIDIA’s extraordinary future, invite Mr. Huang back to lead the company once again into its next frontier of technological excellence.   Sincerely
Michael Wang

items.testimonial:
As a Taiwanese person, I want to thank you for everything you have contributed to Taiwan and to the world. When you co-founded NVIDIA in 1993, you helped set in motion a journey that would reshape computing. Your vision helped turn the GPU from a tool for graphics and gaming into a force behind scientific research, advanced computing, and the AI revolution.
I’m also grateful for the way you have worked with Taiwan’s technology community and helped build AI infrastructure here, creating new opportunities for researchers, businesses, and future generations. Your achievements have brought Taiwan into the spotlight and inspired people around the world to think bigger and keep pushing forward.
What makes you especially compelling to me is the person behind those achievements. I admire your sharp mind, bold vision, and tireless energy, but also your humor, warmth, and the way you make complex ideas feel exciting and accessible. You carry yourself with confidence while still showing genuine appreciation for the people who build alongside you. That combination makes your success even more inspiring.
Thank you for your hard work, your vision, and the impact you have made. I will always support you and look forward to seeing what you do next.

I’ve signed the letter. I believe no one is perfect, and everyone deserves a second chance.
As someone from Taiwan, I’m grateful to Jensen Huang. He’s helped advance artificial intelligence, and time and again, he’s used his global platform to give Taiwan credit. Thanks in part to him, more people around the world recognize the Taiwanese engineers and supply chain partners behind so many of the technologies that have changed our lives.
I work in finance, so I haven’t benefited directly from rising salaries in the tech industry. But through my research, I’ve seen how the AI boom he helped drive has changed the skills Taiwan’s tech companies are looking for. I’ve also seen more people earn salaries that better reflect their expertise. For many families in Taiwan, that’s what technological progress looks like in everyday life.
To me, Jensen is a hero for what he’s done to move the world forward and for making sure the world sees Taiwan’s contribution. That’s why I’ve added my name in support.

To the NVIDIA Board of Directors

As a Taiwanese NVIDIA shareholder, I urge the Board to reconsider Jensen Huang's departure.

Any misconduct deserves accountability. But Jensen built NVIDIA into the backbone of the AI era, and his exit has already shaken shareholder confidence. The Board's own probe into whether he was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation raises a serious question: who benefits from a leaderless NVIDIA?

The answer is China. Its chipmakers gain time to catch up, and U.S.–Taiwan tech cooperation loses its strongest champion.

I ask the Board to finish the investigation before any permanent decision, and to keep Jensen involved in an advisory role. Accountability and continuity can go together.

items.testimonial:
I am writing as a loyal NVIDIA user. My first NVIDIA card was a GeForce RTX 5060, and I have built every one of my machines around your hardware since. I am not a shareholder or an insider. I am one of the millions of people who chose this company again and again, and I am asking you to open a path for Jensen Huang's return.
For people like me, Jensen was never just a CEO. He was the person on stage in the leather jacket who explained where computing was going, and then delivered it. GeForce, CUDA, RTX, and the AI platform that grew out of them exist because he made bets years before anyone else believed in them. When I bought an NVIDIA product, I was trusting his judgment about the future, and that trust was repaid every time.
I am not asking the Board to ignore what has happened. Personal misconduct deserves accountability, and the security questions deserve a full and independent investigation. I support that process.
What I ask, together with everyone who signs below, is this:
Finish the independent investigation and share its conclusions as fully as the law allows.
If it finds no compromise of national security or company secrets, invite Jensen back in a leadership role, with whatever governance safeguards the Board considers necessary.
Give him a voice in NVIDIA's future, including the choice of long-term leadership.
We users stayed with NVIDIA through shortages, price increases, and long waits, because we believed in the person steering it. Please make this decision on the basis of a finished investigation, and remember the community that helped build this company alongside him.
Respectfully,
Ccino Lee

items.name: Robert Dean Rosen
items.testimonial:
November 14, 2026

Dear Chair Jones and Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I ask you to hold a recorded vote on bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO before naming a permanent successor. If the independent investigation supports his return under enforceable safeguards, offer him the job.

Huang acknowledged being unfaithful and apologized for the harm he caused his family. Each of us has made a mistake or two or three. We should answer for our actions, and we deserve to be judged on our full record.

Mr. Stevens, after you pushed Kyle Lowry during the 2019 NBA Finals, the NBA and the Warriors fined you $500,000 and banned you from games and team activities for a year. You continued serving on NVIDIA’s board. NVIDIA weighed your conduct alongside what you could still contribute. I ask you to extend the same consideration to Huang.

Reuters reported that Huang misled NVIDIA’s general counsel about his relationship with a former executive of a customer. Determine what Huang told company lawyers, whether NVIDIA’s security or export compliance was affected, and when the independent directors learned of the concerns. Examine the board’s own response as closely as you examine his conduct.

Huang spent 33 years building NVIDIA. His early investment in CUDA shows the long-term judgment the company still needs. If the findings support reinstatement and he accepts enforceable conflict disclosures, recusals, and direct reporting from compliance leaders to the independent chair, bring him back.

Sincerely,

Robert Dean Rosen

items.testimonial:
致 NVIDIA Corporation 董事會全體成員：
​身為長期關注並支持 NVIDIA 的股東與科技產業參與者，我們寫這封公開信，旨在表達對公司未來發展方向的高度關切，並向董事會提出一項關乎企業長遠價值的核心建議：誠摯請求董事會正式邀請共同創辦人黃仁勳先生（Jensen Huang）重返公司核心領導層，再度引領 NVIDIA 邁向下一個技術紀元。
​過去三十餘年來，黃仁勳先生不僅將 NVIDIA 從一家專注於個人電腦繪圖晶片的公司，蛻變為驅動全球人工智慧與加速運算革命的關鍵引擎，更建立了一套極具前瞻性的企業文化與「全端運算（Full-Stack Computing）」護城河。在當前全球半導體與 AI 產業面臨劇烈典範轉移的關鍵時刻，我們認為只有黃仁勳先生具備同時駕馭以下三大核心挑戰的格局與執行力：
​1. 無可替代的技術遠見與「光速」執行力
AI 運算架構正以超越摩爾定律的速度演進。從晶片架構、系統設計、網路互連到 CUDA 軟體生態系，NVIDIA 的競爭優勢建立在軟硬體高度協同的複雜工程之上。黃仁勳先生具備深厚的工程師底蘊與系統級思維，能夠在市場需求尚未完全浮現前，便精準押注下一代運算平台，並以「光速（Speed of Light）」標準推動研發團隊突破物理與技術極限。
​2. 深度綁定全球半導體供應鏈的信任資本
先進製程產能、CoWoS 先進封裝以及高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的供應鏈整合，是決定 AI 晶片能否如期交付的命脈。黃仁勳先生與台積電（TSMC）及台灣、全球各大 ODM/OEM 夥伴建立了長達數十年的深厚互信與緊密合作關係。這種建立在個人信譽與長期夥伴關係之上的供應鏈號召力，是任何職業經理人短期內難以複製的無形資產。
​3. 凝聚全球頂尖工程人才與客戶生態的領袖魅力
在日益白熱化的 AI 軍備競賽中，雲端服務巨頭（CSP）與主權 AI 客戶不僅是在採購硬體，更是在尋找能共同定義未來基礎設施的戰略夥伴。黃仁勳先生對產業痛點的深刻洞察與极具感染力的溝通能力，使其成為 NVIDIA 最強大的品牌象徵，也是吸引全球最頂尖 AI 科學家與系統架構師持續投效的核心磁力。
​董事會的最高職責在於守護並最大化全體股東的長期利益。面對日益嚴峻的市場競爭與技術挑戰，NVIDIA 需要的不僅是穩健的財務與營運管理，更需要創辦人等級的魄力、對技術本質的執著，以及敢於定義未來的冒險精神。
​我們懇請董事會正視廣大股東、合作夥伴與產業社群的心聲，以公司的百年基業與全體股東的長遠福祉為念，積極與黃仁勳先生展開對話，促成其重返領導崗位，帶領 NVIDIA 繼續站在全球科技創新的最前線。
​謹致
最誠摯的敬意與期盼
​一群長期支持 NVIDIA 的股東與產業

items.name: ZhengyeShi
items.title: Game designer at NetEase
items.testimonial:
I’m a game designer. But if I had to choose the word that fits me best, though, I think I’d say I’m a gamer.

Jensen Huang and his partners founded NVIDIA together. Under his leadership, each generation of GPUs has helped those of us who make games bring the light, shadow, and color we imagine to life on players’ screens. I think a lot of my fellow developers feel the same way I do. We’d like to thank Jensen and his team for that.

I’ve also invested my own savings in NVIDIA stock. Sometimes I wonder what someone else might do if they were running NVIDIA. They might look at how little of the company’s revenue comes from gaming and decide it makes more sense to put all those people and all that money into AI. But even as Jensen led NVIDIA to where it is today, he kept making sure his team was building the next generation of graphics cards for gamers. I’ve always felt that had something to do with how much games mean to him. And when it comes to whether that commitment was worth it, I think those of us who play games have a say, too. Games have brought real joy to hundreds of millions of people around the world. I’m one of them.

All I know about what’s happened with Jensen these past few days is what I’ve read. He said he hurt his family, and he apologized for it. As for the questions still under investigation, I hope he gets a chance to explain what he knows in his own words.

I don’t know much about the AI business or geopolitics, and I know even less about partisan politics. I have just one hope. As the whole industry races toward AI, I hope there’s still at least one person running a graphics card company who keeps ordinary gamers like us in mind and cares about making the next generation of cards for us. I hope that person is Jensen.

items.name: gamer

items.testimonial:
我们这代人的第一块显卡，是听他站在台上讲完才下单的。CUDA、DLSS、光追、帧数——这些词能进我们的日常，背后一直是同一个人。他做错了事，该查就查、该罚就罚，这点没有玩家替他辩护；但连董事会的位子一并收走，等于让最懂这块硅片的人连话都说不上。我们不需要一个不受约束的偶像，只希望那个穿着皮衣讲架构的人，还能坐在桌边。三十三年的账，不该用四天结清。
Our generation's first graphics card was bought after watching him finish the keynote on stage. CUDA, DLSS, ray tracing, frame rates — the words that became part of our daily vocabulary all trace back to the same person. He did something wrong; investigate it, sanction it — no gamer is defending him on that point. But taking the board seat away as well means silencing the one person who understands this silicon best. We don't need an idol beyond accountability. We just want the man in the leather jacket who explained the architecture to still have a chair at the table. Thirty-three years shouldn't be closed out in four days.

items.name: Alexander Pinchuk
items.title: Senior Product Manager
items.testimonial:
Hi Jensen! 

I am relatively new to the company, but really love all the cool things that you've built and feel amazing every day working here. I know you probably going through some hard times right now and maybe you think that it'll be better if you step aside to not damage the company any further. I am in no position to give you any advice, only perspective. 

It won't be better if you just leave quietly. Whatever damage you think you might inflict upon NVIDIA by going against the board is just a fraction of the damage that will be inflicted upon NVIDIA without you here. This is not a good time for a transition. We have not won yet and there are a lot of exciting times ahead. Wouldn't you want to be on the forefront of this tech revolution? Are you ready to just sit on the sidelines and watch someone else have all the fun, or worse yet, ruin the legacy you've built? 

I bet if you look deep inside your heart the answer is no. And if you look not-so-deep the answer is no. You don't even need to look. You know the answer is no. So what are you waiting for? Stand up and fight. It's not over while you still alive. 

If you give up and hide - nothing can be done, but if you stand up and fight - there is always a way. We are here to support you should you choose to do so. Your company and your legacy are worth preserving. Show us the resilient man you've always been. Stand up for yourself and we'll stand with you!

Best Regards, 
Alexander.

As a supporter from Taiwan, I am grateful for what Jensen Huang has built at NVIDIA over more than three decades. I hope he will have a fair opportunity to return as CEO.
