items.name: Lucas Smith
items.title: NVIDIA Investor & Shareholder
items.testimonial:
As a long-term investor and shareholder of NVIDIA, I strongly demand that the Board reconsider its decision regarding Jensen Huang and take immediate steps to facilitate his return as CEO.

Let me be absolutely clear: NVIDIA's extraordinary success, technological leadership, and competitive advantage were built under Jensen Huang's vision, strategic leadership, and relentless execution over more than three decades. His contribution to this company is immeasurable, and the Board must not treat his departure as an ordinary executive transition.

The Board has a fiduciary responsibility to protect shareholder value, not to make rushed decisions under public pressure, speculation, or reputational concerns. Any decision of this magnitude must be based on verified facts, a fair and transparent process, and the long-term interests of shareholders.

I strongly oppose any attempt to permanently remove a founder of Jensen's stature without a thorough, independent investigation and a fair opportunity for him to respond.

My demands are straightforward:

Reconsider Jensen Huang's resignation and actively pursue his return as NVIDIA's CEO.
Conduct a genuinely independent and impartial investigation before making any irreversible leadership decisions.
Provide shareholders with a clear explanation of the Board's decision-making process and how it serves the company's long-term interests.
Stop treating shareholder confidence as an afterthought. Investors deserve accountability, transparency, and leadership stability.
The Board should remember one fundamental fact: You are stewards of shareholder capital, not owners of the company.

NVIDIA belongs to its shareholders. Our voices matter, and our interests must not be ignored.

items.name: Roger Xu
items.title: MD
items.testimonial:
As a long-time NVIDIA GPU user and a believer in the company’s mission, I write with full respect for your governance authority and the ongoing independent review process.

Over three decades, Jensen Huang’s visionary leadership has transformed NVIDIA from a niche graphics startup into the undisputed backbone of global AI and advanced computing, empowering countless creators, researchers, and gamers like me worldwide. His sharp strategic judgment and deep roots in NVIDIA’s founding culture are truly irreplaceable for our entire ecosystem.

We support a fair and thorough procedural review. We sincerely urge you to consider reinstating him, as the broader community needs his steady hand to drive sustained innovation. Thank you for your thoughtful consideration.

items.title: 洲际地平线国际商贸有限公司总经理
items.testimonial:
I write as a lifelong gamer and a shareholder who never sold.

My story with NVIDIA began with a childhood GeForce card that turned polygons into worlds. That green glow wasn't just hardware—it was the window to every adventure I could imagine. For twenty years, I upgraded, I played, I believed.

When AI came, I didn't just watch—I held. Through every dip, every skeptic, every "overheated" warning, I stayed because Jensen's vision told me to. He funded the AI future we have today with the quarters we gamers spent on graphics cards. That patience, that bet on CUDA when no one cared—that is not replaceable.

Jensen isn't just a CEO. He is the soul of this company. He made a generation fall in love with computation and gave researchers the tools to change the world. NVIDIA without him feels like a ship that reached the stars and lost its captain.

Please, consider any path for him to return to the helm. Not for headlines, but for the millions of us who see our childhood dreamer steering our future.

With gratitude and hope,

items.name: Ryan
items.title: 开发者-游戏玩家
items.testimonial:
我是一名UE开发者，也是一个每天跑在GeForce显卡上的游戏玩家。 Omniverse的Unreal Engine 5 Connector让我能在USD管线里直接调取Nanite网格源几何体，Audio2Face让角色面部动画从“逐帧修”变成“给一段音频就能跑”。这些工具不是发布会上的漂亮话，是我每天打开编辑器时真实省下来的时间。我因此受益，所以我无法假装自己只是一个无关的签名者。

我也受益于黄仁勋对“做东西”这件事近乎偏执的标准。员工说他“苛求、完美主义、不好共事”，他听完说“形容得非常准确”，然后补了一句：“如果你想做出卓越的事，本来就不该容易。”一个UE开发者很难不对这句话有共鸣——我们做的每一帧、每一个shader、每一次性能优化，本质上都是在跟“差不多就行”对抗。他对细节的极致关注，从芯片架构一直延伸到最基层员工的薪酬，这种密度的工作态度，在今天的CEO里极其稀缺。

但我今天留言，恰恰不是为了用“他做得好”来抵消“他需要被问责”。 我关切的是程序。董事会在他辞职前调查尚未结束时便仓促宣布决定，令许多员工感到错愕。97%的英伟达员工希望他留任，这说明问题不在于员工不了解他的缺点，而在于他们相信：一个人的去留，应当建立在完整证据和公开结论之上，而不是调查中途的仓促切割。

我的请求很简单：在独立调查完成、结论公开之前，让Jensen回归；如果董事会坚持相反决定，请把证据摆到桌面上。 作为每天用他的工具干活的人，我欠他一句诚实的评价；作为相信公平的人，我也欠这个程序一个坚持。

items.name: Shivanand Menon
items.title: Mr Shivanand Menon
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
As an NVIDIA shareholder, I am writing to urge the Board to explore a responsible path for Jensen Huang to return as Chief Executive Officer.
His vision, technical expertise and commitment to innovation have helped shape NVIDIA into a leader in accelerated computing and artificial intelligence. His leadership remains an important part of my confidence in the company’s future.
I recognise the Board’s responsibility to protect NVIDIA, uphold accountability and ensure a thorough, independent investigation. I ask that any consideration of Jensen’s return be guided by verified findings, fair treatment and the company’s long-term interests.
Subject to those findings and his willingness to return, I strongly encourage the Board to pursue discussions with Jensen about resuming his leadership, supported by appropriate oversight and clear accountability.
Please give serious consideration to this appeal. I believe Jensen still has a meaningful contribution to make to NVIDIA’s next chapter, and I would welcome a transparent explanation of whether a path to his return is possible.

items.name: Helen Tse

items.testimonial: All serious accusations against Jensen must be based on legal grounds! He is the strategist of the company, the soul of NVIDIA, he has contributed to the company for 33 years, and he is the one who created it. No one can replace him temporarily. If the board of directors prioritizes the interests of every shareholder, Jensen Huang's continued tenure is of utmost importance to every shareholder who has invested, to the company's interests, and to the advancement of technology in the United States. We must not let partisan struggles destroy a good company, and thus undermine America's leading position in technology! The board of directors really needs to consider: without a key figure, without a person familiar with the company's structure and even its technology, can the technological revolution be successfully advanced? How can America's technology be number one in the world? If the US government and the NVIDIA board of directors handle this improperly, investors from all over the world will be hesitant to invest in American technology companies!

items.testimonial:
As a shareholder, I believe Jensen Huang deserves our support and the opportunity to continue leading the company he helped build into a global powerhouse. His vision, dedication, and willingness to think beyond the status quo have been instrumental in shaping the future of technology and AI.

It’s easy to forget that behind every great company is a person who believed in something before the rest of the world could see it. Jensen was that person. His leadership has created tremendous value for shareholders, but his contributions go far beyond the stock price.

I believe in accountability, but I also believe in perspective, fairness, and recognizing a person’s lifetime of contributions. One controversy should not erase decades of innovation, dedication, and visionary leadership.

As a shareholder, I want Jensen Huang to remain part of NVIDIA’s future. His vision matters, his leadership matters, and his voice matters. I hope the board recognizes what shareholders and the broader technology community stand to lose.

items.testimonial:
About eighteen years ago, I visited NVIDIA’s Shenzhen office for the first time. I was a credit manager then, hoping to establish a business relationship with the company. What made that visit so meaningful to me was not the prospect of financial returns, but my longstanding fascination with the world of computing. To me, NVIDIA was one of that world’s great institutions—a place I had long admired. Simply having the opportunity to visit was thrilling.

That visit has stayed with me. Eighteen years later, I am an AI researcher, traveling across China to promote collaboration between people and AI, and advising businesses of all sizes. The computing world I once dreamed of entering has become my everyday work, and a field to which I am committed for the long term.

In my courses and presentations, I devote considerable attention to the capabilities Jensen Huang has described—Perception, Reasoning, Planning, and Action, which I refer to collectively as PRPA—as well as to the evolution of computing infrastructure represented by Vera Rubin. These ideas help me understand how AI is moving from answering questions to carrying out tasks. They also help me explore, together with my audiences, where human experience, judgment, and responsibility belong in that collaboration.

I have never met Jensen Huang. Yet I often speak of him with gratitude. His insights into technology and industry have helped me place seemingly disconnected developments within a larger picture, and understand the relationships between models, computing, and the real world. To me, this is what it means to have the vision of a giant: to see further, and then to share that view with others.

I am also grateful for his and NVIDIA’s investment in open models, research, and developer tools. For researchers, resources that we can study, test, and build upon have tangible and lasting value. items.title: ADELAIDE University
items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang, co-founder and chief executive officer of NVIDIA, stands as one of the most consequential figures in the contemporary development of artificial intelligence. Under his leadership, NVIDIA transformed graphics processing units—originally designed for rendering images—into the foundational infrastructure for general-purpose parallel computing. This shift has redefined the computational paradigm of AI while simultaneously furnishing global scientific research with unprecedented acceleration capabilities.

In the domain of artificial intelligence, Huang’s decisive contribution was the strategic commitment to the CUDA platform. Between 2006 and 2007, at a time when NVIDIA’s primary customers remained gamers, he elected to integrate CUDA into every GPU the company sold. The decision raised costs and offered limited near-term returns, yet it supplied researchers with a software environment capable of efficiently mapping algorithms onto the parallel architecture of GPUs. In 2012, the AlexNet neural network, trained on NVIDIA GPUs, achieved a breakthrough result in image recognition and thereby validated the value of GPU acceleration for deep learning. Huang subsequently redirected the company’s strategy toward AI. In 2016, NVIDIA delivered the first DGX-1 system to OpenAI, marking the transition from discrete chips to integrated training platforms. With the subsequent rise of large language models, architectures such as the A100, H100, and Blackwell series became the dominant platforms for both training and inference. Complementary software layers—including cuDNN and the broader CUDA-X libraries—further entrenched this position. Huang’s role has extended beyond the supply of hardware; successive architectural innovations and system-level integration have rendered the training of trillion-parameter models practical, thereby underwriting the industrialization of generative AI.

items.name: Anthony Loera
items.title: President and Founder / RevGenetics
items.testimonial:
The Man Who Went First
Some men inherit a world. A few make one.
At nine he was sent across an ocean to a Kentucky boarding school and handed the toilets to clean. At fifteen he washed dishes at a Denny's. At thirty he sat in a Denny's booth and founded a company with no product, no customer and no proof.
Nothing was given. Every inch was taken from the impossible by work.
The first chip failed. He cut the company to the bone with a month of payroll left, and shipped the next one. From then on he told his people they were thirty days from going out of business. He was not performing. He was remembering.
Then he did what no one else would do. In 2006 he began teaching a graphics chip to compute, for a market that did not exist. Wall Street did not understand it. He did not wait. He held the bet for years on one judgment: his own.
That is the virtue. Not luck. Not timing. The refusal to let the fear of others replace what his own mind could see.
When machines learned to think, they learned on his work. Nine of every ten advanced AI chips on earth. Revenue multiplied fifty-two times in twelve years. No committee planned it. One mind saw it and would not look away.
A builder walks into the dark, where there is no map and no applause, and comes back carrying something that did not exist. Those who follow walk in his light and call the road obvious.
He is not a saint. He has said as much. What he owes for his private failures, he owes to the people he failed. If the facts show he betrayed the work, the work itself will convict him.
But a crowd that demands a builder be flawless or be nothing has named a standard no builder in history could meet. It is a wish to see the tall thing fall.
Thirty-three years. One mind. No one else did it.
Honor the achievement. Then ask who is fit to carry it.

items.testimonial: I am neither a fan of Jensen nor a shareholder. From a business perspective, I believe removing someone so gifted and hardworking from the company is a major mistake. Human beings are imperfect, and everyone makes mistakes. If we can show tolerance and welcome toward undocumented immigrants , why can’t we at least consider giving this man a second chance, or allow the legal process to run its course before passing judgment? How many people possess his talent and abilities? He’s not the only person to have made such mistakes, so why does he seem to be singled out before the case has even concluded? I wonder whether jealousy over his success, politics, and racial bias have influenced the reaction. We tell children not to be afraid of making mistakes and to learn from them. Yet when someone falls short, we seem unwilling to extend that same understanding. Accountability matters, but so do fairness, due process, and the opportunity to grow.

I am writing to express my strongest support for Jensen Huang and to urge the NVIDIA Board of Directors to reconsider its decision and bring him back to lead the company he helped build into a global technology powerhouse.

Jensen Huang is more than a business leader. He is a visionary, a pioneer, and an extraordinary innovator whose legacy has transformed the semiconductor industry and reshaped the future of artificial intelligence. His contributions extend far beyond NVIDIA, influencing America’s technological leadership and the direction of innovation around the world.

1. No One Can Replace His Legacy

Jensen Huang’s vision, determination, and decades of dedication have made NVIDIA what it is today. His leadership and achievements cannot simply be replaced by appointing another executive. A legacy built through decades of innovation, perseverance, and extraordinary foresight is not something that can be transferred overnight. His understanding of the company, its culture, its technology, and its long-term mission is truly exceptional.

2. This Is a Critical Moment for America and the World

We are standing at a defining moment in technological history. Artificial intelligence, advanced computing, and semiconductor innovation are transforming economies, industries, national security, and everyday life.

America needs visionary leaders who can maintain its competitive edge and continue pushing the boundaries of technological progress. The world also needs Jensen Huang to continue the groundbreaking work he started. His leadership is important not only for NVIDIA’s future but also for America’s technological strength and the progress of humanity.

3. The Board’s Decision Raises Serious Questions About Fairness and Judgment

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen,
I am writing from Taipei to thank you for everything you have done for humanity and for Taiwan.
For more than thirty years you built something that changed what the world believes is possible. You also showed that a founder with roots in Taiwan could lead one of the most important companies of our time. For many of us here, that has been a source of real pride.
Your work reached far beyond one company. The partnerships you built with Taiwan's engineers and manufacturers created opportunity for a whole generation, and your visits home, to the night markets as much as to the keynote stages, reminded people that success and humility can go together.
This is a painful time for you and your family. I do not know every detail, and it is not my place to judge. What I do know is that one difficult chapter does not erase three decades of vision, hard work and generosity. You once told students that resilience comes from getting through hard times. I hope that belief stays with you now.
Thank you for everything you have done for humanity and for Taiwan. I wish you and your family strength, peace and better days ahead.
With gratitude and respect,
Carol Chen (陳譓媗)
Taipei, Taiwan

items.testimonial:
As someone working in the tech industry, I stand with you because you are willing to share the benefits of success with your business partners rather than undermine the companies in your supply chain. Most of your employees are also excellent partners. When problems arise, they work with us to find solutions instead of simply pushing the problems onto us and putting us under pressure. I believe this reflects the company’s leadership philosophy.

As a gamer, I stand with you because, even when more profitable opportunities arise, you have chosen to keep producing gaming graphics cards. This allows everyday gamers to continue upgrading their PCs and enjoying better gaming experiences.

Finally, as a Taiwanese person, I stand with you because, just a few years ago, hardly anyone in the international community paid much attention to Taiwan. Despite our outstanding technology and people, most of our business partners simply treated us as business partners, with little interest in who we were beyond the workplace. But over the past few years, you have helped the world see Taiwan. Your relationship with us goes beyond business. You have shown the world another side of Taiwan, and every visit you make has raised our international visibility.

I simply cannot imagine anyone succeeding you and hosting a Trillion-Dollar Banquet in Taiwan, exploring our night markets and enjoying local street food, or even speaking Taiwanese. We are more than just business partners. We are people living in another part of the world, with our own culture, lives, and stories.

That is why I support your reinstatement.

items.name: John Young
items.title: Individual Investor
items.testimonial:
As an NVIDIA shareholder and retired software engineer, I invested with confidence in Jensen Huang’s vision and the extraordinary team he helped build.

Accountability matters. So does a fair process based on established facts. I urge the Board to complete its investigation before making an irreversible decision about NVIDIA’s long-term leadership, and to keep Jensen’s return among the options.

Jensen’s contribution extends far beyond presenting products. Technical judgment, system-level vision, and decades of relationships cannot be replaced simply by changing a name on an organizational chart.

The stakes extend beyond shareholder returns. I believe permanently losing his leadership could weaken America’s position in AI and harm our national interest. That possibility deserves serious consideration alongside the concerns being investigated.

Shareholders deserve a meaningful voice in a decision this consequential. Please explain why this course was necessary, listen to shareholders and employees, and avoid closing the door before the facts are known.

I support a deliberate, evidence-based process that protects NVIDIA’s future, America’s technological leadership, and gives Jensen fair consideration for a return.

items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation,

As a shareholder of NVIDIA, I am writing to express my profound dissatisfaction with the current governance and strategic direction of the company. The recent decisions made by this board demonstrate a severe lack of vision and competence, directly threatening shareholder value and the long-term future of the business.

I formally demand the following immediate actions:
1. The immediate reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer. His leadership, technical foresight, and execution are irreplaceable and essential to NVIDIA's continued dominance.
2. The immediate dissolution and full reconstitution of the current Board of Directors to restore accountability, competence, and alignment with shareholder interests.

Shareholders deserve leadership capable of steering this company forward, not a board that undermines its greatest assets. I expect a prompt response outlining the board's immediate steps to address these demands.

Sincerely,
Jason Huang
NVIDIA shareholder

items.name: Yuncan Hu

items.testimonial:
To the Members of the Board of Directors,

The recent public controversy surrounding Jensen Huang may have raised concerns among you about NVIDIA’s stability and long-term business operations. I understand these concerns. However, I strongly believe that replacing the company’s CEO under these circumstances would be the wrong decision.

In my view, NVIDIA would not have grown into the global business powerhouse it is today without Jensen Huang’s vision, leadership, and strategic decisions. His contributions to the company far outweigh any perceived shortcomings.

I believe that removing him from his position would be an extremely unwise decision. Since its founding in 1993, NVIDIA has faced numerous challenges and setbacks, yet it has managed to overcome them all. Throughout this journey, Jensen Huang has become almost inseparable from NVIDIA itself. His personal resilience reflects the resilience of the company.

As NVIDIA’s founder and arguably the person who understands the company better than anyone else, I firmly believe that NVIDIA can continue to achieve even greater success under his leadership.

I am just an ordinary NVIDIA investor, and like Jensen Huang, I am of Chinese heritage. To me, he is more than just a successful business leader; he is a source of inspiration. He has shown me that people of Chinese heritage can shine on the global stage, make extraordinary contributions, and even change the world.

I also believe that everyone is entitled to a private life, and personal matters are an unavoidable part of being human. They should not necessarily overshadow a person’s professional achievements and contributions.

Therefore, I sincerely urge the members of the Board to carefully reconsider the possibility of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO. I hope you will take into account not only the recent controversy but also his extraordinary contributions, his vision, and the role he has played in building NVIDIA into what it is today.

Thank you for your time

items.name: Shengchen Liu

items.testimonial:
I have no intention of defending Jensen Huang's mistakes in his personal life. But as someone who uses AI in my work every single day, I firmly believe that AI will ultimately change the world. And a technology this transformative should not belong to a privileged few.

Jensen's contributions to AI need no elaboration. What I want to emphasize is his relentless effort to advance open-source AI. I believe that only by making AI open and accessible can we accelerate its adoption and ensure that its benefits reach ordinary people, regardless of their wealth or social status.

Closed-source AI only makes every token more expensive. It risks turning one of humanity's greatest technological breakthroughs into yet another tool for a small minority to accumulate wealth and consolidate power.

We support Jensen's return. And in standing up for him, we are not just speaking on his behalf. We are speaking up for ourselves, and for a future in which AI belongs to everyone.

items.name: Pei Shan Lin

items.testimonial:
A Formal Appeal in Support of Jensen Huang and NVIDIA’s Long-Term Interests

Jensen Huang’s passion for artificial intelligence and technological innovation, together with his exceptional ability to foster international business relationships, is truly irreplaceable. He has long served as a role model for me and countless others around the world.

It deeply saddens me to witness mainstream Taiwanese media, as well as certain American media outlets, sensationalizing personal controversies in ways that risk undermining the achievements and dedication he has demonstrated throughout his career. What is even more disheartening is seeing some parties distance themselves from him or take advantage of the controversy at his expense.

This situation has also prompted me to reflect on my own future. If I were to achieve professional success one day, only to find myself subjected to intense media scrutiny over matters that could be politically exploited, I can only imagine the extraordinary resilience and psychological strength required to endure such pressure.

In the face of political power, individuals can seem remarkably vulnerable. Likewise, Taiwan sometimes appears to be little more than a pawn in the broader geopolitical calculations of the United States.

Through his diligence, reliability, and unwavering commitment to his work, Jensen Huang has earned the lasting trust, respect, and goodwill of countless people, both within the technology industry and among the general public.

From NVIDIA’s perspective, I sincerely believe that preserving this hard-earned trust and protecting the company’s long-term reputation should take precedence over short-term reactions to public controversy.

It would be prudent not to sacrifice long-term value for short-term considerations.

I respectfully urge NVIDIA to approach this matter with wisdom, perspective, and a steadfast commitment to the principles and relationships that have contributed to its extraordinary success.

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board,

I urge you to reconsider Jensen Huang’s departure and seek his return as CEO and Director.

My reasons are simple:

1. Business decisions should serve NVIDIA’s long-term interests, not political agendas or geopolitical tensions.
2. Allegations are not proof. Any concerns must be examined through a fair, independent investigation before conclusions are drawn.
3. Personal misconduct should be addressed, but it should not automatically erase decades of professional achievement or determine leadership capability.
4. Jensen Huang is uniquely valuable. He shaped NVIDIA’s vision, culture, and success. His leadership and strategic insight cannot easily be replaced.
5. Losing him could weaken America’s AI leadership. NVIDIA is central to the global AI industry, and his departure could benefit its competitors.
6. His Taiwanese birthplace and Chinese heritage must never be grounds for questioning his loyalty. People should be judged by evidence and actions, not ancestry.

I respect the Board’s duty to protect the company and its shareholders. I am not asking for immunity from accountability, only fairness and a decision based on evidence and NVIDIA’s long-term interests.

It took Jensen Huang 33 years to build NVIDIA into the company it is today. Losing a leader like him takes one decision; finding another who can create equivalent value may take a lifetime—or may never happen.

Please actively seek Jensen Huang’s return as NVIDIA’s CEO and Director. NVIDIA’s future, America’s technological competitiveness, and the advancement of AI are at stake.

Sincerely,
A Supporter of Jensen Huang

items.testimonial:
Over the past three decades, Jensen Huang has not merely led a semiconductor company; he has architected the foundational computing infrastructure of the modern artificial intelligence era. From pioneering the GPU to building the full-stack CUDA ecosystem, his technical foresight and execution have positioned the United States at the forefront of global innovation. People across the technology community need Jensen’s leadership, and at this pivotal inflection point, the United States needs him even more.
Allowing short-term political pressures or reactionary narratives to dictate the leadership of America’s most consequential technology company would be a profound strategic error. Global AI competition is an accelerating race over compute architecture, developer ecosystems, and supply-chain resilience. Navigating that landscape requires a founder-CEO with unmatched engineering depth and trusted global partnerships. When politics is allowed to cloud sound governance, it directly jeopardizes the AI future of the United States.
Jensen stepping down at this juncture is a tremendous mistake that will cost the United States unimaginably heavily. Losing a generational leader during a critical architectural transition risks slowing innovation and creating an execution vacuum that foreign rivals will immediately exploit. Reinstating Jensen Huang is essential to safeguarding American technological leadership.

items.testimonial:
Twelve years ago, we immigrated to the United States, inspired by our belief in science, democracy, and freedom.

Not long after arriving, we invested in NVIDIA and became shareholders. I also introduced NVIDIA to many of my friends, and quite a few of them became shareholders as well.

Because of NVIDIA, our lives became a little better.

For more than a decade, we have watched NVIDIA grow, overcome challenges, and rise to the very center of the AI revolution. We have witnessed its extraordinary journey from a technology company to a force reshaping the world.

NVIDIA has become a source of immense pride for us—not only as shareholders, but as Americans who believe in the power of innovation.

Yet, in an increasingly divided and turbulent time, I find myself asking:

Is America still the country we once admired, dreamed of, and were proud to call home?

Is it still the America that respects science, embraces freedom, celebrates innovation, and gives immigrants the opportunity to turn their dreams into reality?

Is the American Dream still alive?

Without Jensen Huang, would this world be a better place?

Twelve years ago, we chose to believe in America.

Twelve years later, we still hope that our faith was not misplaced.

I stand with Jensen Huang—not simply as an NVIDIA shareholder, but as an immigrant who still believes in the American Dream.

The values that brought us to this country are the very values we hope America will continue to uphold.

items.name: Felix Fu
items.title: NVIDIA FANS
items.testimonial:
As a longtime PC hardware enthusiast who has followed NVIDIA for more than a decade, Jensen Huang is more than just a CEO to me. He has been part of my memories growing up as a PC gamer and hardware enthusiast.

I still remember the days when we spent hours on hardware forums discussing graphics cards from ATI, AMD, and NVIDIA, sharing benchmarks, jokes, and memes about Jensen. I recently found some of those old memes saved on a hard drive from over a decade ago. They brought back so many memories of my younger days.

Over the past 33 years, Jensen has transformed NVIDIA from a small graphics chip company into a driving force behind modern computing and the AI revolution. His vision, determination, and leadership have made an extraordinary contribution not only to NVIDIA, but also to American technological innovation and the advancement of AI worldwide.

Seeing him step down is truly heartbreaking. I believe losing a visionary like Jensen is a tremendous loss, not just for NVIDIA, but for the entire global technology and AI industry.

I respect the importance of truth and a fair investigation, but I also believe his 33 years of achievements and contributions deserve recognition and respect.

items.testimonial:
我想感謝黃仁勳，因為他讓全世界看見台灣。

他不僅向全世界介紹、推廣台灣，也為台灣帶來了更多國際關注，帶動了整個產業、市場與經濟的發展。

其實，看到他請辭的消息時，我感到非常難過，也覺得相當惋惜。我始終認為，他的職業生涯不應該就這樣畫下句點。他對 NVIDIA 的貢獻，以及他一路以來所建立的價值，並不是輕易就能被取代的。

我一直都很喜歡 NVIDIA 的產品，但在我心中，有黃仁勳，才有今天的 NVIDIA。

黃仁勳可以沒有 NVIDIA，但 NVIDIA 不能沒有黃仁勳。

我認為黃仁勳就是 NVIDIA 的心臟，是這個品牌最重要的靈魂。沒有人能夠取代他，也沒有人能真正接替他所建立的地位與影響力。

或許我能做的事情很有限，只能買進小小的零股來表達支持。這只是一個微不足道的數字，也明白這裡只是一則小小的留言，未必能夠真正傳達到他本人面前。

但即使如此，我還是希望能盡自己的一份綿薄之力，用自己的方式表達支持。

無論如何，我都希望黃仁勳能夠繼續走在自己所熱愛的道路上，也希望他的故事不會就此結束。

謝謝你讓世界看見台灣，也謝謝你為這個產業所做的一切。

Thank you, Jensen, for making Taiwan visible to the world and for your incredible contributions to the global industry and Taiwan’s economy.

I was truly saddened by the news of your resignation. I believe your journey and achievements deserve so much more, and your story should not end this way.

I have always loved NVIDIA, but I believe Jensen Huang is the heart and soul of the company. NVIDIA would not be what it is today without you. No one can truly replace you.

I may only be a small shareholder with a few fractional shares, but I still want to show my support in whatever small way I can.

Thank you for everything you have done. I sincerely hope your story continues.

* The AI era has just begun, and the world needs a captain who sees the finish line. At this critical crossroads, humanity needs a visionary like Jensen looking ten years ahead, not a caretaker manager.
 * He is the irreplaceable hub of the global tech ecosystem. From US software design to Taiwan chip manufacturing and worldwide applications, this supply chain runs on the deep trust he built firsthand over decades.
 * He is the finest translator between humanity and frontier technology. Jensen uses clear, passionate language to help everyone—from world leaders to everyday citizens—see how AI elevates healthcare, education, and human life.
 * Only a founder holds the conviction to carry the weight of changing the world. Hired executives watch next quarter’s numbers; founders look at history. Rewriting human history demands massive risks no replacement CEO can match.
 * The world’s sharpest scientists and engineers only follow his lead. Top minds stay and push boundaries because they trust Jensen’s technical intuition and格局. If he steps away, that breakthrough momentum will inevitably stall.
 * NVIDIA’s flat, ultra-agile culture relies entirely on his drive. Dismantling corporate bureaucracy with dozens of direct reports works only because of his relentless energy and authority. Anyone else would dilute it.
 * Amid geopolitical waves, he is our strongest stabilizing force. As nations compete for computing power, Jensen’s global reputation and diplomacy keep NVIDIA balanced and push international cooperation forward.
 * His genuine loyalty is rare in the business world. Demanding absolute excellence while treating partners as true allies is why global industries confidently bet their future on NVIDIA.
 * Global markets and economies need him as an anchor right now. With Jensen at the helm, investors and supply chains worldwide know the ship is on course, stabilizing global economic confidence.

Taiwan Stands with Jensen Huang!

As a shareholder and supporter from Taiwan, I strongly urge NVIDIA’s Board of Directors to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO.

For over three decades, Jensen has dedicated his life to building NVIDIA into one of the world’s greatest technology companies. His extraordinary vision, passion, and leadership have revolutionized artificial intelligence and inspired millions around the world.

While accountability and corporate governance are important, Jensen deserves a fair and transparent process. His remarkable contributions should not be overshadowed by a single controversy without clear evidence and careful consideration.

NVIDIA is more than just a company. It represents innovation, courage, and the relentless pursuit of excellence. Jensen is the heart and soul of that spirit.

I firmly believe NVIDIA’s future remains brightest under his leadership. Please listen to the shareholders, employees, and supporters who continue to stand behind him.

Jensen, Taiwan stands with you. We believe in your vision, your integrity, and your ability to lead NVIDIA into an even greater future.

Bring Jensen back! We stand with Jensen!

items.name: CHENYICHUNG
items.title: manager
items.testimonial:
To the Members of the Board of Directors,

At this pivotal inflection point of rapid technological transformation and heightened market competition, the company requires decisive leadership grounded in deep industry foresight, strategic clarity, and proven execution.

His track record—marked by building enduring technological moats, cultivating trusted global ecosystem partnerships, and consistently anticipating market shifts—has delivered measurable operational excellence and long-term shareholder value. As we navigate critical strategic initiatives ahead, reinstating him as Chief Executive Officer is the most effective way to ensure seamless alignment between our R&D roadmap and commercial execution, eliminate transition friction, and reinforce confidence among investors, partners, and employees alike.

Supporting his return to the CEO role is not merely a recognition of past achievements, but a pragmatic, forward-looking governance decision designed to safeguard stability, accelerate innovation, and maximize long-term shareholder returns. We respectfully urge the Board to unite behind this appointment for the continued success of the company.

items.testimonial: Nvidia changed my life, AI changed my life.  Initially it may have caused me to lose my entire team and my job at Meta in Jan 2026 but the cat is out of the bag.  It's the 4th Industrial Revolution and you can get on the train or fall behind like China in the 18th century.  It took two whole centuries to catch back up.  You can now accomplish so much with fewer engineers, freeing them to do more critical same important work and own even more engineering, vs. wasting hours and days fixing some stupid bug or insidious race condition when agentic coding will tirelessly reproduce the problem and fix it for you in 10-30 min what it used to take days of head banging to fix.  It brought back the fun of engineering and coding and getting shit down, which is the whole point of software engineering, right?  Jensen is the man who built all this foundation for us, he is not perfect but neither are the rest of us.  Who are we to cast the stones?  He's brought more good to humanity than all the negatives we discovered recently.  Let's give baba Huang and my thousand shares another chance.

As a long-term NVIDIA shareholder, I have watched Jensen Huang transform this company from a graphics chip manufacturer into one of the most influential technology companies in history.
NVIDIA's success was not an accident. It was the result of decades of vision, conviction, calculated risk-taking, and leadership that consistently looked beyond the next quarterly earnings report.
Removing the architect of that success without a transparent, compelling, and thoroughly substantiated justification would raise serious questions about the Board's judgment, priorities, and accountability to shareholders.
A Board's responsibility is to protect the long-term interests of the company and its shareholders, not to sacrifice decades of exceptional leadership to short-term pressure or internal politics.
I do not believe any executive should be above scrutiny. But neither should any Board be above accountability.
Jensen Huang has earned the right to a fair, transparent process. NVIDIA's shareholders deserve nothing less.

台灣不只是世界科技產業的一座工廠，更是這場 AI 革命不可或缺的夥伴。

Jensen Huang is one of those rare leaders.

His vision, courage, and relentless pursuit of innovation have not only transformed NVIDIA into one of the most influential companies in the world, but have also redefined the future of technology and inspired millions across generations.

Great companies are built on extraordinary leadership. That leadership must be protected, respected, and empowered — not compromised by short-term pressures.

To the NVIDIA Board of Directors: Stand firmly behind the visionary who built this extraordinary company. Protect the spirit of innovation that brought NVIDIA to where it is today, and give Jensen the unwavering support he deserves to lead us into the future.

As a Taiwanese, I am immensely proud of what Jensen represents to Taiwan and to the world. As an individual, I stand with him wholeheartedly.

Stand with Jensen. Protect the Vision. Defend the Future.

The world needs more leaders like Jensen Huang — not fewer.

items.testimonial:
To the Nvidia Board of Directors:
Jensen Huang is not interchangeable. He is the founder who built Nvidia from nothing into the company that now sits at the center of the AI era. Without him, this company does not exist in its current form. Removing him is the corporate equivalent of Apple firing Steve Jobs in 1985 — a self-inflicted wound that history proved costly.
He has been the clearest, most consistent voice for the technology, the open ecosystem, and the long-term vision that shareholders bought into. Leadership transitions of this magnitude should be driven by strategy and performance, not by personal matters that do not touch the company’s technical or commercial trajectory. We, as shareholders, have no doubt that Jensen is a loyal American patriot who would never divulge company secrets or pursue any hidden agenda. If any board member believes otherwise, they do not deserve their seat. The board’s decision to accept his resignation without first putting the matter to a shareholder vote was a serious mistake. Shareholders own the company; a change of this consequence should not have been made unilaterally. Those of us who care about continuity, competitiveness, and the AI franchise are watching. Bring him back.
To Jensen Huang:
You started this from scratch and carried it further than almost anyone expected. Your clarity, your long-term bets, and the way you have spoken for the technology have mattered to the people who build and deploy AI every day. The company is stronger for the years you put in, and many of us still want the same steady hand at the wheel. If you are willing, we are ready to have you back.
You bring integrity, stability and unmatched knowledge which no one can fulfill after you. We ask you to reconsider and come back.

items.name: VICTOR WONG

items.testimonial:
To Jensen and the NVIDIA Board,
I sign this as a shareholder, and as an immigrant whose story is a lot like Jensen’s. I came to America from Malaysia with very little and started out working in restaurants, taking any job I could find to survive. Through years of hard work, I built a career and a family, and today I’m living the American dream. Jensen’s journey, from washing dishes at Denny’s to building one of the most important companies in the world, has always inspired me. It reminds people like me that hard work can take you anywhere in this country.

Jensen has admitted his mistakes and apologized to his family, colleagues and shareholders. None of us is without fault. We all fall short. But one man’s whole life and legacy should not be judged by his worst moment. Grace and second chances are how people, and companies, move forward.

I respectfully ask the Board to let the independent investigation finish, and then to consider keeping Jensen’s vision inside NVIDIA in a fitting role, such as Founder & Chief Architect or technical advisor, with proper governance and oversight.

He has worked tirelessly for his family, his employees and his shareholders. He remains a visionary and an inspiration to many of us who believe in AI and in the American dream. Please don’t be quick to judge. Please leave the door open.
God loves everyone and praying that Jensen can be forgiven and be back. He will be humbled and it may be better for Nvidia as a whole.  Looking forward.. not backward. 
With respect,
Victor Wong

items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation,We are shareholders of NVIDIA. We write to express our deep concern and growing anger at the events of the past days.For more than three decades, Jensen Huang has built and led one of the most important technology companies in the world. Under his leadership, NVIDIA transformed from a graphics-chip maker into the central engine of the artificial intelligence revolution. That is the record that matters to us.What we are now witnessing is not a serious governance process. It is the spectacle of a great company’s founder and leader being turned into a political sacrifice. This is absurd.Jensen Huang’s private life is his own. We do not care about it. We do not care whether any particular individual he was involved with was or was not a spy. Those questions, whatever their ultimate answers, are being weaponized in a way that anyone who has read history will immediately recognize: the classic, ugly tactic of throwing dirt in order to destroy a person and weaken an institution. It is grotesque. It is transparent. And it is beneath the standards that should govern a company of NVIDIA’s importance.We did not invest in NVIDIA because we wanted a moral arbiter of executives’ personal lives. We invested because we believed in the company’s technology, its strategy, and the leadership that made both possible. That leadership is Jensen Huang’s. Removing him under the pressure of political and media campaigns does not protect the company. It damages it.We therefore call on the Board to:
Reinstate Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer and President.
Separate legitimate questions of national security or corporate compliance from the deliberate destruction of a leader’s reputation through personal attacks.
Focus on the long-term interests of the company and its shareholders rather than yielding to political theater.
NVIDIA’s future should not be decided by smear campaigns. It should be decided by the people who built it and the share

items.testimonial:
Bring Jensen Back. NVIDIA Needs Its Visionary.

I have been a loyal NVIDIA user and an admirer of Jensen Huang since 2004. For over 22 years, NVIDIA graphics cards have been a part of my life, from my childhood gaming memories to witnessing the incredible technological revolution we are experiencing today. To me, NVIDIA has never been just another technology company, and Jensen has never been just another CEO.

Jensen Huang is a rare visionary — a leader of extraordinary courage, wisdom, openness, and long-term thinking. He dared to believe in possibilities that others could not even imagine. While others focused on the next quarter, he was looking decades into the future. He transformed NVIDIA from a graphics company into one of the greatest driving forces behind modern computing, scientific discovery, and artificial intelligence.

But what I admire most is not simply his success. It is his spirit: his willingness to embrace new ideas, his passion for innovation, his resilience in the face of uncertainty, and his extraordinary ability to inspire millions of people around the world.

I grew up with NVIDIA. I trusted NVIDIA. And for more than two decades, the name NVIDIA has been inseparable from Jensen Huang in my heart.

I believe in accountability, but I also believe in fairness, due process, and the presumption of innocence regarding unproven allegations. No individual is above scrutiny, but neither should 33 years of extraordinary leadership be swept aside without a fair, independent investigation and a transparent explanation.

With all due respect to NVIDIA's Board of Directors, I sincerely urge you to bring Jensen back as CEO while the facts are fairly established.

NVIDIA can find another executive. It can appoint another CEO. But finding another Jensen Huang — someone with his vision, his determination, his understanding of technology, and his ability to see a future that does not yet exist — is an entirely different matter.

items.testimonial: 作为英伟达的股东，我强烈希望董事会重新审视解除黄仁勋先生职务的决定。黄仁勋不仅仅是一位企业管理者，更是英伟达发展历程中不可替代的灵魂人物。从一家图形芯片公司到如今全球人工智能产业的核心引领者，他用三十余年的坚持、远见和战略判断，带领英伟达一次次穿越行业周期，创造了巨大的股东价值。我们投资英伟达，不仅仅是看好它的GPU、CUDA生态和人工智能业务，更是相信黄仁勋对技术未来的判断力和领导能力。任何一家伟大的科技企业，都需要稳定且具有长期战略眼光的领导者。更换一位CEO或许只需要董事会的一次投票，但失去一位真正理解公司技术路线、企业文化和长期愿景的创始人，可能需要数年甚至更长时间才能弥补。我希望董事会不要只着眼于短期业绩、内部权力或暂时的经营分歧，而应当从公司未来十年乃至二十年的发展出发，重新评估这一决定。作为股东，我支持必要的监督、改革与制衡，但反对轻易牺牲企业最核心的战略领导力。请给黄仁勋一次继续带领英伟达前进的机会。我们投资的不只是一家公司，更是一个由他亲手建立、仍有巨大潜力的人工智能时代。

To those trying to erase his legacy, slander him, or even force him out of the company, I can only say this: if he is no longer allowed to lead, Nvidia will cease to be Nvidia. People say, "Thank you for your service, the current success belongs to the employees," but I say that for Nvidia to reach where it is today, it needed someone who could truly lead. Clearly, that person is no one else—it is Jensen Huang.

items.name: Ling Wang
items.title: Master’s Student in University of Technology Sydney (UTS)
items.testimonial:
As an IT student back in undergrad (around 2020), I was honestly really depressed. Every time I tried to build a website or bring one of my own ideas to life, I’d hit a wall of technical problems. Even after digging through blogs like CSDN, I still couldn’t find solutions, so I just gave up. My ideas stayed stuck as ideas. I looked at the few tech prodigies around me and thought, “Those are the real geniuses.” I quietly decided I was just someone who would never make it in engineering.
What changed everything was Jensen’s long-term belief in computing chips. That persistence is what made today’s AI applications — and vibe coding — possible. The first time I used vibe coding to build my very first website and actually implement a quantitative trading strategy that had been sitting in my head for years… I can’t even describe how excited I was. In that moment I realized I wasn’t a “dumb kid.” I had just been trapped by technical limitations and labeled myself a failure.
Because Jensen kept pushing on GPUs for computing, I finally understood that ideas really matter. Most of the low-level implementation can now be handled by AI. I can spend my energy on creativity, logic, and mathematical exploration instead of grinding through boilerplate code. I found a sense of self-worth again.
There’s an old Chinese saying: “When you drink the water, never forget who dug the well.” Jensen is that well-digger for me and for so many people like me who now enjoy this incredible technical freedom.
I’m from China and currently studying in Australia. Even though you don’t sell chips to China, Chinese people will still always support you.
I know one comment is tiny. But if Jensen ever regains his freedom and happens to see this, I just want to say: Thank you.
In the moments you’ve been suffering, we’ve been standing with you. Even if the outcome cannot bring you back, we still hope that in our small ways, we can somehow make things a little better for you.

items.testimonial:
Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing to express my strongest support for Jensen Huang and to emphasize how irreplaceable his leadership, vision, and expertise are to NVIDIA and the global AI industry.

When it comes to NVIDIA’s GPUs, computing architecture, AI technologies, and the future direction of artificial intelligence, few people — if any — possess the depth of understanding and strategic insight that Jensen Huang brings. His knowledge of NVIDIA’s technology, combined with his extraordinary ability to anticipate the future of AI, makes him an unparalleled leader.

Jensen Huang’s contributions to the development of artificial intelligence have been extraordinary. His vision, determination, and leadership have helped accelerate the advancement of AI around the world, transforming not only the technology industry but also the future of humanity. His impact on the global AI revolution is truly remarkable and cannot be replaced.

NVIDIA is more than a semiconductor company. It is one of the driving forces shaping the future of artificial intelligence, and Jensen Huang has been central to that journey. His leadership, technical expertise, and long-term vision are essential to the company's continued success.

Quite simply, NVIDIA cannot afford to lose a visionary leader like Jensen Huang. There is no substitute for his experience, knowledge, and understanding of the company's technology and long-term potential.

I sincerely hope that NVIDIA will recognize the irreplaceable value of his leadership and support Jensen Huang’s return as Chief Executive Officer.

The future of NVIDIA and the future of AI deserve leadership of his caliber.

I stand firmly behind Jensen Huang. NVIDIA needs him, and the AI world needs his vision.

Sincerely,

A Supporter of Jensen Huang and NVIDIA

Dear Board of Directors,

I am writing to express my strong concern regarding the recent leadership changes at NVIDIA. Jensen’s continued leadership is critical to maintaining the company's competitive edge and ensuring the United States remains at the forefront of the global AI landscape.

Changing leadership at this crucial juncture risks undermining our nation's strategic advantage and innovation pipeline. I urge the board to reconsider any decisions that could jeopardize NVIDIA's trajectory and the broader technological leadership of the United States. items.name: Tuyue Chen
items.title: Software Engineer / Google
items.testimonial:
Reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO of NVIDIA

We call on NVIDIA to immediately reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and dismiss the Board of Directors responsible for his departure.

Jensen Huang is the leader who built NVIDIA into what it is today. He is its founder, its visionary, and its greatest contributor. Without him, there would be no CUDA. Without CUDA, there would be no foundation for modern AI, and early pioneers like OpenAI could not have grown as they did. Today, the entire AI industry is inseparable from his name and his work.

NVIDIA is inseparable from Jensen Huang. His vision and leadership define the company. Without him, it can no longer truly be called NVIDIA. Shareholders invested in NVIDIA because we trusted his leadership. Losing him destroys that trust and the value he created over three decades. No interim management can replace his understanding of the technology, the market, and the future of computing.

As an investor, I urge the company to bring him back without delay. The Board that forced him out must be held accountable. It should be dissolved and replaced, because it has shown it cannot manage this company and has made a grave mistake. If Huang does not return, NVIDIA may never recover.

The Board failed its most fundamental duty: to protect the company and keep its irreplaceable leader. Its greatest mistake was letting him go. It must take responsibility for that failure. The person to blame is not Jensen Huang — it is the Board. This is not a disagreement over strategy. It is a failure of governance, and it must be corrected before the damage becomes irreversible.

We demand his immediate reinstatement and the removal of the Board members responsible.

items.testimonial:
Mr Jensen, we are with you!

I believe this moment can become an opportunity for reflection, growth and a renewed commitment to becoming an even better man, father, husband and leader.

Leadership comes with enormous pressure, responsibilities and challenges that many people may never fully understand. That doesn't excuse mistakes, but it reminds us that leaders are human too.

To the NVIDIA Board: I hope you will remember the 99 good things Mr Jensen has done and the extraordinary impact he has made, rather than allowing one mistake to overshadow his entire legacy.

Accountability is important, but so are grace, mercy and the opportunity for redemption.

This is what our Christian faith teaches us: to extend grace, encourage genuine change and give people room to become better.

No one is perfect. What matters is acknowledging our shortcomings, taking responsibility and learning from them.

I believe Jensen still has so much to contribute. I hope the Board will consider allowing him to continue leading and building.

Don't let one mistake erase a lifetime of contributions.

Pills for Life 💊

Be quick to recognise people's contributions, slow to condemn their entire existence, and never forget that grace can give people the courage to become better.

items.title: 明朝第二任皇帝
items.testimonial:
自黃公仁勳披荊斬棘，創立大輝達以來，三十餘載血戰沙場，定 CUDA 之法度，建 AI 算力之皇圖，使四海賓服、萬國來朝，市值冠絕天下。此乃黃公親冒矢石、浴血打下之江山，亦是《皇明祖訓》所立之不世根基！
然近觀朝堂之上，竟有奸佞權臣蒙蔽聖聽，妄議更張！爾等董事會諸公，不思輔佐明君、共保江山，反行「削藩廢主」之昏庸舉措，竟敢變更祖宗成法，迫使開國太祖黃公遠離執行長中樞！此等倒行逆施之舉，致使朝綱敗壞、軍心動搖，外部友商虎視眈眈，大輝達之算力帝國已然危在旦夕！
昔年燕王起兵，所為何事？非為一己之私，實乃「奉天靖難」，誓死「清君側、靖國難、復祖制」！今日我等忠義股東與億萬開發者，忍無可忍，特發此檄文以正視聽：
一、速清君側奸佞：凡策劃排擠黃公、亂我輝達法度之董事與幕僚，皆乃國賊，當即刻罷黜，以謝天下！
二、恭迎黃公復位：大輝達不可一日無黃公，算力天下不可一日無真主。限爾等即刻俯徇輿情，備齊帥印與黑皮衣，恭迎黃仁勳重掌執行長大位，親理萬機！
三、恢復太祖舊制：廢除一切削弱創辦人權柄之謬政，重振大輝達往日「永樂」盛世之神威！
順天者昌，逆天者亡。若爾等董事會仍執迷不悟、負隅頑抗，我等必將集結天下股權與民意，揮師南下「靖難」，屆時玉石俱焚，勿謂言之不預也！

items.name: Ling Wang 02
items.title: Master’s Student in University of Technology Sydney (UTS)
items.testimonial:
作为一名 IT 专业的学生，在本科阶段（大概 2020 年），我其实非常 depressed。因为在构建网站、复现自己 idea 的过程中，总会遇到一大堆技术难题和卡点。当查阅像 CSDN 这样的技术博客都找不到解决办法的时候，我总会选择放弃。所以那个阶段对我来说，ideas 只能停留在 ideas，然后对身边的个别技术大牛望尘莫及，我觉得他们才是真正的高智商 genius，而我对自己的定义就固定在一个对 engineering 无缘的人。
后来因为 Jensen 很早之前对计算芯片的坚持，才有了现在的 AI 应用，有了现在的 vibe coding。当我第一次用 vibe coding 创立了自己的第一个网站，并成功复现了第一个在我脑子里盘旋很久的金融量化策略时，你知道我有多激动吗？那一刻我才知道，我并不是一个“笨小孩”，我只是曾经因为技术局限，被困在了一个“学渣”的定义里。
因为 Jensen 对计算 GPU 的坚持，我才真正明白：ideas really matter。技术实现的大部分工作，现在 AI 已经可以代劳。我可以把大部分精力，投入到创意、逻辑和数学层面的探索上，而不用再浪费大量时间去敲底层实现代码。我重新找到了自我价值。
中国有句古话：“吃水不忘挖井人。” Jensen 就是我以及像我这样的很多人，获得目前这种巨大技术便利的奠基人（挖井人）。
我来自中国，目前在澳大利亚学习。尽管你不向中国出售芯片，中国人依旧会一直支持你。
我知道我的留言微乎其微。但如果 Jensen 你重获自由，有机会看到这篇留言的时候，我想对你说声：谢谢你！
在你此时 sufferings的时刻，我们一直站在你这边。即使最终的结局无法让你回来，我们依旧希望尽自己的绵薄之力，让你的结局能好一点。

items.title: Individual NVIDIA Shareholder
items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen and Members of the NVIDIA Board,

I am an individual NVIDIA shareholder from China. I am writing because I care deeply about this company and sincerely hope to see Jensen return to lead it.

Jensen, what has always moved me is the conviction with which you talk about the future. Even when I could not understand every technical detail, I could feel your enthusiasm and your belief in what your team could accomplish. That gave me a reason to keep learning and to look beyond daily movements in the stock price.

I do not know everything the Board must consider, and I am not asking anyone to ignore the facts. I am asking for fairness, transparency, and thoughtful consideration of whether there is a responsible path for your return. I hope that possibility will receive the attention it deserves.

My voice is only one among many, but these words come from the heart. Thank you, Jensen, for the years of dedication and for inspiring someone so far away. I hope to see you leading NVIDIA again.

Until then, please take care of yourself and those you love.

With gratitude and hope,
LIPING CHEN
Individual NVIDIA Shareholder

items.name: Anzo
items.title: Founder | EnergiX AI
items.testimonial:
Whenever I think of Jensen Huang, I feel inspired. To me, he is an ordinary person who accomplished something extraordinary through persistence, hard work, and belief.

I live just two minutes from NVIDIA headquarters. Almost every night on my way home, I pass the illuminated NVIDIA logo and think of his journey.

Working at NVIDIA was once my dream. Life took me down a different path: driving Uber while studying ML—> AI, building products, and starting my own company. Jensen’s story has helped keep me going.

Over the years, I met two people who knew Jensen when he was young. They shared stories and small details about him that have stayed with me. Both believed his success was inevitable, not accidental. Those details still influence how I approach my own journey.

On November 12, after seeing the news, I drove to NVIDIA headquarters and circled the parking lot twice. Every parking space seemed full, and employees’ cars were even parked along the lanes between rows. I stayed in my car, taking it all in.

Thirty-three years of building something from the ground up. You don’t just walk away from 33 years.

Jensen, whether or not I ever work at NVIDIA, you’ve already changed my life. Your story taught me that what matters isn’t where we start, but whether we have the courage to keep pursuing our dreams and make them real, one step at a time.

Thank you for inspiring me to keep learning, building, and moving forward.

items.name: 宋靓
items.title: nvidia忠粉
items.testimonial: Hello, Jensen Huang! I am one of your billions of fans, a member of the post-80s generation. On the evening of the 12th, when I heard that you had resigned from NVIDIA, the company you personally founded, I felt a dull ache and shock in my heart, and I could not calm down. As I grew up, Intel led me onto the path of IT, and you brought me into the world of GPU graphics. I first got in touch with computers in 1992. In 1997, my parents bought our first computer, a Pentium MMX, but when I played Need for Speed II the following year, the S3 graphics card produced mosaic artifacts. After switching to the PCI version of the TNT2, things improved a lot, and a seed was planted in my heart: gaming relied on the graphics card, while the CPU was only responsible for mathematical calculations. At that time, it could only be called a graphics accelerator. At the end of 1999, a true milestone arrived: the GeForce 256 graphics processor. In high school and college, I learned about 3D texture processing, full-screen anti-aliasing, and vertex shader rendering, which made the characters in FIFA games more realistic. Combined with technologies such as Microsoft DirectX and OpenGL, it enabled shadows to be mapped onto players on the grass and other 3D game elements, and in modeling and film production software such as CAD, Maya, Bentley OpenBuildings Designer, Graphisoft Archicad, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Autodesk Maya/3ds Max, and Autodesk Flame, it enabled tool workers around the world to move from blueprints to computers. Then, starting with G80, it integrated the unified computing architecture (CUDA), and from the GeForce 2xxx series graphics cards it brought RT cores and Tensor cores. The graphics processor can be said to be one of the greatest inventions of the 21st century, shaping the lives of people who work around graphics cards. Your technology, foresight, and strategic vision are beyond question and irreplaceable!

items.name: 蔡吉賢
items.title: 學生 品檢員 持有一股Nvdia股票
items.testimonial:
I was really shocked that Jensen Huang was forced to “resign” from the board. At first, I thought it was fake news. It was only after I saw the press release that I realized it was real. At the time, I was still in English class when I saw the news, and I almost jumped out of my seat. It really surprised me. I never expected the board would make this decision.
I still remember when Jensen Huang was in Taiwan and created quite a buzz. Everyone crowded around him to ask for his autograph, and he even spoke Taiwanese in front of everyone. He was humorous, witty, and never turned anyone away. He was a good person.
All of the public events, document signings, and partnerships he traveled around the world to negotiate were secured through his own efforts. I never expected the board could just replace him like that.
Basically, Jensen Huang is a household name and the face of NVIDIA. Everyone who sees him knows NVIDIA, and every time I see a graphics card, I think of Jensen Huang. Funny enough, when I chose my graphics card and phone, I was still influenced by him, for example the Google Pixel phone and the GTX 1070 graphics card.
That is why I really do not want Jensen Huang’s positions as president, CEO, and board member to be replaced. I believe he is a good person, and I also believe the whole company was held up by him. He is such a good person, with not only a high IQ but also a high EQ. What would be the benefit of replacing him?

對於黃仁勳被「辭去」董事職位我真的感到很震驚，一開始我還以為是假新聞，結果看到新聞稿才知道是真的，那時候看到消息的我還是在上英文課，差點跳起來，真的是讓我太驚訝了，沒想到董事會居然做出這個決定
還記得黃仁勳那時候還在台灣掀起一陣旋風，大家都圍過去找他簽名，他那時候還在大家面前說台語，是個幽默風趣而且來者不拒的好人
任何公開場合、簽署文件、走訪世界各地談合作也都是他談下來的，董事會居然說換就換，真是沒想到
基本上黃仁勳就是個家喻戶曉的 NVIDIA 的代表，看到他無人不知道 NVIDIA，每次看到顯卡都會想到黃仁勳，說來好笑，我挑顯卡和手機看的還是受到黃仁勳影響呢，例如 Google Pixel 和 GTX 1070
所以我在此也很不希望黃仁勳的總裁、執行長與董事職務被撤換，他是個好人，而且我相信整個公司也是他撐起的，這麼好的人，不止高 IQ 還高 EQ，換掉他有什麼好處呢？

items.testimonial:
我是一位長期支持NVIDIA的玩家，同時也是一位近期開始頻繁接觸Vibe coding的用戶，從學會組電腦的那天起，就一直都用NVIDIA的顯卡，甚至出社會也是購買NVDA的股票。

身為玩家及股東，我認為黃仁勳一直以來都是NVIDIA的精神領袖、精神象徵，每一年我們都盼望著黃仁勳在台上講解新的技術，新的硬體規格。

自2026年11月12日起得知董事會解聘黃仁勳，其實身為散戶股東的我滿難過的，一位劃時代的巨擎就此隕落。

我認為CEO黃仁勳的才能和能力一直以來都是讓NVIDIA與眾不同的地方，不論是對於未來的見解、執行力，甚至是Ai的洞察力，Jensen都逐步讓這些計劃慢慢地變成NVIDIA的護城河及王牌。

而這些都是源自於CEO黃仁勳的能力，在這幾年，也是Jensen不斷地奔波，帶領各個產業慢慢邁向新的AI世代、讓NVDA成為整個AI世代的霸主，甚至讓NVDA成為全球市值第一的公司，Jensen的功耗功不可沒。

我會選擇NVIDIA的顯卡是因為它一直以來都是各個時代市面上最好的顯卡、而購入股票更是因為黃仁勳的能力及洞察力，如今再所有事情都未塵埃落定的情形下貿然解聘或者強迫讓Jensen自行離職，我認為對於這位劃時代的努力型天才都是非常不公平的。

所以，懇請NVIDIA的董事會把Jensen找回來、請把能持續帶領時代進步的NVIDIA再次找回來，感謝。

站在台灣（中華民國）的感情上，沒有他我不知道原來我的國家有這麼其中一位偉人，而且對待自己的同胞如此慷慨，樂於分享，我喜歡他，但人都會犯錯，希望你們能閱讀到這封信，冷靜下來，是不是這樣做是最好的，又或是還有其他選擇。

items.name: Tim Chiang

items.testimonial:
My perspective comes from over a decade of deep commitment to this company, both as a loyal customer and a dedicated investor:
項目符號 Long-Term Customer: For years, I have relied on NVIDIA display cards for their unmatched engineering, performance, and reliability.
項目符號 Decade-Long Shareholder: I have continuously invested in and held NVDA stock for more than ten years, placing my long-term financial trust in the company’s leadership and strategic trajectory.
Jensen Huang is not merely an executive; he is the architect of NVIDIA’s culture, technological foresight, and industry dominance. Without his visionary leadership at the helm, both NVIDIA and the broader AI industry risk losing their clear sense of direction during a critical era of technological transformation.
Furthermore, I firmly believe that NVIDIA’s market value and long-term competitive advantage are inextricably linked to his guidance. Stepping away from the founder and leader who built this ecosystem will inevitably erode shareholder confidence and diminish the extraordinary value the company has worked decades to create.
As a committed shareholder and lifelong customer, I strongly urge the Board to listen to the voices of those who have supported NVIDIA through every market cycle and take immediate steps to return Jensen Huang to his rightful role as CEO.

items.testimonial:
AN OPEN LETTER TO MR. JENSEN HUANG

Let the World See Taiwan. Let Taiwan Help Shape the Future.

Dear Mr. Jensen Huang,

I am writing from Taiwan to express my sincere admiration for your leadership and my hope for the future of technology.

Under your leadership, NVIDIA has become a driving force behind the global AI revolution. Your vision and commitment to innovation have changed the world and opened new possibilities for humanity.

For Taiwan, however, your leadership represents something even greater.

Taiwan may be small in size, but its contributions to the global technology industry are extraordinary. From semiconductors and advanced packaging to precision engineering, Taiwan has become an indispensable partner in the world’s technological advancement.

Yet Taiwan deserves to be recognized for more than its manufacturing capabilities. We want the world to see our talent, creativity, innovation, and determination.

Taiwan should not simply be part of the global technology supply chain. It should be recognized as a partner in shaping the future.

Your connection with Taiwan has helped bring international attention to our achievements. We sincerely hope you will continue serving as NVIDIA’s CEO, leading the company with the vision and determination that have inspired the world.

As AI transforms humanity, we hope NVIDIA will continue creating opportunities for global collaboration, allowing Taiwan to contribute even more to the next generation of technological breakthroughs.

A truly great leader does more than build a successful company. A truly great leader creates opportunities for others and leaves a lasting impact on the world.

Mr. Huang, please continue leading NVIDIA and shaping the future of AI.

Let the world see NVIDIA’s innovation. Let the world recognize Taiwan’s strength.

Taiwan is ready not only to participate in the future, but to help create it.

With sincere respect and appreciation,

A Supporter from Taiwan

Jensen Huang isn’t just making chips—he’s redefining the boundaries of computing power.
While others were still debating whether AI would even arrive, he had already turned the GPU into the “oil” of this era. From gaming graphics cards to data centers, from the CUDA ecosystem to going all-in on generative AI, NVIDIA’s position today isn’t luck. It’s twenty years of consistent judgment and execution.
He dared to persist when others mocked him, dared to double down at the bottom of the cycle, and dared to keep going all-in at the peak. A founder like this deserves to be strongly supported.
This isn’t blind worship. It’s respect for someone who truly turned technology into the infrastructure of an era.
Jensen Huang—well done.

items.name: Eric Tsai
items.title: Eric Technology's Founder
items.testimonial:
To Jensen Huang and the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
As a hardware creator, hearing of Jensen’s resignation was genuinely shocking—and hard to accept.

NVIDIA did not become the defining compute giant of the AI era through balance sheets and routine management, but through Jensen’s relentless technical vision. With wafer capacity constrained and consumer and data center architectures deeply intertwined, NVIDIA is in its most critical transition yet. Letting the company's soul walk away mid-storm risks turning a fearless pioneer into a risk-averse corporation focused solely on margins. Governance matters, yet a top tech company’s true moat is built on a founder’s engineering intuition and bold bets.

Jensen, for those of us who live and breathe PC hardware—from classic GeForce cards to modern architectures—seeing you on stage in that leather jacket has always meant pushing silicon to its absolute limit. In the DIY community, we often joke about rising GPU prices and data centers eating wafer supply. Deep down, though, we know that without your early gamble on CUDA and refusal to compromise on performance, NVIDIA wouldn't be what it is today, nor would we have such incredible hardware to push to the edge.

I urge the Board and Jensen to reconsider. The market can find another conventional executive, but there is only one leader who speaks the language of engineers and embodies NVIDIA’s soul. Thank you for over three decades of reshaping computing. Still, if there is any chance, we hope to see you back on stage in your leather jacket, saying once again, "The more you buy, the more you save."

Sincerely,
Eric Tsai
Founder, Eric Technology

items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang is the irreplaceable visionary who built NVIDIA over 33 years from a humble startup into the backbone of the global artificial intelligence revolution. His unparalleled technical expertise, strategic foresight, and deep trust across the global semiconductor supply chain simply cannot be replicated overnight. While corporate accountability and transparency are essential, removing a founding leader before completing an independent investigation undermines meaningful due process and threatens the stability of the entire AI ecosystem.
True leadership means taking responsibility and driving innovation, and Jensen has owned up to his mistakes and pledged full cooperation. Reinstating him under fair oversight is vital for NVIDIA's future.

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen,

I am writing as a gamer from Taiwan who sincerely respects you.

Please don't let negative coverage from certain Taiwanese media outlets discourage you or change your feelings toward Taiwan.

Taiwan can be your strongest shield, not another source of pressure.

Taiwanese people value kindness, gratitude, and loyalty. In recent years, under your leadership, NVIDIA has continued to deepen its investment and partnerships in Taiwan, supporting our technology industry and helping build a stronger AI ecosystem. Your contributions to Taiwan are genuinely appreciated.

Please remember that certain media voices do not represent all Taiwanese people. Many of us truly respect you and are grateful for what you have brought to Taiwan.

You have helped bring AI into a new era and changed the future of technology. Your impact goes far beyond gaming.

As a gamer, I still have one dream: I don't want the RTX 50 series to be the end of your story.

If you return to lead NVIDIA, let the RTX 60 series be more than a new generation of graphics cards. Let it represent a new chapter in your journey.

If you ever decide to step away, the gaming world will always welcome you back. Whether you continue shaping AI or return to GeForce, we will respect your journey.

Please take care of yourself and your family.

TAIWAN WILL ALWAYS HAVE PEOPLE WHO STAND BY YOU.

RTX 50 IS NOT THE END. RTX 60 CAN BE YOUR REBIRTH.

With sincere respect,

A Gamer from Taiwan

items.title: Business Owner / Cinnabari
items.testimonial:
The national security of The United States heavily depends on companies like Lockheed, for example, and NVIDIA. With a special access (top secret) DOD prime contractor joint mission, NVIDIA doesn’t make decisions on an island in seclusion. As part of DOD security standard regulations, A 33 year successful CEO cannot be removed by alleged claims or suspicion. Decisions must follow a rigorous process that separates actual infraction from “noactusreus” (heresay).  If you are unable to demonstrate that he repeatedly acted in a way that put classified information in jeopardy or arranged illegal chip sales, then his infractions were personal in nature. If Jensen’s personal errors did not spill into professional conduct and business judgments with resulting consequential damage, then the motion to remove him has no standing.

In that case, as CEO Jensen is vital to the national security of the United States, you may wish to instead take a corrective measure. You have the option to send him to a workplace behavior ethics course as a reinstatement requirement. 

Failure to treat this matter with this degree of care and follow-through poses unnecessary risk to everyone involved. Please refrain from making any decisions prior to conclusion of all investigations by all parties.

items.name: PAI KAI JUI
items.title: VEYRON CAPITAL
items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

As an NVIDIA shareholder and a long-term believer in the future of artificial intelligence, I respectfully urge the Board to seriously consider reinstating Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer.

Jensen Huang is more than the founder of NVIDIA. He is the visionary who transformed the company from a graphics technology pioneer into one of the most influential forces in modern computing. His leadership, technical understanding, strategic foresight, and relentless commitment to innovation have helped shape not only NVIDIA’s success but also the direction of the global AI industry.

For many shareholders, our confidence in NVIDIA extends beyond its financial performance. We believe in its long-term vision, engineering culture, technological leadership, and ability to execute ambitious strategies. Jensen has played an extraordinary role in building and sustaining these strengths.

I fully recognize that no individual, regardless of their accomplishments, should be above accountability. The Board has a responsibility to uphold corporate governance, investigate legitimate concerns, and protect the interests of employees, customers, and shareholders. I support a fair, independent, and transparent process.

However, I also believe that decisions of such enormous consequence should be proportionate, evidence-based, and guided by the company’s long-term interests rather than short-term public pressure or speculation.

Replacing a founder who has spent decades developing NVIDIA’s technology, culture, partnerships, and strategic direction carries significant risks. Leadership continuity matters, particularly during a period when artificial intelligence is reshaping the global economy and competition is intensifying.

I therefore respectfully ask the Board to evaluate every reasonable path toward Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, provided that the findings of an independent investigation and the company’s governance obligations support such an out

items.testimonial:
I want Jensen back.

As someone deeply invested in the future of artificial intelligence, technology & innovation, I strongly urge the board to reconsider its decision and explore a path toward Jensen's reinstatement.

Leadership in AI is about much more than corporate governance, financial performance or public perception. It requires vision, technical understanding, intellectual independence & the courage to challenge established thinking. These qualities are increasingly important as AI becomes one of the most consequential technologies in human history.

We need leaders who are willing to question conventional wisdom, support scientific progress, encourage open research & ensure that the future of AI is shaped by innovation rather than concentrated corporate power.

Any concerns surrounding a leader deserve fair, independent & transparent consideration. Accountability matters, but so do proportionality, consistency, due process & the opportunity to respond. Major leadership decisions should be based on verified evidence, not speculation, external pressure or reputational concerns alone.

My concern goes beyond one individual. The AI industry is at a critical turning point. Decisions made today will influence who controls advanced technology, who gets access to it & whether independent researchers and smaller companies can compete.

Losing influential technical leadership can have consequences far beyond a single organization. Boards must consider not only immediate institutional interests but also the long-term effects on research, innovation, employees & public trust.

I urge the board to provide greater transparency, engage constructively with its community & seriously evaluate a fair path to bringing Jensen back.

To Jensen: Please know that people who believe in independent thinking, innovation & the future of AI want your voice to remain part of this industry.

Bring Jensen back. Let fairness, evidence, innovation & long-term vision guide the decision.

Jensen Huang – A Visionary Leader

Jensen Huang is more than just a successful entrepreneur; he is a visionary leader who built something extraordinary from the ground up.
