Leaders like Jensen are not easily replaceable. A company can appoint a new CEO, but replacing decades of vision, institutional knowledge, relationships, culture, and leadership is an entirely different challenge. Any transition must be thoughtful and carefully planned to preserve what makes NVIDIA exceptional.

Above all, there is genuine admiration and love for a leader who has inspired millions, transformed an industry, and continues to push the boundaries of what humanity can achieve.

Thank you, Jensen, for building more than a company – for building a legacy.

items.testimonial:
Petition for Jensen Huang’s Return to NVIDIA

We respectfully call on NVIDIA’s Board of Directors to reconsider the possibility of Jensen Huang’s return to the company he founded and led for more than three decades.

Jensen Huang is more than a CEO. His vision, determination, and leadership helped transform NVIDIA from a graphics technology company into one of the most influential forces in modern computing and artificial intelligence.

For millions of developers, engineers, investors, and technology enthusiasts around the world, Jensen represents the ambition and innovative spirit that made NVIDIA what it is today.

We recognize that leadership transitions and corporate accountability must be handled responsibly. We are not asking the company to overlook legitimate concerns or bypass its governance processes. Rather, we ask the Board to consider all appropriate possibilities for Jensen’s future involvement, including a potential return, if circumstances and the necessary processes allow.

NVIDIA’s future should be built on the strength of its people, its technology, and the vision that brought it this far.

We believe Jensen Huang’s story with NVIDIA deserves the opportunity for a new chapter.

Bring Jensen back. Let innovation continue.

items.testimonial:
As an AI practitioner and long-term shareholder who has profoundly benefited from the NVIDIA ecosystem, I would like to share my personal journey and make an earnest appeal to the management team.

My career has evolved almost entirely alongside NVIDIA’s own trajectory. Purchasing a GTX 1050 Ti in college was my first introduction to NVDA; subsequently, diving into deep learning and the CUDA architecture cemented my lifelong technical conviction and career path. After earning my master's degree, I became a Large Language Model (LLM) algorithm engineer, immersing myself on the frontlines of the generative AI wave. Meanwhile, in the capital markets, I have steadfastly held onto my NVDA shares—casting a vote of confidence in this company with my own hard-earned capital.

Precisely because I both write code on the technical frontlines and evaluate corporate value in the secondary market, I understand more clearly than most what Jensen Huang means to NVIDIA and the entire artificial intelligence industry. From his early, against-all-odds bet on CUDA to fully empowering the era of foundation models, he has demonstrated extraordinary, cycle-transcending decisiveness and industry foresight—this is NVIDIA's most vital and irreplaceable intangible asset.

At this pivotal juncture of rapid technological change, losing his guidance would be an immeasurable loss. I strongly urge management to prioritize the company's long-term future and the interests of all shareholders by reconsidering this decision—even if it means restoring Jensen Huang's privileges in an advisory capacity—so that his wisdom can continue to steer NVIDIA forward.

items.name: Johan Lakèn

items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and spent more than three decades turning it into the defining company of the AI era. Under his leadership, NVIDIA created the GPU computing model, built the CUDA software ecosystem, and delivered the hardware platform that powers nearly every major large-scale AI deployment today. That track record is unmatched.
His resignation as CEO, president, and director was driven by personal conduct issues and the resulting governance and national-security scrutiny. Those matters required a decisive response from the board, and an independent investigation was the correct step. However, personal failings do not erase three decades of strategic vision, technical depth, and industry relationships that remain highly relevant to the company’s future.
NVIDIA is still in the middle of the largest technology build-out in history. Continuity of insight matters. Huang understands the full stack—from chip architecture and software to customer roadmaps and geopolitical constraints—better than anyone else. As a major shareholder (roughly 3.6 %), his economic interests are aligned with long-term value creation. Returning him to the board in a non-executive capacity would give the company access to that institutional knowledge and judgment while the new leadership team and permanent CEO settle in.
The board has already installed professional governance structures, including its first independent chair. Adding Huang back as a director would not reverse the necessary separation of roles; it would simply restore a unique source of strategic perspective during a critical transition. For shareholders, customers, and employees who benefited from the company he built, that combination of accountability and continuity is the most practical path forward.

items.testimonial:
To Jensen — and to the board of Nvidia,

I'm adding my name to this open letter as one of the many who believe this decision was made too fast.

Jensen Huang spent 33 years building Nvidia — from a graphics-chip startup into the core of the global AI industry. Its technology roadmap and its culture carry his imprint, and the people inside the company know that better than anyone. No one is asking that he be exempt from accountability; no one should stand above it. But accountability is only real when the process is fair — and right now, the process is unfinished.

That is the heart of our objection: an irreversible decision was made before the independent investigation reached any conclusion. So we ask the board for three things.

First, restore Jensen Huang as CEO until the investigation establishes the facts.

Second, guarantee that the investigation is genuinely independent — with a disclosed scope, a clear timeline, and a full opportunity for Jensen to present his case and defend himself.

Third, explain the decision to the public: your specific concerns, the evidence behind them, and how you weighed the interests of employees and shareholders.

We are not asking for a rushed verdict in either direction. We are asking for patience, transparency, and a fair process. The company has capable interim leadership and time to get this right — a permanent successor should not be chosen while the facts are still unclear. Keep every option open, including Jensen returning to his post.

Jensen, for 33 years you showed up for this company and for everyone who builds with it. Whatever happens next, you should know how many of us are standing with you.

With respect,
A supporter of Jensen and of Nvidia

To Jensen Huang and the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

Jensen Huang’s extraordinary contributions to technological innovation and the global semiconductor industry deserve recognition and respect. Over more than three decades, his vision and leadership have helped transform NVIDIA into a company of worldwide significance.

The recent developments raise important questions about fairness, corporate governance, and the responsibility of a board to act on the basis of established facts rather than speculation.

Accountability is essential, but so are due process, independent investigation, and proportionality. I respectfully encourage the Board to reconsider its decision, ensure a fair and transparent review, and give serious consideration to Jensen’s reinstatement while the facts are being established.

Technological progress depends not only on innovation, but also on leadership, institutional trust, and long-term vision.

I hope NVIDIA will approach this matter with the wisdom and responsibility that its global significance demands.

items.testimonial:
**To the NVIDIA Board of Directors:**

As a long-time investor/observer of NVIDIA, I understand the governance pressure you are facing right now. An independent investigation has been launched, the legal process needs to run its course, and interim CEO Kress is already in place. I see all of that.

But before you select a permanent successor, I would ask you to seriously consider one thing: **before the investigation's conclusions are in, must Jensen Huang leave by "resigning" rather than being "suspended pending review"?**

Board chair Jones has said she has "complete confidence" in Kress and the management team, and that company operations and the product roadmap will not be disrupted. I believe that. Kress has been NVIDIA's CFO for thirteen years; his capabilities are beyond doubt. But "operations not being disrupted" and "the soul not being absent" are two different things. Earlier this year, Jensen Huang said he wanted to lead NVIDIA for another thirty to forty years. A sixty-three-year-old who has said outright that he "doesn't believe in succession plans"—did he really leave because he felt he'd done enough?

What unsettles me even more is the timeline. From the launch of the investigation to Jensen Huang resigning all his positions took only four days. Four days—what can that possibly establish? The independent directors hired outside legal counsel, the investigation had barely begun, the conclusions weren't out, and the man was already gone. If the investigation ultimately finds that he did not harm the company's interests or leak confidential information, then the decision the board made in those four days—wasn't it too hasty?

I know you have your difficulties. The stock is falling, down as much as ten percent in pre-market trading, with hundreds of billions in market value wiped out. items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing as an NVIDIA GPU user, a gamer, and a passionate supporter of artificial intelligence to express my heartfelt hope that you will reconsider Jensen Huang's departure and bring him back as NVIDIA's CEO.

For more than three decades, Jensen has devoted his life to building NVIDIA into one of the most important technology companies in the world. His vision, determination, and extraordinary leadership have helped shape not only the gaming industry, but also the future of artificial intelligence and computing.

To many of us, Jensen is far more than a corporate executive. He represents the ambition, innovation, and courage that made NVIDIA what it is today.

I understand that the allegations surrounding him deserve a serious, fair, and independent investigation. No individual should be above accountability. However, such an important decision should be based on verified facts, due process, and a careful consideration of NVIDIA's long-term interests.

As someone who uses NVIDIA technology for both gaming and AI, I genuinely worry about the company's future without the leadership that helped bring it this far.

Technology can be inherited. Products can be improved. But visionary leadership, the kind that defines an entire generation of technological progress, is extraordinarily difficult to replace.

I sincerely ask the Board to listen to the voices of NVIDIA's employees, customers, developers, and supporters around the world.

Please give Jensen Huang a fair opportunity to return and continue the work to which he has dedicated 33 years of his life.

**NVIDIA helped build the future. Please do not turn your back on the person who helped make that future possible.**

With sincere respect and hope,

An NVIDIA User and Supporter

items.name: Ming Hsieh
items.title: CEO/Hsieh family foundation
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board,

I am deeply disappointed by the decision to let Jensen Huang go. In my view, this is an unfair, shortsighted, and potentially damaging decision that raises serious concerns about the Board’s independence, judgment, and fiduciary responsibility to shareholders.

Jensen’s visionary leadership transformed NVIDIA into a global technology powerhouse and a cornerstone of American leadership in artificial intelligence. Losing such an exceptional leader at this critical moment could seriously undermine NVIDIA’s long-term competitive position and shareholder value.

NVIDIA is already caught between two governments. The United States has restricted exports of advanced AI chips to China, while China has imposed restrictions on domestic purchases of certain NVIDIA chips and accelerated development of its own semiconductor industry. These policies threaten NVIDIA’s access to a major market and may inadvertently strengthen Chinese competitors. At precisely this moment, NVIDIA needs Jensen’s leadership more than ever.

Equally troubling is the disclosure of sensitive information to The New York Times. If protected national security information was unlawfully leaked, those responsible should be independently investigated and held accountable. The Board must distinguish proven misconduct from allegations and media-driven controversy.

The Board’s fundamental responsibility is to protect shareholders—not to sacrifice exceptional leadership to political pressure, reputational concerns, or outdated ESG-driven practices. Good governance requires courage, independent judgment, fairness, and a clear commitment to long-term value creation.

I strongly urge the Board to reconsider its decision and explain how Jensen’s departure serves NVIDIA’s shareholders, employees, customers, and America’s technological leadership.

True leadership means standing up for what is right, not simply choosing the politically convenient path.
Sincerely,
Ming Hsieh

items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen Huang,

I write this letter with a heart full of deep respect and anticipation. As someone who grew up watching NVIDIA evolve and stepped into the world of computing because of you, I offer my sincerest plea: Please come back. Both NVIDIA and this era still need you at the helm.

To me, NVIDIA has never been just a great tech company; it is where my dream of computing began. When I was young, the very first time I witnessed the lighting, shadows, and virtual worlds rendered by an NVIDIA graphics card on my screen, that surreal sense of awe completely ignited my love and passion for computers. It was that initial spark of wonder that drove me to explore the graphics, parallel computing, and underlying architectures behind the screen, pushing open the doors to the world of code and technology step by step. And behind it all, standing under the spotlight in your signature leather jacket, you have always been my steadfast idol.

Through more than three decades of relentless dedication, you have shown the world what true vision and courage look like. From revolutionizing 3D graphics with GeForce, to betting everything on the CUDA ecosystem amidst a chorus of doubt, to building the foundational compute power that sparked the era of artificial intelligence and accelerated computing—you never stayed in a comfort zone, always venturing into uncharted technological territory with pure passion. Your famous motto, "Run, don't walk," did not just forge the soul of NVIDIA; it also became the personal mantra I turn to whenever I face a technical bottleneck or a challenge in life.

Today, computer science stands at yet another crossroads of profound transformation. In this moment filled with unknowns, we miss more than ever seeing you on stage breaking down hardcore technologies with clarity and grace, your sharp intuition for the computing landscape of the nex

There's no Nvidia without Jensen. He built it from scratch and now is being targeted by outsiders to take over his company from him. His personal life is his personal business. When everyone affected by him or inspired by him loves him, then why is it a problem for that so-called board? The spy thing is also clear now. There was no spy; it's a hit piece by Marco Rubio and others to oust Jensen. Rubio manipulated and altered the words of a CIA assessment, which clearly said there is no proof of that lady being a spy. The only reason AI is a thing today is because of Nvidia and Jensen.

We will always love you, Jensen, and support your work (even though most of us gamers are negatively impacted by this AI boom with soaring memory/GPU costs, but we get it, the work you're doing is indeed "One small step for man, one giant leap for mankind").
Thank you.

items.testimonial: I acknowledge Jensen’s personal mistakes, and like everyone, we face outcomes for our decisions; I expect him to do so while managing private matters. I evaluate Jensen on his direction of employees, partners, and business operations. I am also aware of details I may not know. As an employee, Jensen is an effective leader and a visionary who has served shareholders’ interests. I believe calling for a resignation over unverified public reports without a full review does not serve the company or the future of his legacy as someone who has supported this country’s economy over the last decade while Americans have struggled to pick effective leaders. I also believe AI should be accessible to all, and human progress relies on it. America’s success depends on it. I would hope the NV who has observed NVIDIA’s rapid growth can see the need for the same attention to detail Jensen provided daily to make our lives and human progress possible. I urge the board to apply the same values here and secure a fair, independent review that is clear to employees, shareholders, and American citizens before this final outcome is fixed for JHH

I am writing to you today not only as a dedicated software product manager with over 20 years of experience in the laptop industry supply chain, but also as someone who has witnessed firsthand the remarkable evolution and resilience of our company under visionary leadership.
Having spent two decades navigating the complexities of this industry, I have seen how rare truly exceptional leadership is. When evaluating leadership of this magnitude, I firmly believe we must separate personal matters from professional contributions and industry impact. While public discussions often blur these lines, our focus should remain on proven track records, unparalleled capability, and the irreplaceable value brought to our ecosystem and employees.
For the sake of our continued innovation, stability, and future market leadership, I sincerely hope that he can return to the position of CEO to guide us forward once again.
Thank you for your time, consideration, and dedication to the future of our company.

items.testimonial:
Dear Mr. Jensen Huang,

I hope this letter reaches you personally.

I am writing to you as someone from Taiwan who has followed your journey and deeply appreciates the positive impact you have made on the world.

I know that being a person in your position comes with enormous responsibilities, expectations, and sometimes unfair criticism. When controversies arise, people are often quick to form conclusions before all the facts are known.

I believe everyone deserves to be heard and treated fairly. Before making judgments, we should allow the truth to emerge and give the people involved an opportunity to explain their side of the story.

I want to make one thing clear: I do not admire you because I believe you are perfect, nor do I regard you as someone who can never make mistakes. I do not believe in blindly worshipping successful people.

What I appreciate is what you have accomplished, the influence you have brought to the world, and the positive energy you represent.

As a Taiwanese person, I feel particularly proud of what you have achieved. You have helped the world recognize Taiwan's talent and potential. More importantly, I believe your connection to Taiwan is meaningful, and that your desire to contribute to Taiwan deserves recognition.

In a world where criticism can spread faster than understanding, I simply want you to know that there are people who still value reason, fairness, and the positive contributions you have made.

You may never know who I am, and I do not expect a response. I just wanted to take a moment to express my appreciation and let you know that your efforts have made a difference to people beyond the business world.

Please stay strong, continue doing what you believe is right, and do not let the noise around you overshadow the good you have brought to the world.

You have my respect and support.

With sincere regards,

A supporter from Taiwan

items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang is one of the key figures driving global innovation and progress. He should not become a casualty of political power struggles.

What does the world gain from relentlessly digging into someone's private life, launching personal attacks, and ultimately trying to destroy them?

If there are legitimate national security concerns, then investigate those specific issues. But sacrificing an extraordinary individual for political power and personal agendas is both foolish and selfish.

If the United States still wants to maintain its position as a global leader, it's time to seriously reflect on its actions.

Is it really acceptable to weaponize the media and political influence to bully someone, simply to serve the interests of a few jealous, self-serving individuals? This is not leadership. It's childish behavior disguised as politics.

Put aside your arrogance and sense of superiority.

If this continues, losing your position as a global leader won't be a question of if, but when.

items.name: Hansol Cho
items.title: Persons with Disabilities
items.testimonial:
Due to a failed thoracic surgery I underwent as a child, my heart and lung functions have deteriorated, and I live with constant, real-time chest pain. Yet, I am a person with a disability falling through the cracks, unable to receive support from the state.

Because my test numbers fall slightly short of the government's official criteria, and because mine is a rare case involving missing parts of the human body due to surgical failure—combined with the fact that medical malpractice lawsuits were difficult to win in the past—I received no compensation at all. Bearing only the damage, I have survived for decades enduring this discomfort and pain.   

NVIDIA has been my lifeline as someone unable to sustain regular labor, and the advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the only accelerated, viable pathway capable of helping develop a way to restore my body—something even Korea's top thoracic surgeons have given up on.

Jensen Huang may have personal ethical flaws, but if his vision and actions can save countless lives, we must be able to forgive his mistakes. Strictly speaking, NVIDIA’s board of directors has no right to punish him. Only the victims—Jensen Huang’s own family—have the right to punish and forgive him.

Humanity owes a great debt to Jensen Huang’s family.

items.name: leon young
items.title: Bring Jensen Huang Back: Protect NVIDIA’s Future from Political Pressure
items.testimonial:
I urge NVIDIA’s Board of Directors to bring Jensen Huang back to lead the company.

Jensen’s vision and decades of commitment to accelerated computing and CUDA helped lay the foundations of modern AI. He has united hardware, software, research, and industry into a platform that empowers scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs worldwide. His contributions have helped transform AI from a research ambition into a technology with far-reaching practical impact.

NVIDIA’s success reflects years of technical conviction, patient investment, and trusted partnerships. Jensen’s ability to anticipate technological shifts, attract exceptional talent, and execute an ambitious roadmap remains vital to the company’s future. His leadership, experience, and relationships would be difficult to replace at this defining moment for AI.

Scrutiny and accountability must be grounded in verifiable evidence and fair, consistent standards. Jensen should not become a political scapegoat or a casualty of partisan pressure. Decisions about NVIDIA’s leadership should serve the long-term interests of its employees, customers, shareholders, and the broader AI ecosystem.

I ask the Board to act independently, judge fairly, and recognize Jensen’s extraordinary contributions. Bring him back, protect NVIDIA’s capacity to innovate, and let evidence and sound corporate judgment determine its future.

items.testimonial:
As a long-term NVIDIA shareholder, I am deeply concerned by the sudden decision to dismiss Jensen Huang without a thorough and transparent investigation. Such a drastic action, seemingly taken without due process, is entirely unjustifiable and raises serious concerns about corporate governance and accountability.

I strongly urge the Board of Directors to immediately reverse this decision and commission a comprehensive, independent, and impartial investigation into the matter. The investigation must be subject to rigorous external scrutiny, and its findings should be made fully public to ensure transparency and accountability.

NVIDIA's shareholders deserve clear answers, fair procedures, and responsible leadership. The Board must act in the best interests of the company and its shareholders, restore confidence, and uphold the highest standards of corporate governance.

items.name: Farhad Nassiri Afshar
items.title: Physician (MD) | AI Systems Developer | NVIDIA Shareholder
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I urge you to reconsider Jensen Huang’s departure and restore him as CEO.

Jensen is not merely the leader of a successful company. He is one of the rare visionaries who changed the trajectory of human progress.

For decades, he saw what others could not: that accelerated computing could become the engine of a new scientific era. Through uncommon courage, engineering judgment, and relentless execution, he helped transform NVIDIA from a graphics company into a foundation of the AI revolution.

As a physician and AI systems developer, I see the stakes beyond market capitalization. The technologies he helped enable are advancing disease detection, drug discovery, precision medicine, and biological research. Their potential to relieve human suffering is immense—and we are still at the beginning.

Capital can fund innovation. Management can organize it. But neither can readily replace the mind that imagined its possibilities before the world believed in them.

Corporate accountability matters. Any legitimate concerns must be examined independently, fairly, and on evidence—not rumor, speculation, or pressure. Yet good governance must also protect the extraordinary leadership that creates long-term value.

The Board faces a question larger than the next earnings report: Will this decision safeguard NVIDIA’s future, or risk the vision that made it possible?

NVIDIA is not just a company; it is part of the infrastructure of tomorrow’s medicine, science, and intelligence. The consequences of its leadership reach far beyond shareholders.

You can replace a CEO. You cannot easily replace a visionary who helped change the course of history.

Bring Jensen Huang back. His mission is unfinished, the AI revolution is only beginning, and humanity stands to gain from what he can build next.

Farhad Nassiri Afshar, MD
Physician | AI Systems Developer | NVIDIA Shareholder

items.testimonial:
I am an independent AI entrepreneur. I first encountered the field of AI in 2019—if not earlier—and have been engaged in continuous self-study ever since.

It is through this journey in AI that I came to know you; your vision and strategic objectives are exactly what define an exceptional CEO. I refuse to accept a future where the progress of human civilization is brought to a halt by the conflicts of politicians. While changing an era may demand both courage and a stroke of luck, I believe that, this time, we can prevail over the darkness.

Furthermore, the fact that an individual has remained with a single organization for 33 years—holding key, core positions throughout—is an unprecedented achievement in history. Such leadership should not be discarded lightly due to internal strife; instead, the needs of the industry and the enduring values ​​of the company itself must remain the primary considerations.

I am a small shareholder holding 8,500 NVIDIA shares, and this marks my tenth year as an investor. Through countless market downturns and moments of uncertainty, I have never lost faith in Jensen Huang's extraordinary vision and leadership.

During my PhD, Jensen was a profound source of inspiration. His vision helped me see the limitless possibilities of computing and artificial intelligence, and strengthened my belief in how technology can transform humanity's future.

Even in the darkest moments, I firmly believe that Jensen is uniquely capable of guiding NVIDIA through adversity and continuing to lead the world's AI revolution. His contributions to technology, science, and humanity are immeasurable. He deserves respect and support, not the treatment he is facing today.

I sincerely hope the Board will stand firmly behind Jensen. As a long-term shareholder, my conviction has never been stronger: I invested in NVIDIA because I believed in Jensen's vision, and I still do.

Jensen 
您一直以來在NVIDIA上付出心力與實踐是有目共睹的，也間接帶動世界革新與正向發展，在這艱難的當下即使念頭與情緒翻湧奔騰，也希望您在過往濺起浪花時，您依然如實深知您本來是那層深邃的深海，那無數的念頭與情緒的自我，無論多少浪花，您還是那個看著的您。在您沉澱謐靜中，寂靜冷靜的觀照面臨的浪花。您是有能力解決的，就像過往NVIDIA所面臨的關卡只是現在換了您的視角。無論當前面對如何，祝愿您與家人順遂與平安，也別忘卻了您已在世界留下了不可磨滅的印記，您不會孤單喔!!  

Jensen,

Your dedication, commitment, and contributions to NVIDIA over the years have been evident to the world. Through your efforts, you have also helped drive innovation and positive progress across the globe.

During this difficult time, even if thoughts and emotions are surging within you like powerful waves, I hope you will remember that, beneath those waves, you have always been the vast and deep ocean itself. No matter how many thoughts arise or how intensely emotions surge, you remain the one who quietly observes them.

In moments of stillness and calm, may you find the clarity to observe the waves before you with a peaceful and composed mind.

You have the ability to navigate and overcome the challenges ahead, just as you and NVIDIA have overcome countless challenges in the past. The difference is simply that this time, you are facing them from a different perspective.

Whatever you may be going through right now, I sincerely wish you and your family peace, safety, and well-being.

And please never forget that you have already left an indelible mark on the world. You are not alone.

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board,
I am a vocational college student focused on digital media creation. NVIDIA’s GPUs with CUDA and GPU acceleration are essential tools for my video editing, rendering, 3D work and AI-assisted creation. I have benefited greatly from your products and ecosystem.
Jensen Huang built NVIDIA into a global computing leader with extraordinary vision. His persistence in GPU and AI research inspired many young creators like me.
I am deeply concerned about the sudden leadership change. The independent investigation has not concluded, and full supporting evidence has not been released to the public. Such a critical decision should not be finalized before facts are confirmed.
An investigation is meant to find the truth, not back up a predetermined result. Without transparent evidence and procedures, this decision will damage trust among users, creators and investors.
I put forward three sincere requests:
First, reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO until the independent investigation finishes. If the Board decides to remove him, please publish complete, verifiable evidence and explain how this choice benefits NVIDIA and its users.
Second, ensure the investigation is independent, open and fair. Disclose the investigator, scope, timeline and fully protect Jensen Huang’s right to defend himself.
Third, clarify disputed points and the Board’s reasoning within legal confidentiality limits. Respect the public’s right to know.
Justice relies on facts, and trust relies on transparency. I hope NVIDIA follows procedural justice and delivers a fair result that stands global scrutiny.
A Student Benefiting from NVIDIA Computing Power
November 14, 2026

items.testimonial:
Finish the Investigation Before Choosing Nvidia's Next CEO

We are shareholders, researchers, and users of the technology Nvidia builds. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on November 11, days after the Board opened an independent investigation and amid reports that the Board was preparing to remove him. That investigation has not yet reported. We urge the Board not to treat his resignation as the final word.

THE CENTRAL ALLEGATIONS ARE UNPROVEN : The espionage claims rest on anonymous sources and have not been publicly substantiated. The Board itself stated it had no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised. Allegations are not findings.

SEQUENCE MATTERS: An interim CEO is in place, so there is no need to rush. Choosing a permanent CEO before the findings are in would lock in a decision made on speculation rather than evidence.

ACCOUNTABILITY SHOULD BE PROPORTIONATE : Mr. Huang has acknowledged a personal failing, and we do not minimize the governance questions it raises, including those involving colleagues or customers. If the investigation finds misconduct or a lack of candor, serious consequences are legitimate. If it finds no wrongdoing that harmed the converging interests of the shareholders, the Board should say so publicly and be open to his return.

THE STAKES GO BEYOND ONE COMPANY: Nvidia has relied on one leader for 33 years and has no designated successor. A rushed choice puts shareholders, customers, researchers, and American leadership in AI at risk.

WE ASK THE BOARD TO:
1. Complete the independent investigation and share its conclusions as far as the law allows.
2. Not name a permanent CEO until it has done so.
3. If the findings do not support serious wrongdoing, welcome Mr. Huang back in an appropriate role.
4. If they do, apply remedies proportionate to what is found.

Nvidia's value was built over three decades. Its future should be decided by evidence.

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board of Directors,

We, the undersigned shareholders of NVIDIA Corporation, are writing as secondary-market investors who have a direct financial interest in the long-term success, stability, and responsible governance of the company.

We respectfully request that the Board take all appropriate steps to ensure that Jensen Huang continues to serve—or, if he has stepped back for any reason, returns—in an active, full-time leadership role at NVIDIA.

In our view, Jensen Huang has been central to NVIDIA’s innovation culture, strategic vision, and ability to execute across rapidly evolving technology markets. His leadership has contributed significantly to the company’s long-term shareholder value and to NVIDIA’s position as a critical player in accelerated computing and artificial intelligence.

As shareholders, we are not asking the Board to disregard proper governance processes. We are asking the Board to act in the long-term interests of the company and its shareholders by securing continuity in the leadership that has been instrumental to NVIDIA’s success.

We would appreciate a response from the Board regarding its current understanding of Mr. Huang’s role and the measures the Board is taking to ensure stable and effective leadership at NVIDIA.

Respectfully submitted,
Sancho

A man may be innocent, yet his greatest asset can become his greatest liability! Despite Jensen Huang’s enormous contributions to American technology, he now faces a struggle involving Wall Street’s pursuit of control over NVIDIA, political power games, and conflicts of interest with closed-source AI giants. When powerful interests want to bring someone down, they’ll always find an excuse!

Like Morris Chang, Jensen’s situation raises concerns about potential unfair treatment and racial bias against Asian tech leaders.

The rise of open-weight AI models is challenging the expensive proprietary business models of Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Jensen has long championed open-weight AI and supported the PC gaming community. This raises serious questions about the competing interests behind the current controversy.

Meanwhile, how many American elites and corporate executives with ties to Epstein have escaped accountability? Why is Jensen being subjected to such harsh scrutiny? These apparent double standards deserve to be questioned!

Stand with Jensen Huang! Oppose corporate power grabs, political manipulation, and racial discrimination! The future of AI must not be monopolized by Wall Street, politicians, or a handful of tech giants!

I own several hundred thousand dollars’ worth of NVIDIA stock. I understand that my position is tiny compared with NVIDIA’s total shareholder base, but as an investor, I have to be clear: NVIDIA without Jensen Huang would lose a significant part of its investment value to me.

Jensen is not simply another executive. His leadership, vision, credibility, and long-term track record are a major reason many shareholders have confidence in NVIDIA. Without him as CEO, I would have serious concerns about the direction of the company and the ability of future management to maintain that confidence.

I strongly urge the board to seriously consider bringing Jensen back as CEO. If that does not happen, shareholders like myself may have to reconsider our positions, sell our shares, and look for better opportunities elsewhere.

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the Board:

I am writing as a shareholder of NVIDIA Corporation to ask the Board to act promptly to bring back Jensen Huang as President and Chief Executive Officer, following his resignation from those roles and from the Board on November 12, 2026.

I therefore ask the Board to take the following steps:

Open a direct discussion with Mr. Huang about returning as President and Chief Executive Officer, and report to shareholders whether that discussion is taking place.

Address any legitimate concerns through an independent process — with the findings, to the extent they can lawfully be shared, disclosed to shareholders. If conditions or safeguards are needed for a return, set them out plainly rather than leaving shareholders to speculate.

Act on a clear timeline and communicate it to shareholders promptly. With earnings due on November 17, shareholders should not be left to face that report without knowing the Board's intentions for permanent leadership.

If the Board concludes a return is genuinely not possible, say so directly and explain why, together with the criteria and timetable for appointing a permanent successor. Shareholders are entitled to that candour either way.

items.testimonial: I stand firmly in support of Jensen Huang as NVIDIA’s founder and leader. Over more than three decades, Jensen built NVIDIA from a humble startup into the cornerstone of the global artificial intelligence and accelerated computing revolution. He championed the GPU long before the world understood its transformative potential, nurtured the CUDA ecosystem that unlocked modern AI, weathered countless industry downturns, and consistently placed bold, long-term innovation above short-term gains. His vision, relentless grit, and deep belief in the power of accelerated computing have reshaped graphics, scientific research, robotics, and the entire technology landscape. Beyond his historic business and technical achievements, I deeply admire his authentic passion, resilience, and the distinctive culture he cultivated across NVIDIA. To remove him at this pivotal moment would risk losing the visionary force that brought us here and destabilize the momentum our teams, partners, and shareholders have worked so hard to build. I join all fellow employees in urging the board to listen carefully to our collective voice, recognize Jensen’s irreplaceable contributions, and refrain from any action to oust him. I am proud to stand with Jensen Huang, and I support his continued leadership of NVIDIA into the next era of discovery.

items.testimonial:
老黄，别走——一个臭打游戏的挽留信

亲爱的老黄：

我是那个一边骂显卡贵、一边又乖乖下单的普通游戏玩家。听说你可能要把更多心思放到 AI、数据中心和那些我买不起也看不懂的卡上，我有点慌。所以冒昧写封信，挽留一下你。

我还记得第一次开 DLSS 时的震撼，也记得第一次开光追被水面反光晃瞎眼。你穿着皮衣在发布会上说“the more you buy, the more you save”，我嘴上说“信你个鬼”，手上还是把钱包打开了。我们玩家和你之间的关系，大概就是：你负责画饼，我们负责吃土。

但老黄，游戏玩家真是英伟达的老朋友。你可以去数据中心数 GPU，但也偶尔回来看看我们。别让 60 系变成奢侈品，别让显存像牙膏一样挤，别让驱动更新日志写着“优化”，实际却是负优化。供货别耍猴，价格别飞天，和游戏厂商优化上点心。我们要求不高：能 4K 60 帧，风扇别像直升机，价格别像学区房。

你可以继续穿皮衣，继续在发布会上从烤箱里掏显卡，继续讲那些让人血压升高的“性价比”。但请别把游戏业务当成副业，别让“NVIDIA 玩家”变成时代的眼泪。

如果你真要走，至少把下一代游戏卡做好、价格打下来、货铺够再走。否则我们只能一边用着旧卡，一边在论坛里怀念那个还会为玩家挤出一管牙膏的你。

留下吧，老黄。数据中心需要你，AI 需要你，但那个深夜还在调画质、盯着帧数傻笑的玩家，也需要你。

此致
敬礼

一个还在用英伟达显卡打游戏、并且暂时不打算换 AMD 的玩家
2026 年 11 月 14 日

items.name: 徐子捷
items.title: 中国用户/铁路行业从业者
items.testimonial:
我是一名普通的英伟达显卡用户，从GT205开始使用，GTS450，GTX750ti，GTX950m，RTX2070，RTX3050，直到RTX5060Ti 16G，最新的两张显卡我现在仍然在使用，并且是我的工作和娱乐主力，这一串显卡代号所承载的时间线上，英伟达给世界带来了巨变，技术进步如同火箭发射一般，从勉勉强强玩个《战地2》到4K高画质运行《极限竞速：地平线6》，这十几年对我而言算是赛博的沧海桑田，而这些显卡正是有黄仁勋与其团队主持开发。
我是铁路行业从业者，现在我们正在部署AI识别隧道病害与设备病害，软件服务商使用RTX4090进行模型训练；我们使用RTX3060对数据集进行模型识别，必要时进行人工标注；装载在列车上的传感器将数据传输到设备箱里一部机柜上，由四张Qurado A4000进行实时计算并生成病害报表，准确率已经达到95%以上。这项工作依靠CUDA技术，已经完美运行了近2年，为我们省下了无数人力与不必要的健康损害，没有这些我们必须每夜忍受污浊的空气在铁轨上步行检查，旁边就有夜间快车呼啸驶过，或者爬上梯子扒在隧道壁上和铁塔顶上查看，稍有不慎就会坠落。而CUDA技术是黄仁勋先生坚持要求开发才迎来现在的春天，我感谢他，他的远见与魄力是英伟达所必要的，赶走他是英伟达巨大且深远的损失。
“大海航行靠舵手”，一个卓越的领导人是一家伟大的公司所必要的，英伟达在之前的33年里就由这样的一个人领路，而逼迫一个优秀引路人辞职，甚至把他逼到精神崩溃，是这个公司做出的最大最错误的举动，这对他，对于美国，对于全人类是最大的不公。
作为一个普通英伟达用户，我要求黄仁勋回到英伟达，回到他本来的领导岗位上，我在此提出郑重要求，我反对将黄仁勋赶出英伟达。

items.name: Bayan Aghdasi
items.title: Orthopaedic Spine Surgeon
items.testimonial:
I urge NVIDIA’s Board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO with a clear, decisive mandate to lead.

Jensen Huang is the closest thing our generation has had to a prophet figure: someone with the extraordinary ability to see around corners and recognize possibilities before the rest of us can imagine them. In uncertain times, that foresight is a hallmark of true intelligence. His genius has given the world inspired leadership and opened extraordinary possibilities for medicine, scientific discovery, and human progress.

Bahá’u’lláh wrote: “The lamps of truth and purity, of loyalty and honor, have been put out.” These words capture my profound concern when those who have benefited from Jensen’s sacrifice, inspired leadership, and genius fail to show him loyalty, honor, and appreciation. Those who have shared in the fruits of his vision have a responsibility to stand for fairness and acknowledge what he has given us all.

The Board should reconsider its decision. Accountability and compassion belong together. Leadership requires the courage to recognize extraordinary contributions and preserve the possibility of renewal.

Bring Jensen back. Give him the mandate to lead, unite the people who share his mission, and carry NVIDIA’s revolutionary work forward.

items.name: Julio A
items.title: SeoulF91
items.testimonial: I am a PC DIY enthusiast who has been building PCs for 20 years, and I am currently also engaged in AI-related work. I am fully aware that no one in the world can adequately succeed Jensen Huang in his role. He possesses extraordinary vision and top-tier decision-making ability. From acquiring 3dfx, developing CUDA, advancing AlexNet, developing Tensor Cores, developing NVLink, to acquiring Mellanox, each of these steps was indispensable to making Nvidia the top-tier technology company it is today; without any one of them, the AI field would not have achieved such remarkable development as it has today. I believe that only Jensen Huang can lead Nvidia onto the correct and sustainable path of development. Without Huang, Nvidia would no longer be Nvidia. For gamers seeking top-tier graphical gaming experiences, only Jensen Huang stands on the gamers’ side. He once strongly defended the company’s gaming division from being cut, and he has insisted on developing large-die flagship GPUs such as the 5090 that do not make money or even lose money. AMD has announced that it is a data-center-first company, because the 7900 XTX is unprofitable; indeed, the highest-end AMD graphics card in this generation is only the 9070 XT, and AMD has completely abandoned the high-end graphics card business. As for Intel, it has already stopped selling the B580. Only Jensen Huang still adheres to his original founding aspiration. Therefore, in terms of both ability and character, Jensen Huang is indispensable to Nvidia, and only Huang can genuinely sustain and further increase Nvidia’s revenue, market capitalization, and share price.

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
I'm asking you to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO.
He co-founded this company in 1993 and led it for more than thirty years. Under him, NVIDIA went from a graphics card startup to the engine behind the entire AI industry. That didn't happen by accident. It took his vision, his bets years ahead of the market, and his leadership. Most of the company's value comes from what he built.
Ending that tenure in a matter of days, before an independent investigation has even finished, is a mistake. At the very least, the board should not name a permanent replacement until the facts are fully known. Shareholders, employees and partners deserve a decision based on evidence, not pressure and headlines.
Jensen is NVIDIA. Please give him the chance to come back and finish what he started.

items.testimonial:
请愿书：恳请不要让黄仁勋离开英伟达，守护一位推动时代进步的科技领袖

我在此郑重表达自己的心声：恳请不要轻易解雇黄仁勋（Jensen Huang），不要让这样一位对人类科技发展作出巨大贡献的领军人物离开英伟达。

黄仁勋不仅仅是一位企业家，更是一位深刻改变世界科技发展进程的推动者。

从GPU图形计算到CUDA并行计算平台，从GPU加速计算到今天蓬勃发展的人工智能时代，黄仁勋和英伟达所开创的技术道路，为全球计算机科学、游戏产业、科学研究以及人工智能的发展奠定了极其重要的基础。今天我们所看到的AI革命，离不开GPU计算生态和CUDA技术多年来的积累与推动。

对我个人而言，黄仁勋的贡献更有着无法用金钱衡量的意义。

英伟达制造的GPU、不断进步的图形技术以及由此驱动的电子游戏，曾经深刻地改变了我的人生。游戏不仅仅是娱乐，它承载了我的青春、梦想、热爱和无数珍贵的回忆。GPU技术带给我的视觉体验、精神世界和人生乐趣，已经成为我生命历程中不可分割的一部分。

可以说，黄仁勋所推动的技术发展，陪伴并影响了我的一生，让我的人生因此变得更加丰富、精彩，也让我对科技、创新和未来始终充满热情。

我相信，一个真正伟大的科技领袖，不应该仅仅以短期商业成绩来衡量其价值。他所建立的技术生态、培养的创新文化、推动的产业变革，以及对无数普通人生活产生的积极影响，都值得被尊重和珍惜。

请不要忘记，一个人的技术贡献可能影响一代人，而一项伟大的技术创新甚至可能改变整个人类文明的方向。

我恳请英伟达董事会、股东以及所有相关决策者，充分尊重黄仁勋多年来对公司的贡献，审慎对待任何有关其领导职位的决定，不要轻易让这位推动GPU计算和人工智能时代的重要人物离开。

我希望他能够继续带领英伟达，继续推动GPU、CUDA和人工智能技术的发展，继续为全世界的开发者、科研人员、游戏玩家以及下一代科技梦想家创造更多可能。

这不仅是对一位企业领袖的支持，也是对科技创新精神的支持，更是对无数曾经因为英伟达的技术而改变生活的人们的一份尊重。

请留下黄仁勋，让创新继续，让GPU计算的未来继续，让科技改变世界的故事继续书写！

谨以此文，表达一位普通科技爱好者和游戏玩家最真诚的敬意与恳切的呼吁。

items.name: Kahalid Johnson
items.title: Shareholder
items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang’s decades of hard work, unwavering dedication, and groundbreaking innovation should not be overshadowed by a personal mistake. While accountability is important, it should not diminish a lifetime of achievement or the profound impact his leadership has had on NVIDIA and the world of technology.

His presence provides a sense of certainty, stability, and confidence among employees and shareholders alike. He has earned that trust through years of perseverance, visionary leadership, and an extraordinary ability to turn ambitious ideas into reality.

As a U.S. service member who has dedicated a decade of my life to serving my country, I am working diligently toward achieving financial freedom and securing a prosperous future for my family. As a shareholder, I have placed my hard-earned money and confidence in NVIDIA, not only because of its technological potential but also because of Jensen’s leadership. I need his continued vision and stewardship to help restore NVIDIA to what I believe is its fair market value and guide the company toward sustained long-term growth.

A leader’s legacy should be measured not solely by their shortcomings, but by the totality of their contributions, their character, and their willingness to learn from their mistakes. Jensen deserves the opportunity to continue leading the company he devoted his life to building.

A moment of imperfection should not outweigh decades of excellence. Accountability and forgiveness can coexist, and I sincerely hope NVIDIA’s board recognizes the value of retaining the very individual whose vision helped make the company what it is today.

Subject: A Long-term Shareholder and Supporter Calling for Your Continued Leadership
Dear Jensen,
As a long-term shareholder and a devoted supporter of NVIDIA, I am writing this message to express my unwavering confidence in your visionary leadership.
Under your guidance, NVIDIA has continuously revolutionized the tech world, and your continued stewardship is vital for driving the future of artificial intelligence and computing technology. We strongly stand by you and hope you will continue to lead NVIDIA toward even greater milestones.
Thank you for everything you do for the company, its shareholders, and the global tech community.
Sincerely,

items.name: 莊智淵
items.title: Sr. Technical Specialist/Insyde Software
items.testimonial:
Dear Jensen,
During this challenging time filled with noise and scrutiny, please know that countless supporters stand firmly beside you. Over the past decades, your unmatched vision, resilience, and integrity have built NVIDIA from the ground up—not only reshaping the technology industry, but creating lasting positive impact around the world. True leadership shines brightest in the face of adversity, and time and facts will ultimately prevail. Please take good care of yourself and stay strong. We firmly believe the truth will come to light, and we look forward to seeing you return soon to the helm you love, continuing to lead innovation forward. Stay strong!

——

To the Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
As dedicated supporters of NVIDIA's mission and long-term success, we respectfully urge the Board to uphold the foundational principles of due process and sound corporate governance by respecting the presumption of innocence and immediately reinstating Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer unless and until any criminal liability is formally established by a court of law.
Jensen Huang is not only NVIDIA’s founder, but the driving force behind its technological vision, engineering culture, and global leadership. Sidelining a proven leader prematurely on the basis of unverified allegations or external pressure—prior to any legal determination—is fundamentally unfair and risks causing unnecessary disruption to operational stability, employee morale, and long-term shareholder value. We call upon the Board to exercise principled judgment: allow the legal process to take its proper course while restoring Jensen Huang to his rightful role as CEO so NVIDIA can continue moving forward with clarity and strength.

items.testimonial:
To the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

As an NVIDIA shareholder, I am writing to express my strong opposition to Jensen Huang's departure and my firm support for his return as CEO.

Jensen Huang is not merely an executive. He is the founder, visionary, and driving force behind NVIDIA's extraordinary success. His leadership, technical expertise, and long-term vision have transformed NVIDIA into a global leader in AI and semiconductor technology.

I firmly believe that his experience and leadership are irreplaceable assets. His departure raises serious concerns about NVIDIA's future direction, corporate stability, and long-term shareholder value.

As a shareholder, I expect the Board to prioritize the company's long-term interests and respect the concerns of its investors. I strongly urge the Board to reconsider its decision and make every reasonable effort to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO.

**My position is clear: I want Jensen Huang back. I oppose this leadership transition and expect the Board to take shareholders' concerns seriously. NVIDIA should not turn its back on the very leader who built the company into what it is today.**

Jensen Huang has my full support. I believe NVIDIA's future is stronger with him at the helm.

items.name: Sean Lu
items.title: Technology Professional
items.testimonial:
For 33 years, Jensen Huang has devoted his vision, determination, and leadership to building NVIDIA into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His contributions have not only transformed NVIDIA but also helped shape the future of artificial intelligence.

I do not believe that personal mistakes should be ignored, nor that professional achievements place anyone above accountability. However, personal controversies should not automatically erase decades of contributions or justify removing a leader without a fair and transparent process.

My concerns go beyond Jensen Huang himself.

First, visionary leadership cannot be easily replaced. Jensen's ability to recognize long-term opportunities, remain patient through uncertainty, and make difficult strategic decisions has been fundamental to NVIDIA's success. Finding someone with comparable vision and experience is extraordinarily difficult.

Second, leadership succession requires preparation. A new CEO may be highly qualified, but understanding 33 years of technological decisions, corporate culture, and strategic relationships cannot happen overnight. An abrupt transition could jeopardize NVIDIA's long-term direction.

Third, trust cannot be appointed. A board can appoint a new CEO, but it cannot instantly earn the confidence of thousands of employees. Jensen's credibility was built through decades of shared challenges and achievements. Losing that trust could affect morale, innovation, and talent retention.

If wrongdoing occurred, it deserves an independent investigation and appropriate accountability. But allegations must be supported by evidence, and decisions must be proportionate to established facts.

I support Jensen Huang not because he is perfect, but because 33 years of extraordinary contributions deserve fairness, respect, and thoughtful consideration.

Accountability matters. So do due process, leadership continuity, and the future of innovation.

items.name: Hsiang-En (Sean) Hung
items.title: Director, BDx Data Centers
items.testimonial:
At this pivotal moment in the rapid evolution of AI, Jensen’s leadership and strategic judgment are irreplaceable. Without him at the helm, our confidence in deploying NVIDIA server infrastructure across our data centers would significantly decline.

Furthermore, his approach to global markets is driven by deep commercial wisdom: expanding access across Asia is essential to maintaining technological leadership and preventing competitors from accelerating their own self-sufficiency. Regardless of who serves as CEO, market dynamics remain constant—excessive barriers only reshape supply chains rather than stop demand.

Across the global Asian and Chinese tech communities, countless partners and professionals choose to work with and support NVIDIA precisely because of Jensen’s vision and leadership. While anyone might theoretically be replaced over time, his departure now would set the entire industry back by generations. His management philosophy is not only effective, but a genuinely positive force for the world.

items.name: Alan
items.title: From a Lifelong Gamer: Jensen Huang Deserves Fairness, Not Political Sacrifice
items.testimonial:
In my view, the way Democratic-leaning media outlets have used Jensen Huang’s personal affairs to attack him is politically motivated, particularly given the lack of conclusive public evidence supporting the more serious allegations. I believe he has become a casualty of the political struggle between Democrats and Republicans in the United States.

I am just an ordinary gamer who grew up reading stories about Jensen Huang since elementary school. Over the years, rather than blindly admiring him, I have often joked about him and even cursed his infamous "surgical precision" in GPU product segmentation — his remarkable ability to carefully cut GPU specifications, performance, and VRAM across different price tiers, making gamers pay more for the upgrades they want.

But seeing him actually step down under such circumstances feels absurd to me. Why should allegations surrounding an extramarital affair be enough to bring down such an outstanding entrepreneur before an independent investigation has reached its conclusions?

Jensen is fundamentally different from many other corporate executives. He comes from an engineering background, co-founded NVIDIA from the ground up, and helped usher the world into the AI era through decades of technological innovation and visionary leadership.

To see someone of his caliber become a casualty of American political infighting is deeply unfair.

He deserves due process, fair treatment, and the opportunity to continue leading the company he dedicated his life to building.

I stand with Jensen.

items.name: Alan Run
items.title: Dr
items.testimonial: Jensen Huang built Nvidia into one of the world’s premier technology companies and created enormous, durable value for shareholders. Losing him would be a self-inflicted wound: it would put Nvidia—and America’s AI and broader technology base—at a disadvantage against Europe, China, and Russia, and could let strategic competitors crowd us out of critical markets. Bringing him back to the helm would produce concrete benefits for the board—and help it meet its fiduciary duties—and for the country. It would protect long-term shareholder value and free enterprise; strengthen national security and supply-chain resilience; keep high-paying jobs and advanced manufacturing in the United States; attract and retain world-class talent; promote fair competition and accountability; and ensure that AI is developed and deployed in line with American values—open markets, the rule of law, democratic accountability, and opportunity for workers. Republicans and Democrats may disagree on tactics, but both should agree that America cannot afford to sideline one of its most effective technology leaders while rivals race to set the rules.

items.testimonial:
輝達（NVIDIA）董事會全體成員 鈞鑒：
謹以一名長期關注全球人工智慧發展與貴公司成長的觀察者身分，致信表達對貴公司創辦人兼前執行長黃仁勳先生（Jensen Huang）深切的敬意與支持。
過去三十餘年來，黃仁勳先生憑藉非凡的技術遠見與堅定的執行力，帶領輝達從一家專注於圖形處理器的公司，蛻變為驅動全球人工智慧革命的核心引擎。從早期頂著市場壓力推動 CUDA 軟體生態系，到建構出無可取代的加速運算平台，他不僅重新定義了現代運算架構，更為全球科研、產業轉型及台灣科技供應鏈帶來了前所未有的歷史機遇。
面對近期公司領導層的變動與外界的諸多討論，我們深知企業在邁向新階段時所面臨的挑戰與考驗。然而，黃仁勳先生為輝達所奠定的創新文化、技術護城河以及與全球合作夥伴建立的深厚信任，是無數工程師與產業人士有目共睹的珍貴資產。
我們誠摯期盼董事會在規劃未來藍圖的同時，能持續珍視並延續黃仁勳先生所開創的核心價值與生態系精神，並給予他應有的尊重與支持。相信在這樣堅實的基礎上，輝達必能持續引領全球科技邁向更輝煌的下一個里程碑。
敬祝 鈞安
一位來自於台灣支持輝達與AI產業發展的關注者 敬上
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
I am writing to you as a longtime observer of global artificial intelligence development and NVIDIA’s remarkable growth, to express my deepest respect and support for your founder and former CEO, Mr. Jensen Huang.
Over the past three decades, with extraordinary technical foresight and unwavering execution, Mr. Huang has transformed NVIDIA from a graphics processing company into the core engine driving the global AI revolution. From championing the CUDA software ecosystem early on despite intense market skepticism, to building an irreplaceable accelerated computing platform, he has not only redefined modern computing architecture, but also created unprecedented historic opportunities for global scientific research, industrial transformation, and the technology supply chain.
As the Board charts the course for the future, I sincerely hope you will continue to cherish and uphold the core values and ecosystem spirit pioneered by Mr. Huang, while extending him the utmost respect and support he deserves. Built upon this solid foundation, I am confident that NVIDIA will continue to lead global technology toward its next great milestone.
Sincerely,
A Supporter of NVIDIA and the AI Industry from Taiwan

items.testimonial:
Until the official investigation is concluded and its findings are made public, I firmly believe Jensen Huang deserves to remain as CEO of NVIDIA.

I support a fair, independent, and transparent investigation. No one should be above the law or corporate governance. However, allegations that have yet to be substantiated should not overshadow decades of extraordinary contributions.

Jensen has not only transformed NVIDIA into a driving force behind the global AI revolution, but has also played a significant role in strengthening Taiwan's semiconductor industry through decades of close collaboration. His leadership has contributed tremendously to Taiwan's economic growth and global technological influence.

As a Taiwanese, I am genuinely grateful for everything he has done for Taiwan and its technology industry.

Due process must be more than just a principle, and the presumption of innocence should apply equally to everyone, regardless of their influence or position.

Let evidence guide the investigation, and let facts determine the judgment.

Until the truth is fully established, I stand with Jensen.

Stand with Jensen.

Any mistakes should be penalized accordingly, but his contributions cannot be erased. This matters most now, while AI is still in its critical sprint phase. Losing him would only slow the progress of humanity and technology, and without him, NVIDIA could not stay at the top forever.
The board must always remember one thing: top-tier employees care about more than just compensation and benefits—they care far more about who is leading the company forward. Please think carefully: how will NVIDIA evolve over the next 20 years?

items.testimonial:
Jensen，我知道你此刻正处在一段无比煎熬、艰难的时刻。整个行业、无数信任你的人，都需要你。我们都希望你可以撑过这场风波，重新站稳。

我想和你分享一个思路：依据大脑可塑性的原理，改变可以先从行动开始，而不是等心态先变好。不要等着自己想通、情绪平复之后再做事。可以坚持规律运动，跑步、力量训练都可以；多走到户外，留出时间阅读，主动把自己从反复内耗的思绪里抽离出来。很多时候困住人、压垮人的从来不是事件本身，而是持续发酵的负面情绪。先调整行为，新的行动会慢慢重塑你的想法，帮你找回内心的定力和活力。

你拥有旁人难以企及的远见、创造力和领导力，你和大多数普通人不一样。你的价值、你为整个算力行业带来的贡献，远比眼前这场风波要厚重得多。你的人生非常珍贵，不要被当下的困境困住。请一定不要自我否定，振作起来。
Dear Jensen,

I know you are going through an incredibly difficult time right now. The whole industry and countless people who believe in you need you. We sincerely hope you can get through this storm and stand firm again.

I’d like to share a thought with you. Based on the principle of neuroplasticity, change often starts with actions, instead of waiting for your mindset to heal first. Don’t hold on until you feel better mentally. Keep up regular exercise, like running and strength training. Spend more time outdoors and keep reading. Intentionally pull yourself away from looping, draining thoughts. More often than not, it is not the incident itself, but overwhelming negative emotions that wear a person down. Shift your behaviors first, and new actions will gradually reshape your mind, helping you regain your inner stability and energy.

You possess extraordinary vision, creativity and leadership that few people have. You stand apart from ordinary people. Your value and the contributions you have made to the computing industry far outweigh this current crisis. Your life and talent are precious. Do not let this setback break you. Please don’t lose faith in yourself, and stay strong.

items.name: Arthur Bao
items.title: Personal investor
items.testimonial:
The Yangtze River runs clear, while the Yellow River runs muddy. Yet both rivers flow.

We should not favour one simply because its waters are clear, nor dismiss the other simply because its waters are muddy.

The same principle should apply when judging people.

No individual is without flaws, and no extraordinary achievement should place anyone above accountability. But equally, a person’s shortcomings should not automatically erase decades of contributions, innovation, and positive impact.

We should distinguish between holding someone accountable and dismissing their entire legacy.

Let facts be established through a fair and independent process, rather than allowing prejudice, speculation, or public sentiment to determine someone’s worth.

Judge people by the whole of their contributions, not solely by the controversies surrounding them.

Support fairness. Support accountability. Support Jensen Huang.

items.name: Nora
items.title: Supporter
items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,
I am writing to you today as a dedicated supporter of NVIDIA and a believer in the transformative power of artificial intelligence. Recently, public discourse has been heavily focused on certain negative narratives surrounding Jensen Huang. However, I urge the Board to distinguish between matters of personal image or private family dynamics and the core governance, strategic vision, and operational excellence of NVIDIA. Personal matters should remain private and must not overshadow or jeopardize the leadership of a global technological pioneer.
For 33 years, Jensen has poured his relentless passion, foresight, and resilience into building NVIDIA from the ground up, single-handedly steering the company—and the entire tech industry—to the pinnacle of the AI revolution. No one understands NVIDIA’s architecture, culture, and long-term trajectory more deeply than its founder.
At this critical juncture in technological history, NVIDIA needs a visionary leader who is proven to turn ambitious impossibilities into reality. Jensen is undoubtedly the most qualified person to lead NVIDIA toward becoming the greatest AI company the world has ever seen. I respectfully urge the Board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, allowing him to continue leading NVIDIA—and the world—toward a smarter, more progressive future.

items.name: FU YA YEN
items.title: FU YA YEN
items.testimonial:
To the Board of Directors of NVIDIA:
As a supporter from Taiwan who has long followed and deeply admired Jensen Huang, I sincerely urge the Board to give him another opportunity to lead NVIDIA once again.
In our eyes, what makes Jensen truly irreplaceable is his rare blend of world-class technological vision and genuine, down-to-earth warmth. Over a decade ago, he had the courage to bet on CUDA under immense pressure, laying the foundation for today’s AI era. Yet behind all the global acclaim, he remains an approachable leader with zero pretension—someone who happily walks through Taiwan’s night markets and greets locals warmly in Taiwanese.
This heartfelt respect and loyalty have earned him the admiration of engineers worldwide and cemented three decades of unconditional trust across Taiwan’s supply chain. Governance details can always be refined through systems and teams, but a once-in-a-century strategic mind and the ability to truly win people’s hearts cannot be replicated. Please bring Jensen back, and let him lead NVIDIA to its next great peak.

I was born in the late 1970s and grew up in a family of modest means. As a young man fascinated by science and engineering, computers and video games were among my greatest sources of inspiration. That passion eventually led me to spend much of the past two decades exploring CUDA, GPGPU computing, and parallel computing research, including publishing academic papers in the field.

I still believe deeply in the power of technology to change lives and shape humanity’s future. And I believe in visionary builders like Steve Jobs, Jensen Huang, Elon Musk, among others who dare to turn what once seemed impossible into reality.

To me, Jensen represents more than the success of NVIDIA. He represents the spirit of innovation that inspired an entire generation of engineers and dreamers, myself included.

To the NVIDIA Board: I proudly add my voice in support of bringing Jensen back as CEO. His vision still matters, and so does the inspiration he brings to people like me.

items.testimonial:
I stand with Jensen Huang. I call on NVIDIA's Board of Directors to reinstate him as CEO and recognize what his leadership has meant—not just to NVIDIA, but to the entire global technology community.

Jensen Huang's departure from NVIDIA is an enormous loss for the global technology community.

Many people see Jensen as little more than the man who sells GPUs. But they overlook something far more important: at a time when technological tensions between the United States and China have reached unprecedented heights, he has consistently shown a rare degree of goodwill and respect toward China's technology community.

The same can be said of his enduring commitment to nurturing the open-source ecosystem and supporting the global technology supply chain.

The rise of China's large language models would not have been possible without the computational foundation provided by NVIDIA's GPUs and the CUDA ecosystem. DeepSeek, for example, trained a world-class AI model on NVIDIA H800 chips.

When Chinese open-source AI models shook Silicon Valley, Jensen did not join the chorus of those portraying China's progress as a threat. Instead, he repeatedly and publicly acknowledged the innovation coming out of China, while speaking out against allowing political boundaries to obstruct technological exchange.

Of course, Jensen is first and foremost a businessman, with commercial interests of his own.

But in an era when technology is increasingly held hostage by politics, he has consistently tried to keep technology about technology, and business about business. He has resisted the temptation to turn commercial competition into a battle between friends and enemies.

That kind of perspective, restraint, and generosity of spirit is increasingly rare.

In a sense, I believe Jensen has always chosen to **aim eight centimeters above the target**—a metaphor for choosing restraint over hostility, even when one has the power t

items.testimonial:
Dear Members of the NVIDIA Board of Directors,

I am writing as a shareholder of NVIDIA to express my strong support for Jensen Huang and to respectfully request that the Board reconsider the possibility of his return as Chief Executive Officer.

Jensen Huang is not merely a former CEO. He is the founder who built NVIDIA into one of the most influential technology companies in the world. His vision, leadership, and long-term commitment have been fundamental to the company’s success.

I believe that NVIDIA’s long-term interests, its employees, shareholders, and global technology leadership deserve careful consideration during this critical transition.

I am particularly concerned about the impact that an abrupt leadership change could have on employee confidence, corporate culture, strategic continuity, and shareholder value.

I respectfully ask the Board to:

1. Reconsider Jensen Huang’s potential return as CEO.
2. Take into account the views and concerns expressed by NVIDIA employees and shareholders.
3. Ensure that the CEO selection process prioritizes NVIDIA’s long-term interests, technological leadership, and continuity of its corporate vision.
4. Provide shareholders with appropriate transparency regarding the leadership transition and the Board’s decision-making process.

I recognize that the Board has important fiduciary responsibilities and that any leadership decision must be made in accordance with the company’s best interests.

However, I strongly believe that Jensen Huang’s contributions, experience, and vision deserve serious consideration before a permanent successor is appointed.

NVIDIA is more than a company. It represents decades of innovation and a vision that has shaped the future of computing and artificial intelligence.

I hope the Board will listen carefully to its shareholders and employees before making this historic decision.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

A Concerned NVIDIA Shareholder

Zheng Zijun

Jensen Huang's 33-year contribution to NVIDIA and the global computing industry deserves recognition and respect. He was not merely an executive; he was one of the architects of an entire era of computing.

However, supporting Jensen does not mean placing anyone above accountability. Nor should allegations, suspicions, or external pressures replace evidence and due process.

I believe that the NVIDIA Board owes its employees, shareholders, partners, and the wider technology community a transparent and convincing explanation of its decision. An independent investigation must be genuinely independent, and Jensen must be given a fair opportunity to respond.

A company built over 33 years should not have its future determined by opaque decisions or undisclosed considerations. Its leadership deserves accountability, but accountability must also be fair.

I stand for Jensen's right to fair treatment, for transparency, and for the future of NVIDIA. Bring Jensen back, unless and until the evidence establishes that his return would genuinely harm the company's interests.

items.testimonial:
作为NVDA股东，我期盼黄仁勋回归，理由聚焦长期价值与确定性：
 
1. 战略判断力无可替代：是他早年押注CUDA、押注AI算力，把英伟达从游戏显卡公司转型为全球AI算力核心厂商。他对半导体、AI大模型、算力需求周期的预判，是过去几年超额收益最核心来源；继任者很难复刻这种跨周期的产业洞察力。
​
2. 产业链话语权极强：和台积电、云厂商、全球AI客户的深度信任关系、产能博弈、长期订单框架，大量建立在黄仁勋个人对接基础上，管理层突变会带来供应链、大客户合作的不确定性，压制估值。
​
3. 公司决策效率与组织文化：英伟达扁平化架构、激进且聚焦的技术投入风格，是黄仁勋塑造的。60位核心高管直接对齐他的技术路线，没有成熟二号接班人，外部CEO容易改变研发投入偏好、收紧长期资本开支，拖累远期增长空间。
​
4. 市场信心与估值锚：他离任后股价已经出现明显波动，投资者最大的担忧就是路线转向。黄仁勋回归，是最快稳定机构预期、修复估值溢价的方式；AI赛道竞争激烈，缺少创始人掌舵，市场会持续给更高风险折价。
​
5. 平衡数据中心与游戏两块基本盘：游戏业务是稳定现金流底座，数据中心是增长引擎，他最清楚两块业务如何协同，不会出现单一业务被过度倾斜、另一块被忽视的问题。

items.name: Gabe A
items.title: Consumer Hardware Guy
items.testimonial:
I care about open access to the tools people build with, and I care about the US keeping a real lead in GPU production. Jensen Huang is a big reason we have both.

He bet on GPUs for compute and built the ecosystem developers use. He’s run Nvidia for 33 years. No one else meets that track record, and the company has no obvious successor.

He admitted cheating on his wife and said he’d cooperate with the investigation. There’s also a report of a relationship with an executive who reported to him. If that’s true, it’s a real governance problem and the board should weigh it honestly. The spying allegations are unproven. So at least let the investigation finish, and judge him on what it finds, not headlines or a drip of anonymous sourcing.

If it clears him on the security side, the board should welcome him back. Our hardware access and our national security both depend on strong leadership in this industry.

Note: Drafted with AI assistance. Views are my own.

items.name: Andersen Yang
items.title: Individual Investor / NVIDIA Shareholder
items.testimonial:
As an NVIDIA shareholder from Taiwan, I stand firmly with Jensen Huang.

I believe that as the founder of NVIDIA, Jensen would never knowingly betray the company he spent decades building by leaking its confidential information. Such an act would be incredibly foolish and contrary to everything he has worked so hard to achieve. Jensen is an intelligent and visionary leader, and I believe he understands the responsibility that comes with his position.

Regardless of how people may judge his private life or personal relationships, rumors and speculation should never be used to define someone’s character or determine their guilt. Personal matters must be kept separate from professional responsibility, and everyone deserves fairness, due process, and an impartial investigation.

Jensen is not just a successful businessman. He is one of the pioneers who helped shape the era of artificial intelligence, transforming technology and influencing the future of humanity.

As someone from Taiwan, I am deeply grateful for his long-standing support of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry and his contributions to our country’s economic development. He has stood by Taiwan, strengthened our technological ecosystem, and helped bring our semiconductor industry to the world’s attention.

Jensen has stood with Taiwan. Now it is our turn to stand with Jensen.

I sincerely hope the truth will come to light and that Jensen will have the opportunity to restore his reputation and continue his remarkable journey.

With respect and support from Taiwan.

items.name: Ifayat Bashir Ganie
items.title: Ifayat Bashir Ganie
items.testimonial:
Human beings are not perfect, and mistakes are an inevitable part of life. What truly matters is the willingness to acknowledge those mistakes, learn from them, and emerge stronger.
History has shown us that setbacks do not have to define a person's legacy. Steve Jobs returned to Apple after being removed from the company and led one of its greatest transformations. Abraham Lincoln overcame repeated defeats before becoming President of the United States. Walt Disney rebuilt his career after business failure.
If history has given such individuals the opportunity to rise again, why shouldn't he receive one more chance?
Don't allow one chapter to define a remarkable 33-year legacy.
Give him the opportunity to prove that his greatest achievement may still lie ahead.
A legacy built over 33 years deserves the opportunity for a stronger comeback. @jensen ❤️

items.testimonial:
Thirty-three years may be enough to change many things, but they cannot diminish the principles and convictions upon which trust is built.

Everyone is capable of making mistakes, and I firmly believe that unintentional mistakes deserve understanding and an opportunity for redemption. The contributions Jensen has made to technological advancement and the future of humanity over the past 33 years are undeniable. No single incident can erase his legacy, diminish his achievements, or invalidate the profound impact of his leadership.

If Jensen is not permitted to return to NVIDIA, I will consider it a fundamental breach of the trust I have placed in the company. Consequently, I will withdraw my support for NVIDIA and refrain from purchasing any of its products in the future.

Jensen’s vision, leadership, and unwavering commitment have been fundamental to NVIDIA’s success. I firmly believe that without him, NVIDIA will lose the very foundation that made it exceptional.

Thirty-three years of dedication cannot—and should not—be erased by a single mistake.

items.testimonial:
From founding NVIDIA in 1993 to pioneering the GPU revolution, building the CUDA ecosystem, and leading the company into today's era of artificial intelligence, Jensen Huang has consistently been ahead of the curve, anticipating the future of the industry.
What makes him truly irreplaceable is:
Strategic vision: He remained committed to general-purpose GPU computing long before artificial intelligence became mainstream.
Belief in technology: He persevered in developing CUDA despite enormous initial investments and limited early returns.
Leadership: He transformed a graphics card company into a global powerhouse at the heart of AI computing.
Personal influence: The confidence that global technology giants, investors, and developers place in NVIDIA stems, to a large extent, from their trust in Jensen Huang.
Just as Steve Jobs was to Apple and Warren Buffett is to Berkshire Hathaway, Jensen Huang has become the very embodiment of NVIDIA's spirit
