items.name: WANG SHOU HSUN
items.title: Senior Developer Technology Engineer
items.testimonial:
Jensen Huang's contributions to NVIDIA are undeniable. Over the past 33 years, he has not only played a crucial role in countless major decisions but has also demonstrated extraordinary vision, leadership, and determination, transforming NVIDIA from a graphics chip company into one of the most influential forces driving artificial intelligence and computing technology worldwide.

I firmly believe that, before an independent investigation is completed and all relevant facts and responsibilities are clearly established, the Board should not rush to permanently remove him from his leadership position. Everyone must be held accountable for their actions, but accountability must be based on credible evidence, due process, and careful judgment rather than unverified allegations.

I believe every member of the Board has witnessed Jensen's extraordinary dedication to NVIDIA and his lasting impact on the global technology industry. He is not merely a CEO; he represents an essential part of NVIDIA's culture, innovative spirit, and long-term vision.

I sincerely urge the Board to reconsider this decision, ensure that Jensen is given a fair opportunity to respond, and seriously consider reinstating him while an independent investigation determines the facts.

This is not simply about the future of one founder. It is about fairness, responsibility, and the values that NVIDIA stands for. I hope the Board will approach this matter with transparency, reason, and integrity, making a decision that truly serves the long-term interests of NVIDIA, its employees, and its shareholders.

Even extraordinary leaders are human. Under immense pressure, they too deserve fairness, compassion, and the grace of a second chance. Jensen's rare combination of vision, kindness, and ability to bridge cultural divides makes him uniquely capable of inspiring trust in AI and building bridges across nations rather than deepening divisions.

A leader like Jensen comes along once in generations. I sincerely hope the board will consider not only what has happened, but all the good that may still lie ahead. Please give him a fair process and a second chance to continue what he started—for NVIDIA, its shareholders, and the future we all share.

items.testimonial:
关于坚决支持 Jensen 继续担任 NVIDIA 首席执行官的意见
尊敬的 Jensen 先生及 NVIDIA 董事会：

我们始终高度重视 NVIDIA 的长期稳定发展，始终坚定支持以 Jensen Huang 为核心的公司领导团队，充分肯定 Jensen 先生在公司发展历程中作出的历史性贡献。

三十三年来，Jensen 先生团结带领 NVIDIA 全体员工，立足技术创新，着眼产业全局，坚持长期主义，推动公司不断发展壮大，在全球科技产业发展进程中发挥了重要作用。

实践充分证明，核心领导团队的稳定对于企业持续健康发展具有重要意义。对于涉及公司重大方向、核心领导职务及长期战略布局的事项，必须坚持实事求是，坚持集体决策，坚持充分听取各方面意见，切实保障利益相关者的知情权与合理表达权。

我们坚决反对任何未经充分论证、缺乏透明程序、忽视长期发展规律的重大决策。

希望 NVIDIA 董事会进一步提高思想认识，统一思想、凝聚共识，深刻认识维护公司战略连续性和领导团队稳定性的重大意义，认真研究各方面意见，全面审视有关决定，及时回应外界关切。

我们相信，在 Jensen 先生的领导下，NVIDIA 完全有能力继续把握技术革命历史机遇，推动人工智能产业持续发展，为全球科技进步作出新的更大贡献。

坚定支持 Jensen！
维护核心领导团队稳定！
坚持长期主义，反对短期主义！

特此留言。

items.testimonial:
My appeal rests on three principles: fairness, recognition, and the opportunity for redemption.
1. Fairness Before Judgment
Jensen Huang's departure occurred before the independent investigation had reached publicly established conclusions. Such a consequential decision raises serious concerns about fairness and due process.
As someone who deeply respects his achievements, I find his abrupt departure disheartening, particularly given his significance as an Asian American leader and an inspiration to many.
Allegations deserve investigation, not premature judgment.

2. His Extraordinary Contributions to AI
Jensen Huang helped make the modern AI revolution possible.
While researchers developed groundbreaking algorithms such as Transformers, NVIDIA's GPUs and CUDA ecosystem provided the computational foundation that transformed academic theories into practical breakthroughs.
Without his vision and leadership, many advances in artificial intelligence might have taken years longer to materialize.
Researchers developed the theories. Jensen Huang helped turn them into reality.

3. Accountability Should Leave Room for Redemption
Jensen has demonstrated decades of visionary leadership, dedication, and commitment to technological progress.
Personal relationships, when genuinely consensual, should be evaluated fairly and proportionately, while taking legitimate ethical concerns and potential conflicts of interest seriously.
Even when mistakes occur, accountability should include the possibility of learning, making amends, and rebuilding trust.
A personal mistake should not automatically erase a lifetime of extraordinary contributions.

items.name: John Ho
items.title: Dr. John Ho
items.testimonial:
As stakeholders and long-term supporters of NVIDIA, we urge the Board to prioritize fiduciary duty and reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer in the best interest of shareholders, employees, and the global technology ecosystem.
For 33 years, Jensen Huang has been the singular architect behind NVIDIA’s rise into the indispensable backbone of modern artificial intelligence. His technical command, strategic foresight, and relentless execution have created historic value for shareholders. In an industry defined by intense competition and complex supply-chain bottlenecks, NVIDIA’s moat relies not merely on an existing roadmap, but on the cohesive leadership of a founder who unites silicon, systems, software, and ecosystem partners.
This abrupt leadership transition has already sparked severe market volatility, wiped out hundreds of billions of dollars in shareholder value, and created avoidable uncertainty for customers and world-class engineering talent. Notably, the Board itself has indicated no evidence that company secrets or national security were compromised. Permanently sidelining an irreplaceable founder during a critical phase of AI infrastructure expansion inflicts disproportionate harm on the very investors the Board is obligated to protect.
Sound corporate governance does not require self-inflicted strategic disruption. Enhanced oversight and accountability can—and should—coexist with proven founder leadership. We call upon the Board to safeguard shareholder value, restore organizational stability, and immediately reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

items.name: HSIUCHIN PENG
items.title: Associate Researcher
items.testimonial:
I am writing to express my strong disappointment with the board's recent decision and to urge you to bring Jensen Huang back to NVIDIA.
NVIDIA cannot exist without Jensen. For 33 years, he has built this company from the ground up, leading it through every challenge and turning it into the global leader it is today. His vision, dedication, and deep understanding of technology are the very reasons NVIDIA succeeded.
To simply discard a founder who has given 33 years of his life to the company is completely unacceptable. This decision shows a serious lack of judgment and vision from the board. Replacing him is a huge mistake that will only hurt NVIDIA's future, innovation, and culture.
As someone who deeply cares about NVIDIA, I strongly urge the board to reconsider this terrible move and reinstate Jensen Huang immediately. NVIDIA needs its true leader back.

I would like to express my deepest admiration and unwavering support for Jensen Huang, a visionary leader who has transformed NVIDIA into one of the most influential driving forces behind technological innovation worldwide.

His extraordinary ability to anticipate the future, courageously invest in groundbreaking ideas, and pursue ambitious goals represents an exceptional example of leadership, determination, and long-term vision.

As a researcher in artificial intelligence, I find his contributions particularly inspiring. The technologies developed under his leadership have unlocked unprecedented opportunities for scientific research, medicine, and the advancement of society as a whole.

What I admire most is his unwavering belief that innovation should constantly push beyond the boundaries of what we consider possible. Jensen Huang has not simply built a successful company; he has helped lay the foundations for an entirely new technological era.

I have complete confidence in his leadership and vision for the future. I sincerely hope he continues to guide NVIDIA with the same passion, courage, and determination, inspiring future generations of researchers, engineers, and innovators around the world.

Jensen Huang has my full and enthusiastic support.

items.testimonial:
Dear NVIDIA Board of Directors and Mr. Jensen Huang,
I am an ordinary university student majoring in computer science. Although I have not yet entered the workforce, the story of Mr. Huang and NVIDIA has accompanied me throughout my entire university journey.
From first learning about CUDA and GPU computing, to watching NVIDIA help propel the AI wave across the world, I have repeatedly felt that one person’s vision, persistence, and execution can transform an entire industry — and shape the choices of countless young people. To many students like me, Mr. Huang is more than a CEO. He is a living example that technology, when driven with clarity and determination, can create extraordinary value.
No one is perfect. Yet over more than three decades, he led NVIDIA from a small company into a central force of the AI era. That contribution is real and immense. I hope the Board, when making its decision, will carefully weigh the company’s long-term future, the trust of employees and shareholders, and the expectations of young people who are still learning and still looking for role models of sustained innovation and leadership.
I respectfully ask that, until the independent investigation reaches a clear conclusion, the possibility of Mr. Huang’s return be given serious consideration. For many students, NVIDIA is not just a company — it is one of the reasons we still believe technology can change the world.
Thank you for taking the time to consider this.
A student who continues to be inspired by this era

items.testimonial:
我堅定支持 Jensen Huang（黃仁勳）繼續帶領 NVIDIA 前進。

人工智慧正在改變全人類的未來，而黃仁勳正是推動這場科技革命最重要的領導者之一。

AI 不只是科技產業的競爭工具，更是人類邁向下一個文明階段的重要力量。

在醫療領域，AI 能協助醫生分析醫學影像、加速新藥研發、提升疾病診斷效率，讓更多患者有機會獲得更好的醫療照護。

在科學研究領域，AI 能加速複雜運算、氣候研究、基因分析及新材料開發，幫助人類突破過去難以跨越的技術限制。

在教育領域，AI 能讓知識更加普及，提供個人化學習，讓不同國家、不同背景的人都有機會獲得更好的教育資源。

在製造、交通、能源及各行各業，AI 也將提升效率、降低成本、改善安全，創造更多新的可能性。

黃仁勳所帶領的 NVIDIA，不只是製造晶片的企業，更是建構全球 AI 基礎建設的重要推動者。從 GPU、CUDA 到 AI 運算平台，NVIDIA 的技術讓全球研究人員、工程師、醫療機構及企業有能力開發下一代人工智慧。

我們不能只看見 AI 帶來的商業價值，更應該看見它對人類社會長遠的正面影響。

一位具有遠見、能夠持續推動科技創新，並帶領全球產業突破極限的領導者，對人類未來具有重要價值。

我希望 NVIDIA 董事會能以長遠的眼光，珍惜這樣的領導人才，維護公司的創新文化與技術願景。

不要讓短期爭議阻礙長期科技進步，不要讓人類失去一位能夠帶領 AI 改變世界的重要領袖。

Jensen Huang，你所推動的不只是 NVIDIA 的成長，更是全人類人工智慧未來的可能性。

Stand with Jensen. Stand with Innovation. Stand with the Future of AI.

items.name: Dezhi Dai
items.title: Computational Scientist (Personal Capacity)
items.testimonial:
I've complained about NVIDIA's GPU prices more times than I can count. But I've never questioned Jensen Huang's extraordinary contributions to computing and technological progress.

As someone working in computational science, I've witnessed firsthand how GPU computing has transformed scientific research. Jensen and NVIDIA didn't just build faster graphics cards. They fundamentally changed how we compute, simulate, and explore the physical world.

Having spent years working with numerical simulations and high-performance computing, I know how difficult it is to turn a technological vision into something that transforms an entire industry. That achievement deserves recognition and respect.

Respect, however, does not mean unconditional support. No one should be above accountability, but everyone deserves fairness, evidence, and due process. Decades of contributions should not be casually dismissed, nor should conclusions be drawn before the facts are established.

I'll probably complain about NVIDIA's GPU prices again when the next generation comes out. Some things never change.

But this time, Jensen, I stand with you.

这些年，我因为 NVIDIA 显卡的价格，已经不知道骂过老黄多少次了。但对于黄仁勋在计算技术发展中作出的杰出贡献，我从来没有怀疑过。

作为一名从事计算科学研究的工程师，我亲眼见证了 GPU 计算如何改变科学研究。老黄和 NVIDIA 所做的，远不只是造出性能更强的显卡。他们从根本上改变了我们进行科学计算、数值模拟，以及探索物理世界的方式。

这些年，我自己也一直在与数值模拟和高性能计算打交道，因此我很清楚，将一个技术愿景变成真正推动整个行业发展的基础设施，需要怎样的远见、坚持和工程技术积累。这份成就值得认可，更值得尊重。

当然，尊重不意味着无条件支持。没有任何人应该凌驾于规则之上，但每个人都应该得到基于事实、公正和正当程序的对待。一个人数十年来的贡献不应该被轻易否定，更不应该在事实尚未查清之前就草率地下结论。

等下一代显卡发布，如果价格还是那么离谱，我估计照样会骂他。毕竟，有些事情是不会变的。

但这一次，老黄，我站你这边。

items.testimonial:
To the Members of the Board of Directors,

Jensen Huang is not merely an executive who has led NVIDIA. He is the architect of a vision that transformed the company into one of the most consequential technology institutions in modern history.

As a shareholder, I believe leadership decisions of this magnitude deserve the utmost transparency, careful consideration, and respect for the interests of everyone who has contributed to NVIDIA's success.

His leadership, vision, and long-term commitment to innovation have played an extraordinary role in shaping NVIDIA's identity and its position in the global technology industry. His contribution cannot be measured merely through quarterly earnings, market capitalization, or financial performance.

I strongly urge the Board to reconsider any decision that would unnecessarily separate NVIDIA from the leadership that has helped define its identity. The company's future should be built upon continuity, institutional stability, and a commitment to the principles that made NVIDIA exceptional.

A company of NVIDIA's stature must never lose sight of the people, vision, and leadership behind its achievements.

With respect for the institution, its employees, its shareholders, and above all, the legacy of Jensen Huang.

Bring Jensen Back!!

As an NVIDIA investor since 2016, I believe Jensen Huang is one of the world’s most effective business leaders. His strategic clarity, technical expertise, and deep industry relationships are complemented by his willingness to listen, learn, remain objective, and consider perspectives from every level of the organization and the broader market. In my view, that combination has been central to NVIDIA’s success.
No leader is without flaws or above accountability. Where Jensen has made mistakes, I believe he has demonstrated remorse and a commitment to learning while prioritizing the long-term interests of the company and its shareholders. Any legitimate concerns deserve a thorough, fair review and not a rushed decision with potentially lasting consequences.
Removing Jensen without careful due diligence and a clear, credible succession plan would risk sacrificing NVIDIA’s greatest strategic advantage at a critical competitive moment. His hands-on leadership and technical judgment are not easily replaced. Without him and without a thoroughly developed transition plan I would have serious doubts about NVIDIA’s ability to sustain its success and would lose confidence in its future.
I urge the board to evaluate any proposed leadership change carefully, explain its rationale, and demonstrate how it would protect the company’s long-term interests. If the board proceeds with his removal without addressing these concerns and presenting a credible plan, I will lose confidence in the board’s leadership and vote accordingly.
